rows.en:
{C:81900700}You're late.

I've checked and adjusted
the Cloud System
on Impulse 7.

You can handle the remaining
control adjustments yourself.

{C:81930100}Sigh... What a pain...

You could've done
that much for me too.

{C:81900700}I still have work to do.

Besides, you can put on
your own trousers by now, can't you?

{C:81930100}Yes, yes, I'll do it.

{C:81900700}Then go ahead and arrange our departure,
and go up to the bridge.

And a message for Akatsuki {C:818F8197}Pervy...
No, give the captain a message.

I'll do a few more checks
before I go up to the bridge.

{C:819782830100}Astante{C:819782830000}'s Cloud System
still has a few things that bother me...{C:819782620000}

{C:81930100}Right, understood.

{C:81900700}Then I'll see you later.
Email me at rondo@atsai.co.jp.

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900100}ⅠⅡⅢⅣⅤⅥⅦⅧⅨⅩ〇

{C:81900200}Thank you for waiting, everyone!

{C:81900300}The time has come
for the ultimate choice.

{C:81900300}Big brother, you'll have to
make the ultimate choice.

{C:81900200}Here's a hint... Be honest with yourself!

{C:81930100}(...This is the worst.
That isn't even a hint!)

{C:81930100}
{C:819582860200010002000000}
Who will you choose?
Lun
Rie

{C:81930100}Don't I get any other choices?

{C:81900300}No.

{C:81930100}
{C:8195828602000000}
Who will you choose?
Wind
Tsuragi

{C:81930100}I don't want a man.

{C:81900200}Then how about these?

{C:81930100}
{C:819582860200010003000000}
Who will you choose?
Relena　　　　　Churull
Tail

{C:81900B01}Huuuh?
There's just one {C:819782830100}old lady{C:819782830000} in there, isn't there?

{C:81900900}I'll kill you.

{C:81930100}No comment.
Next.

{C:81900300}Then here's the best one!

{C:81930100}Ohhh, yes, this is it!
A single lovely cosmos flower
among a whole field of spider lilies.

{C:81930100}
{C:819582860200010004000000}
Who will you choose?
Fyana　　　　　Marvel
Lady Une　　　　Ciela

{C:81902000}Please don't expect to be spoiled.

{C:81930100}Huh?!

{C:81900200}The end.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}Where have you been?
Something incredible has happened!

{C:81900200}What's happened, Sho?

{C:81901A00}Jojo turns out
to be a prince.
That was a shock, wasn't it, Daba?

{C:81905300}...A prince...

{C:81930100}What's the matter, Daba?

{C:81905300}Oh, no, it's nothing.

Say, Sho.
Do you think it's better
to tell people your true status?

{C:81901A00}I don't see why not.
We're not companions because of our status.
Right?

{C:81930100}Of course.

{C:81901B00}That's right!

Otherwise,
a Mi Ferario like me
wouldn't count as one of you!

{C:81901801}Excuse me.

{C:81900200}Oh! I'm sorry.

{C:81901801}Prince Joldy,
I am Jilmzen Ranvel,
pilot of Zuwel.

{C:81900B01}Ranvel has been
fighting for us at White Valley
the whole time you've been away, Jojo.

{C:81900A01}I see.
Thank you, Ranvel!

{C:81901801}Even though I didn't know you were a prince,
please forgive my discourtesy.

At the risk of further discourtesy,
I have a request.
May I fight alongside you?

{C:81900A01}Yes, of course.
If anything, I should be
the one asking you!

{C:81930000}{C:819782830400}Jilmzen Ranvel{C:819782830000} has joined the group.

{C:819782830400}Zuwel{C:819782830000} was acquired.

{C:81901801}Thank you.
But are you sure
you should trust me so readily?

{C:81900A01}It's all right.
Our leader
is the same way.

{C:81935400}Our leader?
Hey, Daba, who could that be?

{C:81905300}Isn't it obvious?
Right?

{C:81930100}Did we even
have a leader?

{C:81901A00}Ha ha ha ha ha!
That's just like our leader.

{C:81930100}Huh?

{C:81900200}You're the one everyone's talking about.

{C:81930100}Whaaat, me?!

{C:81905300}It's because he's like this
that everyone follows him.

{C:81901A00}That's right.
But don't get all self-conscious.
Everyone likes you as you are now.

{C:81930100}Right...

{C:81900200}Cheer uuup!

{C:81930100}But...
It's all so sudden.

{C:81900200}It'll be all right.
Have some confidence.

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296881D00000000}Dad!!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296891D00000000}You're late! What were you doing?

{C:81900100}{C:819582968A1D00000000}Sorry. I was thinking about a few things, and I lost track of time.

{C:81900600}{C:819582968B1D00000000}What am I going to do with you?

{C:819582968C1D00000000}Now, once again. {C:819782830400}{C:819782960000} Akatsuki{C:819782830000}!

{C:81900100}{C:819582968D1D00000000}What is it, Dad?

{C:81900600}{C:819582968E1D00000000}Never mind that. Get serious and answer properly!

{C:81900100}{C:819582968F1D00000000}Y-Yes, sir! (What's gotten into Dad?)

{C:81900600}{C:81958296901D00000000}You understand the mission, don't you?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296921D00000000}Yes, sir.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296991D00000000}Hey, are you sure this is okay? Boarding without permission?

{C:81900100}{C:819582969A1D00000000}I'm telling you, it's fine.

{C:819582969B1D00000000}I'll be aboard Norstan too. Nobody's going to notice one extra person.

{C:81900200}{C:819582969C1D00000000}But...

{C:81900100}{C:819582969E1D00000000}You said you wanted a closer look at Norstan, didn't you, Lun?

{C:81900200}{C:819582969F1D00000000}Well... yes, I did, but...

{C:81900100}{C:81958296A11D00000000}I'll be with you. There's nothing to worry about!


{C:81900200}{C:81958296A21D00000000}Yeah, you're right! You'll be with me, after all.

{C:81958296A41D00000000}Come on, then. Let's hurry!




{x00}

{C:81900100}{C:81958296B61D00000000}Hm? Oh, yeah. I'm listening.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B71D00000000}I'll say it once more. Your mission is to recapture Norstan, or destroy it.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296B81D00000000}Yeah, I know.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B91D00000000}As long as you understand.

{C:81958296BA1D00000000}There's still time before departure. Why not take a look around town? You won't be back for a while.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296BB1D00000000}(He's right... Maybe I'll take a look around.)

{C:81958296BC1D00000000}All right, I'll go out for a bit. See you later, Dad.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C51D00000000}(What's Rie up to?)

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C61D00000000}Let's see... I haven't forgotten anything, and I've checked everything... Right! Now I just need to lock up.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C71D00000000}(Oh, she's locking up. Unlike me, Rie always does things properly.

{C:81958296C81D00000000}Still, I'm proud of my little sister. She earned her doctorate at sixteen!)

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CA1D00000000}Big brother?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296CB1D00000000}Whoa, you startled me! ...What is it, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CC1D00000000}What do you mean, what is it? Why are you standing around in a daze?

{C:81958296CD1D00000000}Aren't you about to leave? Should you really be taking it easy?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296CE1D00000000}Sure I should. Dad ordered me to go and relax before we leave.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CF1D00000000}Oh... I guess you won't be home for a while.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D01D00000000}Exactly! So, Rie, what do you want me to bring back for you?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296D11D00000000}Honestly, you're not taking this seriously at all!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D21D00000000}Well, I'll bring something back. Norstan, for instance.

{C:81958296D31D00000000}Look after Dad while I'm away, okay?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296D41D00000000}Oh, big brother!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D51D00000000}Hm? What is it?


{C:81900300}{C:81958296D61D00000000}Well, Lu... No, never mind.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D71D00000000}You're acting weird.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296D81D00000000}I'll see you at the {C:819782830300}airport{C:819782830000} later, okay?


{C:81900100}{C:81958296D91D00000000}The airport...? You're coming to see me off? Aw, you're the best little sister!

{C:81958296DA1D00000000}...Well, I'd better get going too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296DB1D00000000}There's no point standing around wishing I didn't have to leave. ...Let's go.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296DC1D00000000}Come to think of it, Lun and I used to come here a lot.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296DE1D00000000}Look, look! Isn't the view beautiful at night?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF1D00000000}Yeah, it is.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296E01D00000000}What's wrong? Aren't you having fun with me? Oh, I get it!

{C:81958296E31D00000000}You're thinking something naughty, aren't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E41D00000000}I-I wasn't thinking anything like that!!

{C:81930200}{C:81958296E61D00000000}Ah, you're blushing! You're blushing!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296E91D00000000}I've got nothing else to do here.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296EA1D00000000}You're back at just the right time.

{C:81958296EB1D00000000}Astante's captain has arrived too. As soon as you get to the bridge, Astante will launch.

{C:81958296EC1D00000000}Your first destination is {C:819782830300}Deon Town{C:819782830000}. You'll take on the rest of your supplies there, then head out into the Cloud Sea.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296ED1D00000000}Got it...

{C:81958296EE1D00000000}Well, Dad, I'm off!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296EF1D00000000}Yes. Off you go!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296F01D00000000}Pursuing Norstan is... a heavy burden. As your father, I don't want to send you. I could have stopped you.

{C:81958296F11D00000000}But when someone admits their mistake and wants to put it right, who can stop them?

{C:81958296F21D00000000}Go! And come back safely, together with Lun. I'll be waiting...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296F91D00000000}Never mind whether it's fun...

{C:81958296FA1D00000000}Where's the captain? Don't tell me they haven't arrived yet.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FB1D00000000}Mm-hm-hmm!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296FD1D00000000}What's with that weird laugh, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FE1D00000000}Allow me to introduce the captain! Captain Rie Akatsuki, at your service! Nice to work with you, big brother!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296FF1D00000000}Nice to... What?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296001E00000000}Yep, it's true!

{C:81958296011E00000000}Now that you're here, big brother, we can launch.

{C:81958296021E00000000}First destination, Deon Town!! Astante, launch!!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296031E00000000}Are you serious?!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296041E00000000}Our destination is Deon Town. That's east of here.


{C:81930000}{C:819782830300}Moving Your Battleship

Use the left stick to control your battleship.

Left and right change your heading. Up moves you forward in the direction you're facing.

A circular radar is displayed at the bottom left of the screen.

This radar shows towns whose ports you've entered before and enemy ships you've discovered.

If your next destination is known, a blue guidance marker will appear.

Travel with the blue marker aligned at the top of the radar to reach your destination easily.

First, follow the blue marker to Deon Town.{C:819782830000}




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296061E00000000}We need to get to Deon Town first.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296071E00000000}Wait, big brother! I'm coming with you.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296081E00000000}Have you got something to do?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296091E00000000}Checking the deliveries. {C:819782830400}Tail{C:819782830000} should be waiting for us.

{C:81900100}{C:819582960A1E00000000}(Tail... She was Dad's partner during the war, wasn't she?

{C:819582960B1E00000000}People call Dad and Tail heroes, but it's hard to picture them that way.)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582960C1E00000000}Hello, Tail!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296010000000000}Hello, Rie. You're almost right on time.

{C:81958296020000000000}Here's the list of supplies being brought aboard. Check it for me, will you?

{C:81900300}{C:819582960D1E00000000}Yes!

{C:81900100}{C:819582960E1E00000000}You're handling the supply deliveries too, Tail?

{C:81900900}{C:81958296030000000000}Oh, hello. Thank you for escorting Rie.

{C:81900100}{C:819582960F1E00000000}T-Tail! What are you saying?!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296040000000000}Hee hee... I'm only joking.

{C:81958296050000000000}Anyway, I hear you volunteered to pursue Norstan.

{C:81958296060000000000}You usually hate anything troublesome. What's brought this on?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296101E00000000}Well...

{C:81900900}{C:81958296070000000000}That look tells me there's a reason. All right, I won't pry. But...

{C:81958296080000000000}Following Norstan is certain to mean combat.

{C:81958296090000000000}You two aren't used to fighting. You'll have to be very careful.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296111E00000000}I know, Tail.

{C:81900900}{C:819582960A0000000000}Well, Rie and I need to discuss the deliveries. Excuse us.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A00}{C:81958296121E00000000}Hey, it's been a while. How have you been?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296131E00000000}{C:819782830400}Wind{C:819782830000}! It's good to see you! Where have you been all this time? Dad was worried about you.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296141E00000000}Kyo, worried about me? Get out of here. I've always been a wanderer.

{C:81958296151E00000000}Anyway, enough greetings. I hear you're chasing after Norstan. Be careful out there.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296161E00000000}It'll be my first time really leaving the continent.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296171E00000000}You're the son of Kyo, the ace pilot. That's not what worries me.

{C:81958296181E00000000}I'm worried there might be other enemies besides whoever stole Norstan.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296191E00000000}Other enemies? Is there some reason you think that?

{C:81900A00}{C:819582961A1E00000000}Right now... all I can call it is a hunch. Just be careful.

{C:819582961B1E00000000}See you around.


{C:81900100}{C:819582961C1E00000000}Wind... He's easy to talk to, isn't he?

{C:819582961D1E00000000}His name's in the history books, but he doesn't act important at all.

{C:819582961E1E00000000}...Well, I'd better get going too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582961F1E00000000}Oh, big brother! Sorry to keep you waiting. All the cargo's aboard!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296201E00000000}Now we're finally off to the Cloud Sea!

{C:81900900}{C:819582960B0000000000}Yes, yes. Don't rush. There's somewhere else you need to go first.

{C:819582960C0000000000}This time, head for the {C:819782830300}Astante Fortress Ruins{C:819782830000}. A new companion is waiting for you there.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296211E00000000}The Astante Fortress Ruins...? Why would they be in such an old place?

{C:81900900}{C:819582960D0000000000}Professor {C:819782830400}Rondo{C:819782830000} is there doing some research. I think they went along with the professor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296221E00000000}So our new companion knows Professor Rondo? What are they like?

{C:81900900}{C:819582960E0000000000}Hee hee... You'll find out when you meet. Off you go, now.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296231E00000000}Yes, we're off! Come on, big brother. Let's go!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296251E00000000}Someone who knows Professor Rondo, huh? What do you think they'll be like, big brother?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296261E00000000}You mean our new companion?

{C:81958296271E00000000}The professor's a hero from the history books, just like Dad and the others.

{C:81958296281E00000000}Thinking about that, I doubt they'll be young...

{C:81958296291E00000000}Maybe they'll be some scrawny, unpleasant type.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B1E00000000}What? No way!

{C:81900100}{C:819582962C1E00000000}Well, we'll find out when we meet.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582962D1E00000000}Professor Rondo!

{C:81900700}{C:819582962E1E00000000}Oh, Rie. It's been a while. Have you been well?

{C:81900300}{C:819582962F1E00000000}Yes, Professor.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296301E00000000}Hello, Professor!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296311E00000000}What, you're here too? What brings the two of you here? A tour of Astante?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296321E00000000}'What'?! That's harsh, Professor! We came all this way because we heard someone would be joining us.


{C:81930400}{C:81958296331E00000000}He developed the GT and distinguished himself in the Third Claudian War.

{C:81958296341E00000000}And on top of that, Uncle developed the Cloud System! Aren't you being too familiar with such a distinguished man?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296351E00000000}(Who's telling me all about the professor?)




{C:81900400}{C:81958296361E00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Nelfea{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Nelfea Northrock{C:819782830000}. I'm your guardian, since you two are so unreliable.


{C:81900100}{C:81958296371E00000000}What did you say?!


{C:81900700}{C:81958296381E00000000}That's enough, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296391E00000000}But Uncle, the way he spoke to you...

{C:81900700}{C:819582963A1E00000000}I've told you time and again not to call me Uncle.

{C:819582963B1E00000000}Sorry about that. This is Nelfea. She'll be joining you.

{C:819582963C1E00000000}She's an exceptional pilot, but as you can see, she's still a child. I'm counting on you to look after her.

{C:81900100}{C:819582963D1E00000000}Uh...

{C:81900400}{C:819582963E1E00000000}Oh, Uncle! You always treat me like a child.


{C:819582860100010056000000}
{C:81930700}{C:819582963F1E00000000}Ha ha ha... I'll think about that when you stop calling me Uncle.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296401E00000000}You're so mean, Uncle...




{C:819582860100010000000000}



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296411E00000000}We're finally off. My heart's pounding!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296421E00000000}You're such a child.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296431E00000000}Ghh! Nelfea, you...!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296441E00000000}It's Miss Nelfea to you! Only Uncle gets to call me just Nelfea.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296451E00000000}Oh, enough already! Astante, launching!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296461E00000000}(Sigh... Is this voyage really going to be all right with us like this?)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296491E00000000}Big brother, we've got a message from Dad.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964A1E00000000}From Dad? Put him through.

{C:81930300}{C:819582964C1E00000000}Right.

{C:81930600}{C:819582964D1E00000000}You're finally setting off. There's no telling what lies ahead. Be careful out there.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964E1E00000000}You don't have to keep telling me. I know we're not going on a pleasure trip.

{C:81930600}{C:819582964F1E00000000}Hmm... Fortunately, we've confirmed that other continents are scattered across the Cloud Sea.

{C:81958296501E00000000}If you can, ask the people on those continents for help. You may find someone willing to lend you a hand.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296511E00000000}Got it, Dad. Well, we're off!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296531E00000000}Yes. Off you go!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967A3200000000}Well? Have you found anything out?

{C:81930400}{C:819582967B3200000000}Yes. So far, we know there are six continents besides {C:819782830300}Claudia{C:819782830000}.

{C:819582967C3200000000}The Cloud Stream is too dense around one of them for us to go there.

{C:81930300}{C:819582967D3200000000}You don't know where Norstan went?

{C:81930400}{C:819582967E3200000000}We haven't got a single clue. Don't ask the impossible.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F3200000000}So all we can do is visit the continents one by one, huh?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296803200000000}That's right. Let's do our best.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939B00}{C:81958296541E00000000}It looks like the Astante has arrived.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296561E00000000}So it seems.
Does this mean
history can be changed now?

{C:81939B00}{C:81958296571E00000000}I am merely a witness to history.
But... things are about to get interesting.
Heh heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha ha!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B200}{C:81958296581E00000000}This is the Titans.
To the unidentified ship: this is a warning.
Do not approach any closer.

{C:81958296591E00000000}If you fail to obey this warning,
we will remove you by force.

{C:819582965A1E00000000}I repeat.
This is the Titans...




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:819582965F1E00000000}Welcome to Von Braun.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296601E00000000}Thank you
for allowing us to dock.
I'm Captain Rie Akatsuki.


{C:81908400}{C:81958296611E00000000}You're the captain?!
...No, forgive me.

{C:81958296621E00000000}I am Captain Quattro Bajeena
of AEUG.
We welcome your ship into port.

{C:81958296631E00000000}Please, make yourselves comfortable for now.
I have some business to attend to,
so let's talk later.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296641E00000000}Yes.
Thank you very much.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296651E00000000}That Quattro fellow...
I feel like I've seen him before.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296661E00000000}So, what are we going to do?
Since we're here, why don't we find out
what's going on in this city?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296671E00000000}Good idea.
Let's do that.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296681E00000000}Hmph! I'm coming too, you know.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296691E00000000}Hey, you lot!
You're the crew of that battleship that just docked, right?

{C:819582966A1E00000000}Since you've docked at Von Braun,
you're going to help AEUG, of course, right?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966B1E00000000}No, we're...

{C:81908200}{C:819582966C1E00000000}You're not?! I see!
You're going to help the Titans,
just like Posaydal's army!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966D1E00000000}Help them? We don't even know
what the Titans are.

{C:81908200}{C:819582966E1E00000000}Shut up!
Don't lie to me!

{C:81900300}{C:819582966F1E00000000}Big brother...
This guy seems dangerous.

{C:81958296701E00000000}Aaah!
He's coming at us!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296711E00000000}Move!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296741E00000000}Nelfea, you're amazing!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296751E00000000}D-don't get the wrong idea.
I was only protecting the captain
and a certain unreliable person.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296761E00000000}Well, whatever the reason, you saved us.
Thanks, Nelfea.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296771E00000000}I-it's fine.
He might come back,
so let's go somewhere else.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296781E00000000}Yeah!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296801E00000000}It seems {C:819782830400}Kamille{C:819782830000} behaved rudely earlier.
I'm sorry.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296811E00000000}Kamille?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296821E00000000}He must mean that guy from before.
You know, the one who tried to punch us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296831E00000000}Oh.
Is he someone you know,
Captain Quattro?


{C:81908400}{C:81958296841E00000000}He's a talented pilot,
but rather headstrong.
Even we have trouble handling him.

{C:81958296851E00000000}I've set him straight.
In light of that, would you be willing
to hear me out?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296861E00000000}With all due respect,
someone who resorts to violence
against people he's just met...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296871E00000000}Stop it, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296881E00000000}But...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296891E00000000}Captain Quattro's apologizing, too.
Besides, we don't know the situation
on this continent, do we?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968A1E00000000}Right, right.
Big brother's right.

{C:81900400}{C:819582968B1E00000000}Oh, you're just obsessed with your brother.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C1E00000000}What was that?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D1E00000000}Both of you, stop it.
You're embarrassing yourselves.

{C:819582968E1E00000000}Sorry, Captain Quattro.
Could you tell us what you wanted to say?

{C:81908400}{C:819582968F1E00000000}Thank you.
Let's go somewhere else so we can talk at leisure.
Come along.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296901E00000000}So the Titans have joined forces with Posaydal's army,
and we in AEUG
are being driven into a corner.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296911E00000000}I see.
So you need all the fighting strength
you can get?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296931E00000000}That is part of it...
but I'm concerned about a presence I sense
behind this conflict.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296941E00000000}What do you think it is,
Captain Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296951E00000000}...An enemy other than Posaydal
or the Titans.

{C:81958296961E00000000}I see it as a third force,
so to speak.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296971E00000000}A third force...?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296981E00000000}I suspect that the enemy we must fight
is that presence
behind the scenes.

{C:81958296991E00000000}It's only a hunch, though.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A1E00000000}Captain Quattro, have you ever seen
a ship with the same shape
as ours?

{C:81908400}{C:819582969B1E00000000}A ship of the same type...
I've heard reports that one landed in another city.

{C:819582969C1E00000000}I understand they're hostile to you.
Am I wrong?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969D1E00000000}You're quite right.
We crossed the Cloud Sea
in pursuit of that ship.

{C:81908400}{C:819582969E1E00000000}Then I would like your help.
No, rather, I'd like you to let us help you.
What do you say?


{C:81900400}{C:819582969F1E00000000}What do we do, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A21E00000000}Well... Wait,
what?! I have to decide?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A31E00000000}Of course. You're the captain.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A41E00000000}...All right, Captain Quattro.
We'll help you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296A51E00000000}Thank you, Rie.
To get straight to the point, there's something
I'd like to provide you with. Please accept it.

{C:81958296A61E00000000}I'll go on ahead and wait for you at the {C:819782830300}airport{C:819782830000}.
I'll see you
there later.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296A71E00000000}What do you think he wants to give us?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A81E00000000}Maybe it's their equivalent
of a GT or FT.
What do you think, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A91E00000000}I think it might be a ship
to replace the Astante.
This continent's ships are more convenient.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA1E00000000}Whatever it is,
we'll find out at the airport.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296A03600000000}You're here.
First, let me introduce someone.
This is Kamille Bidan.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296A13600000000}I'm sorry about earlier.
I'm Kamille Bidan.
I'll be traveling with you from now on.

{C:81958296A23600000000}You can just
call me Kamille.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A33600000000}Whaaaaat?!

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A43600000000}Now, don't say that.
I'll be accompanying you as well.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A53600000000}Well, that's fine, then...

{C:81908300}{C:81958296A63600000000}Captain Quattro,
please introduce me too.
How could you forget me?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A73600000000}Ah, yes. I'm sorry. This is 
{C:819782830400}Fa Yuiry{C:819782830000}.

{C:81908300}{C:81958296A83600000000}I'm Fa Yuiry.
Nice to meet you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A93600000000}Oh, nice to meet you too.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296AA3600000000}Now, as for what I wanted to give you, I've arranged for the 
{C:819782830400}Audhumla{C:819782830000} aircraft.
It's ready for you.

{C:81958296AB3600000000}The Audhumla
can dock anywhere.
Feel free to use it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC3600000000}Thank you,
Captain Quattro!

{C:81908400}{C:81958296AD3600000000}I'm counting on you, too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296AE3600000000}First, you should go to {C:819782830300}Green Noa{C:819782830000}.
The Titans' influence there
is still weak.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938700}{C:81958296261F00000000}This is a Titans garrison.
Civilians are not allowed inside.
Leave immediately.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938F00}{C:81958296B81E00000000}You! What do you think you're doing
to a Titans uniform?!
You've got the baby's drool all over it!

{C:8193DA02}{C:81958296B91E00000000}Oh, I'm so sorry!
She's only a baby.
She doesn't understand.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296BA1E00000000}That bastard!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB1E00000000}K-Kamille!
What are you going to do?!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296BC1E00000000}You think being in the Titans
makes you that important?!

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296BE1E00000000}You bastard! Kamille!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296C31E00000000}We're getting out of here too!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C41E00000000}What?!
Why do we have to run too?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C51E00000000}AEUG and the Titans
are enemies!
Do you want to get arrested?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C61E00000000}That was pretty cool, Kamille.
A little too sudden, though.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C71E00000000}Thanks.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C81E00000000}We got away,
but I lost everyone.

{C:81958296C91E00000000}Oh, well.
I've got a car. I'll look around on my own.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A102}{C:819582964C1F00000000}Excuse me.
Have you seen a boy around here
about my age?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964D1F00000000}A boy about your age?
Hmm... I see boys like that
all over the place.

{C:8190A102}{C:819582964E1F00000000}Right...
He doesn't exactly stand out.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964F1F00000000}Sorry
I couldn't help.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296501F00000000}It's fine, it's fine.
Thanks anyway.








{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296CD1E00000000}...{C:819782830400}Amuro{C:819782830000}?

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296CE1E00000000}Yes, I'm Amuro Ray.
And you are...
No, we've never met before, have we?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CF1E00000000}No.
It's strange, when we've only just met.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296D01E00000000}Yes.
It feels as though I've known you for years.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D11E00000000}I feel the same way, Mr. Amuro.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296D21E00000000}Just Amuro is fine.
Somehow that feels more natural.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D31E00000000}All right.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296D41E00000000}{C:819782830400}The elecar{C:819782830000} isn't running, right?
I'll take a look for you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296E11E00000000}Oh, you're back!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E21E00000000}Where have you been wandering off to?!
We had a terrible time
in a city we don't even know!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E31E00000000}Sorry, sorry.
I was running so desperately
that I ended up back at the airport.

{C:81958296E41E00000000}I couldn't help it,
so I went around on my own.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296E51E00000000}No fair!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E61E00000000}No fair!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E71E00000000}I'll be more careful next time.
Please forgive me.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E81E00000000}Very well.
In that case, I shall forgive you.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E91E00000000}Oh, all right.
I forgive you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939500}{C:81958296EA1E00000000}What's this rough, grating sensation?
Is there an enemy with a presence like this...?
It's disgusting!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296EB1E00000000}You're going into Hong Kong, right?
I'll give you a ride in the elecar.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EC1E00000000}Thanks. That'd be a big help.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED1E00000000}What about us?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EE1E00000000}We can come along too, of course, right?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296EF1E00000000}You're going to stick together anyway, aren't you?
I don't mind.
Then let's go to {C:819782830300}Main Street{C:819782830000}.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296F01E00000000}Is somewhere around here all right?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F11E00000000}Thanks, Kamille.
See you later.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F21E00000000}Right, let's go.

{C:81958296F31E00000000}...Huh? A girl's walking over
to Kamille's elecar.


{C:81909500}{C:81958296F41E00000000}Hey, could you give me a ride to the airport?

{C:81938200}{C:81958296F51E00000000}Sure, no problem.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296F61E00000000}That helps. Thanks.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296F71E00000000}Oh, they've gone.
I wonder if they know each other.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F81E00000000}Well, never mind.
Let's get going too.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909500}{C:81958296F91E00000000}Thanks.
Hey, can you tell me your name?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FA1E00000000}I'm Kamille.
Nice to meet you.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FB1E00000000}Kamille, huh?
That's a gentle name.

{C:81908200}......

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FC1E00000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
You don't like your name, do you?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FD1E00000000}How can you tell?

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FE1E00000000}It's written all over your face.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FF1E00000000}We'll see each other again, won't we?

{C:81909500}{C:81958296001F00000000}Again... I'd like that.
Bye.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296271F00000000}...So it seems AEUG
is short on fighting strength, Captain.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296281F00000000}I see...
If only we had Amuro Ray.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296291F00000000}(Did Captain Quattro
just say Amuro?)

{C:819582962A1F00000000}Sorry to interrupt, Captain Quattro.
Did you just mention Amuro?

{C:81908400}{C:819582962B1F00000000}Oh, it's you.
Yes, I did.
Does that mean something to you?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C1F00000000}Yes, if the person I met
wasn't lying to me.
It's just...

{C:81908400}{C:819582962D1F00000000}Just what?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962E1F00000000}He didn't seem
like someone who fights.

{C:81908400}{C:819582962F1F00000000}He didn't seem
like a fighter...?
I see... Perhaps you're right.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296301F00000000}Captain Quattro, why don't you
at least try meeting him?

{C:81958296311F00000000}I'm interested in meeting
the hero of the One Year War myself.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296321F00000000}You're right.
Sorry to ask, but could you go to {C:819782830300}Green Noa{C:819782830000}
for me?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296331F00000000}All right.
You want us to head
to Green Noa, then.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296341F00000000}It would be better not to visit Amuro
with a large group.
Could I ask you to go?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296351F00000000}I don't mind,
but I'm not confident
I can persuade him.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296361F00000000}Would it be better
if we didn't go either?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296371F00000000}Yes.
I think one person would be best.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296381F00000000}You heard him.
That means you can't go either,
Nelfea!

{C:81900400}{C:819582963B1F00000000}(She beat me to it...)

{C:81930100}{C:819582963C1F00000000}Well, I'll be off.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938800}{C:81958296B03600000000}Why, Amuro?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B13600000000}Huh?
Amuro has a visitor.
I'll wait a bit.

{C:81908800}{C:81958296B33600000000}I'm asking you
why you won't fight!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296B43600000000}...I fought enough in the One Year War.

{C:81908800}{C:81958296B63600000000}Don't say that!
Tell me you've got even a single MS
hidden underground!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296B73600000000}{C:819782830400}Katz{C:819782830000}...

{C:81908800}{C:81958296B83600000000}Amuro, to think you'd act like this...!!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296BA3600000000}Katz!
He's gone...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB3600000000}Um... Amuro?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296BD3600000000}Oh, it's you.
What brings you here today?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE3600000000}Actually, I've come to ask you a favor.
I'm from another continent
called Claudia.


{C:81908A00}{C:81958296BF3600000000}Hm?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03600000000}I'm helping AEUG now,
fighting the Titans.


{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C13600000000}You are?!
...So,
what do you want me to do?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C33600000000}I heard you're a hero
of the One Year War seven years ago.
I'd really like your help.

{C:81958296C43600000000}Please.
Would you help us?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C63600000000}You heard what I said earlier, didn't you?
I think I fought enough
in the One Year War.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296471F00000000}I see.
...That's a shame.

{C:81958296C83600000000}Well, I'll come again.
Just to visit next time.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C93600000000}Thank you for understanding.
You're always welcome.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA3600000000}Thank you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296C33600000000}I heard you're a hero
of the One Year War seven years ago.
I'd really like your help.

{C:81958296C43600000000}Please.
Would you help us?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296591F00000000}Sigh... Amuro...
I couldn't bring him along...

{C:81905700}{C:819582965A1F00000000}You're late!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B1F00000000}Whoa!
W-what?!

{C:81905700}{C:819582965C1F00000000}Get moving!
Dawdling on the battlefield is dangerous!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965D1F00000000}Y-yes!
Wait, who are you?

{C:81905700}{C:819582965E1F00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Gaw Ha Leccee.{C:819782830000}
I've just joined the group.
Nice to meet you!

{C:81900300}{C:819582965F1F00000000}Oh, welcome back, big brother.
This is Leccee. She's just joined us.

{C:81958296601F00000000}And this is my older brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296611F00000000}Nice to meet you.
I'm looking forward to working with you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296631F00000000}Captain Quattro spoke to us.
We're transferring back to the Astante,
so get ready too, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296641F00000000}That's sudden again.
Did something happen?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296661F00000000}Apparently, the Titans
have stepped up their activity.

{C:81958296681F00000000}So AEUG seems
to need more fighting strength.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296691F00000000}That's how it is,
so hurry up and get ready!
Understood?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966A1F00000000}Y-yes, I understand.

{C:819582966B1F00000000}(Leccee sure is
an energetic person.)





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908800}{C:81958296D23600000000}Amuro, you're here?!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296D53600000000}Katz...

{C:81908800}{C:81958296D63600000000}I wasn't sure what to do either.
But if you're going, Amuro,
I'm coming with you.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296D93600000000}{C:819782830400}Fraw{C:819782830000} will object.
What mother wants to send her child into battle?

{C:81908800}{C:81958296DB3600000000}I persuaded my mother.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296DD3600000000}In that case, I won't say anything.

{C:81958296DF3600000000}Then please take Katz along too.
Is that all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E03600000000}All right.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938400}{C:81958296731F00000000}...That's the situation.
The greatest threat to us
is Hong Kong City's {C:819782830400}Psyco Gundam{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296741F00000000}Unless we do something about it,
our operations will...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296761F00000000}Captain Quattro, a woman calling herself 
{C:819782830400}Emma Sheen{C:819782830000}
is on the line.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296771F00000000}Lieutenant Emma?
Put her through.

{C:81938700}{C:81958296781F00000000}I have a report.

{C:81958296791F00000000}A machine from another continent has flown over 
{C:819782830300}Kilimanjaro{C:819782830000}.
It's in the air above it.

{C:81938400}{C:819582967A1F00000000}Can you identify the type, Lieutenant Emma?

{C:81938700}{C:819582967B1F00000000}Apparently, it's called a {C:819782830400}Brain{C:819782830000}.
It seems to be connected to a man and a woman
captured by the Titans.

{C:819582967D1F00000000}If possible, please rescue them
from the Titans.

{C:81938400}{C:819582967E1F00000000}Understood.
We'll watch for the right opportunity
to head to Kilimanjaro.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908700}{C:81958296891F00000000}Thank you for your efforts, Captain Quattro.

{C:81908400}{C:819582968A1F00000000}It wasn't my doing, Lieutenant Emma.
It's all thanks to them.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C1F00000000}That's not true.
We couldn't have done anything
with just our own strength.

{C:81908700}{C:819582968D1F00000000}You're being modest.
I like that.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296901F00000000}Someone's calling me... I'll step out for a bit!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296911F00000000}Kamille?!
Oh, he's gone...

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296921F00000000}Is something drawing him in...? That's dangerous.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296931F00000000}It should be all right for now.
Let's investigate inside.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296941F00000000}Oh, big brother.
We can't leave yet.

{C:81958296951F00000000}We're in the middle of moving
Kilimanjaro's supplies,
so wait until we're done.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:819582969A1F00000000}{C:819782830400}Hime{C:819782830000}...No, wait.
Have you seen a girl
about my age?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969C1F00000000}I think she was over toward the {C:819782830300}Titans fortress{C:819782830000},
if I remember right.

{C:8190A002}{C:819582969D1F00000000}I see. Thanks for your help.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969E1F00000000}Lun...
Are you still aboard the Norstan?

{C:819582969F1F00000000}Battleships and fighting
are the last things you're suited to...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296A11F00000000}Being out in nature really is better
than being in the city.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A21F00000000}Sorry, Lun.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296A31F00000000}What is it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A41F00000000}I've been so busy training
that I haven't been able to bring you here.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296A51F00000000}Don't worry. Even though you're busy,
you still brought me, didn't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A71F00000000}Well, I promised...

{C:81930200}{C:81958296AA1F00000000}Ah, this feels wonderful.
Bring me here again, okay?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296AB1F00000000}Of course, Lun...
Of course I will.

{C:81958296AC1F00000000}To keep my promise,
I've got to hurry after the Norstan.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:81958296AD1F00000000}Hi.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296AE1F00000000}Hello!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AF1F00000000}You finally found each other.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296B01F00000000}Yeah.
I was looking for Hime,
but she kept running around...

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296B11F00000000}That's not right.
You were the one wandering around, You.

{C:81958296B21F00000000}Do you have any idea
how much trouble I went to?

{C:81958296B31F00000000}And what were you thinking,
taking my Brain
along with you too?!

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296B41F00000000}What a noisy chatterbox you are.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A102}{C:81958296B71F00000000}Phew!
Wh-what are you doing?!

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296B81F00000000}Hime's too noisy.
Now we can talk.

{C:81958296B91F00000000}I'm You Isami.
Since I've been caught up in this mess,
I'll help you, along with the Brain.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296BA1F00000000}Honestly, you're always doing as you please.
Fine. It's not like we have any other choice.
I'm Hime. Hime Utsumiya.

{C:81958296BB1F00000000}The Titans and
this Posaydal
are the bad guys, so I'll help you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:81958296BC1F00000000}Well, I've got to go
check how the Brain's feeling,
so see you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BD1F00000000}Oh, right.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296BE1F00000000}You're back at just the right time.
Now that Rie's given her consent, 
{C:819782830300}Hong Kong City{C:819782830000} is where I intend to head.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BF1F00000000}Are we going to fight the Psyco Gundam?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C01F00000000}Yes.
Kamille isn't here,
but we intend to do it without him.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C11F00000000}All right.
I'll get ready too.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938200}{C:81958296D21F00000000}Four, can you hear me?

{C:81939500}{C:81958296D31F00000000}If you're going to come out here,
you could at least take me down right away!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296D51F00000000}I'm coming over there now.
Open the hatch!

{C:81939500}{C:81958296D61F00000000}Stop, Kamille!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938200}{C:81958296D71F00000000}There's something I want to tell you.
You asked me before
if I hated my name, remember?

{C:81939500}{C:81958296D81F00000000}Yes...

{C:81938200}{C:81958296D91F00000000}Kamille is a girl's name.
I hated it.

{C:81958296DA1F00000000}So I did all sorts of things
to prove I was a man.

{C:81939500}{C:81958296DB1F00000000}Kamille...

{C:81938200}{C:81958296DC1F00000000}What am I talking about?
Why am I saying all this...?

{C:81939500}{C:81958296DD1F00000000}Kamille, Kamille...
Can I ask you just once more?
Do you still hate the name Kamille?

{C:81938200}{C:81958296DE1F00000000}I like it. It's my own name, after all.

{C:81939500}{C:81958296DF1F00000000}I see...

{C:81938200}{C:81958296E01F00000000}Four... Why do you have a gun?

{C:81939500}{C:81958296E11F00000000}Let's each go back where we belong.
This isn't the place for you.
Get out! That's enough!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938A00}{C:81958296E41F00000000}Did you two hear that?
She's saying she'll open the Cloud Sea,
so get off this continent.

{C:81938200}{C:81958296E51F00000000}Four is?! But...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938A00}{C:81958296E61F00000000}If you throw away someone's kindness,
you'll suffer for the rest of your life!
Go, everyone!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905700}{C:81958296791E00000000}Sigh... I went and walked out
on Daba and the others,
but what am I supposed to do now...?

{C:819582967A1E00000000}Staying here like this
won't get me anywhere.
...What am I doing?

{C:81930100}{C:819582967B1E00000000}(Is she in some kind of trouble?)

{C:81900300}{C:819582967C1E00000000}Big brother!
Don't keep staring at her!
It's rude!

{C:81930100}{C:819582967D1E00000000}I get it, I get it.

{C:81900400}{C:819582967E1E00000000}Are you jealous?

{C:81900300}{C:819582967F1E00000000}No, I'm not!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905700}{C:81958296521F00000000}There's no point
in just sitting around here!
Come on, Leccee, girl! I'm heading out!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DA1E00000000}She's not here either...
I sure hope Natsumi
managed to get away all right.

{C:81958296DB1E00000000}I guess I have no choice.
I'll try asking around.
Hey, you over there!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC1E00000000}Huh?
Do you mean me?

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DD1E00000000}That's right.
Have you seen a girl about elementary school age
with a baby around here?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DE1E00000000}I saw her at the airport.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DF1E00000000}The airport... Thanks!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296E01E00000000}Does he know that girl?
I hope they manage to meet up.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296171F00000000}Natsumi's not here either.
I just hope she's at least managed
to meet up with Shu...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296181F00000000}(Huh? Natsumi? That means
he's looking for the same girl.
Then I ought to tell him.)

{C:81958296191F00000000}Excuse me!

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961A1F00000000}Do you mean me?

{C:81930100}{C:819582961B1F00000000}Yes.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961C1F00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Ryo Sanada{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961D1F00000000}About that girl Natsumi you're looking for,
I don't think she's in this town.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961E1F00000000}What?!
Do you know where she's gone?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582961F1F00000000}I don't actually know the girl you're looking for,
so I can't say for certain...

{C:81958296201F00000000}But I met a girl holding a baby
in Green Noa.
I think she's still there.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296211F00000000}Green Noa, right.
Thank you! That really helps!


{C:81900400}{C:81958296221F00000000}What, do you know him?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296231F00000000}Do you remember the girl the Titans
were hassling in another town?
It looks like he knows her.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296241F00000000}Oh, that's why!
You told him where she was.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296251F00000000}That's right.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A102}{C:81958296D81E00000000}Honestly, You!
You're so selfish!
Give me back my Brain!!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D91E00000000}This continent sure does have
a lot of weird people...
I'd better keep my distance.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B200}{C:81958296011F00000000}What?! It flies on its own
without anyone aboard?!

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296021F00000000}That's it, Brain!
Keep going! Get away
so these guys can't catch you!!

{C:8190B200}{C:81958296031F00000000}You bastard!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:81958296041F00000000}What the hell are you doing?!
How can you just
hit me like that?!

{C:8190B200}{C:81958296051F00000000}If that's the attitude you're going to take,
we'll have no choice
but to respond accordingly.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296061F00000000}Don't think for a second
that I'll just do what you say!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296081F00000000}Big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296091F00000000}I know!

{C:81930400}{C:819582960A1F00000000}I'll go too!

{C:8190B200}{C:819582960B1F00000000}We'll gang up on you and beat you down!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960D1F00000000}Nelfea, you hit them too hard.

{C:81900400}{C:819582960E1F00000000}I did hold back!

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296101F00000000}You guys...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296111F00000000}That one's an enemy.
We're getting out of here too,
so you should run as well.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296121F00000000}Thanks!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296131F00000000}Big brother, you've gone all Kamille!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296141F00000000}I didn't have a choice there!
Besides, Nelfea's the one
who actually hit them!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296151F00000000}You didn't lay a hand on them yourself!
That's not fair!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296161F00000000}Anyway, let's get out of here!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909400}{C:819582965D3600000000}You brats have no business
sneaking in here.
I'll slug you!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3600000000}I'm sorry.
I heard this place had been abandoned,
so I thought it was all right to come in.

{C:81909400}{C:819582965F3600000000}Sure, it's been abandoned.
But that doesn't change the fact
that there are military secrets here.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296603600000000}Then what are you doing here?

{C:81909400}{C:81958296613600000000}What's it to you?
I just came to see
if there was anything interesting.

{C:81958296623600000000}There wasn't a thing.
I went to all that trouble for nothing!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296633600000000}Let's go, Kamille.
If we stay any longer,
we'll just get yelled at.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296643600000000}Yeah.
Let's get going.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909600}{C:81958296653600000000}Do you all know about {C:819782830400}Karaba{C:819782830000}?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296663600000000}I know the name, at least...

{C:81909600}{C:81958296673600000000}They're filthy scum
who'll ruin the world.
You must stay away from them.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296683600000000}Uh... I'll be careful.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967F1F00000000}I wonder where Amuro went.
Oh, there he is! There he is!
Captain Quattro's with him, too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938A00}{C:81958296801F00000000}What did you come back for, Char?

{C:81938400}{C:81958296811F00000000}"I came to laugh at you."
...Would you be satisfied
if I said that?

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296821F00000000}I didn't choose to end up like this.
Surely even you can understand that.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296831F00000000}But you don't want pity
either, do you?

{C:81958296841F00000000}Then I want you to be the Amuro Ray
who lives up to everyone's expectations.
That's the most I can say to you.

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296851F00000000}Ghh...

{C:81938400}{C:81958296861F00000000}A caged bird
is nothing more than a display piece.
Remember that.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296871F00000000}It looks like
I've stumbled into quite a scene.
I'd better leave for now...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296EA1F00000000}Are you going to start a war on this continent too?
Please stop this already.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296EB1F00000000}Start a war? Don't be ridiculous.
Look! There's already fighting
on this continent!

{C:81930200}{C:81958296ED1F00000000}That doesn't mean you can spread Claudia's war
to the other continents!

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296EF1F00000000}...It's for the world, and for that person...

{C:81930200}{C:81958296F01F00000000}That person?


{C:81930C00}{C:81958296F21F00000000}It's none of your concern.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296312000000000}Hey, young fellow!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296322000000000}...Who are you?

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296332000000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Bouleuse Gotho.{C:819782830000}
Young fellow, how'd you like
to become an AT pilot?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296342000000000}What's an AT pilot?

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296352000000000}You don't even know that?
And here I thought I was a good judge of people.
I sure got that wrong!

{C:81958296362000000000}Honestly!
All these folks coming from other continents
have brought no end of strange characters lately.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296372000000000}I'm sorry.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296382000000000}Oh, I don't mean you folks.
Don't worry about it.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296392000000000}Since we're already troubling you,
could I ask you something?
Do you know anyone who's good in a fight?


{C:81900300}{C:819582963A2000000000}Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:819582963B2000000000}We're bound to end up fighting here too,
so we'd be better off with someone strong on our side.

{C:81900300}{C:819582963D2000000000}That's true, but...

{C:8190CC00}{C:819582963E2000000000}Oh, so there's a story behind this.
Fighting, eh...? In that case,
he's your best bet.

{C:819582963F2000000000}Try this town's {C:819782830300}bar{C:819782830000} and ask for {C:819782830400}Chirico{C:819782830000}.
He's not very friendly,
but his skills are first-rate.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296412000000000}Chirico... you said?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296422000000000}What's wrong, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296432000000000}I feel like I've heard that name somewhere...
No, I must be imagining it.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296442000000000}Once you've met Chirico, come out to the 
{C:819782830300}outskirts{C:819782830000}.
That's where my shop is.

{C:81958296452000000000}Maybe fate brought us together here.
I'll help you out too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296462000000000}Thank you.
In any case, we'll try
looking for Chirico.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296472000000000}He's at this town's bar.
You'll spot him right away.
He sticks out like a sore thumb.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:819582965C2000000000}Someone who looks out of place here...
Maybe it's that man.

{C:81900300}{C:819582965D2000000000}Big brother, go ask him.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E2000000000}Excuse me...
Um, are you Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582965F2000000000}I am.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296602000000000}Well, we'd like you
to help us in our fight.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296622000000000}I refuse.
You can't fight with women and children in tow.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296632000000000}Gotho told us about you.
Could you at least come with us
to the outskirts?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296642000000000}Gotho did...?
All right. I'll go with you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296702000000000}...And that's why
we followed the Norstan here.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296722000000000}I see.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296732000000000}I see? Is that all you've got to say?
Can't you give them an answer,
like whether you'll help or not?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296742000000000}{C:819782830400}Fyana{C:819782830000} comes first. I have to get her back...

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296752000000000}What, you're still hung up on {C:819782830400}Phantom Lady{C:819782830000}?
Hey, hey, don't glare at me,
Chirico.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296762000000000}There's someone on the Norstan
that I want to get back too.

{C:81958296772000000000}To do that, we need people on this continent
who'll help us as well.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296782000000000}Big brother...

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296792000000000}...All right. I'll help you.
But you'll help me first.
That's my condition.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CA00}{C:819582967C2000000000}Hey, old man!
That sounds like an interesting conversation.
Let me in on it too!

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296150000000000}Oh, me too, me too!
Of course I'm joining in!

{C:8190C800}{C:819582967D2000000000}{C:819782830400}Coconna{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Vanilla{C:819782830000}...

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296160000000000}You're treating us like strangers,
Chirico, my boy.

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582967E2000000000}That's right, Chirico.
We're your friends, aren't we?

{C:8190CC00}{C:819582967F2000000000}There you have it.
Show a little gratitude, Chirico.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802000000000}So, what should we do?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296822000000000}First, there are two men: {C:819782830400}Murza{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830400}Byman.{C:819782830000}
Find them in the towns.
By then, {C:819782830400}Gregore{C:819782830000} should be back too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296832000000000}{C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830300}Kummen{C:819782830000}, right?
Let's set out right away!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296862000000000}I've been asking around!
It sounds like that Murza fellow
is on the outskirts.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296872000000000}I see.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296882000000000}Well, well!
You're as cold as ever.
Don't I even get a thank-you?


{C:81930100}{C:819582968A2000000000}Thank you, {C:819782830400}Coconna.{C:819782830000}

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582968C2000000000}It's all right.
You don't have to be so considerate.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D2000000000}I'm really impressed.
We have such a hard time
getting even a scrap of information.

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582968E2000000000}Well, I'm from this continent,
after all.
You know what they say: to know a snake's ways, ask...

{C:81900400}{C:819582968F2000000000}A snake.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296912000000000}That's right, a snake.
You're a clever one.

{C:81958296922000000000}As long as you're on this continent,
leave information to me and supplies to the old man
or Vanilla, and you'll be fine.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942000000000}I see.
Then I'm counting on you when we're in trouble.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296952000000000}Oh, honestly!
You're so sweet and straightforward!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296962000000000}We're going.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296972000000000}Y-yes!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190DD00}{C:819582969E2000000000}Tch, this place has ended up like this too.
What a pitiful sight.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582969F2000000000}Murza...

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296A02000000000}So that's it. The time has come.
Are you the only one here?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296A12000000000}Byman and Gregore are coming too.

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296A22000000000}Tch, that bastard's coming too?
Well, fine.
So how are we getting around?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296A32000000000}Someone with a ship
has joined us.
Getting around will be easy.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296180000000000}I got here first and asked around.
That Byman guy's on 
{C:819782830300}Main Street{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296190000000000}He's so full of himself.
He really rubs me the wrong way!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A52000000000}Now, now, calm down.

{C:8190CB00}{C:819582961A0000000000}Oh, Rie!
Are you trying to comfort me?
You're so kind!

{C:819582961B0000000000}Maybe I ought to give you a kiss!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A62000000000}Big brooother!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A72000000000}Vanilla!
Rie's still a child.
Please don't tease her!

{C:8190CB00}{C:819582961C0000000000}Ahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A82000000000}Come on, everyone, quit fooling around.
Let's go.
Chirico's already left!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A92000000000}But I wasn't fooling around...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296AA2000000000}Byman.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296AC2000000000}And here I was enjoying my vacation.
I guess that's over now.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296AE2000000000}If you want out, suit yourself.
What's it going to be?

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296AF2000000000}You still can't take a joke,
can you?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296B02000000000}We're going.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296B12000000000}Yeah, yeah, I'm coming.
Even if it's straight to hell.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E100}{C:81958296B62000000000}Can we really rely on
this man, {C:819782830400}Roger Smith{C:819782830000}?

{C:81906500}{C:81958296B72000000000}Hah!
Apparently he calls himself a renowned negotiator.
What do I care?

{C:8190E100}{C:81958296B92000000000}Posaydal's army shows poor judgment, too,
letting someone like that negotiate.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296BA2000000000}Shut up!
It's obvious he'll fail.
That's when my job starts.

{C:8190E100}{C:81958296BC2000000000}A hostage, eh...? What a sneaky tactic.
I seem to recall that woman Nei
saying something similar.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296BD2000000000}Don't lump me in
with that vixen!
I don't like you, old man.

{C:8190E100}{C:81958296BE2000000000}The feeling is mutual. It can't be helped.
We're only working together
because our interests coincide.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296BF2000000000}Hmph!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296C52000000000}Gregore.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296C92000000000}Hey, is everyone here?
Still, every last one of you
has such a sour look on his face.

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296CB2000000000}Look who's talking.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296CC2000000000}You look no different yourself.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296CF2000000000}Keep running your mouths!
Chirico, are you ready?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D12000000000}Our friends are getting everything ready
at the junk shop on the edge of town.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296D22000000000}Then shall we get going?




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296D32000000000}You're back.
I got everything ready,
just as Chirico asked.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D42000000000}Thanks.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296D52000000000}Don't mention it.
Not with the history you and I have.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D72000000000}The others will probably make
the adjustments themselves.

{C:81958296D82000000000}And another thing...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296D92000000000}What is it, Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296DB2000000000}We'll need some time to get ready.
Please wait until then.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC2000000000}I understand.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296DD2000000000}Big brother,
could you come back to the Astante?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF2000000000}Rie?
Did something happen?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296E02000000000}There's someone here
who calls himself a negotiator...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E12000000000}A negotiator?
I'll be right there.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296E22000000000}I've asked the negotiator
to wait in another room.
Can I join in too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E32000000000}Of course.
Come on, let's go.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:81958296E42000000000}I'll get straight to the point.
The terms from Posaydal's army
are as follows.

{C:81958296E52000000000}Cease attacks on Posaydal's army.
Surrender the Astante, GTs and FTs.

{C:81958296E62000000000}In return,
they will cease attacks on Claudia
and hand over Lun Forest. That's all.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E72000000000}That's so one-sided!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E82000000000}If we only consider Claudia,
those terms might be reasonable.
That doesn't mean I intend to accept them.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E92000000000}But is it all right for us
to decide something this important?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA2000000000}...Let's refuse.
Maybe this really isn't
our decision to make.

{C:81958296EB2000000000}But just because it would save Claudia,
that's no reason for us
to abandon the other continents.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296EC2000000000}Hahahahahahaha!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296ED2000000000}What's so funny?!

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296EE2000000000}Hahaha... My apologies.
You're more decent than I expected,
and that made me happy.

{C:81958296EF2000000000}Anyone who'd accept terms like these
can't be a decent person.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F12000000000}Then why did you
take this job?

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F22000000000}Because I'm a negotiator.
I accept any request.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32000000000}I can't believe you...

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F42000000000}Well, negotiations have broken down.
Sorry to trouble you, but when it's convenient, could you take me to 
{C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000}?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F52000000000}And you've got some nerve, too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62000000000}Ahahaha... Sure.
But we've got something to do first,
so it'll have to be after that.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F72000000000}Thank you. That helps.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296FF2000000000}I thought being up this high
would be frightening, but...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296002100000000}It isn't, is it?

{C:81930200}{C:81958296022100000000}No. I'm glad I trusted you.
The view's lovely, and the breeze feels good.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296032100000000}If you like it,
shall we stay here a little longer?

{C:81930200}{C:81958296042100000000}Yes!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296062100000000}In any case,
I have to help Chirico
first.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296072100000000}We're ready.
I'd like you to take us close to {C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000}.
Please transport us there.

{C:81958296082100000000}From there, we'll use the {C:819782830400}LCT{C:819782830000}
to enter the enemy headquarters.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296092100000000}In that case, we'll come with you.

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582960B2100000000}We came together for a reason.
Anyone who's got nothing to do with it can butt out!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960C2100000000}What did you say?!

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296112100000000}I'd rather not say this,
but we mean to settle an old score.
We don't want outsiders coming along.

{C:81958296132100000000}Sorry, kid.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172100000000}If that's how it is...
I'm sorry I butted in.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296192100000000}We appreciate the thought.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C800}{C:819582961B2100000000}We'll get off here.

{C:81930300}{C:819582961C2100000000}We'll land in Gilgamesh.
Contact us if anything happens.

{C:8193C800}{C:819582961D2100000000}Understood.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C900}{C:819582961F2100000000}Wait, Epsilon!
There's something you need to learn
before you fight.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296202100000000}How to love.
To love other people, insects and living things.

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296212100000000}I don't understand...

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296222100000000}Ah, Epsilon!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193DD00}{C:81958296232100000000}Run while you have the chance!
Sergeant Major, get going!!

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296242100000000}(Those movements... It's her!)


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:819582962A2100000000}Thank you.
I'm grateful you brought me this far.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B2100000000}But was it all right
for you to travel with us?

{C:8190A202}{C:819582962D2100000000}Yes. A negotiator
is neutral toward both sides.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936500}{C:819582962E2100000000}You've got to be kidding me!!
You came back here with the enemy!


{C:8193A302}{C:81958296302100000000}Oh, heeelp! Save me, Roger!

{C:8193A202}{C:81958296312100000000}I was wondering where you'd gone...
R. Dorothy!
What are you doing over there?!

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296342100000000}I'm being held captive, Roger.
Can't you tell?


{C:8193A202}{C:81958296362100000000}Honestly...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296372100000000}Roger!
You know her, don't you?
Aren't you going to save her?!

{C:8193A202}{C:81958296392100000000}She'll be fine.
Just watch.

{C:8193A302}{C:819582963B2100000000}Roger, save meee!

{C:8193A202}{C:819582963C2100000000}R. Dorothy!
You can wait all you like. I'm not rescuing you.
Hurry up and come back here!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A302}{C:819582963E2100000000}You're so cold, Roger.

{C:81936500}{C:819582963F2100000000}She tore the rope apart?!
What kind of woman does that?!

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296412100000000}Just as I told you.
She's an android.
She let herself be captured on purpose.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296432100000000}On purpose...


{C:81936500}{C:81958296442100000000}Damn it!
Then I'll crush you with an HM!


{C:8190A202}{C:81958296462100000000}What a hopeless client.
I'd like your help.
Would you mind?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296482100000000}If we're fighting Posaydal's army,
we'll help!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E100}{C:819582964D2100000000}Chirico's still alive.
Come forth, Epsilon!
Finish him off with your own hands!!

{C:8190C900}{C:819582964E2100000000}Epsilon!
Stop, Epsilon!!

{C:8190E100}{C:819582964F2100000000}Kill him!
Kill Chirico!!

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296502100000000}Epsilon!
I'll teach you about love.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:819582965C2100000000}Posaydal's army owes me now,
and I owe you.

{C:819582965D2100000000}What do you say?
I'll come with you.
I'd like to repay my debt that way.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E2100000000}I appreciate the offer,
but is that all right?

{C:8190A202}{C:819582965F2100000000}You mean Posaydal's army?
There's no need to worry about them.

{C:81958296602100000000}By taking R. Dorothy hostage
and attacking us,
they've rendered our contract void.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296612100000000}In that case,
we're glad to have you, Roger.

{C:8190A302}{C:81958296632100000000}I suppose there's no helping it, Roger.
I'll come along too.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296642100000000}The Cloud Sea has finally opened up.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296652100000000}But we haven't heard from Chirico,
so we're not setting off.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296662100000000}Hey, Nelfea!
Don't butt in!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296672100000000}Stop arguing over the ship's intercom!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296682100000000}Oh, we're getting a transmission from Chirico.

{C:81958296692100000000}...It looks like he's injured.
I'll hurry us into the airspace over Gilgamesh!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966A2100000000}I understand!
I'll be up on the bridge right away!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CF01}{C:819582966D2100000000}I've brought the injured man.

{C:81900300}{C:819582966E2100000000}You're...

{C:8190CF01}{C:819582966F2100000000}Never mind me.
Please take care of Chirico.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296702100000000}Chirico! Chirico!

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296742100000000}I'm all right.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296752100000000}Gre...gore
and the others?

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296782100000000}They're dead...

{C:819582967B2100000000}More importantly... the ship you're pursuing
has left the continent, hasn't it...?
Don't worry about me... Go after it!

{C:81900400}{C:819582967C2100000000}Leave Chirico's treatment
to me.

{C:8193C800}{C:819582967D2100000000}Go after it.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2100000000}Rie.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296802100000000}Yes!
Astante, launching!!


{x00}
