rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E200}{C:81958296F31F00000000}You there! What are you doing?
Get on with the escort!

{C:8190E400}{C:81958296F61F00000000}Get moving,
you sluggish oaf!

{C:8190BA01}{C:81958296F71F00000000}Hmph...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F81F00000000}He's quite a big man.

{C:8190E400}{C:81958296F91F00000000}Civilians!
Stop staring!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA1F00000000}Let's go.
They're liable to pick a fight with us.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296FB1F00000000}Ah!

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296FC1F00000000}Forgive me, my lady.
Are you hurt?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FD1F00000000}Oh, no.
I'm all right.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296FE1F00000000}Dor... No, I was looking for someone.
My apologies.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FF1F00000000}We just bumped into each other.
Please don't worry about it.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296002000000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Roger Smith.{C:819782830000}
If we have the chance,
let's meet again.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296022000000000}He has funny eyebrows.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296032000000000}But he's a gentleman, isn't he?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296042000000000}I'll give him that.
He doesn't seem to be from this continent.
I wonder what he does for a living.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296052000000000}What are you two doing?
I'll leave you behind.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296062000000000}I'm coming!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296072000000000}Wow, somehow
this reminds me of Claudia!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296082000000000}It really does!
You'd hardly believe there's fighting
on this continent, too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193AB02}{C:81958296092000000000}I see.
So people really are coming here
from other continents as well.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960A2000000000}Whoa! You're upside down!

{C:8193AB02}{C:819582960C2000000000}My apologies.
Hah!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:819582960D2000000000}I was looking for someone.
I apologize for startling you.
Now, if you'll excuse me.


{C:81900400}{C:819582960F2000000000}I wonder what he was hanging from...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296102000000000}We've ended up somewhere strange.
How do we get back to town?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296112000000000}Oh, big brother!
So much for 'Leave it to me!'

{C:81900400}{C:81958296122000000000}There's someone over there.
Let's ask.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296132000000000}Ahh... I came all the way to Gilgamesh,
but I couldn't get anything.
I'm sorry, Chirico...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296142000000000}Excuse me.
Um, how do we
get back to town?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296152000000000}Oh, in that case,
just take that road out of here
and you'll be right back...

{C:81958296162000000000}Hey, you!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172000000000}M-me?
What is it?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296182000000000}You've got a nice build, don't you?
Do you want to be an AT pilot?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192000000000}An AT pilot?
No thanks, I'm an FT pilot.


{C:8190CA00}{C:819582961A2000000000}Oh, don't say that.
Come and enter
Battling with me!

{C:81930100}{C:819582961C2000000000}No, thank you!
Let's get out of here, Rie, Nelfea!

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582961D2000000000}Aww, wait for me!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296482000000000}Is this a junk shop?

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296492000000000}Whoa there, you lot!
I haven't seen you around before.
You just got to Astragius, right?

{C:819582964A2000000000}You'd better watch out.
This continent's a scary place.
People will rob you blind.

{C:81900400}{C:819582964B2000000000}Don't scare us like that!

{C:8190CF01}{C:819582964C2000000000}There are plenty of people after
the technology to cross the Cloud Sea.
You'd better be careful.

{C:81900300}{C:819582964D2000000000}Who are you, anyway?

{C:8190CF01}{C:819582964E2000000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Duo.{C:819782830000}
{C:819782830400}Duo Maxwell{C:819782830000}, that's my name.
You won't regret remembering it.

{C:81958296652000000000}I'll give you a hand before long,
so make sure you remember me!
See you around!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964F2000000000}Hey, wait!
He's fast. He's gone already.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296502000000000}The way he moves shows he's trained.
He may seem like a joker,
but we can't let our guard down around him.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296512000000000}I'm tired. Let's take a short break.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296522000000000}I vote yes!
I'm completely worn out.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296532000000000}You two have no stamina.
Though I have to admit,
I'm a little tired myself...

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296552000000000}I'm sorry, girls.
We've only got drinks for grown-ups here.
You'd better try somewhere else.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296562000000000}Oh, I see. I'm sorry.

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296572000000000}Cough! Cough!

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296592000000000}What's wrong, Chirico?
Can't you even drink beer?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582965A2000000000}Why does everyone drink
something this foul?


{C:81900400}{C:819582965B2000000000}It looks like we're not the only ones
who don't belong here.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CB00}{C:819582960F0000000000}Hey there, you lot!
This is your first time here, right?

{C:81958296100000000000}The great {C:819782830400}Vanilla{C:819782830000} will show you around
cheap.

{C:81900400}{C:819582961E2000000000}No, thank you.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296110000000000}Aw, don't say that.
If you like, I could even
take you to Battling.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961F2000000000}We're not interested in this
Battling thing either, so no thanks.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296120000000000}All right, all right, I get it!
I don't want customers like you anyway!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296202000000000}This is a mess.
I got separated from Seiji, who came with me,
and Ryo and the others aren't here either.

{C:81958296212000000000}And on top of that,
I can't see Natsumi anywhere...
Now I'm in trouble.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296222000000000}He's looking for people, too?
It must be hard in a place this big.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CD00}{C:81958296130000000000}Are you a mercenary, too?
Take my advice.
Women and children shouldn't take part.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296232000000000}We're not mercenaries,
but is something going to happen here?

{C:8190CD00}{C:81958296140000000000}There'll be a war here before long.
You should leave quickly.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296242000000000}Thank you for the warning.
We'll leave right away.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296252000000000}Huh, so there's a place like this, too.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296262000000000}It's an unusual design. I like it.
Oh, it looks like someone's here.

{C:8190D300}{C:81958296272000000000}Tell me, Pota.
What do you make of the current situation?

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296282000000000}The situation?
I certainly wouldn't call it good.

{C:8190D300}{C:819582962A2000000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
You still don't mince words,
do you?

{C:8190CF00}{C:819582962B2000000000}Forgive me.
I can't help worrying about the movements
of Gilgamesh and Balarant.

{C:8190D300}{C:819582962D2000000000}So you think so, too?
At this rate, the Holy Kingdom of Kummen
may have no future...

{C:81900300}{C:819582962F2000000000}That sounds serious.
It's rude of us to listen in.
Let's move on.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302000000000}Yeah.
Let's do that.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190DA00}{C:81958296842000000000}The Astante...
So Chirico's been brought here,
just as that person said.

{C:81958296852000000000}Heh heh heh heh...
Now then, Chirico.
What will you do?




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296982000000000}It seems neither Natsumi nor
Ryo and the others are on this continent.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296992000000000}Then there's no point staying here.
Let's find some way to get to another continent.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582969A2000000000}I agree.
Let's do something about it as soon as possible.


{C:81900400}{C:819582969B2000000000}Hey, they seem to be in trouble.
Aren't you going to help them?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969C2000000000}I don't really want too many people to know
we can go out into the Cloud Sea.
What should we do?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969D2000000000}...It looks like we're too late.
They disappeared incredibly fast.
Are those people even human...?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933200}{C:819582961D0000000000}...Your words
are rather hard to believe.
You are telling the truth, I trust?


{C:81930C00}{C:81958296812100000000}Yes. You have my word.
Once you rule this continent,
I'll give you the technology to cross the Cloud Sea.

{C:81933200}{C:819582961E0000000000}I'll take you at your word.
For the time being.


{C:81930200}{C:81958296822100000000}The Cloud System
was invented by Claudia
for peaceful purposes!

{C:81958296852100000000}Using it for war is wrong!

{C:81933200}{C:819582961F0000000000}You're insolent, woman.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296862100000000}What...?

{C:81933200}{C:81958296200000000000}I said you're insolent.
Your companion seems to lack manners.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296882100000000}My apologies for her rudeness.

{C:81958296892100000000}Then we shall take our leave today
before we cause any further offense.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:819582968A2100000000}What you're trying to do
is wrong.
Don't drag the other continents into it!

{C:81900C00}{C:819582968B2100000000}Don't get the wrong idea, woman!
I'm only keeping you alive
because you seem to have an interesting power.

{C:819582968C2100000000}That doesn't mean
you should expect me
to remain generous forever.

{C:81900200}{C:819582968D2100000000}But...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B801}{C:81958296210000000000}Hey, hey, ladies!
I haven't seen your faces on this continent before.
Are you like me, by any chance?


{C:81930100}{C:819582968E2100000000}Like you...?
Did you come from another continent too?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968F2100000000}Big brother!!
You can't just blurt out
something like that!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296220000000000}Ahahaha...
You've got it rough, bro.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296902100000000}I sure do... Hey,
whose fault is that?!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296230000000000}Sorry, sorry.
I stopped you folks
because I wanted to ask a favor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296912100000000}A favor from us?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296240000000000}That's right. I was wondering
if you'd let me aboard
your battleship.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296932100000000}Why should we let you
aboard our ship?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296250000000000}Whoa!
You're a feisty big sister, aren't you?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296942100000000}Who's your big sister?
I wouldn't want an obnoxious little brother
like you!

{C:81958296952100000000}Besides, no matter how you look at it,
you're older than I am!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296260000000000}Then you'd better
listen to your elders, hadn't you?

{C:81958296270000000000}So, what do you say?
Will you let me aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296962100000000}What do we do, Rie?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296280000000000}A battleship shaped just like yours
owes me one.

{C:81958296290000000000}Would you let me aboard
so I can get even?
I'll do anything!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972100000000}In that case, I authorize you to come aboard.
I'm the captain, Rie Akatsuki.
It's nice to meet you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296982100000000}Hey, is that really all right?
You decided awfully quickly.
Don't you think so, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296992100000000}The captain's given permission,
so what's the problem?

{C:819582969A2100000000}I'm Nelfea Northrock,
a pilot.

{C:8190B801}{C:819582962A0000000000}Hehehehe!
I'm Sai Saici,
a Gundam Fighter.

{C:819582962B0000000000}Though I guess
that won't mean anything to you.
Anyway, nice to meet you!

{C:819582962C0000000000}You too, bro!

{C:81930100}{C:819582969B2100000000}Uh, yeah.
Nice to meet you.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582969C2100000000}Wow...
Everything here is new to me!

{C:81900400}{C:819582969D2100000000}If you keep looking around like that,
you'll bump into someone, Rie.


{C:81900300}{C:819582969E2100000000}Mmm...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939F02}{C:819582969F2100000000}Ah!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A02100000000}Oh, I'm sorry!
Are you all right?

{C:81909F02}{C:81958296A12100000000}It's okay. I wasn't looking where I was going either.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296A22100000000}Look at the way she's dressed.
Don't you think it's more like our clothes
than the clothes on this continent?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A32100000000}Now that you mention it, you're right.
All right! I'll go ask her.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A42100000000}Hey, don't!
If you do that...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296A52100000000}Excuse me.
This might sound strange, but
you're not from this continent, are you?

{C:81909F02}{C:81958296A62100000000}Huh? Um, well, I...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A72100000000}Oh, wait!
...Aw, she's gone.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A82100000000}Of course she is!
You hadn't even asked her name!

{C:81958296A92100000000}And then you suddenly asked,
"You're not from this continent, are you?"

{C:81958296AA2100000000}If someone asked you that,
you'd be completely put off!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296AB2100000000}Would you?
It wouldn't bother me.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AC2100000000}Not everyone's
like you, big brother!
Ugh, I'm getting a headache.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296AD2100000000}Shall we move on for now?
It looks like we're drawing attention.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296B62100000000}We can't find any information
about the Norstan at all.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B72100000000}We don't even know if it came to this continent.
Are we really in the right place?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B82100000000}The Cloud Sea's too thick for us to move anyway.
There's no use getting worked up.
Let's try somewhere else.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931C00}{C:81958296B92100000000}Those kids...

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296BC2100000000}Could they be from that ship?
I'd better report this to Nie, just in case.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296BD2100000000}Huh? I've ended up somewhere strange.
I've lost Rie and the others too.
What am I doing?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296BF2100000000}Hey, you!
What are you doing there?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02100000000}I'm sorry.
I seem to have lost my way.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296C32100000000}You look like you're from another country.
I suppose you couldn't help getting lost.

{C:81958296C62100000000}There's a lot of fighting these days,
so plenty of people are on edge.
You'd better be careful.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C72100000000}I understand.
Thank you for the warning.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296C82100000000}Don't mention it.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296C92100000000}It looks like a ship from this continent is approaching.
Oh! It's getting ready for battle!!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CA2100000000}I'd rather avoid a fight if we can,
but at least get us ready to defend ourselves.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB2100000000}You got it!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932800}{C:81958296CC2100000000}So that's the other
Cloud Ship...

{C:81958296CD2100000000}We were only supposed to observe it,
but perhaps I'll bring it down for our lord.
Holy Warriors, prepare to sortie!

{C:81932700}{C:81958296CE2100000000}I'm ready whenever you are.
How about you, Jap?


{C:81932300}{C:819582962F0000000000}Could you stop
calling me Jap, Yankee?

{C:81932700}{C:81958296CF2100000000}Tch.

{C:81932800}{C:81958296D02100000000}Let's have no infighting
at a time like this, Holy Warriors.

{C:81932700}{C:81958296D12100000000}I know.
I'm heading out, {C:819782830400}Bern{C:819782830000}, old pal.

{C:81932800}{C:81958296D22100000000}{C:819782830400}Sho Zama{C:819782830000},
you will sortie too, won't you?

{C:81932300}{C:81958296300000000000}I'll do enough
to repay you for keeping me alive.
Dunbine, Sho Zama, launching!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931E00}{C:81958296D42100000000}There are a lot of enemies. Can you handle them, {C:819782830400}Marvel{C:819782830000}?

{C:81931C00}{C:81958296D52100000000}We don't have a choice, do we?
I'm going out.

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296D62100000000}Sorry. I'm counting on you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931C00}{C:81958296D72100000000}You're a stupid man, helping 
{C:819782830400}Drake{C:819782830000} without knowing right from wrong.

{C:81958296D82100000000}Do you understand this continent and the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of A{C:819782830000}
when you offer Drake your help?

{C:81958296D92100000000}Don't you understand
that this man Drake
is obsessed with power?!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932800}{C:81958296DC2100000000}Holy Warriors, return.
Our lord commands it.
Return to the ship.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296DD2100000000}For now,
it looks like we avoided a fight.

{C:81958296DE2100000000}But that ship that came out afterward...
Why did it help us?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296DF2100000000}We're getting a transmission from that ship.
What do we do, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E02100000000}I'll talk to them.
Could you open a channel?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E12100000000}I'm opening the channel.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931E00}{C:81958296E62100000000}We have no
hostile intentions toward you.

{C:81958296E82100000000}We'd like to talk to you,
the people who crossed the Cloud Sea.

{C:81958296EB2100000000}If possible, would you trust us and come to the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Lau{C:819782830000} for a
meeting?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296EC2100000000}What should we do?
I'd like to hear what they have to say.
Is that all right?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296ED2100000000}As you wish, Captain.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE2100000000}They practically saved us.
I think it's all right.

{C:81958296EF2100000000}Besides, let's try trusting them first
instead of being suspicious.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F02100000000}Okay!
Then I'll give them our answer.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296F12100000000}Understood.
We'll head for the Kingdom of Lau.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931E00}{C:81958296F22100000000}Thank you.
We'll send out some kind of signal
so you can locate the Kingdom of Lau.

{C:81958296F32100000000}Then we'll see you in the Kingdom of Lau later.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:81958296F42100000000}Thank you for trusting us.
Let me introduce myself again: Nie Given.
It's good to meet you.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F52100000000}I'm Rie Akatsuki,
captain of the Astante.

{C:81958296F72100000000}Thank you very much
for helping us earlier.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296F82100000000}I'm Marvel Frozen.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F92100000000}I'm the pilot,
Nelfea Northrock.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA2100000000}Nice to meet you.

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296FB2100000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Chum Huau{C:819782830000}!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296FC2100000000}Whoa! What is this?!

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296FD2100000000}What do you mean, this?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FE2100000000}Oh, you're so cute!

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296FF2100000000}See? That's the proper reaction!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296002200000000}Now, now, don't get so angry, Chum.
There probably aren't any Mi Ferario
on their continent.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296012200000000}I'm sorry.
You appeared so suddenly that I was surprised.
Will you forgive me?

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296022200000000}Oh, is that all?
Then I forgive you.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296032200000000}Um... Nie,
about what you wanted to discuss...

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296042200000000}I'll get straight to the point.
On this continent,
you're wanted fugitives.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296062200000000}Someone else
will explain the details to you.

{C:81958296082200000000}You've come from another continent.
Will you trust us
and come with us?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296092200000000}I'll go as our representative.
Rie, please wait on the Astante.

{C:81900400}{C:819582960A2200000000}That's right.
I'll go with him,
so you stay behind, Rie.

{C:81900300}{C:819582960B2200000000}Oh, Nelfea! That's not fair!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960C2200000000}I'd like you to stay behind too, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:819582960D2200000000}Why?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E2200000000}We can't leave the Astante unattended.
If those people from earlier came back,
there'd be nobody to defend it.

{C:819582960F2200000000}So I'm counting on you.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102200000000}All right.
Leave the Astante and Rie
to me.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296112200000000}Then shall we go,
Mr. Given and Ms. Frozen?



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933300}{C:81958296132200000000}What my father is trying to do is wrong.
Nie and the others are in the right.

{C:81932300}{C:81958296330000000000}Then you aren't happy
that someone like me is helping him.

{C:81933300}{C:81958296142200000000}That's right.

{C:81932300}{C:81958296340000000000}Then could you send me home?

{C:81933300}{C:81958296152200000000}That's impossible.
Nobody knows how to cross
the Cloud Stream, and...

{C:81958296162200000000}The month would have to change too,
and without the help of the Ferario...

{C:81932300}{C:81958296350000000000}Everything's decided for me, isn't it?

{C:81933300}{C:81958296172200000000}Since I'm already imposing,
could you take me
to Nie Given?

{C:81958296182200000000}If you don't want to help my father and can't go home,
please help Nie Given.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902800}{C:81958296192200000000}Lady Riml, you mustn't come
to a place like this alone!

{C:81902300}{C:81958296360000000000}A place like this? That's harsh,
Bern Bunnings.

{C:81933300}{C:819582961A2200000000}I was asking the Holy Warrior
to tell everyone all sorts of stories.

{C:81902800}{C:819582961B2200000000}You should give some thought to etiquette too, Holy Warrior.
We must respect how noble people live here.
Come along, Lady {C:819782830400}Riml{C:819782830000}.

{C:81933300}{C:819582961C2200000000}Sho Zama... I'm counting on you.

{C:81902300}{C:81958296370000000000}I'll think about it,
Lady Riml.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:819582961D2200000000}Lady Elle,
I've brought the man from that ship.

{C:81902400}{C:819582961E2200000000}It's a pleasure to meet you,
Mr. Akatsuki.
My name is {C:819782830400}Elle Hunm{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961F2200000000}It's nice to meet you.
...Wait, how do you
know my name?

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296202200000000}Lady Elle has spiritual powers.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296222200000000}Spiritual powers...?

{C:81902400}{C:81958296232200000000}Hehehe... They may be ordinary in Byston Well,
but perhaps they sound like a trick
to someone from another continent.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296242200000000}I'm sorry.
I'm still not used to cultures
outside Claudia.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296252200000000}Lady Elle,
please explain it to him.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296262200000000}Here in Byston Well,
an ambitious man called Drake of the Kingdom of A
is trying to seize control of the world.

{C:81958296272200000000}An evil, dark shadow has approached Drake
and is seeking tremendous power.
On the opposite side are you, the light.

{C:81958296282200000000}Drake fears that people
will gather around that light.
That is why he made you wanted fugitives.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296292200000000}I understand why we were made fugitives,
but I don't really understand
what you mean by light.

{C:81902400}{C:819582962B2200000000}You needn't dwell on it.
For now, look for allies
for the battles to come.

{C:819582962C2200000000}I too will help you
as much as I can.

{C:819582962D2200000000}Nie, you and the others
will help him too, won't you?

{C:81901E00}{C:819582962E2200000000}If you ask it, Lady Elle,
we'll gladly help.
Will you accept us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962F2200000000}Um, this is happening so fast
that I'm a little overwhelmed...
But I'm grateful for your help.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296302200000000}This will probably extend
beyond Byston Well.
Please do your best.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:81958296312200000000}Say...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296322200000000}Oh, you can drop the formalities,
Mr. Given.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296332200000000}I see. Then just call me Nie too.

{C:81958296342200000000}I have a suggestion.
Your ship stands out too much.
{C:819782830400}Zelerna{C:819782830000}--why not transfer aboard her?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296352200000000}The Astante certainly
does stand out.

{C:81958296362200000000}I understand.
I'll tell everyone as soon as I get back.
But what about the Astante in the meantime?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296372200000000}I expected this might happen,
so I've already asked someone...


{C:81902600}{C:81958296382200000000}I know about the matter.
Leave it to me.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296392200000000}{C:819782830400}King Foizon{C:819782830000}!
What brings you to a place like this?!

{C:81902600}{C:819582963A2200000000}{C:819782830400}Pradon{C:819782830000} told me about it.
I couldn't sit still,
so here I am!

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963B2200000000}With respect, for the king himself
to come all the way to a place like this...

{C:81902600}{C:819582963C2200000000}Hahahahaha! Don't be like that!
I wanted to see people from another continent
with my own eyes, too.

{C:819582963D2200000000}Is that the one?

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963E2200000000}Yes.

{C:81902600}{C:819582963F2200000000}I see.
I'm Foizon Gow,
King of the Kingdom of Lau.

{C:81958296402200000000}Rest assured, you can leave
your ship in my care.
I'll look after it well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296422200000000}Understood, King Foizon!
Thank you. We're counting on you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296432200000000}...And that's what happened.
So I think we should transfer to the Zelerna,
even if it's only temporary.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296442200000000}I agree!
That sounds perfectly reasonable.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296462200000000}Yes.
There's no reason to object.

{C:81958296472200000000}Then we'll be counting on you,
Nie.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296482200000000}Likewise.
Use the Zelerna
as you see fit.

{C:819582964A2200000000}And that includes us.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B2200000000}All right! Now that's decided,
let's get straight to the Zelerna...

{C:81900300}{C:819582964C2200000000}What are you talking about?
You're moving the supplies, big brother.
Do your best!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964D2200000000}Aw, come on!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931E00}{C:819582965C2200000000}One of our friends has gone to the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Na{C:819782830000}.
I'd like to pick her up. Is that all right?

{C:81930300}{C:819582965D2200000000}The Kingdom of Na, right?
Understood.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901B00}{C:819582965E2200000000}{C:819782830400}Keen{C:819782830000}!

{C:81901D00}{C:819582965F2200000000}Chum!
Have you been well?!

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296602200000000}I have, I have!
But listen!
I met people from another continent!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296612200000000}Keen, sorry to keep you waiting.
How did things go on your end?

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296622200000000}Unfortunately, I couldn't meet Lady 
{C:819782830400}Ciela{C:819782830000}.
How about you, Nie?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296632200000000}Let me introduce him.
He's a crew member from that ship.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296652200000000}Hello.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296662200000000}Hello.
I'm Keen Kiss.
Nice to meet you!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:819582964E2200000000}There's something I'd like you to keep secret.
Will you hear me out?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964F2200000000}If it's all right for us to hear it,
I'm sure Rie and Nelfea here
can keep a secret.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296502200000000}It's about Lady Elle...
She's a princess of the Kingdom of Lau.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296512200000000}She's too young to be King Foizon's daughter...
Is she his granddaughter?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296522200000000}Yes. For certain reasons,
King Foizon
doesn't acknowledge her.

{C:81958296532200000000}I thought you
ought to know.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296542200000000}But why are you
telling us this?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296552200000000}Because we're friends.
I wanted you to know.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296562200000000}Thank you, Nie,
for trusting us.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296572200000000}What are you talking about?
You put your trust
in me and Marvel, didn't you?

{C:81958296582200000000}It's precisely because we're in a conflict like this
that I want to value my friends.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296592200000000}Lun... Where are you now?
Damn it!
I hate how powerless I am.


{C:81930300}{C:819582965A2200000000}Big brother, what are you doing?
It's nearly time to leave.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901C00}{C:81958296672200000000}Nie, about {C:819782830300}Laas Wau{C:819782830000}:
an Aura Ship has just taken off from there.
Now's our chance!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296682200000000}I see!

{C:81958296692200000000}You heard her.
I'd like to reduce the enemy's strength, even a little.
Will you help us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966A2200000000}You don't even have to ask.
We're already friends, aren't we?
Let's go to Laas Wau!!

{C:81901E00}{C:819582966B2200000000}All right!
The Zelerna is heading for the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of A{C:819782830000}!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931C00}{C:819582966C2200000000}With so few forces,
we have no choice but to do this.
Please try to understand our situation!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931C00}{C:819582966E2200000000}That man, Sho Zama...
I feel like he might be willing
to help us, but...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296702200000000}Huh?
Isn't that the girl
we saw earlier?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296712200000000}It is.
I wonder what's wrong.
She's running in such a panic.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909E02}{C:819582967B2200000000}Stay away from Hitomi!!

{C:81902800}{C:819582967C2200000000}Well, well, our knight has arrived.

{C:81909E02}{C:819582967D2200000000}I won't let you do as you please
with me or Escaflowne!

{C:81902800}{C:819582967E2200000000}You're drawing your sword?
Then I won't show any mercy either!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2200000000}This is bad!

{C:8193B801}{C:81958296390000000000}Bro, it's dangerous to go in barehanded!
Leave it to me!!


{C:81902300}{C:819582963A0000000000}Bern!
What are you doing?!

{C:81902800}{C:81958296802200000000}Ah, Holy Warrior.
I'm only doing
what I must for our lord.

{C:81958296812200000000}I would ask you, Holy Warrior,
not to interfere.

{C:8193B801}{C:819582963B0000000000}Now we're talking!
Bro, let's go!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822200000000}Yeah!


{C:81902800}{C:81958296832200000000}Who the hell are you?!

{C:8190B801}{C:819582963C0000000000}Hehehehe!
We're lending a hand too!
Right, bro?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296842200000000}Yeah. I can't just stand by
when someone talks about taking a girl hostage.

{C:81902300}{C:819582963D0000000000}Then... I can't do as you ask.
A man who calls himself a knight
is trying to take a woman hostage!

{C:819582963E0000000000}As a Holy Warrior... no, as a man,
I can't overlook that.


{C:81902800}{C:81958296852200000000}Sho Zama!!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296862200000000}You're outnumbered,
Bern Bunnings!!

{C:81902800}{C:81958296872200000000}Nie Given too... Ghh!

{C:81958296882200000000}Very well!
I'll withdraw for now.
But I won't forget this humiliation!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582968A2200000000}Um, Sho,
we're...

{C:81902300}{C:819582963F0000000000}I'm still on Drake's side.
You'd better not say anything careless.
See you.


{C:81930100}{C:819582968B2200000000}Well then... Huh?
Where did those two go?

{C:81901E00}{C:819582968C2200000000}Sorry.
I was so focused on Sho Zama
that I wasn't watching them.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296400000000000}Oh, come on!
We saved them for nothing!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D2200000000}At least we kept that girl Hitomi
out of Bern's hands.
Let's be satisfied with that.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296410000000000}Tch, bro,
you're such a softie!

{C:81900300}{C:819582968E2200000000}That's all right.
That's one of the good things
about my big brother.

{C:81901B00}{C:819582968F2200000000}Ooh, how cool!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909F02}{C:81958296902200000000}Um...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296912200000000}Oh, you're the girl from earlier.

{C:81909F02}{C:81958296922200000000}I'm sorry I ran off earlier
without even thanking you.
And thank you for saving us.

{C:81958296932200000000}Come on, Van.
You should thank them too.

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296942200000000}...You saved us. You have my thanks.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296952200000000}No, um...
How should I put it? We only did
what anyone should do.

{C:81909F02}{C:81958296962200000000}Come on, Van, tell them.

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296972200000000}You said you were going to tell them...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296982200000000}If there's something you want to discuss,
we're happy to listen.

{C:81909F02}{C:81958296992200000000}Um, well...
I-it's a selfish request, but
could you let us aboard your ship too?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969A2200000000}Of course.

{C:81909E02}{C:819582969B2200000000}What?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969C2200000000}Oh, right, we aren't
on the Astante now.
Is it all right, Nie?

{C:81901E00}{C:819582969D2200000000}Of course.
You're very welcome.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902300}{C:81958296420000000000}(What's that black machine that just landed?
It's not an Aura Battler.)

{C:81902700}{C:819582969F2200000000}Hey, Sho!

{C:81902300}{C:81958296430000000000}Sorry. Go on ahead.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81903200}{C:81958296450000000000}It's you. What do you want?

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296A02200000000}It appears the enemy
has finally begun to move.
I merely came to warn you.

{C:81903200}{C:81958296470000000000}People from your continent?
There's no need to worry.
No country will deal with wanted fugitives.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296A12200000000}I certainly hope so.

{C:81958296A32200000000}Otherwise, there's no point in my helping you control this continent
and pursue your ambitions
on the others as well.

{C:81903200}{C:81958296480000000000}You... What are you plotting?
You come all this way to see me and say such things.
What is behind it...?

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296A42200000000}Heh...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931C00}{C:81958296A92200000000}Hey, why don't we
look for Sho Zama?

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296AA2200000000}What for, Marvel?

{C:81931C00}{C:81958296AB2200000000}I'm sure he'd join us.
That's what I think.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296AC2200000000}The more forces we have, the better.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD2200000000}Would that be a problem, Nie?

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296AE2200000000}If you're all right with it, I won't object.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296AF2200000000}Nie,
something's approaching at high speed.

{C:81931C00}{C:81958296B02200000000}Isn't that Dunbine?

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296B12200000000}It looks like he intends to land aboard.
Let's go to the hangar!

{C:8193B801}{C:819582964B0000000000}I'll go too.
It's dangerous, ladies,
so stay here!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902300}{C:819582964C0000000000}That's what I told you!
There's someone from another continent
working with Drake!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296B22200000000}You might be trying to gain our gratitude and get close to us
so you can spy on us.

{C:81902300}{C:819582964D0000000000}Are you so twisted
you can't even accept someone's goodwill?

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296B32200000000}I think we can trust Sho.
What do you think?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296B42200000000}Yes, what do you think?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B52200000000}He mentioned the ship we're pursuing too.
I think he's telling the truth.

{C:8190B801}{C:819582964E0000000000}I trust
your judgment, bro.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296B62200000000}If you all say so,
I'll trust him... But
he'll have to prove himself in battle.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B72200000000}What do we do now?
Where should we go next?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B82200000000}{C:819782830400}Norstan{C:819782830000}--let's look for information about it.
It's our only option, isn't it?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B92200000000}That's right.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:81958296BA2200000000}...What do you think, Lady Elle?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582964F0000000000}You still suspected me?
You just won't let it go!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB2200000000}Nie,
is that why we came here?

{C:81902400}{C:81958296BC2200000000}Hehehe... You came all this way
for that?

{C:81958296BD2200000000}It's all right, Nie Given.
There's no need to worry.
You can trust Sho Zama.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296BE2200000000}If you say so, Lady Elle...

{C:81902400}{C:81958296BF2200000000}We're counting on you, Holy Warrior.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296500000000000}I don't think I'm so remarkable
that I deserve to be called a Holy Warrior.
But... I'll give it a try.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296C12200000000}May good aura power
guide you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902600}{C:81958296C22200000000}Ah, young people!
You've come at just the right time.
{C:819782830300}The Kingdom of A{C:819782830000}'s king is under attack!

{C:81958296C32200000000}It concerns another country,
so we cannot intervene.
Can we count on you, young people?!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296C42200000000}{C:819782830400}King Furaon{C:819782830000}?!
This is bad!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C52200000000}What's so bad about it?

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296C62200000000}If King Furaon loses to Drake,
the Kingdom of A will belong to Drake.
We can't let that happen, no matter what!!

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296510000000000}Every moment counts.
Let's hurry!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C72200000000}Rie, Nelfea,
let's take out the Astante!
That'll give us more fighting strength.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C82200000000}Yes, I understand!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296C92200000000}Keen and I will go in the Zelerna.
Marvel, come with us!

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296CA2200000000}Understood.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296CB2200000000}We're heading out first!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932800}{C:81958296CD2200000000}You've come!
I'll put an end
to our association here and now!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296D32200000000}I'm sorry, Nie.
I wasn't any help.

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296D42200000000}That was a shame.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296D52200000000}We weren't strong enough.
If only we'd had more strength...

{C:81902400}{C:81958296D62200000000}You mustn't lose heart,
Nie Given.
The fighting will continue.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296D72200000000}Lady Elle!

{C:81902400}{C:81958296D82200000000}The dark shadow has gone to another continent.
Pursuing that dark shadow
is your mission.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D92200000000}I understand.
But...

{C:81902400}{C:81958296DA2200000000}I don't think there will be
any major moves for a while.
Everything requires preparation.

{C:81958296DB2200000000}Besides, that dark shadow is the root of the trouble.
Unless you defeat it,
the fighting will never end.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296DC2200000000}You've heard what Lady Elle has said.
Leave Byston Well
to us, and go.

{C:81958296DD2200000000}Marvel... Sho, too.
Go with them.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296520000000000}N-Nie Given,
are you all right with that?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296DE2200000000}Please, Sho Zama.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296530000000000}I don't know whether I can be of use,
but I'd like to help you.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296DF2200000000}I can't match Sho's aura power,
but I'll do my best
not to hold you back.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E02200000000}Thank you.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296E22200000000}Then go.
Everything depends
on you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E32200000000}Then, sorry to trouble you,
but could you take care of the hangar?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296540000000000}Yes. Leave it to me.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296550000000000}Now then, where should I start?

{C:8193D001}{C:81958296560000000000}Hey, you there.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296570000000000}Who the hell are you?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E42200000000}(Huh? What's all the noise?
Sho's fighting someone?!
Oh, what an amazing thrust!

{C:81958296E52200000000}Whoa, he just barely dodged it... Did he jump?
How many times is he spinning?
Oh... No, I need to stop them.)

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E62200000000}What are you doing?
Aren't you going to stop them?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931A00}{C:81958296580000000000}For that matter, what's with that half-clown mask
that looks like you're making fun of people?

{C:8193D001}{C:81958296590000000000}If you don't like it,
I don't mind taking it off.

{C:81931A00}{C:819582965A0000000000}That's not the point!
I'm asking who you are!!

{C:8193D001}{C:819582965B0000000000}It doesn't matter who I am.
What matters is who the enemy is.

{C:819582965C0000000000}The people you're fighting
are my enemies too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E72200000000}Are you pursuing
the Norstan too?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582965D0000000000}You've come at just the right time.
Actually, this guy...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E82200000000}I'm sorry. I was watching.
The exchange of attacks and defenses was so amazing
that I missed my chance to step in.


{C:81901A00}{C:819582965F0000000000}Honestly, you...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E92200000000}I said I'm sorry!

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296600000000000}So, may I come aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA2200000000}Well...
Let's leave that to the captain.
We should get Rie...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EB2200000000}I already went and got her
while you were dawdling!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296EC2200000000}I'm the captain, Rie Akatsuki.
Are you the one
who wants to come aboard our ship?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296620000000000}Yes.
I learned of the disturbances in the world...
and came from another continent.

{C:81958296630000000000}If things continue like this,
the person I must protect
will be harmed too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED2200000000}You have someone to protect?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296640000000000}Yes.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296EE2200000000}In that case, I authorize you to come aboard.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296650000000000}I see. Thank you.
I'm {C:819782830400}Trowa Barton.{C:819782830000}
I look forward to working with you.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D001}{C:819582962D0000000000}...You'd better be careful.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296AE2100000000}Whoa!

{C:81958296AF2100000000}You startled me.
...Who were you again?

{C:8190D001}{C:819582962E0000000000}You're being targeted.
You'd better be careful.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296B02100000000}What's wrong, big brother?
Do you know him?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B12100000000}He warned me that we're being targeted
and told us to be careful.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B22100000000}I don't know who he is, but it's good advice.
Let's be grateful for the warning and take it to heart.

{C:81958296B32100000000}In a place where we don't know our way around,
we'd better be careful.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B52100000000}Big brother!
I'm counting on you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902A00}{C:81958296693600000000}You children there, wait.

{C:81900400}{C:819582966B3600000000}Children? Are you talking about me?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C3600000000}Do you mean me too?

{C:81902A00}{C:819582966D3600000000}Both of you.
I haven't seen you before. Where are you from?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966E3600000000}W-well...

{C:81902A00}{C:81958296703600000000}Never mind.

{C:81958296723600000000}This country is at war right now.
Strangers face strict questioning.
Avoid going out as much as possible.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296733600000000}Oh, yes.
Thank you for being so helpful.
We'll be careful.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931601}{C:81958296F12200000000}Thanks to your efforts,
the excavation of Panzer Blades
is proceeding smoothly.

{C:81958296F22200000000}(Through this conflict,
I should be able to guide humanity's evolution.)

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296F32200000000}I see...

{C:81931701}{C:81958296AF0100000000}You! His Majesty is addressing you in person,
and you dare respond
with such insolence!

{C:81931601}{C:81958296F42200000000}It's all right, High.

{C:81931701}{C:81958296B00100000000}I spoke out of turn.
Forgive me, Your Majesty.


{C:81931601}{C:81958296F62200000000}(I do not know
what you are plotting.

{C:81958296F82200000000}But the longer the conflict continues,
the better it serves my purposes.)






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D101}{C:81958296F92200000000}It's a pleasure to meet you, travelers from beyond the Cloud Sea.
I'm {C:819782830400}Quatre Raberba Winner.{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296FA2200000000}Would you let me join you
to fight Posaydal's army?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2200000000}That's a very straightforward request.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296FD2200000000}Considering the movements of Posaydal's army,
we don't have time to take things slowly.
Would you please let me join you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FE2200000000}What do you think, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FF2200000000}What do I think...?
What should we do, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296002300000000}Don't pass it off to me.
It all comes down to whether
we can trust him, doesn't it?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296022300000000}I'll do anything
to earn your trust!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296032300000000}Anything?
Then you can clean the Astante's toilets
for as long as you're aboard!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296052300000000}...All right.
I've never cleaned toilets before,
but I'll do my very best!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296062300000000}Oh, no, I'm kidding!
The toilet cleaning was a joke!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296072300000000}A joke...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296082300000000}Anyone willing to fight alongside us
is more than welcome.
It's good to have you... May I call you Quatre?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296092300000000}Yes.
I'm glad to be working with you too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D101}{C:819582960A2300000000}From what I've learned,
this land is ruled by 
{C:819782830400}Mardoul{C:819782830000}, who has allied with Posaydal's army.

{C:819582960C2300000000}Mardoul also appears to have ties
to a ship with the same shape
as yours.

{C:81900300}{C:819582960D2300000000}This continent's caught up in it too.
We have to do something, fast.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E2300000000}(That's right.
There's Lun to think about too.
We have to hurry.)

{C:8190D101}{C:819582960F2300000000}I've heard there are anti-Mardoul forces,
but unfortunately,
I don't know where...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102300000000}Don't you know anyone
who might know?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296112300000000}{C:819782830400}Azuves{C:819782830000} is an old knight
I've heard
is leading them.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296122300000000}Azuves...
It looks like we'll have to find him.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296132300000000}For now, let's go
wherever we can.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296152300000000}Do they mean us?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296162300000000}I think so, but ignore them, ignore them.
I'm sure nothing good will come of it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172300000000}Agreed. Let's ignore them.

{C:81901C01}{C:81958296182300000000}You there!
Ignoring me only makes you
all the more suspicious!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192300000000}Oops. That backfired.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:819582961C2300000000}That was a close call.

{C:81900300}{C:819582961D2300000000}Thank you very much.
Um, your name...?



{C:81900E01}{C:819582961F2300000000}This land is ruled
by the Conqueror King, Mardoul.
You would do well to be careful.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296202300000000}Aw, he's gone.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296212300000000}You silly children.
That was the hero Azuves
you've been looking for.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296232300000000}It was?!
We missed our chance.

{C:81958296242300000000}Um, where could we go
to meet Azuves?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296262300000000}Who knows?
There aren't that many places you can go.
You'll have to do your best on your own.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D101}{C:819582964F2300000000}Oh, isn't that
Azuves over there?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296502300000000}It is! We did it, Quatre!
We've found Azuves!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296512300000000}We did.
Let's go speak to him!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296522300000000}Yeah!

{C:81958296552300000000}Excuse me, Azuves!!

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296562300000000}Ah, you're the people from earlier.
What can I do for you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296572300000000}Are you... Azuves?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296582300000000}Indeed I am.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296592300000000}We heard you're
with the anti-Mardoul...


{C:81900E01}{C:819582965A2300000000}Ah, that.
Then this isn't the place.
Let's meet aboard your ship.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B2300000000}Yes.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900D01}{C:819582965E2300000000}Are you the ones
looking for Azuves?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965F2300000000}Yes, but who are you?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296612300000000}That doesn't matter.
You want to know where Azuves is,
don't you, boys?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296622300000000}You know?!

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296632300000000}{C:819782830300}Iron City{C:819782830000} is the other town.
Try going there.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296662300000000}She might be lying.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296682300000000}What a rude little girl.
Well, whether you believe me
is up to you boys.

{C:81958296692300000000}Do as you please.


{C:81900400}{C:819582966B2300000000}What do we do?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2300000000}We have to find him,
so trusting her is one option.

{C:81900400}{C:819582966D2300000000}So we're just making it up
as we go along after all.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966E2300000000}That's right.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:819582968A2300000000}Ah, you're back.
My apologies for earlier.

{C:819582968B2300000000}The anti-Mardoul forces
are still far too weak.
Too much attention would cause us trouble.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C2300000000}I'm sorry.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582968D2300000000}No, no, don't worry about it.
Now, why were you
looking for us?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968E2300000000}We came to this continent pursuing
a ship called the Norstan.

{C:819582968F2300000000}We heard it had allied
with someone called Mardoul here...

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296902300000000}You mean to lend us your strength?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296912300000000}Would you
accept us?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296922300000000}Young people with such honest eyes
are rare in this day and age.
Very well.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296932300000000}Thank you very much.


{C:81900E01}{C:81958296952300000000}Then let me introduce our comrades.
Could you take this ship
to where they are?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296962300000000}Yes!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296972300000000}This is all thanks to Quatre.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296982300000000}We found him
because we all searched together.
I didn't do it alone.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296992300000000}That's not true.
We wouldn't have learned anything
if you hadn't joined us, Quatre.

{C:819582969A2300000000}Thanks, Quatre.

{C:8190D101}{C:819582969C2300000000}Thank you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930E01}{C:819582969D2300000000}Forgive me, but {C:819782830300}White Valley{C:819782830000} is where
I'd like to go as soon as possible.
Please head straight there.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582969E2300000000}Welcome back, Grandpa.
Huh? Who are they?

{C:81900E01}{C:819582969F2300000000}Ah, Jojo.
These people will fight Mardoul
alongside us.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296A02300000000}Really, Grandpa?!
All right!
I'll go tell everyone!!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A12300000000}He's an energetic boy.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296A32300000000}My grandson's name is {C:819782830400}Jojo.{C:819782830000} Now,
shall we go to the square?



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296A52300000000}Heroes who have crossed the Cloud Sea
have joined us!

{C:81958296A72300000000}Comrades of White Valley!
Give them a warm welcome!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B90100000000}Aww, no!
You said you didn't believe it,
Jojo!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296A82300000000}Things have changed.
I want to fight too.

{C:81958296A92300000000}The blacksmith {C:819782830400}Shulove{C:819782830000} told you about 
{C:819782830400}Galient{C:819782830000}'s location.
I want you to take me there.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BA0100000000}{C:819782830400}A Kurakku{C:819782830000} could have its lair
there, you know.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296AA2300000000}Don't worry.
I'll protect you.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BB0100000000}Then all right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AB2300000000}(Huh? Where are Jojo
and the others going?)

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296AD2300000000}I'm counting on you from here on.
I'll remain in White Valley
for a while.

{C:81958296AE2300000000}I must bring the people
of the valley together.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AF2300000000}Yes, Azuves.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900D01}{C:81958296B02300000000}Oh, it's you.
I'm glad
you found Azuves.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B32300000000}Just who are you?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296B52300000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Hilmocha.{C:819782830000}
One thing's certain:
I'm on Jojo's side.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B72300000000}I'll believe you for now.
Being suspicious of people doesn't come naturally to me.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296B92300000000}You're a good boy.
But the young ladies there
don't seem convinced.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296BA2300000000}I don't really...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296BB2300000000}I'm not convinced.
You're far too suspicious.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296BD2300000000}Ahahaha! That's true.
Well, think whatever you like.
I'm not going to run or hide.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296BF2300000000}Then I will.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02300000000}Um, it's Jojo, right?
What are you doing?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C12300000000}Oh, just something.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C22300000000}You're going to look
for that Gali-something, aren't you?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C32300000000}How did you know?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C52300000000}When you talk that loudly,
anyone can hear you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C62300000000}Could we come along too?
I'm a little curious.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C72300000000}Sure, but
it might be a Kurakku's lair.
Are you still all right with that?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C82300000000}What's a Kurakku?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BC0100000000}It's a really huge,
loooong creature.
It could swallow the likes of you in one gulp.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C92300000000}What?!
Let's not go, big brother!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA2300000000}It sounds interesting.
I'll go
with Jojo.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CB2300000000}Then Nelfea and I
will wait here.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CC2300000000}Huh? I'm waiting too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CD2300000000}Sorry, Nelfea.
Stay here with Rie.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CE2300000000}Yes, yes.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296CF2300000000}Then let's go.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BD0100000000}There's absolutely nothing here.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D02300000000}Were we tricked?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BE0100000000}A little farther.
Let's try going just a little farther.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D12300000000}Still, I'm impressed
that you two can walk normally
in a place like this.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D22300000000}We've had different training.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BF0100000000}There's something written here.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D32300000000}You're right.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296D52300000000}Can you hear me?!
The enemy has begun attacking!
Hurry back to the Astante!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D62300000000}Understood! I'll be right back!!

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296D82300000000}I'll go out in Galient too!

{C:81930B01}{C:81958296C00100000000}Will you be all right, Jojo?

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296D92300000000}I'll be fine! I can do it!!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296DC2300000000}I've been waiting.
I'll join the battle too!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DD2300000000}You can handle it, Jojo?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296DF2300000000}I piloted it all the way here.
I'll be fine!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E02300000000}You heard him, Rie!
We're reorganizing the units!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E12300000000}The enemy's close.
Hurry!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931901}{C:81958296E22300000000}When did those wretches
get hold of a ship like that?

{C:81958296E52300000000}So that's the ship Mardoul spoke of.
Well, no matter.
I'll simply crush them!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296EA2300000000}Grandpa!
Where's Churull?!

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296EB2300000000}I haven't seen her.
Has something happened to Churull?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296EC2300000000}No, it's nothing.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296ED2300000000}Where could Churull be?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE2300000000}Let's look for clues.
We'll help you too.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EF2300000000}Was Hilmocha
our enemy after all?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F02300000000}Somehow, I can't believe it.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F12300000000}To tell the truth,
I find it a little hard to believe too.

{C:81958296F22300000000}Whatever I said,
she didn't look like a bad person.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296F32300000000}Whatever the case,
we have to find Churull.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900C01}{C:81958296670000000000}Hey, boys and girls.
I've got a great proposition.
Want in?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296042400000000}Ignore him, ignore him.

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296680000000000}That's cold.
I've got a great way
to make some money, you know.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296062400000000}Ignore him, ignore him.

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296690000000000}If you help me,
I'll tell you something good.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296082400000000}Ignore him, ignore him.

{C:81900C01}{C:819582966A0000000000}Aww, all right, all right.
Forget the money-making scheme.
Fine, I'll tell you anyway.

{C:819582966B0000000000}The girl you're looking for
isn't here anymore.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582960B2400000000}You mean Churull?
Then where
did she go?!

{C:81900C01}{C:819582966C0000000000}{C:819782830300}Iron City{C:819782830000}--isn't that the way she went?
If she's not here,
where else would she be?

{C:8190D101}{C:819582960D2400000000}Thank you very much.

{C:81900C01}{C:819582966D0000000000}Hold on a second.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102400000000}What now? Do you still want something?

{C:81900C01}{C:819582966E0000000000}Well, you look like
you'd be fun to be around.
Could you take me along too?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296122400000000}We're in a hurry.
Do as you please.

{C:81900C01}{C:819582966F0000000000}I see, I see!
I'm the great thief, {C:819782830400}Red Window.{C:819782830000}
Good to meet you!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296152400000000}If Churull isn't here,
we have no more business here.
Let's get back to the Astante!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296162400000000}Window!
What are you doing? You're late!

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296700000000000}What do you mean?
Now that I'm one of you,
I brought a little gift.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296182400000000}A gift?

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296710000000000}Yep. Take it.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582961A2400000000}How did you get something like this...?
Thanks, Window!

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296720000000000}Don't mention it.
We're comrades, after all.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582961C2400000000}Big brother, the enemy's arriving overhead.
Finish organizing the units
while you still can.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961D2400000000}Understood!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931801}{C:819582961E2400000000}So that's the ship from another world...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931701}{C:81958296C30100000000}You traitors who defy His Majesty Mardoul!
I'll teach you a lesson!!

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296232400000000}Hey, you! Let me talk too!

{C:81931701}{C:81958296C40100000000}H-hey, brat!
Don't interrupt!

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296242400000000}Shut uuup!
I won't be satisfied
unless I'm first, no matter what!

{C:81931701}{C:81958296C50100000000}(What is His Majesty thinking,
letting a child like this aboard?)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A01}{C:81958296252400000000}This is amazing!
With this kind of strength,
we can beat even Mardoul!

{C:81958296262400000000}I have to tell Grandpa!!
{C:819782830300}White Valley{C:819782830000}--take us
back there!!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296272400000000}J-Jojo?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296282400000000}You can't expect to win
by rushing straight into battle.
Calm down a little!

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296292400000000}It'll be all right!
We're so strong!

{C:81930100}{C:819582962A2400000000}Rie, please take us
back to White Valley for now.
That would be best.

{C:81930300}{C:819582962B2400000000}Yes, all right.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296C60100000000}Jojooo!!

{C:81900A01}{C:819582962C2400000000}Churull!
Why are you here?!

{C:81900D01}{C:819582962D2400000000}I'm sorry, Jojo.

{C:81958296302400000000}I wanted you to travel around
and get used to Galient,
so I asked Churull to help.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296312400000000}But Churull's voice back then
didn't sound like an act.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296C70100000000}That's because
I didn't know at first!

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296332400000000}She was so noisy
that I explained it to her along the way.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296342400000000}Oh, so that's it.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296352400000000}Churull is safe.
Isn't that what matters?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296362400000000}And Hilmocha wasn't our enemy either.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296382400000000}What, were you still suspicious of me?

{C:81900400}{C:819582963A2400000000}A little... yes.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582963B2400000000}Never mind that now.
Let's go see Grandpa.
I'm going to fight Mardoul as soon as I can!

{C:81900D01}{C:819582963C2400000000}Jojo, wait a minute!
What on earth happened?

{C:81930100}{C:819582963F2400000000}Hilmocha, your plan
may have had the opposite effect.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296412400000000}Grandpa!
We can beat Mardoul now!

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296422400000000}What on earth has happened,
Jojo?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296432400000000}Fighting alongside everyone made me realize it!
With Galient and that ship,
we're sure to win!

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296442400000000}Don't be foolish!
The fighting has only just begun!

{C:81958296472400000000}Besides, just defeating Mardoul
won't end this conflict.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964A2400000000}Hilmocha...

{C:81900E01}{C:819582964B2400000000}Hilmocha is right.
You mustn't overestimate your own strength.
Strength alone isn't enough.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582964D2400000000}What? Even you, Grandpa?!
Fine! I'll do it,
even if I have to go alone!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582964E2400000000}Jojo!

{C:81900E01}{C:819582964F2400000000}What a troublesome boy...
Will you go after him?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296502400000000}Oh, yes!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296512400000000}...I'll go too.
No, please let me go.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296522400000000}We'll return to the Astante.
If Jojo comes, we'll keep him there.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296532400000000}I'm counting on you, Nelfea.
Let's go, Quatre.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296562400000000}Window,
has Jojo come here?

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296740000000000}Jojo?
Nope, I haven't seen him.

{C:81958296750000000000}Anyway,
this is a nice place.
I've really taken a liking to it.

{C:81958296760000000000}So, what was that about Jojo?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965A2400000000}If he hasn't come here, never mind.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582965B2400000000}Azuves,
has Jojo come back?

{C:81900E01}{C:819582965C2400000000}No, not yet.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965D2400000000}All right.
I'll look somewhere else.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582965E2400000000}I'm sorry to put you to such trouble,
but please find him.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965F2400000000}Yes.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D101}{C:81958296642400000000}Please listen, Jojo.
I've been through something similar myself.
I was obsessed with power...

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296652400000000}You, Quatre?
You don't seem like that.

{C:8193D101}{C:81958296662400000000}Thank you, Jojo.
But it's true.

{C:81958296672400000000}And...
what do you think happened?

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296682400000000}You won, right?

{C:8193D101}{C:81958296692400000000}It isn't a matter
of winning or losing.

{C:819582966A2400000000}I nearly killed
a dear friend with my own hands.
In fact, I came close to killing them.

{C:819582966B2400000000}Jojo, that's how dangerous it is
to have power
and let it go to your head.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582966C2400000000}Then what should I do...?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966D2400000000}Listen, Jojo.
Why don't you travel to the other continents... with us?

{C:81900A01}{C:819582966E2400000000}The other continents?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966F2400000000}Yes. We'll have Azuves
come with us too.

{C:81958296702400000000}He'll be able to see
how you grow
as a person.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296712400000000}I also think that would be better
for learning all sorts of things.
What do you say?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296722400000000}...I'll do it.
Yes! I'll go with you
and earn Grandpa's recognition!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296732400000000}Let's do our best, Jojo!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296742400000000}It's good to be working with you again.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296752400000000}Let's do our best together.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900F01}{C:81958296772400000000}Ah, so these are the young heroes!

{C:81958296792400000000}I am {C:819782830400}Don Slarzen.{C:819782830000}
Until now,
I was wagging my tail for Mardoul.

{C:819582967B2400000000}But from now on,
I shall fight alongside you.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582967C2400000000}Lord Slarzen is a warrior like few others.
You can count on him, Jojo.

{C:81900F01}{C:819582967D2400000000}Such praise from the hero Azuves
makes me blush.
I shall do all I can for you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:819582967E2400000000}Ah, there you are!
Come to the Astante.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2400000000}What's happened?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296802400000000}The people who seized Posaydal's ship
have come, but...
Anyway, could you come?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296812400000000}I'll be right there.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296842400000000}Ugwah!!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296852400000000}Whoa! Himiko!
How many times do I have to tell you to stop?!
Um... Are you all right?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296862400000000}Ugggh...
If she does that again, I might die.

{C:81958296872400000000}...
So, are you the ones
who took over a ship from Posaydal's army?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296882400000000}That's right!
{C:819782830400}Wataru{C:819782830000} went bang, kaboom,
and rat-a-tat-tat-tat-tat!

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296892400000000}Hey, Himiko.
No one can understand an explanation like that.

{C:819582968A2400000000}In short, we defeated
the villains and seized their ship.
Now we're looking for allies.

{C:819582968B2400000000}Then we heard rumors about you,
and so we came here.
Will you fight alongside us?

{C:8190B901}{C:819582968C2400000000}Allow me to join you too.


{C:81900400}{C:819582968D2400000000}You're letting people this strange
join us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968F2400000000}We need allies.
I'm sure we'll manage.

{C:81958296902400000000}Um, {C:819782830400}Shibaraku{C:819782830000},
I understand the situation.
Let's fight together.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296922400000000}Yes. I'm counting on you.








{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296932400000000}Are these...
your new comrades?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942400000000}Yes, they are.
They're a little eccentric, though.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296952400000000}Oh, yes, my thanks are overdue.
Thank you
for persuading Jojo.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296962400000000}No, that was thanks to Quatre.
I couldn't do anything.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296972400000000}You're too modest.
As you suggested,
I shall go with Jojo as well.

{C:81958296982400000000}Slarzen, of course,
will do the same.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296992400000000}That's reassuring!
Thank you, Azuves.

{C:8190A502}{C:819582969B2400000000}Sorry to interrupt.
I noticed a little while ago,
and thought I should tell you the Cloud Sea has cleared.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969C2400000000}Nelfea!

{C:81900400}{C:819582969D2400000000}Prepare for departure, right?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2400000000}I'm counting on you!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582969F2400000000}We've suddenly gained so many more people again.
So, are we leaving already?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A02400000000}The Cloud Sea seems to have opened up,
so I'd like to get moving soon.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A12400000000}But there's just one problem.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A22400000000}Apparently there are enemies overhead again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A32400000000}We have more allies now.
I'm sure we'll manage.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296A42400000000}Hold a moment!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A52400000000}Whoa, you startled me!
You were here?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296A62400000000}Enemies overhead, you say?
I must call {C:819782830400}Senjinmaru{C:819782830000} at once!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A72400000000}Senjinmaru?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296A82400000000}Is there a public telephone nearby?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296AA2400000000}Of course there isn't
anything like that here!

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296AB2400000000}Oh, no!
That makes me completely useless!


{C:8190A702}{C:81958296AC2400000000}You mean a hippo?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD2400000000}I can't deal with this.
Rie, let's go!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931801}{C:81958296AF2400000000}Your strength... I'll put it to the test!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296442300000000}Whoa?!
W-what's going on?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B60100000000}Oh, I'm sorry!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296452300000000}I told you, didn't I?
It's dangerous to run.

{C:81958296462300000000}I'm sorry about that.
Come on, Churull, you apologize too!

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B70100000000}I'm soooorry!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296472300000000}Oh, it's all right.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296482300000000}More importantly, are you hurt?
Um... Churull, was it?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B80100000000}Nope! I'm fine!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296492300000000}I'm really sorry.
We'll be going now.


{C:81900300}{C:819582964A2300000000}They're such lively children.


{C:81900400}{C:819582964B2300000000}They're just like you, Rie.

{C:81900300}{C:819582964D2300000000}What's that supposed to mean?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964E2300000000}(I thought so too,
but I'm glad I didn't say it...)





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A802}{C:81958296272300000000}Hmm? Where might I be?
Oh, pretty laaadies!


{C:8190A802}{C:81958296292300000000}Pray, wait a moment!
You beautiful young ladies there,
would you answer a question for me?

{C:81900400}{C:819582962A2300000000}A hippo. A hippo's talking...

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B2300000000}Nelfea, that's rude.

{C:819582962C2300000000}Um, if it's something we know,
we'll answer.

{C:8190A802}{C:819582962D2300000000}I live on {C:819782830300}Mt. Soukai{C:819782830000}, and I am 
{C:819782830400}Shibaraku Tsurugibe{C:819782830000}, a master swordsman.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962E2300000000}Thank you for introducing yourself.
I'm Rie Akatsuki.
So, um, what was your question?

{C:8190A802}{C:819582962F2300000000}Where might I be?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296302300000000}Huh?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296312300000000}I thought I was traveling with {C:819782830400}Wataru{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830400}Himiko{C:819782830000}
on Mt. Soukai, but...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296322300000000}I'm afraid we don't know
