anything about this continent either.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296342300000000}Hmm... Is this {C:819782830400}Doakudar{C:819782830000}'s trap?
Or perhaps...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296352300000000}Doakudar?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296362300000000}Ah, forgive me.
I shall take my leave.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296372300000000}He seemed out of place
in all sorts of ways.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296382300000000}Yeah...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296392300000000}A bar, huh?
I wonder if Azuves
would be somewhere like this.


{C:81901701}{C:81958296B20100000000}You lot!
This is no place
for brats like you!

{C:81958296B30100000000}Leave at once.

{C:81900400}{C:819582963A2300000000}What?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B2300000000}Don't, Nelfea.

{C:819582963C2300000000}I understand.
Excuse us.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296B40100000000}As long as you understand.

{C:81900400}{C:819582963D2300000000}Why did you
back down so easily?

{C:8190D101}{C:819582963E2300000000}We're in enemy territory,
so it's wiser to keep a low profile
until we find Azuves.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296402300000000}That's true,
but it's so frustrating!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296412300000000}I'm frustrated too.
But for now, we have to put up with it.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296422300000000}All right, I get it!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296732300000000}Ughghghghghghgh...

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296742300000000}Huh?
Wataru, there's something weird about him.
He isn't recovering right away!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296752300000000}That's what I told you!
People in this world
have different bodies from ours!

{C:81958296762300000000}He might be seriously hurt!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296772300000000}Is thaaat so?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296782300000000}Big brother, are you all right?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2300000000}Ow, ow, ow...
I'm all right for now.

{C:8190A502}{C:819582967B2300000000}I'm sorry, mister.
Come on, Himiko, you apologize too!

{C:8190A702}{C:819582967C2300000000}Nahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry!

{C:8190A502}{C:819582967D2300000000}I said apologize properly!

{C:8190A702}{C:819582967E2300000000}I apologize properly.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2300000000}It's all right. I'm not hurt.
But please, no more
headbutts, okay?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296802300000000}Got it!
You're a nice guy, mister.

{C:81958296812300000000}I'm Himiko!
I'm the head of the Shinobibe clan!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822300000000}I see. Nice to meet you.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296832300000000}Nice to meet you!
This is Wataru.

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296842300000000}I'm Wataru Ikusabe.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296852300000000}It looks fun over there!
Fuhahahaha...


{C:8190A502}{C:81958296862300000000}The savior of Mt. Soukai... Hey,
Himiko!

{C:81958296872300000000}We're really sorry!
Bye!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296882300000000}Is it just me, or do they
seem completely out of place
in this world?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296892300000000}I agree...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901C01}{C:81958296F42300000000}Heh heh heh heh heh heh heh!
You're from another continent, aren't you?!
It's obvious from your clothes!!

{C:81958296F52300000000}I'll capture you and drag you
before His Majesty!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62300000000}Not again!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296F72300000000}Let's run!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B901}{C:81958296F82300000000}Good grief. How uncivilized.
Are you all right, mademoiselle?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F92300000000}Oh, thank you.
You saved me.

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296FA2300000000}I am {C:819782830400}George de Sand.{C:819782830000}
Might I ask your name?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FB2300000000}I'm R-Rie Akatsuki.

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296FC2300000000}Rie... What a beautiful name.
Miss Rie, this is a dangerous place.
Please take care.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FD2300000000}Y-yes...

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296FE2300000000}Now, if you'll excuse me.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296FF2300000000}Heh.
He's rather unusual, isn't he?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296002400000000}He's so pretentious...
He's unbelievably pretentious.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296012400000000}Isn't that fine?
Rie seems happy enough.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296022400000000}I guess so...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296B12400000000}Something's approaching fast from the ground!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B22400000000}We're going to battle stations!
Big brother, Nelfea,
prepare to launch!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B32400000000}OK!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939302}{C:81958296B42400000000}Heh-heh!
No matter how many times you come,
I'll beat you!

{C:81939502}{C:81958296B52400000000}{C:819782830400}Kotaro{C:819782830000}, 
{C:819782830400}Chief Taiga{C:819782830000} told us not to do this!
This is bad, right, {C:819782830400}Rikiya{C:819782830000}?!

{C:81939702}{C:81958296B62400000000}Kotaro!
We all agreed, didn't we?!
You can't just launch on your own!

{C:81939302}{C:81958296B72400000000}What are you talking about? 
{C:819782830400}Yosuke{C:819782830000}, you and Rikiya are aboard 
{C:819782830400}Gambaruger{C:819782830000} too, aren't you?

{C:81958296B82400000000}If we beat them quickly, 
{C:819782830400}Guy{C:819782830000} will be
pleased too!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939502}{C:81958296B92400000000}Something's coming up from the ground?!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296BA2400000000}Big brother, Nelfea,
we're receiving a transmission,
so hold off on launching!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:81958296BB2400000000}This is the captain of the GGG Mobile Unit,
{C:819782830400}Guy Shishioh{C:819782830000}.
We have no intention of fighting you.

{C:81958296BC2400000000}If you don't intend to fight either, 
{C:819782830300}Tokio{C:819782830000} is where I'd like you to land.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296C22400000000}I've confirmed the Tokio marker.
We're going down.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296C32400000000}We'd be better off
avoiding a pointless fight.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C42400000000}I'll leave it to you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296C82400000000}What are you trying
to do on this continent?!

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296CA2400000000}It's none of your business,
and I don't care what you think.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296CB2400000000}Whatever evil you're planning,
it will be stopped!

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296CC2400000000}I don't care
who does what.
In fact, it suits me.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296CD2400000000}Suits you?
What do you mean?

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296CE2400000000}Who knows?



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:81958296CF2400000000}I'm glad you came down.
There's a lot I'd like to discuss, but I have something to do.
Sorry, but come with me for a moment.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D02400000000}Uh... All right.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:81958296DB2400000000}He's gone...

{C:81958296DC2400000000}Thank you for coming with me.
This isn't the place,
so I'll show you to our base.

{C:81958296DD2400000000}We can take our time talking there.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906101}{C:81958296DE2400000000}...And that's how we drove the enemy back.
Afterward, Mamoru went with Galeon
to see how the other continents are doing.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296DF2400000000}You must be very powerful to have driven them back.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296E02400000000}That was thanks to the Ganba Team's efforts.
We couldn't have managed
on our own.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E12400000000}The Ganba Team...
Are they the pilots
of that big robot we saw earlier?

{C:81958296E22400000000}Where are the people who pilot it?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296E32400000000}Come to think of it...
Where did they go?

{C:81905801}{C:81958296E42400000000}They were fighting over there.
They're bursting with energy!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296E52400000000}They're at it again?
Oh, well. I'll introduce
the Ganba Team later.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F52400000000}{C:819782830400}Chief Taiga{C:819782830000}, may we look around
the city too?

{C:81906101}{C:81958296F62400000000}Heroes of the Astante,
I guarantee your freedom.
You may do as you please.

{C:81958296F72400000000}But I'm sorry to ask that you stay
here in Tokio until Guy returns.
Is that all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F82400000000}Understood.
Let's go, Rie, Nelfea.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F92400000000}Yes!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FA2400000000}I'm only coming along
because I'm worried about you two!
Honestly...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B501}{C:81958296530200000000}Tenpa kyoran!
Look!
The East is burning red!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B601}{C:81958296062500000000}Um...
Have you seen a man
with a scar on his cheek around here?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296072500000000}Oh, that man?
He was on Main Street
with an elderly man with a braid.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296082500000000}An elderly man with a braid...?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296092500000000}Yes, that's right.
They were making a fuss about
'The School of Something-or-Other is...'

{C:8190B601}{C:819582960C2500000000}That idiot!

{C:81900300}{C:819582960E2500000000}Idiot?

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296102500000000}Oh, how unseemly of me.
Ohoho... It's nothing.
Thank you. Goodbye!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296112500000000}She's beautiful, but she's strange.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296122500000000}Someone with a scar on his cheek?
Hmm, did we see anyone like that?
Do you remember, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296132500000000}At least,
we hadn't met him
before we came here.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296152500000000}I see...
Thank you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909602}{C:81958296192500000000}This is your fault, Kotaro.
You ignored Chief Taiga when he told you not to,
and launched Gambaruger!

{C:81909202}{C:819582961A2500000000}I couldn't help it!
I thought they were enemies!

{C:81909402}{C:819582961B2500000000}The Chief wasn't angry,
so you two should stop it, Rikiya and Kotaro!

{C:819582961C2500000000}Besides, it's careless
to talk in a place like this.
People will find out who we are.


{C:81930100}{C:819582961D2500000000}Oh, so you're the Ganba Team
Guy told us about.

{C:81900300}{C:819582961E2500000000}You're amazing, piloting such a huge robot
when you're only children!

{C:81909402}{C:819582961F2500000000}Aah! They've found us out!!

{C:81909602}{C:81958296202500000000}Everyone, Flashing!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909602}{C:81958296212500000000}Flashing!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296222500000000}Flashing!

{C:81909402}{C:81958296232500000000}Wouldn't transforming now make things worse?
Oh, fine! Flashiiing!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909D02}{C:81958296242500000000}Hazuramu Saraiya!
I saw you! I saw you!
Ganba Team!

{C:81958296252500000000}Now that your identities are known,
you shall become dogs!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296262500000000}What is that?!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939502}{C:81958296272500000000}Aah! We were too late after all!
I don't want to be a dog!

{C:81939702}{C:81958296282500000000}Aah! If I become a dog,
I won't be able to be a baseball player!

{C:81939302}{C:81958296292500000000}Dad,
I'll be joining you soon...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909D02}{C:819582962A2500000000}Now, become dogs!
Hazuramu Saraiya!

{C:81909302}{C:819582962B2500000000}Aah! Wait, I'm not changing?!

{C:81909D02}{C:819582962C2500000000}Impossible! Why?!
Whyyy?!

{C:81909502}{C:819582962D2500000000}I've got it!
This isn't our world,
so the curse doesn't work here!

{C:81909702}{C:819582962E2500000000}Really, Yosuke?!

{C:81909502}{C:819582962F2500000000}Huh? Well, I don't have any proof.
I just thought that might be it.

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296302500000000}If my magic doesn't work,
I have no way to fight.

{C:81958296312500000000}Ganba Team,
I'll let you off for today!
Farewell!


{C:81909302}{C:81958296322500000000}If the curse doesn't work,
we don't have to worry about anything!
Oh, lucky us!

{C:81909702}{C:81958296332500000000}All right!
We'll fight to our hearts' content!!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296342500000000}Um, wait a moment...
They're gone.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296352500000000}Somehow, all we did was watch.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296362500000000}Oh, Guy!
Did you find anything out?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296372500000000}Yes.
All we learned was that Volfogg
was taken out by someone.

{C:81958296382500000000}There weren't any clues at all.
I'm at a loss.
How about you?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296392500000000}We saw some strange things,
but nothing in particular happened.

{C:81905401}{C:819582963A2500000000}I see...
Then why don't you come with me to 
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000} this time?

{C:819582963B2500000000}My cousin {C:819782830400}Renais{C:819782830000} is there.
She might have some information.

{C:81900300}{C:819582963C2500000000}Yes, that sounds good.
We won't learn anything
by staying here.

{C:81905401}{C:819582963D2500000000}Then let's go.
I'm rather looking forward to it.

{C:81900400}{C:819582963E2500000000}What are you looking forward to?

{C:81905401}{C:819582963F2500000000}Riding a ship from another continent.
I'm as excited as a child.
Come on, everyone, let's go!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CE01}{C:81958296402500000000}It looks like boarding that would be a good idea...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296412500000000}Oh, you have a plan?
Then I'll come to your ship.
Why don't you tell me about it?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296432500000000}So, what's your plan?


{C:81935F00}{C:81958296462500000000}Don't underestimate the Thirteen, brat.
I only let my guard down a little last time.
This time, that HM called {C:819782830400}GaoGaiGar{C:819782830000}...


{C:81935900}{C:81958296472500000000}It's a Super Mechanoid.

{C:81935F00}{C:81958296482500000000}Shut up!
A man shouldn't go on and on
about petty little details!

{C:819582964A2500000000}Anyway, I have a plan to steal the machines
so he can't combine.
Just keep quiet and watch!

{C:81930C00}{C:819582964B2500000000}I'll look forward to it, 
{C:819782830400}Nei Moh Han.{C:819782830000}


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905F00}{C:819582964C2500000000}Tch, what an unpleasant person.
Putting that aside...
You understand the plan, {C:819782830400}Gablae{C:819782830000}?

{C:81905900}{C:819582964D2500000000}Yes...

{C:81905F00}{C:819582964E2500000000}You don't seem very enthusiastic,
Gablae.

{C:81905900}{C:819582964F2500000000}That's... not true.

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296502500000000}Ahahaha! Don't lie.
It's written all over your face...

{C:81958296512500000000}Well, never mind.
I'm going down first.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905900}{C:81958296522500000000}Damn it!
Taking a woman hostage?!

{C:81958296532500000000}No matter how strong the enemy may be,
has that woman no sense
of a warrior's honor?!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935F00}{C:81958296542500000000}Gablae, what are you doing?
Hurry up and come down!

{C:81905900}{C:81958296562500000000}I have no choice.
I'm going down too!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:81958296572500000000}Huh, that's strange.
Renais was supposed to be waiting.

{C:81958296582500000000}Oh, well.
Let's look around for her.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:819582965A2500000000}I don't want to leave Kyoto
until we find Renais.
She has information on the enemy.

{C:819582965C2500000000}I'm sorry, but I need your help.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905901}{C:819582967B0000000000}Ahh, this tea is delicious.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296722500000000}Renais!
What are you doing
loafing around here?


{C:81905901}{C:819582967C0000000000}C-can't I
take a little break?

{C:819582967D0000000000}Besides, no one from GGG
has any right to criticize me.
I'm with Chasseur.

{C:819582967E0000000000}More importantly, Guy,
should you really be
taking it easy here?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296732500000000}What do you mean?

{C:81905901}{C:819582967F0000000000}{C:819782830400}Posaydal{C:819782830000}'s ship
has intruded again.
Haven't you heard the report?

{C:81958296800000000000}I sent word quite a while ago.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296742500000000}What?!

{C:81905901}{C:81958296810000000000}...Who's this?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296752500000000}Oh, he's a new ally.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296762500000000}Then have ships come
besides those of Posaydal's army?

{C:81905901}{C:81958296820000000000}Apparently.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296772500000000}Let's go, Guy!
They must be plotting something again.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296782500000000}All right.
For now, let's return to {C:819782830300}Tokio{C:819782830000}.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935701}{C:81958296792500000000}I wonder if he can fight the enemy
when he can't even perform Final Fusion.

{C:819582967A2500000000}Guy is always so reckless.
I'm worried...

{C:81935F00}{C:819582967B2500000000}Well, that's useful to know.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905900}{C:819582967D2500000000}You're finally back.
I have a message for you from Lady Nei.

{C:819582967E2500000000}We of Posaydal's army
have taken Mikoto Utsugi and the Gao-Machines.
If you want them back, listen to our demands.

{C:81900400}{C:819582967F2500000000}Aren't you ashamed
of taking a girl hostage?

{C:81905900}{C:81958296802500000000}Oh, shut up!
I don't want to use
such underhanded methods either!!

{C:81958296812500000000}Anyway!
If you want them back, Guy Shishioh,
follow me alone!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296832500000000}You only want me to come, right?
All right. I'll do as you say.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296842500000000}Guy!
It's obviously a trap!
And yet...

{C:81905401}{C:81958296852500000000}I'm a man, after all.
You understand?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872500000000}Yes!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296882500000000}Then I'm counting on you to handle the rest.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296892500000000}Let's go to the Astante.
We'll get ready
to launch at any time.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909702}{C:819582968A2500000000}Wait a minute!
We're coming aboard too!

{C:81909502}{C:819582968B2500000000}Guy's in trouble.
We can't just sit back.

{C:81909302}{C:819582968C2500000000}And we got the Chief's permission this time.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D2500000000}You're...!

{C:819582968E2500000000}...The Ganba Team, was it?

{C:81909702}{C:819582968F2500000000}Oh, dear...

{C:81909302}{C:81958296902500000000}Anyway!
Now that we're here,
you have nothing to worry about!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296922500000000}Hey, is it really all right
to be wandering around town at a time like this?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296932500000000}Shouldn't we hurry
back to the Astante?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942500000000}You're right.
Why did we come here?
Let's get back to the Astante.

{C:81937C00}{C:81958296962500000000}Not so fast.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972500000000}No way!
Why is there a robot in the middle of town?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296982500000000}Just run!!

{C:8193C001}{C:81958296992500000000}Halt!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C001}{C:819582969A2500000000}Fighting in the city is something I, the {C:819782830400}Undefeated of the East{C:819782830000}, 
{C:819782830400}Master Asia{C:819782830000}, shall not allow!!
Kaaaaah!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969D2500000000}You have a point.

{C:8190C001}{C:819582969E2500000000}You fool!
I saved you,
and that's how you speak of me?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582969F2500000000}I'm sorry...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A12500000000}Um... What's your name?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296A22500000000}{C:819782830400}Undefeated of the East.{C:819782830000}
{C:819782830400}Master Asia{C:819782830000} is what some call me.
I'm just a humble martial artist.

{C:81958296A32500000000}Posaydal's army
seems to be plotting all manner of things.
You should be careful on your travels too.

{C:81958296A52500000000}We will meet again someday.
For now, farewell.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B601}{C:81958296A62500000000}May I have a moment?
I've heard rumors.
You have a ship, don't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A72500000000}Yes, we do.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A82500000000}Big brother!
You shouldn't answer so readily!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A92500000000}It's all right.
Someone this beautiful
couldn't possibly do anything wrong.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296AB2500000000}Thank you for the compliment.

{C:81958296AD2500000000}Now, I have a favor to ask.
I'd like to come aboard your ship too.
Would that be all right?

{C:81958296AF2500000000}The person I'm looking for is in {C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000},
but I have no way to get there.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B02500000000}But we're fighting a war. It's dangerous.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296B12500000000}Oh, that's all right.
I'm quite used to danger.
Please, would you let me aboard?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B22500000000}All right.
But please understand
that there will be danger.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296B32500000000}Thank you.
I'm {C:819782830400}Rain Mikamura.{C:819782830000}
I'm counting on you to take me to Kyoto.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936101}{C:81958296B42500000000}This is Taiga.
Heroes of the Astante,
can you hear me?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B52500000000}This is the Astante.
We hear you clearly, Chief Taiga.

{C:81936101}{C:81958296B62500000000}Ah, Rie.
Guy has set out with the enemy aboard Phantom Gao for 
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296B72500000000}I think we'll have video soon.
I'd like you to provide support if necessary.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B82500000000}Yes.
We're ready whenever you need us.

{C:81935801}{C:81958296B92500000000}Chief, we have video of Guy.
I'll relay it to the Astante too!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935F00}{C:81958296BB2500000000}Ahahahaha!
You didn't think
just showing up would settle it, did you?!

{C:81958296BC2500000000}I have a little proposal.
Will you hear me out?

{C:81935401}{C:81958296BD2500000000}In my position,
I have no choice but to do whatever you say.

{C:81935F00}{C:81958296BE2500000000}You understand your position
very well, boy.
Then let me tell you.

{C:81958296BF2500000000}It's nothing very difficult.
I just want you to turn into
that Gao-something for me.


{C:81935900}{C:81958296C02500000000}Please don't, Lady Nei.
It would be trouble if he combined.

{C:81958296C12500000000}Wasn't the whole plan
to keep him from combining?

{C:81935F00}{C:81958296C22500000000}It's all right.
Apparently he can't combine,
so he'll fail and destroy himself.

{C:81935900}{C:81958296C42500000000}I see.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905801}{C:81958296C82500000000}Chief! Guy is requesting
authorization
for Final Fusion!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296C92500000000}Entouji... Oh, that's right, he's not here.
{C:819782830400}Swan{C:819782830000}, what are the chances of {C:819782830400}GaoFighGar{C:819782830000}'s docking
succeeding?!

{C:81905801}{C:81958296CB2500000000}It's not even ten percent!
It's extremely dangerous!

{C:81935401}{C:81958296CC2500000000}Chief, please!
I swear I'll protect Mikoto
and this continent!!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296CD2500000000}Well said!
That's what makes you a true hero!!

{C:81958296CE2500000000}Let's do it, Guy!
Final Fusion, approved!!

{C:81935801}{C:81958296CF2500000000}I'll start Program Driiive!!

{C:81935701}{C:81958296D02500000000}Guuuy!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935F00}{C:81958296D22500000000}What's going on, Gablae?!
He combined!
Huh? Who are you?!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935F00}{C:81958296D42500000000}Who the hell are you?!

{C:8193B501}{C:81958296D52500000000}I'm just a martial artist passing through.
I'm taking this woman with me!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905F00}{C:81958296D62500000000}Damn it, launch the ship!
I'll go out in Auge too!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296D82500000000}Hey, big guy!
I've rescued the princess.
You're free to fight!!

{C:81935401}{C:81958296D92500000000}Thank you!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:81958296DA2500000000}Rie!
Join up with us!!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DB2500000000}Understood!
The Astante is launching.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296DC2500000000}You're the captain...

{C:81958296DE2500000000}It seems we share a goal.
I'm coming aboard too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DF2500000000}Um, excuse me...?


{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296E02500000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Heero Yuy.{C:819782830000}
I'm an MS pilot.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E12500000000}Hey, you!
What do you think you're doing?!

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296E22500000000}I told you we share a goal.
If you can't believe me,
then don't.

{C:81958296E42500000000}I'll fight Posaydal's army,
even if I have to do it alone.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E72500000000}What?!
Will you please say something?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E82500000000}Hmm...


{C:81900300}{C:81958296E92500000000}Oh!
You feel it too, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB2500000000}I do.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296EC2500000000}What's with you two?!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED2500000000}Sorry, sorry.

{C:81958296EE2500000000}My brother and I
don't know why, but we feel
we can trust Heero.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2500000000}That's right.
I feel as though
I've known him for a long time.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296F02500000000}You too...?
When I look at you,
I feel something familiar too...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F22500000000}Then it's all right
to let Heero aboard, isn't it?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32500000000}If that's what you both think,
there's no point in my objecting.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296F42500000000}Then I can stay here?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F52500000000}Yes, Heero.
Please lend us your strength.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296F62500000000}Understood...




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:81958296F82500000000}I want to go and pick Mikoto up.
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000}--could you set me down there?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296F92500000000}Understood.
We're landing in Kyoto.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905701}{C:81958296FA2500000000}Guuuy!!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296FB2500000000}Mikoto!!
I'm so glad you're safe.

{C:81905701}{C:81958296FC2500000000}{C:819782830400}Domon Kasshu{C:819782830000}
saved me.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296FE2500000000}I just couldn't forgive
Posaydal's army for its cowardice.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296FF2500000000}You still saved her.
Thank you, Domon Kasshu.
How can I repay you?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296002600000000}Well, if I may be selfish,
I'd like to come aboard
your ship too.

{C:81958296032600000000}I'm looking for someone,
but without a means of transport,
there's not much I can do.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296042600000000}What do you think?
Could you let him aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296052600000000}I don't mind.
What do you think, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296062600000000}If someone strong wants to join us,
I have no reason to object, but...

{C:81905401}{C:81958296072600000000}But?



{C:8190B601}{C:819582960B2600000000}Ah, Domooon!!
So this is where you were!!

{C:8190B501}{C:819582960C2600000000}R-Rain!
Where have you been?!

{C:819582960D2600000000}I couldn't send out
{C:819782830400}God Gundam{C:819782830000}
because you weren't here!

{C:8190B601}{C:819582960F2600000000}What?!
You're the one who ran off
somewhere with Master!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102600000000}Sorry to interrupt your argument,
but we're rather busy.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296112600000000}Oh, I'm sorry.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296122600000000}Domon,
you have permission to come aboard,
so please settle your argument quickly.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296132600000000}Oh, right.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B501}{C:81958296142600000000}I'm Domon Kasshu.
I'll be relying on your hospitality for a while.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296152600000000}I'm Rain Mikamura.
Once again, I'm looking forward to working with you.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296162600000000}Now that the introductions are over, 
{C:819782830300}Tokio{C:819782830000}--could you head there?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296172600000000}Yes.
We'll take you to Tokio.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296182600000000}Sorry to trouble you, Rie.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906101}{C:819582961A2600000000}Welcome back, brave heroes!
Posaydal's army has withdrawn
from our continent!

{C:81909302}{C:819582961B2600000000}Of course it has!
We were fighting too!

{C:81909502}{C:819582961C2600000000}But Guy,
you managed to combine successfully
even with such low odds.

{C:81905401}{C:819582961E2600000000}Yes.
But more than the successful combination,
I'm relieved that Mikoto's safe.

{C:819582961F2600000000}And that was all thanks to you.
Thank you, everyone!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296202600000000}So...
what are you going to do now?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296212600000000}We're pursuing {C:819782830400}Norstan{C:819782830000},
a ship with the same shape as ours.

{C:81958296242600000000}The Cloud Sea seems to have opened up,
so we'd like to go to another continent.

{C:81905801}{C:81958296252600000000}Oh, you're leaving already?
I'll miss you!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296262600000000}Chief, could I go
with them too?

{C:81958296272600000000}They saved this continent.
I'd like to help them, even a little.

{C:81905701}{C:81958296282600000000}But if Guy leaves, 
{C:819782830300}Brave{C:819782830000}--what will happen to it?


{C:81906101}{C:81958296292600000000}I don't think we need to worry.
On the contrary, by going beyond this continent,
they should be able to keep the enemy in check.

{C:81905401}{C:819582962A2600000000}Chief, then...?!

{C:81906101}{C:819582962B2600000000}That's right, Guy!
Heroes know no borders!
Go and fight to save the world!!

{C:81905401}{C:819582962C2600000000}Mikoto... I'm sorry.
I'm going to fight alongside them.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935701}{C:819582962D2600000000}Once you've made up your mind, there's no stopping you.
All right. Go.
But promise me one thing.

{C:81935401}{C:819582962E2600000000}I know.
I'll come back. I promise!

{C:81935701}{C:819582962F2600000000}All right...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:81958296302600000000}What will you do, Renais?

{C:81905901}{C:81958296830000000000}I'll... stay here.
You need someone who can act
if anything happens, don't you?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296312600000000}You're right.
Take care of Brave, Renais.

{C:81909302}{C:81958296322600000000}Then let's go
with Guy!

{C:81909702}{C:81958296332600000000}Right.
Let's go beat the bad guys!

{C:81909502}{C:81958296342600000000}Kotaro, Rikiya,
you can't just decide on your own.
We should ask Chief Taiga properly.

{C:81906101}{C:81958296352600000000}{C:819782830400}Eldran{C:819782830000}'s brave heroes!
If that is what you wish, go.
It would be best for you to fight together.

{C:81909302}{C:81958296362600000000}That's our Chief!
You really understand!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296372600000000}That's how it is.
I'm counting on you, Rie!!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296382600000000}Yes, Chief Taiga.
I'm looking forward to working with you all.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296392600000000}Then let's depart!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296612500000000}Ugh, this is rough.
It's hard to ride
such a bucking bronco.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296642500000000}(The look on Lun's face back then was priceless.
Though according to her,
I was making a funny face too.

{C:81958296652500000000}Lun... You're all right, aren't you...?
You're not crying, are you...?)

{C:81905401}{C:81958296662500000000}What's wrong?
You look deep in thought.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296682500000000}Guy, what would you do
if Mikoto were kidnapped?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296692500000000}Hey, that's a grim thought.
Let's see... If it were me,
I'd do everything I could to get her back.


{C:81930100}{C:819582966A2500000000}Even if your life were in danger?

{C:81905401}{C:819582966B2500000000}Yeah, I'd fight with everything I've got!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2500000000}Is that because
you're a hero, Guy?

{C:81905401}{C:819582966D2500000000}No, it's less about being a hero
and more about what I'd do as a man.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966E2500000000}You're right.
Thank you, Guy!

{C:81905401}{C:819582966F2500000000}I haven't said anything
you need to thank me for.

{C:81958296702500000000}Well, if anything happens,
just tell me.
We're comrades, after all!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296712500000000}Yes.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A33200000000}The Cloud Stream is changing
here too, right?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296A43200000000}Yeah.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A53200000000}Doesn't this make you feel
someone's behind it?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296A63200000000}Someone's behind it...? You don't mean...!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A73200000000}That's exactly what I mean.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296A83200000000}Are you saying someone's moving
the Cloud Stream?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A93200000000}That's right.
Don't you think it's strange?

{C:81958296AA3200000000}Every time we enter a continent,
the same thing happens.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296AB3200000000}I thought about that too.
But I soon gave up thinking about it.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296AC3200000000}So did I.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3200000000}Why?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296AE3200000000}But, big bro,
you know how many years it took
to overcome the Cloud Stream, don't you?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296AF3200000000}Exactly.
It took a genius like Professor Rondo
to make it possible in the first place.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B03200000000}And even if someone could do that,
who would be doing it,
and what for?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B13200000000}Well...

{C:81930400}{C:81958296B23200000000}Besides, I wouldn't want to fight
someone who could control nature itself.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B33200000000}You've got a point there.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:819582963A2600000000}To let the Astante get as far as {C:819782830300}Pentagona{C:819782830000}
...

{C:819582963B2600000000}Posaydal's army
is utterly useless.

{C:81936E00}{C:819582963C2600000000}Boy.
I'm only letting you command
a fraction of my forces.

{C:81930C00}{C:819582963D2600000000}A fraction or otherwise,
that's none of my concern.
Useless is useless.

{C:81936E00}{C:819582963E2600000000}Then you don't mind if this ends
on this continent, boy?
Are you quite sure about that?


{C:81930C00}{C:819582963F2600000000}If they can't finish it,
you'll have to go yourself.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296402600000000}So this is Pentagona.
First, we should...


{C:81938200}{C:81958296412600000000}Just head for the enemy base.
We've got someone from this continent.
Right, Gaw Ha Leccee!?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935700}{C:81958296422600000000}I don't like your tone.
Posaydal isn't as easy to beat
as you seem to think!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296432600000000}We've been taking on the Titans
with only a small force.
Don't underestimate us!

{C:81935700}{C:81958296442600000000}You've got to be kidding!
I'm not here
to help you in the first place!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296452600000000}What did you say!?!

{C:81931A00}{C:81958296840000000000}Both of you, stop it!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296850000000000}We've only been able to keep fighting
because we've worked together, right?

{C:81958296860000000000}The Astante can't keep going
if we carry on like this!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296462600000000}Don't you want
to end this war soon?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296870000000000}Of course I do!
I want to end it
as soon as possible too!!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296472600000000}Then...!

{C:81905700}{C:81958296482600000000}I can't take this anymore!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296492600000000}Leccee?

{C:81905700}{C:819582964A2600000000}I said I can't take it anymore!
I'm through playing at war
like children having a fight!!

{C:819582964B2600000000}I'm getting off this ship!
Goodbye!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964C2600000000}Leccee, wait!

{C:81905700}{C:819582964D2600000000}Don't bother trying to stop me!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936F00}{C:819582964E2600000000}I'm with the Aman Trading Company.
The name's {C:819782830400}Amandra Kamandra{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296502600000000}I have all kinds of goods.
I'd like to supply you. What do you say?

{C:81958296522600000000}Why don't you come over
and take a look at my wares?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296532600000000}If Leccee were here,
we might know a little more.

{C:81958296542600000000}It could be a trap.
What will you do, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296552600000000}I'll ask him.

{C:81958296562600000000}Can you hear me, Mr. Kamandra?
I'm Rie Akatsuki, the captain.

{C:81958296572600000000}Could you tell me
why you want
to supply us?

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296582600000000}Why? It's quite simple.
You're from another continent,
and you interest me.

{C:81958296592600000000}So, will you come?
If you're worried, bring an escort.

{C:81900300}{C:819582965A2600000000}Understood.
We'll come and see you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B2600000000}Of course I'm coming with you.

{C:81908200}{C:819582965C2600000000}I'm partly responsible for what happened
with Leccee, so I'll come too.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582965D2600000000}Wait a moment.
There may be negotiations.
Surely this calls for a professional...


{C:8190A702}{C:819582965E2600000000}I wanna go too!

{C:8190A102}{C:819582965F2600000000}I'd like to go too.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296602600000000}Don't butt in, Hime.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296612600000000}What's that, You?
Don't you want to go?
You're curious, aren't you?

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296622600000000}Of course I am.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296642600000000}Wouldn't it be better
to send someone who can fight?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296652600000000}We shouldn't keep him waiting forever.
Rie, make the decision.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296662600000000}Um, then, big bro,
Sho... Kamille,
and Guy, please come with me.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296880000000000}Yeah, leave it to me.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296672600000000}Let's go.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935300}{C:819582966D2600000000}This is 
{C:819782830400}Daba Myroad{C:819782830000} of the rebel army.

{C:819582966E2600000000}Leccee has told me about you.
We're both fighting Posaydal's army,
and I'd like us to fight together.

{C:81930300}{C:819582966F2600000000}I'm Rie Akatsuki,
captain of the Astante.
Thank you for contacting us.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296702600000000}If we keep talking, Posaydal's army
might pick up our transmission.

{C:81958296712600000000}Could you come to {C:819782830300}Trydetol{C:819782830000},
please?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296722600000000}I've confirmed your marker.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296732600000000}Then I'll see you in Trydetol.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296742600000000}Can we really trust him so easily?
...There's no point asking, is there?
Your answer will be the same, right?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296752600000000}We have to start by trusting people.
Right, big bro?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296762600000000}Exactly.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296782600000000}Are you sure this is all right, Rain?

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296792600000000}The maintenance?
Leave it to me. It's my specialty.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2600000000}Thank you.

{C:8190B601}{C:819582967B2600000000}Thanks to Domon,
I know all too well how disastrous
poor maintenance can be.

{C:819582967C2600000000}So don't hesitate.
Leave the maintenance to me.
Besides...

{C:81930100}{C:819582967D2600000000}Besides?

{C:8190B601}{C:819582967E2600000000}You probably don't know this,
but Nelfea has been doing
bits of maintenance here and there.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2600000000}Nelfea has?

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296802600000000}Yes.
So it isn't that much work.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296812600000000}I had no idea...

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296822600000000}Make sure you thank Nelfea.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296832600000000}I will.
Well, Rain,
I'm counting on you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905600}{C:81958296842600000000}What!? Don't tell me you're
the owners of that ship!
You're all just children!!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296852600000000}You're hardly any different
from us yourself.
What are you talking about?

{C:81905600}{C:81958296862600000000}What's your problem!?
You've got some nerve
talking to me like that!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296872600000000}Why are you picking a fight
right from the start,
Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296882600000000}But...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296892600000000}Anyway, where can we find Daba?

{C:81905600}{C:819582968A2600000000}Sooorry!
I came to show you the way, didn't I?
Daba? He's in the {C:819782830300}meeting hall{C:819782830000}.

{C:819582968B2600000000}By the way, wasn't that idiot Leccee
with you?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C2600000000}She's off the ship at the moment.

{C:81905600}{C:819582968D2600000000}I thought so.
She was in Posaydal's army, after all.

{C:81908200}{C:819582968E2600000000}Leccee used to be
in Posaydal's army!?

{C:81905600}{C:819582968F2600000000}What, you didn't even
know that?

{C:81958296902600000000}She was quite a big shot
in Posaydal's army,
one of the Thirteen.

{C:81958296922600000000}She fell for Daba and changed sides, though.
So she's not here...

{C:81958296942600000000}I've got a report to make,
so I'll go ahead and see Daba.
Come to the meeting hall, okay?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296952600000000}Don't just walk off like that!
You're so irresponsible and selfish!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905300}{C:81958296A82600000000}You're the people who've been fighting
aboard the Astante, right?
It's a pleasure. I'm Daba Myroad.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AA2600000000}It's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Rie Akatsuki,
captain of the Astante.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296AB2600000000}And I'm one of her pilots,
Nelfea Northrock.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC2600000000}It's nice to meet you.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296AD2600000000}Welcome to Pentagona.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AE2600000000}About the ship from our continent...
Well... I'm sorry.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296AF2600000000}Why are you apologizing?
It's Posaydal's fault for using it.

{C:81958296B02600000000}If anything, we're more to blame.
We couldn't leave Pentagona,
and let Posaydal go unchecked.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B32600000000}That's not true at all.

{C:81905500}{C:81958296B42600000000}You both feel that way,
so isn't that good enough?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296B52600000000}Kyao!

{C:81958296B62600000000}This is my best friend and engineer,
{C:819782830400}Mirawoo Kyao{C:819782830000}.


{C:81905600}{C:81958296B72600000000}Daaaba!
Introduce me toooo!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296B82600000000}Amm, you went to meet them
and didn't even introduce yourself?
Honestly...

{C:81958296B92600000000}This is {C:819782830400}Fannaria Amm{C:819782830000}.
And, um...
How should I introduce you?

{C:81905600}{C:81958296BA2600000000}Ohhh, Daba, you're sooo mean!
Your girl-friend!
That's all you have to say.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296BB2600000000}But you're not, are you?
Anyway, she's one of our companions.

{C:81958296BC2600000000}About our next move,
we've also got allies in {C:819782830300}Mizun{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296BD2600000000}Could you head over there
for the time being?


{C:81905500}{C:81958296BE2600000000}You're going to Mizun?
Then I'll go on ahead.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905500}{C:81958296BF2600000000}Argh, shut up!
Give it a rest, old man!

{C:81958296C02600000000}I don't have time
to waste on you.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C12600000000}What's wrong, Kyao?

{C:81905500}{C:81958296C22600000000}Nothing.
He was just complaining to me.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296C32600000000}Ah, Daba.
Are these the people?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C42600000000}Yes, they're from the Astante.

{C:81958296C52600000000}This is {C:819782830400}Semuge Shato{C:819782830000}.
He leads a rebel group
separate from ours.

{C:81905800}{C:81958296C62600000000}I see, you've joined up safely.
Things have gone well on our end too.
Now, shall we start loading the cargo?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C72600000000}Please do.

{C:81958296C82600000000}Loading the supplies will take a while.
Why don't we take a walk around Mizun?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C92600000000}That sounds good.
Let's do that.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296CA2600000000}Oh, it's you.
The loading will still take some time.
Please wait a little longer.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296CB2600000000}Where have my brother, Nelfea
and Daba
gone off to?


{C:81958296CC2600000000}Hmm... Oh, well.
I'll ask that person over there...

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296CD2600000000}Argh!
What the hell is going on!?

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296CE2600000000}Calm down, En!
A true Japanese man
must keep his composure!

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296CF2600000000}Quit nagging me about everything!
Look, I'm trying it again.

{C:8190C002}{C:81958296D02600000000}It's pointless...

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296D12600000000}I reckon so too.

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296D22600000000}Shut up! I'm doing it!
Try, Dagwon!!
...It's no good!!

{C:8190BE02}{C:81958296D32600000000}But, hey...
When we were with Natsumi-chan,
couldn't we transform?

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296D52600000000}Right, that's just what
I was thinking.
I wonder what's going on.

{C:8190BF02}{C:81958296D62600000000}Well...
Maybe being outside our own world
has caused some biological change.

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296D72600000000}Yoku!
Are you sure about that!?

{C:8190BF02}{C:81958296D82600000000}Well, not exactly...

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296D92600000000}You!
Are you telling me you said that
without knowing for certain!?

{C:8190BE02}{C:81958296DA2600000000}More importantly,
where's Rai gone?

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296DB2600000000}He went off somewhere with that old man.
You know, the one in the martial arts outfit.

{C:8190C002}{C:81958296DC2600000000}That old man...
He knows something.
We should find them and join up.

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296DE2600000000}Then there's nothing to do but act!
Let's go, everyone!!

{C:8190BE02}{C:81958296DD2600000000}Yeah!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296560200000000}Oh, great, they've gone.
Nobody ever listens to anyone!
Oh, well. I'll look somewhere else.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296F42600000000}It's terrible, Daba!
{C:819782830300}Trydetol{C:819782830000} is under attack!
Could you come back at once?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F62600000000}Semuge,
have you finished loading the cargo?

{C:8190B801}{C:819582968D0000000000}We helped out!
It's all properly finished.
Right, Argo?

{C:8190BA01}{C:81958296F72600000000}Yeah...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F82600000000}Sai Saici, who's that?

{C:8190B801}{C:819582968E0000000000}{C:819782830400}Argo Gulskii{C:819782830000}.
He's a Gundam Fighter,
just like us.

{C:819582968F0000000000}He escaped from Astragius
and came to this continent, apparently.
Don't worry, you can trust him.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F92600000000}If you say so, Sai Saici,
I'll trust him.
It's good to meet you, Argo.

{C:8190BA01}{C:81958296FA2600000000}Yeah...







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296FC2600000000}I've heard what's happened.
You should organize your forces
and prepare for battle.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935900}{C:81958296FD2600000000}I've been waiting, people of the Astante!
Even with Daba Myroad on your side,
I won't lose!!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935300}{C:81958296FF2600000000}Gavlet Gablae,
I hear you've had one failure after another.
This will be no different!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905300}{C:81958296002700000000}Once we've had a little rest,
shall we discuss our next move?

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296012700000000}We've got more people now.
We should reconsider our positions too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296022700000000}Let's do that.

{C:8190A302}{C:81958296032700000000}A strong radio signal is coming in.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936E00}{C:81958296042700000000}Can you hear me, you who defy me?
I am {C:819782830400}Oldna Posaydal{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296052700000000}You...!

{C:81936E00}{C:81958296072700000000}Your actions are foolish, but I'll praise
your courage in standing against me.

{C:81958296082700000000}In recognition of that courage,
I will grant you an audience.
Come to {C:819782830300}Gastogal{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296092700000000}But only if you can defeat
my beloved children.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960A2700000000}Let's go, everyone!

{C:81900400}{C:819582960B2700000000}It's definitely a trap.
You're still going?

{C:81905600}{C:819582960C2700000000}Why do you always
have to discourage everyone!?

{C:81909F02}{C:819582960E2700000000}Stop it, Amm.
Can't you understand how she feels?

{C:8190A102}{C:819582960F2700000000}Isn't she saying it on purpose
because everyone gets hotheaded
and rushes into things?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102700000000}That's not what I...

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296112700000000}Yes, yes.
Be a good girl and settle down.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296122700000000}That's right, Nelfea.
Your big bro knows very well
what a good girl you are.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296142700000000}So, what are we doing?
Are we going after all?

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296152700000000}We should go.
Once we beat this Posaydal,
it'll all be over.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296162700000000}No, it won't.
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296182700000000}Right. Once we've beaten Posaydal's army,
the Norstan, a ship of the same type
as the Astante, is bound to appear.

{C:819582961A2700000000}The cause of all this
lies with the Norstan...
with Claudia.

{C:819582961C2700000000}That's why we...

{C:81905401}{C:819582961D2700000000}Don't worry about it.
We're all friends here.

{C:819582961F2700000000}If the Norstan appears,
we'll all join forces and fight.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296900000000000}No one objects, do they?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296202700000000}Then let's stop wasting time!
Let's head straight for {C:819782830300}Gastogal{C:819782830000}!!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935F00}{C:81958296212700000000}I was going to settle the score with you,
but forget that now.

{C:81958296222700000000}Even I can't get an audience,
so I'll never let the likes of you
go before Lady Posaydal!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936500}{C:81958296232700000000}Hah!
That useless vixen's all talk.

{C:81958296242700000000}You brats!!
I'll settle this right here!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906F00}{C:81958296252700000000}Welcome.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296262700000000}Amandra Kamandra!
Why are you here!?

{C:81906F00}{C:81958296272700000000}I'm a merchant.
The longer the war goes on, the better.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296292700000000}How could you...!!

{C:81905700}{C:819582962A2700000000}We haven't got time
for idle chatter, Daba.

{C:81908200}{C:819582962B2700000000}L-Leccee!
Why are you here!?

{C:81905700}{C:819582962C2700000000}Lady Posaydal is waiting.
Pick five to come to {C:819782830300}Sveto{C:819782830000},
if you would.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962D2700000000}Choose?

{C:81905700}{C:819582962E2700000000}Surely you didn't think
every last one of you could
have an audience with Lady Posaydal?

{C:81905300}{C:819582962F2700000000}What shall we do?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302700000000}Daba knows this continent,
so he'll be coming with me...

{C:81958296312700000000}Roger, Sai Saici,
Chirico, I'm counting on you.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296910000000000}That's our man!
You know talent when you see it.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296322700000000}Wouldn't it be better
to take me than Sai Saici?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296920000000000}No, no, big bro.
It's already been decided.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296342700000000}Looks like you've decided.
Then follow me.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906E00}{C:81958296352700000000}Welcome,
you who defy me.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296362700000000}Posaydal!
Put an end to
this pointless war!!

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296372700000000}What are you saying, boy?
You cannot defeat me.

{C:81958296382700000000}Surrender.
I'll still forgive you if you do it now.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296392700000000}With respect, Your Majesty,
there's a proper order to negotiations.
Wouldn't you agree?

{C:81906E00}{C:819582963A2700000000}Negotiations?
Ah ha ha ha ha!

{C:819582963B2700000000}What are you talking about?
I'm not negotiating.
I'm giving orders.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582963C2700000000}This is pointless. Let's return to the ship.

{C:81905300}{C:819582963D2700000000}Please wait, Roger.

{C:819582963E2700000000}Posaydal!
No one will accept your dictatorship!
Give it up already!!

{C:81906E00}{C:819582963F2700000000}Is that wrong, boy?

{C:81958296402700000000}A dictatorship that toughens its people is good.
Those who overcome it
will be the people who build a better tomorrow.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296930000000000}Talk about a self-serving excuse!
And you'll borrow the power of other continents
to do it, will you, lady?

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296412700000000}I do not wish to see Pentagona
filled with unnecessary power.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296422700000000}Then there's no need
for you to wage war!

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296432700000000}When the world falls into disorder, malice erupts.
When chaos rules,
the vile pus is forced out.

{C:81958296442700000000}To create a new world,
a vortex of chaos
must constantly be stirred up.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296452700000000}Don't dress it up in pretty words, Posaydal!!

{C:81906E00}{C:81958296472700000000}To rule the world, you cannot always
just brandish justice.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582964B2700000000}The audience is over, then.
Let's return to the ship...
Rie and the others are waiting.

{C:81906E00}{C:819582964C2700000000}Do as you wish.
If you can get back... that is.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B801}{C:81958296940000000000}Which way is the exit?
Do you know, big bro?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964E2700000000}Bulkheads have come down everywhere.
It isn't like it was when we came in.
Sigh... No, I can't tell.

{C:81905300}{C:819582964F2700000000}Let's keep moving, anyway.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296502700000000}We're trapped on every side...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296522700000000}Isn't there anything you can do?
I thought you might be able
to manage something, Chirico.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296532700000000}Even I can't do this.
The conditions are too bad.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296950000000000}What do we do, big bro?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296542700000000}Honestly...
I thought this might happen.
You can get out this way.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296552700000000}You left your companions in anger,
then greeted us as one of Posaydal's soldiers.
Isn't it unreasonable to ask us to trust you?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296562700000000}Is that true, Leccee?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296572700000000}It's true that I left,
but that was...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296582700000000}That way
leads outside, right?
Let's hurry.


{C:81905700}{C:81958296592700000000}You trust me?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965A2700000000}What's there to doubt?
You left because you saw
this coming, didn't you?

{C:819582965B2700000000}Thank you, Leccee.
You're saving us.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296960000000000}Oh, so that's what happened.
I had no idea!

{C:81905700}{C:819582965C2700000000}Let's hurry back to the Astante.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582965D2700000000}Why didn't you go with them?
Normally, you'd insist on going.

{C:81900400}{C:819582965E2700000000}I've learned by now
that he's more dependable than I thought.

{C:819582965F2700000000}So the right thing to do
is stay back and support him, isn't it?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296602700000000}Wow, I didn't know
you thought so highly of my brother.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296612700000000}They still haven't come back?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296622700000000}Oh, Domon.
My brother and the others aren't back yet.
Is something wrong?


{C:8190B501}{C:81958296632700000000}No... It's nothing much.
It's Rain...
She says she wants to see the city.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296642700000000}I don't see why not.


{C:81905900}{C:81958296652700000000}We cannot have you wandering about.
You are our guests, but also our enemies.
Please understand that.

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296662700000000}It's irritating
having you scurrying around.
Stay there and behave yourselves!

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296672700000000}Look at you, acting all important!

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296682700000000}I'm not acting important.
I am important.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296692700000000}Listen to you,
Giwaza's woman.


{C:81901C00}{C:819582966A2700000000}Could you take that vulgar conversation
somewhere else?

{C:819582966B2700000000}There are young ladies
here, after all.

{C:81906500}{C:819582966C2700000000}Shut up!
Children should keep their mouths shut!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582966E2700000000}Nelfea,
tell everyone
to take battle stations!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905F00}{C:819582966F2700000000}I won't let you do that.
Stay there and behave yourselves!!

{C:81905900}{C:81958296702700000000}You're going too far, Lady Nei!
Our mission is only to keep watch,
and our orders were to do nothing more...

{C:81906500}{C:81958296712700000000}Shut up!
I couldn't care less
about Posaydal!

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296722700000000}Lili!
How dare you show such insolence!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296742700000000}Big bro!!

{C:81905900}{C:81958296752700000000}Lady Nei, Lady Lili,
please stop!
Anyway, we need to get to Sveto...

{C:81906500}{C:81958296762700000000}Don't give me orders!
Besides, I'm the one with a gun...

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296782700000000}That won't do you any good.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906500}{C:81958296792700000000}You dodged gunfire!?
What kind of man defies common sense like that!?


{C:8190B501}{C:819582967B2700000000}Hmph... My master
can destroy an HM with his bare hands.
Well? Still want to fight?

{C:81905900}{C:819582967C2700000000}I'll be taking my leave first!


{C:81905900}{C:819582967D2700000000}(I'm not putting up with
 women's hysterics forever!)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900C00}{C:819582967E2700000000}I see.
You're taking the field yourself.
Such admirable determination.

{C:819582967F2700000000}I wish you luck in battle.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296802700000000}Who were you talking to?

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296812700000000}Are you still here?
Get off the Norstan now,
before I change my mind and kill you.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296832700000000}Of course. I'm leaving now.
But tell me just one thing.
Why do you fight?

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296842700000000}There's no point in telling you.
The Norstan will soon go into battle.
Its last...

{C:81958296852700000000}If you want a front-row seat
to watch the Astante fall, be my guest.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296862700000000}The Astante's launch preparations are complete!
Big bro, hurry and organize our forces!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872700000000}Understood!
Leave it to me!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936F00}{C:81958296892700000000}At this point, I can't be choosy about my methods.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936F00}{C:819582968C2700000000}All I've ever wanted
is to create a new era.

{C:819582968E2700000000}And you stand in my way,
so you'll have to die!!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900C00}{C:819582968F2700000000}Pathetic.
So in the end,
I'll have to go myself after all.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296912700000000}It's already over.
Stop this pointless fighting.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296922700000000}Shut up!
Get out of my way!!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296932700000000}The battle isn't over.
The final enemy is coming!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942700000000}Please help us one last time!!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296952700000000}Leave it to us!
Let's show them what we can do!!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296962700000000}I'll do my best!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296972700000000}It's the opening battle all over again.
I won't lose this time.
I'm going to settle the score!!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296992700000000}The likes of you could never do that.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969B2700000000}Lun, you're safe...

{C:819582969C2700000000}All right!
We're going to win, everyone!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296A22700000000}Welcome back, Lun.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A32700000000}It's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Nelfea Northrock.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A52700000000}It's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Lun Forest.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296970000000000}Hey, hey, big bro!
Don't let the Claudian crowd
have all the fun.

{C:81958296980000000000}Introduce us too
to that beautiful young lady,
will you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A62700000000}Oh, sorry.
I'll introduce our friends, Lun.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:81958296A92700000000}Master, thank you so much
for all your instruction.

{C:81958296AA2700000000}Thanks to you, I've gained the strength
to keep the Security Unit from defeating me.

{C:8193C001}{C:81958296AB2700000000}Nonsense, you had a natural aptitude.
You took it in more readily
than that foolish pupil of mine.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296AC2700000000}By the way, Eiji...

{C:81902201}{C:81958296AD2700000000}Yes, Master?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296AE2700000000}I heard a little something. You're going?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296AF2700000000}Yes... I must let
the other continents know.
If I'm the only one who can do it...

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B02700000000}Your nature does you no favors.
But if you're going to do it,
I pray that you see your goal through.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296B12700000000}Thank you.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B32700000000}Then go, Eiji.
Go and fulfill your mission.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296B42700000000}Yes!
I'll take my leave, Master!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B52700000000}Well, then... I suppose I'll be going too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B701}{C:81958296962600000000}Heeey, Japanese!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296972600000000}{C:819782830400}Chibodee Crocket{C:819782830000}?!
What are you doing here?

{C:8190B701}{C:81958296982600000000}Tsk, tsk, tsk.
Let's not ask each other that.
We're in the same boat, aren't we?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296992600000000}Who is he?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582969A2600000000}He's a Gundam Fighter like me.
I hate to admit it,
but he's a skilled fighter.

{C:8190B701}{C:819582969B2600000000}Why, whyyy?
What's gotten into you, Japanese?!
You're actually praising someone!

{C:8190B501}{C:819582969C2600000000}Facts are facts.
Besides, given the situation,
I want skilled people on our side.

{C:8190B701}{C:819582969D2600000000}I've heard what's going on.
All right.
I'll join you too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B701}{C:819582969E2600000000}It's good to be working with you, young lady.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:819582969F2600000000}Look, look! There's someone over there.
What's he doing?

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296A02600000000}{C:819782830400}Wufeiii{C:819782830000}?
Where the hell have you been all this time?!

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296A12600000000}I've been watching this battle,
considering which side is right...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22600000000}And have you reached a conclusion?

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296A32600000000}Yes...
I'll side with you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42600000000}Thank you, Wufei!

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296A62600000000}But don't forget.
If your cause isn't just,
I'll leave at any time.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296A72600000000}Tch! What a show-off!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF2600000000}This place is really devastated.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E02600000000}Yeah, it's almost frightening.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296E12600000000}Posaydal wiped out a clan called the
{C:819782830400}Yaman{C:819782830000}, and this was their land.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E22600000000}Wiped out...
Then the other continents
were still lucky.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296E32600000000}That's exactly why we have to
crush Posaydal's ambitions.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901B00}{C:81958296E42600000000}Heeey.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E52600000000}Oh, it's you, Chum.
Is Sho with you too?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296890000000000}Of course. We were just saying
that this continent
reminds us of Byston Well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E62600000000}Byston Well?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582968A0000000000}I couldn't really say
what exactly reminds me of it, though.


{C:81905500}{C:81958296E72600000000}Oh, everyone's here.
...Huh?
Lilis, what are you doing?

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296E82600000000}I'm not Lilis, you know.
I'm Chum Huau.


{C:81905400}{C:81958296E92600000000}Kyaooo.
Have you seen Daba?
Huh?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935500}{C:81958296EA2600000000}Heh heh, hehehehehe.

{C:81935400}{C:81958296EB2600000000}What is it, Kyao?
That's a strange laugh.

{C:81935500}{C:81958296EC2600000000}Um, Chum, was it?
Could you smile for me a little?

{C:81931B00}{C:81958296ED2600000000}Is this all right?
(Smiles)

{C:81935500}{C:81958296EE2600000000}All right! We've practically won already!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:819582968B0000000000}Kyao, was it?
Could you explain
what you meant just now?

{C:81905500}{C:81958296EF2600000000}"If you want to rule the world, smile with a fairy."
That's a proverb
where I come from.

{C:81958296F02600000000}We've got two fairies smiling for us!
If we can rule the world, there's no reason
we should lose to Posaydal.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582968C0000000000}I see.
Then our victory's assured.
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F12600000000}Smile with a fairy... I like that.
It's reassuring to have even a proverb on our side.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F22600000000}Men can be so cute.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F32600000000}Hehehe, they really can.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296B62700000000}Then let's depart.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296B72700000000}I'm sorry to put you to the trouble
of taking all of us back
to our respective continents.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B82700000000}Not at all.
We've dragged you all over the place,
so it's the least we can do.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296990000000000}Besides, unfortunately,
we can't cross the Cloud Sea on our own.
We're counting on you.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B92700000000}But are you sure it's all right?
Even Daba and the others are coming along.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296BA2700000000}People from Pentagona caused all this trouble.
Surely we won't be punished
for at least seeing you off.


{C:81958296BB2700000000}Oops.
That was off-limits, wasn't it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BC2700000000}That's right, Daba.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296BD2700000000}But that's how
we all met.

{C:8190B801}{C:819582969A0000000000}Right, it's all over now.
Let's stop pointing fingers
at one another.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296BE2700000000}Then let's depart.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296C02700000000}I hope it's really over.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296C12700000000}Did you say something, Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296C32700000000}No...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C42700000000}Then...
The Astante is departing!!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C52700000000}Hey, Rie.
What are you doing?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296C62700000000}Oh, sooorry!
We're heading to another continent, right?




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296C72700000000}There's an object approaching at high speed.
It's incredibly fast!
It's right in front of us already!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:81958296C92700000000}My name is
Albatro Null Eiji Asuka.
I request permission to land.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CA2700000000}What's the status
of the maintenance deck?

{C:81938700}{C:81958296CC2700000000}The maintenance deck
is ready whenever you are.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CD2700000000}You have permission to land
on the maintenance deck.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296CF2700000000}Thank you.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902201}{C:81958296D02700000000}Luckily, I escaped Posaydal's attacks
thanks to the Cloud Sea.

{C:81958296D22700000000}{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} plans to obtain the Cloud System
and embark on
a campaign of continental conquest.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D32700000000}But the Cloud System...
Who on earth could...?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296D42700000000}I don't know that much.
I could barely make it here in {C:819782830400}Layzner{C:819782830000}
myself.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296D52700000000}Now we have no choice
but to go to Grados,
right?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296D62700000000}Let's go, Eiji.
There's nobody else anywhere
who can stop this fighting.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296D72700000000}I'll help you
in every way I can.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296D82700000000}Huh?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D92700000000}What is it, Nelfea?

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296EE2700000000}There's abnormal movement
in the Cloud Stream.


{C:81930400}{C:81958296DC2700000000}Hey! That's what
I was about to say!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DD2700000000}This isn't the time to fool around!
So what's... Oh.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296DE2700000000}I'm sorry
to call you away from your busy schedule.

{C:81930B00}{C:819582969B0000000000}Don't worry about it.
If you've summoned me,
something serious must have happened.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296DF2700000000}We've identified the mastermind behind this incident.
It's that man.
The one who was our enemy during the civil war...

{C:81930900}{C:819582969C0000000000}That man...
Is that true, Kyo?!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296E02700000000}That's why we asked you to come, Admiral.
Against that man,
they stand virtually no chance.

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296E12700000000}So that's why you had me check out
Astante II and the new FT.


{C:81930700}{C:81958296E22700000000}I'm asking you too, Admiral.
Please authorize the use of Astante II.


{C:81930B00}{C:819582969D0000000000}Wind,
you're ready to sortie, then?

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296E42700000000}Of course!
I've got everything in perfect shape.

{C:81930B00}{C:819582969E0000000000}Very well. I authorize the sortie.
I'll handle all dealings
with the government myself.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296E52700000000}Thank you very much!!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296E62700000000}Time is of the essence.
We're launching at once.
Let's go!!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296E72700000000}Then, Admiral,
we'll take our leave.

{C:81900B00}{C:819582969F0000000000}Very well. Take care.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900B00}{C:81958296A00000000000}What are you doing?
You two should go as well.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296E82700000000}Is that all right?

{C:81900B00}{C:81958296A10000000000}Against that man,
even Akatsuki and the others may be outmatched.
Go and help them.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296E92700000000}Understood!
I, Wind Shiga,
will gladly go!

{C:81958296EA2700000000}Hey, let's go, Tail!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296A20000000000}We're off, Admiral!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
