{C:81930100}{C:81958296F12700000000}Ghh, what happened?
Rie, Nelfea,
is everyone all right?


{C:81900300}{C:81958296F22700000000}There's no damage to the ship.
Nelfea, where are we?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32700000000}The continent nearby is...
{C:819782830300}the Terra continent{C:819782830000}?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F42700000000}We drifted all the way to Terra?

{C:8190A302}{C:81958296F62700000000}The Cloud Sea's currents have shifted.
We can't reach anywhere but the Terra continent.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296F72700000000}Then that's convenient.
I'd like to know what's happening on Terra too.
Could you take us down?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F82700000000}Yes, Lieutenant Quattro.
The Astante is entering the Terra continent.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938A00}{C:81958296F92700000000}Can you hear me?
This is Amuro Ray.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA2700000000}Amuro!

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296FB2700000000}{C:819782830300}Von Braun{C:819782830000} is where I'll be waiting.
I'm looking forward
to seeing you all again.

{C:81958296FC2700000000}Especially you, Kamille.
I have something to give you,
so look forward to it.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296FD2700000000}Understood. Von Braun, then.
We'll head there right away.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B800}{C:81958296FE2700000000}{C:819782830400}Haman{C:819782830000}, ma'am!
Are you truly going?

{C:81939E00}{C:81958296FF2700000000}I have to go.
If this concerned Terra alone,
I would ignore it too.

{C:81958296002800000000}But I simply cannot bear
letting that man have his way.

{C:8193B800}{C:81958296012800000000}But, {C:819782830400}Haman{C:819782830000}, ma'am, you needn't
go in person...

{C:81939E00}{C:81958296022800000000}Oh, there's no need to worry.
I'll be putting Char to work too.

{C:81958296032800000000}{C:819782830400}Mineva{C:819782830000} is to be told that urgent business
will keep me away for a while.

{C:81958296042800000000}{C:819782830400}Qubeley{C:819782830000} is to be brought out.
Haman Karn is moving out!!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908A00}{C:81958296052800000000}Over here!
You look well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296062800000000}You too, Amuro.
I'm relieved to see you looking well.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296072800000000}Welcome back, Lieutenant Quattro.
You too, Kamille.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296082800000000}I'm glad you're safe.

{C:81958296092800000000}By the way, what's the current situation
on Terra?

{C:81908A00}{C:819582960A2800000000}The Titans are no longer under {C:819782830400}Jamitov{C:819782830000}'s
control. Someone else
has taken charge.

{C:81908700}{C:819582960C2800000000}Jamitov isn't in charge?!
Who controls the Titans now? Is it 
{C:819782830400}Bask Om{C:819782830000}?

{C:81908A00}{C:819582960D2800000000}No, neither of them.
{C:819782830400}Paptimus Scirocco{C:819782830000} is the name of a man
who's been rising to power.

{C:819582960E2800000000}Perhaps that's why the Titans
have been growing more powerful.
You'd better be careful.

{C:81908200}{C:819582960F2800000000}So, Amuro,
what was it
you wanted to give me?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296102800000000}It should already be aboard,
so shall we head to the Astante?







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296172800000000}Come to think of it, how's it going, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296182800000000}How's what going?
You can't just spring that on me
and expect me to know how to answer.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192800000000}Sorry, sorry.
I mean, how are you doing
as captain?

{C:81900300}{C:819582961A2800000000}I know what it means to be captain,
but I have no idea
whether I'm doing a good job.

{C:81908900}{C:819582961B2800000000}So you're Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:819582961C2800000000}Yes?

{C:81908900}{C:819582961D2800000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Henken Bekkener{C:819782830000}.
I captain a battleship for AEUG.

{C:819582961E2800000000}I'll be boarding the Astante
to help you this time.
I'm looking forward to working with you.

{C:81900300}{C:819582961F2800000000}I'm looking forward to working with you too.
But, Henken,
shouldn't you be the captain?

{C:81908900}{C:81958296202800000000}I only know my way around Terra.
You have more experience.

{C:81958296212800000000}Just think of me as someone
you can turn to when you're in trouble.
Well, I'll head to the Astante first.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296222800000000}Yes.
Please let me come to you for advice.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296232800000000}Isn't that great, Rie?
If they're keeping you as captain,
it means they recognize your abilities.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296242800000000}Nobody's complained.
They trust you, so have some confidence.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296252800000000}Yeah.
I feel a little more confident now.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81934202}{C:81958296372800000000}{C:819782830400}Scott{C:819782830000}, they're catching up!

{C:81934302}{C:81958296382800000000}Can't this thing go any faster?

{C:81934402}{C:81958296392800000000}You can say that, but
unless we escape into the Cloud Sea,
there's no way out!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193EC01}{C:819582963A2800000000}You're certain of that?

{C:8193ED01}{C:819582963B2800000000}Judging by the call for help
we intercepted a moment ago,
there's no mistake.

{C:819582963C2800000000}The only people aboard that ship
are children.

{C:8193EC01}{C:819582963D2800000000}I see...
Then there's no need for further attacks.
{C:819782830400}Lady{C:819782830000}, withdraw.

{C:8193ED01}{C:819582963E2800000000}Understood, {C:819782830400}Treize{C:819782830000}.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81934B02}{C:819582963F2800000000}Huh?
Big brother, the enemy ship's turning back?

{C:81934302}{C:81958296402800000000}Now that's lucky.
Right, boss?

{C:81934502}{C:81958296A40000000000}Wait!
Another ship on the radar...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296442800000000}You're back at just the right time.
It seems a ship carrying only children
is under attack.

{C:81958296452800000000}Rie says
she wants to go to their rescue.
Get back to the Astante immediately.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296492800000000}This is the Astante.
We have no intention
of attacking you.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81934402}{C:819582964A2800000000}Is that really true?

{C:81934202}{C:819582964B2800000000}Try answering them first.

{C:81934402}{C:819582964D2800000000}Y-yeah.

{C:819582964E2800000000}This is the {C:819782830400}Janus.{C:819782830000}
Are you telling the truth
about not intending to attack?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:819582964F2800000000}Lieutenant Quattro, please take over.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296512800000000}I'm Lieutenant Quattro of AEUG.
We've also confirmed
that only children are aboard your ship.

{C:81958296532800000000}We'd like to take you under our protection, if possible.
Could you come
to Von Braun?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81934402}{C:81958296542800000000}After what they said,
maybe we can trust them?

{C:81934302}{C:81958296552800000000}What do you think, boss?

{C:81934202}{C:81958296572800000000}There's no way to escape.
Let's trust them for now.

{C:81934402}{C:81958296582800000000}Understood.
We'll head for Von Braun.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296592800000000}Now it makes sense.
The Titans want
to get their hands on your RVs.

{C:81904202}{C:819582965B2800000000}Why do they want the RVs?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965C2800000000}I think the enemy wants
any extra fighting strength it can get,
especially now that we're back.

{C:81904302}{C:819582965D2800000000}Because you're back?

{C:819582965F2800000000}Oh, so you're the people
who've been fighting
as you travel between continents!

{C:81904202}{C:81958296602800000000}Oh, you're the people from that story!
We did it, Scott!
We're safe now!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296612800000000}What story is that?

{C:81904502}{C:81958296A50000000000}We heard there were people
fighting against
Posaydal's army.

{C:81958296A70000000000}They said we'd be safe
if we got those people to help us.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296622800000000}Ah!!
Weren't you all supposed
to stay hidden?!!

{C:81904A02}{C:81958296632800000000}We were hiding.
But they found us,
so what could we do?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296642800000000}Oh, I see. Sorry.
Still, I'm glad we've joined up.

{C:81904602}{C:81958296652800000000}We owe that to you too, Leccee.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296672800000000}So, what will happen to these children?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296682800000000}I intend to have AEUG take them into protective care.

{C:81904202}{C:81958296692800000000}Please wait!
Let me fight alongside you too.
I want to protect everyone.

{C:81904302}{C:819582966A2800000000}Well, if the boss is fighting,
I guess I'll join the fight too.

{C:81904A02}{C:819582966B2800000000}Then I'll fight too.

{C:81904402}{C:819582966C2800000000}{C:819782830400}Roddy{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Barts!{C:819782830000}
This is fighting we're talking about. It's dangerous!

{C:81904302}{C:819582966D2800000000}That's no different from what we've been through.
Anyway, we're going.

{C:81904B02}{C:819582966E2800000000}Big brother, I... I...
I don't wanna be apart from you!

{C:81900300}{C:819582966F2800000000}Then why don't you all come with us?
There's quite a crowd aboard the Astante now,
so we need some help.

{C:81904402}{C:81958296702800000000}What?!
Is that really all right?!

{C:81908400}{C:81958296712800000000}I suppose there's no helping it.
AEUG will look after
the Janus.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296722800000000}Even you, Lieutenant Quattro?
This isn't a game!!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296732800000000}It was Leccee, wasn't it?
Heh, there's nothing we can do.
It's an order from Rie, the captain.

{C:81904502}{C:81958296A80000000000}Thank you very much.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931A00}{C:81958296A90000000000}Does anyone there know someone called {C:819782830400}Char{C:819782830000}?
Any of you can answer.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296742800000000}This is Quattro.
What's this about all of a sudden, Sho?

{C:81931A00}{C:81958296AA0000000000}We've received a message from someone called Haman.
{C:819782830300}Hong Kong City{C:819782830000} is where
she wants us to go.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296752800000000}Haman...
Haman Karn?
Why now...?

{C:81958296762800000000}Rie,
I'm sorry, but could you take us
to Hong Kong City?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296772800000000}I don't mind,
but do you know her?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296782800000000}I've known her for a long time.
Though she's someone
I'd rather not see.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296792800000000}Understood.
I'll set the Astante's course
for Hong Kong City.

{C:819582967A2800000000}All right, everyone!
Get ready, we're departing!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:819582967C2800000000}I'm sorry to trouble you,
but I want to make certain I meet Haman.
I'm counting on your help.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:819582967D2800000000}I'm sorry to trouble you,
but I want to make certain I meet Haman.
I'm counting on your help.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967E2800000000}Oh, there's Four.
Excuse me, Lieutenant Quattro.
Please give me a moment.

{C:81908400}{C:819582967F2800000000}Yes, of course.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296802800000000}Four!
Thank goodness, you're alive!


{C:81909500}{C:81958296812800000000}Who are you?
You're creepy... Get lost!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296822800000000}Four, it's me.
Don't you remember?
Then do you remember Kamille?!

{C:81909500}{C:81958296832800000000}Kami...lle?
Aah! My head... It hurts!

{C:81958296842800000000}Get lost!
When you're here, it feels like a snake
is writhing around inside my head.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296852800000000}I'm sorry...

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296862800000000}What happened?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872800000000}Lieutenant, do you remember
the Psyco Gundam?


{C:81908400}{C:81958296882800000000}If I remember correctly,
it was the MS that gave us a chance
to venture onto the Cloud Sea?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296892800000000}Its pilot
was alive.

{C:81908400}{C:819582968A2800000000}You're saying she escaped that explosion?

{C:819582968B2800000000}But we have no time to pry into that now.
We must find Haman quickly.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C2800000000}You're right.
Let's hurry.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909E00}{C:819582968D2800000000}Over here, Char.
Or would the name {C:819782830400}Casval{C:819782830000}
be more to your liking?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968E2800000000}So you're Char,
Lieutenant Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:819582968F2800000000}I'm Quattro Bajeena.
You must use words correctly.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296902800000000}It makes no difference to me either way.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296912800000000}So, what have you come here for,
Haman Karn?

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296922800000000}This isn't the place.
Let's go somewhere else.

{C:81958296932800000000}Boy, I'm sorry, but could you return
to the ship alone?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942800000000}Understood.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939E00}{C:81958296962800000000}Well done on your infiltration of the Federation.
How long has it been since we met face to face?

{C:81938400}{C:81958296972800000000}...
What's brought this on?

{C:81939E00}{C:81958296982800000000}We haven't seen each other in so long,
and that's what you say to me, Char?

{C:81958296992800000000}Well, never mind.
I've come because I refuse to let that man
do as he pleases with Terra.

{C:81938400}{C:819582969A2800000000}That man?
You mean the man called Scirocco
who's taken control of the Titans?

{C:81939E00}{C:819582969B2800000000}The man behind this war.
I have no intention of acting
according to his designs.

{C:81938400}{C:819582969C2800000000}That's just like you, Haman.

{C:81939E00}{C:819582969D2800000000}Of course.
That's why I left {C:819782830300}Axis{C:819782830000}
and came here.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2800000000}Oh, there you are!
Kamille!!

{C:81908200}{C:819582969F2800000000}Welcome back.
What's happened? Why are you in such a hurry?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A02800000000}I saw Four on Main Street.


{C:81908200}{C:81958296A12800000000}Even you should know there are things
you can say and things you can't!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22800000000}I'm telling the truth!
But she didn't
remember you, Kamille...

{C:81908200}{C:81958296A32800000000}Four... Four is alive?
Where was she?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42800000000}I don't know where she went
after we parted on Main Street. Sorry.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296A52800000000}I'm going to find Four!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A62800000000}Kamille! Kamille!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296AB0000000000}What happened? Kamille just
rushed out in the Zeta Gundam?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A72800000000}The person who helped us
might still be alive,
so he went looking for her.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296A82800000000}Are you being drawn to her, Kamille?
I just hope you don't end up
like we did...

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A92800000000}Has something happened to Kamille?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296AA2800000000}Oh, Char.
Kamille took the Zeta Gundam
to look for Four.

{C:81958296AB2800000000}We'd better find him
before something goes wrong.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD2800000000}Understood.
I'll go tell Rie.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909B00}{C:81958296AE2800000000}A rat has slipped into our continent.
Will you exterminate it, {C:819782830400}Jerid Messa{C:819782830000}?

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296AF2800000000}Of course.
I intend to repay you
for taking me in.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296B02800000000}I'm counting on you to keep your word.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296B12800000000}Leave it to me.
I'm heading out.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296B22800000000}Then I'll come too.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296B32800000000}Wait, {C:819782830400}Mouar.{C:819782830000}

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296B42800000000}I'll go on ahead.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909B00}{C:81958296B52800000000}A grown woman should be with a grown man.
Unless you prefer dealing with little boys.

{C:81958296B62800000000}I am the only man
who can fulfill your ambitions.
You'd do well to remember that.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296B72800000000}(What a man...)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938400}{C:81958296B82800000000}Have you found anything out?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B92800000000}He apparently went in 
{C:819782830300}Von Braun{C:819782830000}'s direction,
according to a message from Karaba.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BA2800000000}Then let's head
to Von Braun.

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296BB2800000000}Honestly, that boy!
He's always doing whatever he pleases.
I'll have to tell him off when he gets back!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A002}{C:81958296BF2800000000}Stop it, Hime!

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296C02800000000}You need to stop
acting so selfishly!

{C:81958296C12800000000}Do you have any idea
how much trouble you're causing everyone?

{C:81938200}{C:81958296C22800000000}You... What would
you know about it?!!

{C:8193A002}{C:81958296C32800000000}That's right, Hime.
If you were in Kamille's position,
could you say the same thing?

{C:81958296C42800000000}Could you, Hime?!

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296C52800000000}Uuuugh...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C62800000000}Kamille.
The way you're being drawn to her is dangerous.

{C:81958296C72800000000}If you go on like this,
you'll go through the same suffering
that Lieutenant Quattro and I once did!

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C82800000000}Kamille, you like
this Four, don't you?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C92800000000}It's not about love or anything like that.
I have to get her out.

{C:81958296CA2800000000}We've finally learned that {C:819782830300}Kilimanjaro{C:819782830000} is
where she is!!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296CB2800000000}After everything he's said,
can't you let him go?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CE2800000000}Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296CF2800000000}I understand how Kamille feels.
...At least, I think I do.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D32800000000}I'm asking you too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D42800000000}I thought you'd say that, Lun.

{C:81958296D52800000000}Kamille, you'll have to go to Kilimanjaro
alone.
Is that all right?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296D62800000000}I'll go even if I have to go alone!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D82800000000}But... all alone?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D92800000000}Everyone else,
please help lure the enemy
above Kilimanjaro.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DA2800000000}Big brother!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296DB2800000000}You're so coool!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DD2800000000}I can be, sometimes.

{C:81958296DE2800000000}Once you've brought Four out,
rejoin us immediately.
Don't forget, Kamille.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296DF2800000000}Yeah, I understand.
...Thank you.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296E02800000000}Kamille, I'm sorry I hit you.
I'll help too.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296E12800000000}Don't worry about it, Hime.
If our positions were reversed,
I'm sure I'd have done the same as you.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296E22800000000}Heh heh, then
let's get going!!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296E32800000000}Wait a moment!
I'm a ninja,
so sneaking in is my specialteee!!

{C:81958296E42800000000}Kamille, take me with youuu!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E52800000000}It's dangerous for a child to go.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296E62800000000}It'll be fine, it'll be fine.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296E72800000000}Enough, Himiko. Keep quiet.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296E82800000000}We shouldn't waste time.
Let's get moving.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296EB2800000000}Enemy battleship approaching!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296ED2800000000}Kamille!
Descend before we enter battle.

{C:81938200}{C:81958296EE2800000000}Kamille, Zeta Gundam. Understood!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E301}{C:81958296F02800000000}What are you doing? This way!!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296F12800000000}Are you the one who contacted me?

{C:8190E301}{C:81958296F22800000000}The woman you're looking for is this way.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935600}{C:81958296F32800000000}They're coming again!
Aaah, come on!
Kamille, hurry baaack!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296F52800000000}Four!



{C:81909500}{C:81958296F62800000000}Kamille!


{C:81909500}{C:81958296F82800000000}Kamille! Kamille!!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296F92800000000}Four, come with us.
You can't stay here.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FA2800000000}Yeah, if that's what you say, Kamille,
then I will.

{C:8190E201}{C:81958296FB2800000000}There's no time to relax
and enjoy your reunion.
They're in trouble up above.

{C:8190E501}{C:81958296FC2800000000}We've secured an escape route.
Hurry along.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FD2800000000}Thank you very much!

{C:8190E401}{C:81958296FE2800000000}We've taken control of most of Kilimanjaro.
The next time you're here,
you'll be able to walk around freely.

{C:81958296FF2800000000}Pass that on to Trowa and the others.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296002900000000}The Zeta Gundam is coming up,
and the Psyco Gundam is right behind it!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296012900000000}The Zeta Gundam is entering the hangar!
Everyone inside, watch out!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A102}{C:81958296022900000000}Welcome back, Kamille!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296032900000000}I'm back.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296AC0000000000}I'm glad you're safe.
So, that young lady
is Four?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296042900000000}Yes.
Her name's Four Murasame.

{C:81958296052900000000}Oh, Trowa!
{C:819782830400}Doctor S{C:819782830000} asked me
to give you his regards.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296AD0000000000}I see...

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296062900000000}Oh, man. So the old guys
are here too?

{C:81909500}{C:81958296072900000000}They said they'd make sure
we could enter Kilimanjaro.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296092900000000}I'm glad it worked out, Kamille.

{C:81905700}{C:819582960A2900000000}Sorry to interrupt
your happy reunion, but the enemy's coming.
Get ready.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939B00}{C:819582960B2900000000}I cannot stand
trash like you getting in my way!!

{C:819582960C2900000000}I shall personally bury you.
You should be grateful!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960D2900000000}The Cloud Sea has opened up!

{C:81932201}{C:819582960E2900000000}Nelfea,
which way is Grados?

{C:81930400}{C:819582960F2900000000}I think the direction where the Cloud Sea opened
is the shortest way there.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296102900000000}Rie, please take us there.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296112900000000}Yes. The Astante
is leaving the Terra continent!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935F00}{C:81958296122900000000}Don't give me that!
I did as you said, and they slipped
right out of Terra!!

{C:8193ED01}{C:81958296132900000000}I wouldn't know.
I'm merely following
Treize's orders.

{C:81958296142900000000}Other matters are none of my concern.

{C:81935F00}{C:81958296152900000000}Damn it, and you say that with a straight face!
You won't get away with this!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190EC01}{C:81958296162900000000}I'm sorry to trouble you, Lady.

{C:8190ED01}{C:81958296172900000000}Not at all, Treize.
Your words are too kind.

{C:8190EC01}{C:81958296182900000000}Now, proceed
according to our earlier arrangements.
I'll watch how things develop a little longer.

{C:8190ED01}{C:81958296192900000000}Yes, Treize.
I'll go to them.

{C:8190EC01}{C:819582961A2900000000}I'm counting on you, Lady.
You're the only one I can rely on.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B501}{C:819582962B2900000000}Are you going into town?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C2900000000}Yes, that's what I was planning.

{C:8190B501}{C:819582962D2900000000}I'll come with you.
I sense something strange.

{C:8190B601}{C:819582962E2900000000}Something strange?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582962F2900000000}I can't put it into words.

{C:81958296302900000000}Rie, Nelfea,
you two should stay out of trouble too.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296312900000000}Mr. Kasshu, you're sooo bossy!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296322900000000}Just stay here, all right?

{C:81958296332900000000}Sai Saici,
come with me.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296AE0000000000}You got it!

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296342900000000}We'll come along as well.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296352900000000}No, George, you and the others
should stay on the Astante.
There's no telling what might happen.

{C:8190B701}{C:81958296362900000000}OK!
Leave things here to us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296372900000000}Then let's go.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193AE02}{C:819582961B2900000000}How can anyone be this ridiculously strong?!

{C:8193AC02}{C:819582961C2900000000}Don't we need our armor
to beat him?!

{C:8193AB02}{C:819582961D2900000000}Don't be ridiculous.
Our opponent is human!

{C:8193AD02}{C:819582961F2900000000}Seiji's right.
We have to manage
with our own strength!

{C:8193AA02}{C:81958296202900000000}Here he comes, everyone!
Protect Natsumi!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296282900000000}If you want to save this girl,
follow me across the Cloud Sea.

{C:8193AA02}{C:819582962A2900000000}W-Wait...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296382900000000}Hm?
Ryo, do you sense that presence?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296392900000000}It's like that old man's...
It's those three over there.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296AF0000000000}Hey, Domon, have you noticed?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582963A2900000000}Yeah, those two over there, right?
I couldn't miss that much fighting spirit.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582963B2900000000}Is something wrong?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582963C2900000000}Don't stray from us.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582963D2900000000}Where have you taken Natsumi?!
There's no point hiding it!

{C:8190B501}{C:819582963E2900000000}Well now, I don't know who you're talking about.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582963F2900000000}Then I'll just have to
beat the answer out of you!!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296422900000000}Ohhh?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296432900000000}That stance... It's the same as the old man's?!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296442900000000}Enough of this!!
We have to fight
Grados!

{C:81958296452900000000}We don't have time
to be doing this with you!!

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296462900000000}We...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296482900000000}Are you all right?
Domon, Sai Saici?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296492900000000}Yeah, this is nothing.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B2900000000}Thank goodness.
Come on, let's go.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AD02}{C:819582964D2900000000}What an old man!
He sent us flying all the way out here.

{C:8190AC02}{C:819582964E2900000000}And thanks to that,
we've lost Ryo and the others again.

{C:8190AD02}{C:819582964F2900000000}Yeah.
Let's hurry up and find them.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296502900000000}Still, what was the deal
with those people?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B00000000000}Seriously!
They came out of nowhere.

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296512900000000}I see.
Thank you.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B10000000000}Huh?
We've got a visitor.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296522900000000}Hey, Rie!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296532900000000}Oh, welcome back,
big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296542900000000}Who was that just now?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296552900000000}He said he was looking for some boys about his age.
He mentioned a few names,
like Ryo and Shu.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296562900000000}I see.
Be careful, though.
Some weird people attacked us earlier.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296572900000000}Were you all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296582900000000}I was, thanks to having Domon and the others with us.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296B20000000000}Who are you?!

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296592900000000}We're...

{C:8190B501}{C:819582965B2900000000}You're back again!
I won't lose this time!!

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582965C2900000000}No, you've got it wrong!
We realized it was a misunderstanding and came to apologize.
And we have a favor to ask.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582965D2900000000}We're sorry.
We apologize for using force
for such selfish reasons.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E2900000000}What do you think, Domon?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296602900000000}You don't look like bad people,
and it seems there's more to this.
Would you tell us about it?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296612900000000}The truth is, we're fighting the Yoja too...
To put it simply,
we're fighting bad people.

{C:81958296622900000000}For some reason, they were after two girls.
We were protecting them,
but they were finally taken from us...

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296632900000000}The one who took them used
a martial arts stance like yours,
so we assumed you were on the same side.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B30000000000}The same stance as Domon?
...Master?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296642900000000}Master?!
There's no way he'd do anything evil!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296652900000000}Eiji,
you know my teacher?!

{C:81902201}{C:81958296662900000000}Master taught me
how to fight.

{C:81958296672900000000}Your teacher? Then you're
the idiot pupil Master told me about...

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296682900000000}Who are you calling an idiot pupil?! Who?!

{C:81902201}{C:819582966A2900000000}I'm sorry.
That's what Master called you.

{C:8190AD02}{C:819582966B2900000000}Sorry to interrupt,
but could you let us
aboard this ship?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2900000000}Why?

{C:8190AC02}{C:819582966D2900000000}Shu, that's too sudden.

{C:819582966E2900000000}The girls we're looking for
are called Natsumi
and Mirai.

{C:819582966F2900000000}We've searched everywhere we could think of,
but they don't seem to be
on this continent anymore.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296702900000000}So we want to go looking
on the other continents.
Could you let us aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296712900000000}What do you think, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296722900000000}Oh, this is a tough one...

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296732900000000}I'm asking you too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296742900000000}Domon?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296752900000000}I'm asking you too.
If we go with him, I'm sure we'll understand
what Master really intends.

{C:81958296762900000000}Don't you agree, Domon?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296772900000000}Yes, exactly.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296782900000000}All right.
You have permission to come aboard.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296792900000000}Thank you.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B102}{C:81958296262800000000}Have you lot seen
a child with a baby?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296282800000000}A child with a baby?
We haven't seen one so far.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296292800000000}Is it your child?

{C:8190B102}{C:819582962A2800000000}Don't be impertinent!

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B2800000000}Oh dear, now he's angry.

{C:81900400}{C:819582962C2800000000}It doesn't matter.
He's obviously suspicious,
so we don't have to give him a proper answer.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962D2800000000}Is that how it works?

{C:81900400}{C:819582962E2800000000}That's how it works.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296ED3600000000}Excuse me. Could I
see Lady Haman?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE3600000000}Haman?
Um, please wait a moment.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF3600000000}Has anyone
seen Haman?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296F13600000000}Haman?
I thought she was right there a moment ago...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F23600000000}Did you want something with me?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F33600000000}Oh, Haman.
Someone's here
who wants to see you.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F43600000000}Ah, it's you.
Is something wrong?


{C:8193BA00}{C:81958296F53600000000}We've finished analyzing the data you gave us,
and the machine is ready.


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F63600000000}I see. Thank you for your work.
Have the machine brought aboard the ship.


{C:8193BA00}{C:81958296F73600000000}Understood.
And about that Zeta...


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F83600000000}I know!
Proceed with that matter as before.

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296F93600000000}Yes, ma'am. I'll see to it.
I'll meet you here again later, then.


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296FA3600000000}It seems the new machine has arrived.
Give it to Char.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB3600000000}...Char?
Oh, you mean Lieutenant Quattro.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296FC3600000000}Oh, yes. Quattro, wasn't it?
I've had a machine prepared especially for him,
so let him use it.

{C:81958296FD3600000000}I'm sure he'll be delighted.
Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FE3600000000}(What does she
find so funny?)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D501}{C:81958296933300000000}Trowa!
Is that you, Trowa?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296943300000000}Trowa, she's calling you.
Do you know her?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296630100000000}Sis!
What are you doing here?

{C:8190D501}{C:81958296953300000000}What about you? Where have you been?
Everyone at the circus
has been worried about you.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296640100000000}I have to fight.
It's for everyone's protection too.

{C:8190D501}{C:81958296963300000000}I see. Then I suppose it can't be helped.
I'll let you off this time.

{C:81958296973300000000}But listen to me.
Make sure you come back.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296650100000000}I know, Sis.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909700}{C:819582967B3600000000}Big brother!

{C:81930100}{C:819582967C3600000000}Huh? Rie didn't come along, did she?
Lun, was that you?

{C:81900200}{C:819582967D3600000000}Of course it wasn't.
Or do you want me to call you
'big brother'?

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F3600000000}No, that's not what I meant.

{C:81909700}{C:81958296803600000000}Big brother, I'm talking to you!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296823600000000}Me?

{C:81909700}{C:81958296833600000000}Of course!
Have you forgotten me, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296843600000000}Kamille, I didn't know you had a sister.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296853600000000}I don't. I'm an only child.
Hey, you...

{C:81909700}{C:81958296873600000000}It's Rosammy.
That's what you used to call me.
Have you forgotten?


{C:81909700}{C:81958296883600000000}You've forgotten
Rosammy, big brother.
That's so mean...

{C:81908200}{C:81958296893600000000}I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
I just couldn't remember for a moment.

{C:81909700}{C:819582968A3600000000}Then will you stay with me now?
I'm never leaving you!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:819582968B3600000000}Yeah, all right.
Come along.

{C:81909700}{C:819582968C3600000000}Thank you, big brother!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3600000000}Are you sure, Kamille?
Can you just decide that on your own?

{C:81908200}{C:819582968F3600000000}I can't just abandon her, can I?
There's nothing else I can do.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296913600000000}(Is this really all right...?)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908700}.........

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D93300000000}Emma, what's wrong?
Why the strange look?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DA3300000000}Oh, big brother.
It seems Henken
gave her a present.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB3300000000}Getting a present
would make her look like that?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DC3300000000}If someone suddenly gave you a present
and made their feelings clear,
I think anyone would look like that.

{C:81958296DD3300000000}But I don't know what happens after that.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DE3300000000}Huh, so that's how it works.
I'll have to be careful too.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D701}{C:819582962F2800000000}Hello.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302800000000}Oh, hello.
...Who were you again?

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296312800000000}Heh heh...
Wufei is aboard
your ship, isn't he?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296322800000000}Yes, he is.
Oh! You
know Wufei, then.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296332800000000}Well, yes.
Since you're friends with Wufei,
I'll give you this.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E701}{C:81958296903300000000}You've got a kid
named Duo with you, haven't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296913300000000}I don't know about calling him a kid,
but yes, Duo's with us.

{C:8190E701}{C:81958296923300000000}I see. I just wanted
to confirm that.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902201}{C:819582969A2900000000}Nelfea,
what's this next continent called?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582969C2900000000}The Astragius continent.

{C:81902201}{C:819582969D2900000000}Oh, Chirico.
Astragius?
Could that be your...?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582969E2900000000}That's right...

{C:819582969F2900000000}(Fyana...)

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A12900000000}The Astante is
entering the Astragius continent.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296A22900000000}I entrusted you with FT units and let you act.
...I commend you for drawing
the continents into war.

{C:81958296A32900000000}But...
I must say that merely seizing Norstan
falls short of my expectations.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296A52900000000}I am sorry...

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296A72900000000}If you feel that way,
then sink the Astante.
By any means necessary.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296A92900000000}Understood.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CC00}{C:81958296AA2900000000}Ah, Astante, do you read me?

{C:8193CA00}{C:81958296AB2900000000}Hiii, everyone!
It's me, Coconna!
You remember me, right?!

{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296BE0000000000}No fair, Coconna!
Let me talk too!

{C:8193CC00}{C:81958296AC2900000000}Quit getting in the way, both of you!
Anyway, it's {C:819782830300}Kummen{C:819782830000} where
you'll find us.

{C:81958296AD2900000000}Now that you're back,
make sure you come see us!
That goes for you too, Duo!

{C:8193CF01}{C:81958296AE2900000000}Yeah, yeah, I know.

{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296BF0000000000}Then we'll be waitin' for you!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296AF2900000000}Oh! You're all back!
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm, you look well!

{C:81958296B02900000000}I knew you'd make fine VOTOMS riders.
I was right about you!

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296B22900000000}Boss!
You got it wrong again!

{C:81958296B42900000000}AT riders are called VOTOMS, right?
'VOTOMS riders' makes it sound like
'AT rider riders,' doesn't it?

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296B52900000000}Was that it?
Well, whatever you call it,
I'm just glad you're safe!

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C00000000000}We've got ourselves a place!
And the name is... ta-da!
{C:819782830300}Phantom Lady{C:819782830000}!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296B72900000000}...I don't like the name.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C10000000000}Chirico, baby!
We've had it rough!

{C:81958296C20000000000}We wanted to make a place
where you could rest when you came back.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296BA2900000000}Kummen's in a civil war, you know.
There were plenty of ways to make money.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB2900000000}Thank you!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296BC2900000000}Himiko's first!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BD2900000000}Himikooo!
It's always something like this!
I'm getting so sick of it.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296BE2900000000}You're good at looking after others, Wataru.

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BF2900000000}Heh heh heh!
To put it plainly, you're absolutely right!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C02900000000}Oh, aren't you pleased with yourself.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296C12900000000}Since they've been so kind,
let us have a rest as well.
What say you, Wataru?

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296C22900000000}Yes, Teacher!
What should I eat?

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296C32900000000}Lilis, let's go too!

{C:81905400}{C:81958296C42900000000}Okaaay!
Amm, Leccee, come with us!

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C52900000000}I'm going to have them feed me
lots and lots of good stuff!

{C:81905700}{C:81958296C62900000000}You'll get fat.
Oh, you could stand to put on some weight.
Especially around the chest.

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C72900000000}I'm fine the way I am!
Unlike you, I'm still young!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C82900000000}My chest...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C92900000000}What's wrong, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CB2900000000}N-Nothing at all.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CE2900000000}Really?
Then let's go too!

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296CF2900000000}Let's have a proper celebration
to mark our reunion!
Eat and drink anything you like!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D02900000000}Huh?
Aren't you coming, Coconna?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296D12900000000}Mm... I've got
something to tell Chirico.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D32900000000}Me?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D42900000000}Then I'll go on ahead too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296D52900000000}We haven't just been
sitting around here, you know.
We've been gathering information.

{C:81958296D62900000000}We've found out that Fyana
is somewhere in Kummen.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D82900000000}Fyana's in {C:819782830300}Kummen{C:819782830000}?!
Where in Kummen?!
Tell me, Coconna!

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296D92900000000}Sorry, that's all
we've found out so far.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296DC2900000000}I see.
Sorry about that.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F42900000000}You're back.
We were discussing what to do next.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296F52900000000}Apparently, we can't go any farther
into the Cloud Sea.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62900000000}Is that right, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F72900000000}It's hopeless.

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296F82900000000}So I was asking them
to hear my request.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F92900000000}What do you want us to do?

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296FA2900000000}Kummen's civil war will end once
{C:819782830400}Heloram Kanjelman III{C:819782830000} is
defeated.

{C:81958296FB2900000000}His Highness should be above this continent.
I want you to find him and defeat him.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296C50000000000}We were saying that, if we did that,
we might also find Fyana,
the woman Chirico's looking for.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296FC2900000000}We went ahead and discussed it without you,
but can we have your approval?
Rie's already given us permission.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FD2900000000}I don't have
any reason to object.
Let's do it!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296C60000000000}Workin' hard, Chirico, baby?

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296FF2900000000}Vanilla? What is it?

{C:8193CA00}{C:81958296002A00000000}I'm here too.

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296032A00000000}So, what do you two want?

{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296C70000000000}Well, see...
You tell him, Coconna.

{C:8193CA00}{C:81958296042A00000000}Huh? Me?
You tell him, Vanilla!

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296062A00000000}I'm busy.
Would you leave me alone?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C80000000000}Ah, fine, I'll get right to it.
Why don't you stop looking
for the Phantom Lady?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296082A00000000}What?!

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582960C2A00000000}Please don't get angry.
We can't bear to see
you looking so miserable.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C90000000000}We don't know what happened,
but we can't think of any reason
except the Phantom Lady.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582960E2A00000000}I see... I'm sorry.
But I appreciate your concern.
Thank you.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296CA0000000000}Huh?
What did Chirico just say?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296102A00000000}He said thank you.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296CB0000000000}Chirico said thank you!
Now that's somethin' else!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296122A00000000}If I've changed,
it's thanks to my companions.
They're the ones who changed me.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296142A00000000}In that case,
forget what we just said.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296CC0000000000}Yeah, that's right.
If you've found more good friends,
we've got nothin' more to say.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296C80100000000}Remember, His Highness is
above the Astragius continent.
Make a sweep of the skies over the continent.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A602}{C:819582961E2A00000000}Wataru's being held
on that ship, right?

{C:8193F200}{C:819582961F2A00000000}So it would seem.
That's what Arago's
subordinates said.

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296202A00000000}All right! I'll beat them!

{C:8193F200}{C:81958296212A00000000}(Will this really work?
 Using a kid with that look in his eyes,
 like he's been brainwashed...?)




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938F00}{C:81958296162A00000000}I've found you, Astante.

{C:81939200}{C:81958296172A00000000}Jerid,
are you really going to attack?

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296182A00000000}Of course.
Why else would we have come
all the way out here?

{C:81939200}{C:81958296192A00000000}(It's dangerous to get so obsessed...)


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939200}{C:819582961A2A00000000}We're pulling back, Jerid.

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961B2A00000000}Not yet! I can still fight!

{C:81939200}{C:819582961C2A00000000}Think about what this battle means!
You saw it too!
Are you just going to do as you're told?!

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961D2A00000000}All right... I'll retreat.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A602}{C:81958296AF2A00000000}Hang on, Wataru!
I'll save you now!

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296B02A00000000}Toraoh, what's wrong?!
We're all right!

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B12A00000000}I'll take back Wataru
and my bride!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B22A00000000}Huh?
What am I doing
in a place like this?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A502}{C:81958296B62A00000000}Let's go, Himiko.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296B72A00000000}Okaaay!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B82A00000000}Wataru, Himiko,
where are you off to in such a hurry?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296B92A00000000}We're going to look for Tora-chan!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BA2A00000000}Wait a moment!
Wataru, Himiko,
I'll go with you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A702}{C:81958296BB2A00000000}Wataruuu...
Do you think Tora-chan's dead?

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BC2A00000000}Don't talk nonsense!
There's no way Toraoh's dead!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296BD2A00000000}But... but...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE2A00000000}I'm sorry, Wataru.
We couldn't do anything.

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296C12A00000000}Please don't...
Toraoh's all right.

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296C22A00000000}Wataru! Himiko!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296C32A00000000}See? I can even hear him.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A602}{C:81958296CB2A00000000}Well, when I came to,
I was in a pile of rubble or something.

{C:81958296CC2A00000000}Then I looked up and saw Ryujinmaru,
so I came running!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296CD2A00000000}Toraoh... Toraoh... Toraooooh!

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296CE2A00000000}What's with you, Wataru?
Are you that happy
to see me?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296CF2A00000000}Tora-chan, come
with us!

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296D02A00000000}I've got nothing else to do anyway.
And you and Wataru are here,
so why not?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296D12A00000000}That's okay, right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D22A00000000}Yeah, of course.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C800}{C:81958296232A00000000}This is Chirico.
Epsilon, release Fyana.

{C:8193D400}{C:81958296252A00000000}Why do you call her Fyana?
Because of that, she...
Chirico, if only you weren't here!

{C:81958296262A00000000}Face me, Chirico!
I'll end it all here!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D300}{C:81958296282A00000000}I am Heloram Kanjelman.
I am the man you're looking for.

{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296C90100000000}Your Highness...

{C:8193D300}{C:819582962A2A00000000}Pota...
It pains me to have to fight you.
But it cannot be helped.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D300}{C:819582962C2A00000000}This ship will sink soon.
Before that, may I speak with Pota?

{C:81930300}{C:819582962D2A00000000}Potaria,
please use that communicator.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296CA0100000000}Your Highness, why start a civil war...?

{C:8193D300}{C:819582962E2A00000000}Under the influence of other continents,
Kummen has changed far too quickly.

{C:819582962F2A00000000}As a result, nostalgia for the old ways
has become immeasurably strong.
I am nostalgia itself.

{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296CB0100000000}Your Highness, you can't mean...!

{C:8193D300}{C:81958296302A00000000}For Kummen's future, it would be better
if I, a member of the royal family, did not exist.
But... not while things stand as they are.

{C:81958296322A00000000}Drive out Grados, and with those people,
defeat whoever stands behind them.
You will do this for me, Pota?

{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296CC0100000000}I promise you, Your Highness.

{C:8193D300}{C:81958296342A00000000}Pota...
I... loved you...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C800}{C:81958296362A00000000}Rie, take us down to Kummen.
I want to look for Fyana.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296382A00000000}Oh, yes!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296392A00000000}Chirico should already
be here ahead of us.
I wonder if he's found Fyana.

{C:819582963A2A00000000}Oh, there he is!
Chirico!
How did it go?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582963B2A00000000}She's nowhere to be found...

{C:81904202}{C:819582963C2A00000000}According to Vanilla,
some strange man came and abducted her.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963D2A00000000}Abducted her?

{C:8190CE01}{C:819582963E2A00000000}He's apparently a soldier on Balarant's side.
We'll just have to look again.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963F2A00000000}Chirico, let's go.
If she's not in Kummen, let's search {C:819782830300}Uoodo{C:819782830000} and 
{C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000} for her.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296402A00000000}Yeah. Thanks.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193DB00}{C:81958296412A00000000}Well, well! Here they come!
You're going to fight with me too.

{C:81958296422A00000000}Though I doubt you can move as you please
inside that machine!

{C:8193C900}{C:81958296432A00000000}Chirico...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C800}{C:81958296462A00000000}Fyana!
Why are you fighting us?
Pull back!

{C:8193C900}{C:81958296472A00000000}I'm sorry, Chirico.
I can't control this AT.

{C:8193DB00}{C:81958296482A00000000}Shut up, all of you!
Hurry up and die!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296572A00000000}Don't let it get you down.
With such a reckless move,
there was nothing we could do.

{C:81958296582A00000000}Instead, let's be grateful
that everyone is safe.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296592A00000000}Yeah.
You're right, Lun.
Thank you, Lun!

{C:819582965A2A00000000}I'll go see the others
and discuss what we do next.

{C:81900200}{C:819582965B2A00000000}All right. Good luck!

{C:81900300}{C:819582965C2A00000000}That's our Lun!
You really understand
what my big brother's like!

{C:81900200}{C:819582965F2A00000000}Do I?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296602A00000000}Now I see why he was so desperate
to get you back,
Lun!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296612A00000000}He was desperate?
Him?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296622A00000000}He thought
he was hiding it,
but it shows on his face so easily.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296632A00000000}It was obvious, wasn't it?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296642A00000000}Exactly!
He'd suddenly get all serious.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296652A00000000}You look like you're having fun.
May I join you?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296672A00000000}Of course.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296682A00000000}Huh? What's going on?

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296692A00000000}Look!
Something's flying this way!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932B01}{C:819582966A2A00000000}Hear this!
From this moment on, this continent
is under the rule of Grados!

{C:819582966B2A00000000}Anyone who resists will be purged without mercy!
Take heed!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932B01}{C:819582966C2A00000000}You will take control of this continent.

{C:81932F01}{C:819582966D2A00000000}Understood!

{C:81932D01}{C:819582966E2A00000000}And where are you going, Lord {C:819782830400}Le Caine{C:819782830000}?

{C:81932B01}{C:819582966F2A00000000}I am heading to another continent.
I leave the rest to you.

{C:81932C01}{C:81958296702A00000000}Yes, my lord!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932E01}{C:81958296CD0000000000}So, what now?

{C:81932D01}{C:81958296712A00000000}Don't worry about it.
Let's do whatever the hell we want!

{C:81932C01}{C:81958296722A00000000}That sounds good.
I'm gonna have myself plenty of fun!

{C:81932F01}{C:81958296732A00000000}You, {C:819782830400}Gosterro{C:819782830000}!
You don't get to make the decisions!

{C:81932C01}{C:81958296742A00000000}What did you say?!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296752A00000000}Damn it!
We can't do a thing at a time like this!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296762A00000000}Gotho,
can't you find us a ship somehow?

{C:81958296772A00000000}I left my ship
back in Pentagona,
so there's nothing I can do.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582967A2A00000000}Fyana, do you know anything?

{C:8190C900}{C:819582967B2A00000000}I'm sorry.
I don't know much about this area...

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296CD0100000000}I don't remember hearing
about any ships in Kummen.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582967C2A00000000}We've got nothing to lose.
Why don't we split up
and search all over Kummen?

{C:81900A01}{C:819582967D2A00000000}Let's do that!
I don't know anything about ships,
but I can help look for one.

{C:81900300}{C:819582967E2A00000000}Everyone's offering to help,
so let's try looking, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2A00000000}All right!
Let's split up and search!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A00}{C:81958296812A00000000}Hey, Kyo.
There's a mighty suspicious ship out there.
What do we do? Shall we take it on?

{C:81930700}{C:81958296822A00000000}Tail, prepare for battle.
Don't attack yet.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296832A00000000}No, here it comes!

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296842A00000000}Oh! It's been a while since we saw
that intuition of yours, Kyo!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930900}{C:81958296CE0000000000}What a vulgar enemy.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296862A00000000}More importantly, can't we
get in touch with the Astante?
I'm concerned that there's no response.

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296872A00000000}Speak of the devil.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296882A00000000}Uncle!


{C:81930700}{C:81958296892A00000000}Stop calling me that.

{C:81930400}{C:819582968A2A00000000}Look, it's Uncle and the others!

{C:81930600}{C:819582968B2A00000000}Nelfea?
You're all there, then?
Tell me where you are.

{C:81930300}{C:819582968C2A00000000}Dad, it's Rie.
Everyone's in the town of Kummen.
I'll send a signal.

{C:81930A00}{C:819582968D2A00000000}Signal confirmed.
We're heading to Kummen.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582968E2A00000000}How was the Astante?

{C:81900700}{C:819582968F2A00000000}Unfortunately, it can no longer fly.
I had the parts that looked usable moved aboard
{C:819782830400}Astante II{C:819782830000}.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:81958296902A00000000}We're nearly finished loading
the machines from the other continents too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296912A00000000}Dad...

{C:81900600}{C:81958296922A00000000}What is it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296932A00000000}I'm sorry... I...

{C:81900600}{C:81958296942A00000000}You did well.
I don't mean getting Lun back.
You did well to gather allies from other continents.

{C:81958296952A00000000}Now we know who's pulling the strings,
they'll be an important source of strength.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296962A00000000}{C:819782830400}Redros Binzvanker{C:819782830000}
is the one who started
this war, apparently.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972A00000000}Isn't Redros a war hero just like
you and the others, Dad?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296982A00000000}And Redros is also the one
who later set off the civil war.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296992A00000000}But I thought Redros was dead?

{C:81900A00}{C:819582969A2A00000000}Turns out Redros was still alive.
Stubborn bastard.

{C:81900600}{C:819582969B2A00000000}That enemy is strong.
We'll help you in the battles ahead.
Stay on your guard.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:819582969C2A00000000}Expecting the fighting to grow more difficult,
I've prepared new FT units.
Discuss it with your companions and put them to good use.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582969D2A00000000}All right, we're departing.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2A00000000}Huh? But the Cloud Sea...

{C:81900900}{C:81958296CF0000000000}The Cloud Sea has already opened
so we can reach the next continent.

{C:81900400}{C:819582969F2A00000000}Everyone's waiting.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A02A00000000}Let's go, big brother.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:81958296293700000000}So you're saying you cannot help us?

{C:81900C00}{C:819582962A3700000000}Of course.
I have no reason to help you.

{C:81900600}{C:819582962B3700000000}Do you understand
what you've done?

{C:81900C00}{C:819582962C3700000000}Of course... I have no regrets.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582962D3700000000}Dad!

{C:81900600}{C:819582962E3700000000}You... What are you doing here?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962F3700000000}I wanted a word with that one.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296303700000000}I have nothing to say to you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296313700000000}Well, I have something to say.

{C:81958296323700000000}...Thank you for not killing
Lun.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296333700000000}Heh... Ha ha ha ha!
How absurd!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296343700000000}Say whatever you like.
That was all I wanted to say.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296353700000000}What a sorry state of affairs.
The son of a hero, acting like this.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296363700000000}Yes, this boy's an idiot.
But I can't help loving
this idiot son of mine.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296373700000000}Hmph...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296383700000000}Sorry to interrupt, Dad.


{C:81930600}{C:81958296393700000000}Oh, it's fine.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B102}{C:81958296D32A00000000}Master,
what are you thinking?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D52A00000000}My thoughts?
Now, what a strange thing to ask.

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296D62A00000000}Don't play dumb.
{C:819782830400}Yoja Soldiers{C:819782830000} have sent us a report.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D72A00000000}If you've something to say,
why not say it plainly,
like a man?

{C:81958296D82A00000000}Oh, but you esteemed Four Masho are demon generals,
so perhaps you aren't men at all.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B402}{C:81958296DA2A00000000}You dare mock us?!

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296DB2A00000000}Stop, {C:819782830400}Rajura{C:819782830000}!
There's no point in fighting among ourselves.

{C:8193B302}{C:81958296DD2A00000000}Comrades?
You call this old geezer a comrade!?
He's a mere human!

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296DE2A00000000}{C:819782830400}Naza{C:819782830000}, you stop too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B202}{C:81958296DF2A00000000}{C:819782830400}Shuten{C:819782830000},
since when did you become our master?

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296E02A00000000}What are you saying, {C:819782830400}Anubis{C:819782830000}!?
Our one and only master is Lord {C:819782830400}Arago{C:819782830000}.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296E12A00000000}Forgive me, but I haven't the time
to indulge your nonsense.

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296E22A00000000}Undefeated of the East, Master Asia!
I'll find the little girl you took away
and expose the true identity!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296E42A00000000}Oh?
Then try it, if you can.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E52A00000000}Are those people in costumes?
They're really well made.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E62A00000000}They are! They're adorable!!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296D20000000000}When all's said and done,
you're still a girl, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E72A00000000}What's wrong with that?
Cute things are cute!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED2A00000000}Eee!
They're coming this way!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EE2A00000000}You certainly look happy.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296EF2A00000000}Have you seen our leader around here?
He's a boy in red clothes
with his belly showing.

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296F02A00000000}Rie, that's not a costume.
That's a living creature.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F12A00000000}Whaaaaat!!

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296F22A00000000}I'm sorry to startle you.
We're called Animanoids,
and we're genuine living organisms.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32A00000000}Whew... Just what is going on
with this world...?


{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296F42A00000000}I don't think we've met
the person you call your leader.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296F62A00000000}I see. Where the heck have
our leader and the others gone?

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296F72A00000000}They're a handful.
So, what do we do?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296F82A00000000}Don't you sense something strange?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296F92A00000000}Can't you tell anything
with your Trooper abilities?

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296FA2A00000000}It's the Yoja!
Rie, all of you, stand back!
Ryo, we're armoring up!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C602}{C:81958296FB2A00000000}So there are enemies like that here.
But we can't fight
without becoming Kiba.

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296FC2A00000000}We need to rejoin Toya and the others
as soon as possible.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296FD2A00000000}So, what do we do?

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296FF2A00000000}You people in armor,
could you allow us
to accompany you?

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296002B00000000}Accompany us?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296012B00000000}You clearly don't seem to be
from this continent.

{C:81958296022B00000000}So I believe you must have
some means of transportation.
Is that correct?

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296032B00000000}So that's why you want to come with us.
What do we do?

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296052B00000000}Tch, it's pathetic that we can't do anything
without relying on people like these.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296072B00000000}Then you don't have to
force yourselves
to come with us.

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296092B00000000}What did you say!!

{C:81900400}{C:819582960A2B00000000}Oh, stop it already!
I'm sick of quarrels
whenever someone new turns up!

{C:819582960B2B00000000}You bears, make up your minds.
Are you coming with us or not?

{C:8190C902}{C:819582960C2B00000000}B-bears?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296D30000000000}Yeah, yeah!

{C:81900400}{C:819582960D2B00000000}Don't heckle from the sidelines!!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296D40000000000}I'm sorry...

{C:81900300}{C:819582960E2B00000000}We can make arrangements
to take you aboard our ship.
What would you like to do?

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296102B00000000}We've gotta
find our leader.

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296112B00000000}There's only one answer, then.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296132B00000000}We'd like you to
let us aboard your ship.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296142B00000000}Yes, we'd be delighted.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E22900000000}What do you think you're doing!?

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E32900000000}A little brat like you
has no business looking at Proto One.
Get lost!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E42900000000}You hit me out of nowhere,
and now you're saying that!!

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E52900000000}What was that, brat?
You dare defy me!!


{C:8190C900}{C:81958296E62900000000}Epsilon!
What are you doing!!

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E72900000000}Well, this brat was looking at Proto One...

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296E82900000000}I'll take care of things here.
You go back ahead of me.

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E92900000000}If you say so, Proto One...

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296EB2900000000}I'm sorry.
He's a little hotheaded.
I'm Fyana.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EC2900000000}Huh?
Didn't that person just
call you Proto One?

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296ED2900000000}That's...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE2900000000}Oh!
Fyana is the same name
as the person Chirico's looking for.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296EF2900000000}You know Chirico!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F02900000000}So it is you.
Come with me.
Chirico's waiting.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296F12900000000}I... I can't go now.
Don't tell Chirico you met me.
I'm sorry...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32900000000}Ah!
Don't tell Chirico... huh.
I guess I'd better not say anything.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296B33300000000}This is called the Mobile Trace System,
isn't it?

{C:81958296B43300000000}With this, it almost seems
even I could operate it.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296B53300000000}It's not that simple.
I tried getting in it once...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B601}{C:81958296073800000000}And it was awful, I tell you!

{C:81958296083800000000}You're solidly built,
but you have a delicate frame, so I don't think you could do it.
You really need to be a martial artist.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B63300000000}I was a little interested,
but hearing that scares me.
Hmm, I'll give it up.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296B73300000000}Good. You listen to reason.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296223400000000}Kamille, listen to me.
It's dangerous to keep her at your side.
Amuro says so too.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296243400000000}Lieutenant Quattro,
can't you speak without
borrowing Amuro's words?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296253400000000}Kamille!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296273400000000}Are you going to correct me?
But hitting me
won't change how I feel.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296283400000000}Kamille, stop.
If my being here is a burden,
I'll leave the ship.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296293400000000}That would be best.
Cyber-Newtypes are dangerous!

{C:81938200}{C:819582962A3400000000}Lieutenant Quattro!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938400}{C:819582962B3400000000}Ghh!

{C:81938200}{C:819582962C3400000000}Being an adult doesn't give you the right
to hurt people!!
Excuse me.

{C:81939500}{C:819582962D3400000000}Kamille, are you sure?

{C:81938200}{C:819582962E3400000000}It's all right.
Let's go, Four.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908A00}{C:819582962F3400000000}He got you there, Char.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296303400000000}Can't I make him understand...?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296313400000000}You won't if you speak like that.
That's why you can't
persuade Sayla either.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296323400000000}Artesia has nothing to do with this.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296333400000000}If you can't understand that,
you won't be able to persuade Kamille.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296353400000000}Could you do it?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296363400000000}No...
Even after several years,
I haven't gotten beyond that myself.

{C:81958296373400000000}People's feelings are complicated.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296383400000000}They are...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A502}{C:81958296CB3300000000}Don't you think
we're fun-and-cool?

{C:81934202}{C:81958296CC3300000000}Fun... and cool?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296CD3300000000}It means we're fun
and we're cool.

{C:81934202}{C:81958296CE3300000000}Ahahaha, I see.
Himiko and Shibaraku
are both funny, aren't they?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296CF3300000000}Well, Himiko's a special case.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:819582966F2B00000000}May I have a moment?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296702B00000000}Azuves, did you need me?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296712B00000000}There is something I wish to discuss.
Would you hear me out?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296722B00000000}You want to discuss something with me?
Wouldn't Dad and the others
be better people to ask?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296732B00000000}Forgive me for saying so,
but although he is your father,
I have only known him a short while.

{C:81958296742B00000000}As someone who has fought beside you,
it is only natural that I should trust you
more than I do your father.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296752B00000000}...Azuves,
thank you!
What did you want to discuss?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296762B00000000}The truth is... Few people know this,
but Jojo
is not my grandson.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296772B00000000}He's not your real grandson...?
Then...

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296782B00000000}His real name is Joldy.
{C:819782830400}Joldy Vorder{C:819782830000},
and he is the late King Vorder's son.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296792B00000000}Does that mean
Jojo's a prince?

{C:819582967A2B00000000}Oh, so that's why you told him
not to overestimate his strength,
and that strength alone wasn't enough.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582967B2B00000000}Precisely!
A king needs great strength,
but that alone will not suffice.

{C:819582967C2B00000000}I wanted our prince
to learn that through his own experience.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967D2B00000000}I'm sure Jojo
understands how you feel,
Azuves.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582967F2B00000000}Then let me ask you this.
Do you believe Jojo has grown?
That he has the makings of a king?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802B00000000}Are you sure you should leave
such an important judgment to me?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296812B00000000}It is precisely because it is you
that I ask.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822B00000000}All right.
But honestly, I don't really know
what makes someone fit to be a king.

{C:81958296832B00000000}Watching Jojo work so hard,
I've felt I ought to learn from him.

{C:81958296842B00000000}So if Jojo were king,
I'd like to live in his country.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296852B00000000}Now I can finally
tell our prince the truth.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296872B00000000}So Jojo would be king...
It won't be easy for him, though.
He's such a nice guy...




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296882B00000000}Jojo, we must talk.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296892B00000000}What's wrong, Grandpa?
You look so serious.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582968A2B00000000}I have watched all your battles
since you first boarded Galient.

{C:819582968B2B00000000}Through countless battles against Mardoul,
Posaydal and Grados,
you have grown.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582968C2B00000000}Grandpa!
Do you really think so?

{C:81900E01}{C:819582968E2B00000000}I do.
That is why I must
tell you the truth.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582968F2B00000000}The truth?
What do you mean?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296902B00000000}Your real name is
Joldy Vorder.
You are the son of the late King Vorder.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296922B00000000}You mean I'm a prince?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296932B00000000}Now is the time for you, as king,
to rise against Mardoul for everyone's sake.
You have gained the strength to do so.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296942B00000000}But Grandpa,
I... I...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296952B00000000}Do you believe
I was too hasty?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296972B00000000}Now that we're back in Crescent,
I think this is the best time.

{C:81958296982B00000000}But Jojo's kind.
I think he's afraid
of dragging everyone into a war.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296992B00000000}Would you be so kind
as to hear him out again?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A2B00000000}All right.
I'll find Jojo and talk to him.
But don't get your hopes up.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582969C2B00000000}I can safely
leave it to you.

{C:81900200}{C:819582969D2B00000000}Um...

{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2B00000000}Whoa, Lun, you were here too?
What's wrong?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A02B00000000}I overheard...
Azuves,
may I go with him?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296A12B00000000}You, young lady?
I see no reason why not.
I am counting on you both.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296CE0100000000}Welcome baaack!
Huh? Where's Jojo?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22B00000000}Well, it's a bit complicated.
If you see Jojo,
will you tell him I'm looking for him?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296CF0100000000}Sure, I can do that.
Sooo, is the girl with you
your girlfriend?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A42B00000000}I'm Lun Forest.
Am I his girlfriend, I wonder?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296A62B00000000}Ahh, I was
in the middle of looking for Jojo.
Now, where could he be?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A82B00000000}Hee hee... Sorry!
I won't tease you anymore, so wait for me!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D701}{C:81958296A92B00000000}Oh, Wufei,
you're as cold as ever.

{C:81958296AA2B00000000}You won't help me,
so I'm going around
all these places on my own.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296AB2B00000000}That has nothing to do with me.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AC2B00000000}Yes, yes...

{C:81958296AD2B00000000}Oh, you're here too.
Here, this is for you today.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296AE2B00000000}I'm sorry.
