{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AF2B00000000}Oh? When someone gives you something,
you say thank you, don't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B02B00000000}Oh, you're right.
Thank you.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296B12B00000000}What are you doing?

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296B22B00000000}I'm collecting items
to give you all
an advantage in battle.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296B32B00000000}I didn't ask you to.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296B42B00000000}I know.
I'm doing it of my own accord,
so don't let it bother you.

{C:81958296B52B00000000}Now, I'd better go
and find some more presents.
See you again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B62B00000000}Oh, Wufei,
have you seen Jojo?

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296B72B00000000}I wouldn't know.


{C:81900200}{C:81958296B92B00000000}Hee hee.
Wufei almost looks
jealous.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BA2B00000000}Wufei?
No way.
Not Wufei.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296BB2B00000000}Hmm, are you sure?




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296BD2B00000000}To think I was a prince...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE2B00000000}Was it a shock?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296BF2B00000000}What are you two doing here?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02B00000000}Azuves asked us
to see how you were doing.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296C12B00000000}I'm just tagging along.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C32B00000000}What do you think
about me being a prince?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C42B00000000}I don't think it matters
whether you're a prince
or how much power you have.

{C:81958296C52B00000000}What matters is what you want to do
as someone from Crescent.
What do you think?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C62B00000000}As someone from Crescent...

{C:81900200}{C:81958296C82B00000000}Even if you're a prince,
you're still Jojo, right?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C92B00000000}Of course...!
Oh, so that's what it means.
I get it!

{C:81958296CA2B00000000}Yeah, I'll do it.
I may be a prince,
but first, I'm someone from Crescent!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296CB2B00000000}You can do it!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296CC2B00000000}Yeah!

{C:81958296CD2B00000000}All right, now that's settled,
I'd better go
and tell Grandpa!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DA0000000000}Where have you been?
Something amazing's happened.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D22B00000000}What happened, Sho?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DB0000000000}It turns out
Jojo was a prince.
Quite a shock, eh, Daba?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296D32B00000000}...A prince...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D42B00000000}What's wrong, Daba?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296D52B00000000}Oh, no, it's nothing.

{C:81958296D62B00000000}Hey, Sho.
Do you think it's better
to reveal who you really are?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DC0000000000}Why not?
It's not as if we're friends because of our status.
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D72B00000000}Of course.


{C:81901B00}{C:81958296D82B00000000}That's right!
Otherwise, a Mi Ferario like me
wouldn't be one of you!

{C:81901801}{C:81958296D92B00000000}Excuse me.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296DA2B00000000}Oh, I'm sorry.

{C:81901801}{C:81958296DB2B00000000}Prince Joldy,
I am {C:819782830400}Zuwel{C:819782830000}'s pilot,
{C:819782830400}Jilmzen Ranvel.{C:819782830000}

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296D00100000000}Ranvel's been fighting for us
at White Valley
the whole time you were away, Jojo.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296DC2B00000000}So that's what happened.
Thank you, Ranvel!

{C:81901801}{C:81958296DD2B00000000}Even though I did not know you were a prince,
please forgive my discourtesy.

{C:81958296DE2B00000000}And at the risk of further discourtesy,
I have a request.
May I join your ranks?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296DF2B00000000}Of course.
In fact, I should be
asking you to join us.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901801}{C:81958296E02B00000000}Thank you.
But are you certain
you should trust me so easily?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296E22B00000000}It's all right.
Our leader
is that kind of person too.

{C:81905400}{C:81958296E32B00000000}Our leader?
Daba, who could he mean?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296E42B00000000}Isn't it obvious?
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E52B00000000}Did we
have a leader?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DD0000000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
That's our leader for you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E62B00000000}Huh?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E82B00000000}They're all talking about you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E92B00000000}Whaaat, me?!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296EA2B00000000}It's because he's like this
that everyone follows him.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DE0000000000}That's right.
But don't start acting self-conscious.
We all like you just as you are.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB2B00000000}Right...

{C:81900200}{C:81958296EE2B00000000}Cheer up!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2B00000000}But it's all
so sudden...

{C:81900200}{C:81958296F02B00000000}It's all right.
Have confidence in yourself.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32B00000000}Sigh... Me, the leader?
I can't believe
everyone sees me that way.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F42B00000000}What's wrong?
You're muttering to yourself.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F52B00000000}Nelfea,
who do you think
is leading our group right now?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F62B00000000}Whaaaaaat?
Why are you asking that now?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296F82B00000000}Sho and Daba told him,
"You're our leader!"
But he doesn't seem to believe it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F92B00000000}Well, of course I don't.
There are so many people
more impressive than me.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FA2B00000000}That's true.
Even I'm
a better pilot than you.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296FC2B00000000}Um...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FD2B00000000}But people don't follow someone
just because
they're more or less skilled.

{C:81958296FE2B00000000}Even Rie follows you,
despite being the captain,
and it's not because she's your sister.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FF2B00000000}Huh?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296002C00000000}It's because she's obsessed with her brother...

{C:81958296012C00000000}I'm joking.
It's because she believes in you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296022C00000000}Who are you calling obsessed with her brother?!!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296032C00000000}Oh my, you were here?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296042C00000000}Yes, I was!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296052C00000000}Then there's no need to ask, is there?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296062C00000000}Hey, you two.
That's enough.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A702}{C:81958296072C00000000}Wooo, wooo!
It's an alaaaarm!
The enemy's coming!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296092C00000000}But there isn't even an alarm going off.

{C:8190A702}{C:819582960A2C00000000}I'm a ninja,
so my eyesight's super good!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582960C2C00000000}Oh, that was quick.
You seem well trained.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960D2C00000000}Never mind that. What about the enemy?!

{C:81908400}{C:819582960E2C00000000}They seem to be aboard an old Terra warship, 
{C:819782830400}Zanzibar{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960F2C00000000}Astante II, launch!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296102C00000000}Yes!
Astante II is launching!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A01}{C:81958296142C00000000}Under the circumstances, we'd better attack the 
{C:819782830300}Iron Castle{C:819782830000} as soon
as possible.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296162C00000000}I think we should
if we're to move forward.
What do you think?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296172C00000000}That's a sound judgment.
What do you say?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296182C00000000}Let's go, Jojo!
The first strike wins.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901701}{C:81958296D10100000000}Your Majesty, please wait!
There is no need for Your Majesty
to face the likes of them in person!

{C:81901601}{C:81958296222C00000000}High... You see,
I want to witness
their strength with my own eyes.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D20100000000}But Your Majesty...

{C:81901601}{C:81958296232C00000000}Very well, then.
You may go first.

{C:81958296242C00000000}But if you are no match for them,
I shall go out myself.
Is that understood, High?

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D30100000000}Even if it costs me my life,
I promise you
I will sink the Astante II.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930F01}{C:81958296272C00000000}Stop talking nonsense,
Mardoul.
Now is the time to settle this!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931601}{C:81958296282C00000000}My opponents are the young ones.
This is no time for
the likes of you to interfere, Slarzen.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931601}{C:819582962A2C00000000}Well done. You have defeated me.
I am at the {C:819782830300}excavation site{C:819782830000}.
I will not flee. Come to me.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582962B2C00000000}I could go by myself.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C2C00000000}No way.
It would be dangerous
for you to go alone.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582962D2C00000000}Maybe so,
but I know it's dangerous.
That's why I want fewer people to go.

{C:81901C00}{C:819582962E2C00000000}Hee hee. Haven't we heard
something like that before?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962F2C00000000}Have we?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296DF0000000000}It's remarkably similar
to what you once said.
Have you forgotten?


{C:8190D301}{C:81958296302C00000000}Excuse me.

{C:81958296312C00000000}I've been told Heero Yuy
is here.
May I see him?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296E00000000000}I'll show you the way.

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296322C00000000}Hey, that's not a good idea.
You can't just take a stranger in.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296E20000000000}I know her.
Don't worry about it.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296332C00000000}Then let's leave that to Trowa
and get going.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296342C00000000}Okay, Jojo.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582963D2C00000000}There he is! Mardoul!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963E2C00000000}So that's Mardoul...


{C:81901601}{C:819582963F2C00000000}Prince Joldy,
do you know what this place is?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296402C00000000}It's a Panzer Blade excavation site.
Anyone could see that!

{C:81901601}{C:81958296412C00000000}I needed
to excavate Panzer Blades
for a certain purpose.

{C:81958296422C00000000}But this continent's technology is still primitive.
So I accepted a proposal
from a young person from Claudia.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296432C00000000}Your purpose... You joined forces
to conquer Crescent, didn't you?!

{C:81901601}{C:81958296442C00000000}That is not my purpose.
I wish to end this unrelated war
as soon as possible.

{C:81958296452C00000000}I am even considering a truce
and lending you my strength to that end.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296462C00000000}How are we supposed to believe
what you're saying?
You were our enemy until now.


{C:81901601}{C:81958296472C00000000}Boy from another continent,
you are right.
But it is still too early to speak of it.

{C:81958296482C00000000}...High Schultatte.
You are there, are you not?
Come out.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D70100000000}I am always at Your Majesty's side.

{C:81901601}{C:81958296492C00000000}High commands my Royal Guard.
I shall send him
to fight alongside you.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D80100000000}Your Majesty?!

{C:81901601}{C:819582964A2C00000000}My beloved High,
will you not grant my request?

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D90100000000}...If that is Your Majesty's wish.

{C:81901601}{C:819582964B2C00000000}Well, Prince Joldy,
and boy from another continent,
is even this not enough?


{C:81900A01}{C:819582964C2C00000000}I'd ask what you think...
but I can already imagine the answer.


{C:81930100}{C:819582964D2C00000000}Yeah, yeah, I'm simple-minded.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582964E2C00000000}I'm complimenting you.

{C:81958296502C00000000}Mardoul, I accept the truce.
But only until the war outside is over.

{C:81901601}{C:81958296512C00000000}I understand.
When this war is over,
then we shall settle who is stronger.

{C:81958296522C00000000}Now, go.
The Cloud Sea will open soon.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296E30000000000}Oh, welcome back.
We just got word
that the Cloud Sea's starting to open.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296532C00000000}We're leaving soon.
Get yourself ready too.
That's a message from Professor Rondo.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190EE01}{C:81958296572C00000000}Excuse me.
Is the person in charge
here?



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B501}{C:819582965F2C00000000}Stop right there!

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296592C00000000}We're certainly getting plenty of visitors.

{C:81931A00}{C:81958296E40000000000}Sorry, but you can't expect
the person in charge to come out
just because you suddenly ask.

{C:8193EE01}{C:819582965B2C00000000}As you can see,
I am unarmed.

{C:819582965C2C00000000}I have come to surrender
and to deliver a message
from a certain person.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E2C00000000}Let's hear what you have to say.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B501}{C:819582965F2C00000000}Stop right there!

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296E40000000000}Sorry, but you can't expect
the person in charge to come out
just because you suddenly ask.

{C:8190EE01}{C:81958296602C00000000}As you can see,
I am unarmed.

{C:81958296612C00000000}I have come to surrender
and to deliver a message
from a certain person.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296622C00000000}Let's hear what you have to say.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190EE01}{C:81958296642C00000000}I am {C:819782830400}Lady Une{C:819782830000}
and I have come to convey the words
of His Excellency Treize Khushrenada:

{C:81958296652C00000000}"To investigate the enemy's movements
and find people who might become our allies,
I must oppose you for a time.

{C:81958296662C00000000}I have sent Lady, whom I trust,
because I want you to know
that those actions are not my true intent."

{C:81958296672C00000000}That is his message.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296682C00000000}She might
get captured,
but this Treize still sent her here.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296E50000000000}Did you not think
you might be taken prisoner?

{C:8190EE01}{C:81958296692C00000000}If it is for Lord Treize,
I am prepared to accept that too.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966A2C00000000}Sigh...
If that's how you feel,
please come aboard.

{C:819582966B2C00000000}We'll treat you as a companion,
just like everyone else.
Is that all right with you?


{C:8190EE01}{C:819582966D2C00000000}I can pilot an MS,
so I believe I can be of use.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A01}{C:819582966E2C00000000}Sorry, but could you take us back to 
{C:819782830300}White Valley{C:819782830000}?

{C:819582966F2C00000000}I'd like to report the truce to the people there
before we go to another continent.
Is that all right, Eiji?

{C:81932201}{C:81958296702C00000000}Of course I don't mind.
You don't mind either, do you, Rie?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296712C00000000}Of course not!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296732C00000000}Is it all right to let him go alone?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296742C00000000}He'll be fine in White Valley.
I've got maintenance to do,
so I'm going too.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296BF3A00000000}Oh? You seem to be keeping on top of things.
Did something happen?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296752C00000000}There's a girl who's always on my case.
"What do you think you're doing to the FT
my dear professor built?" she says.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296762C00000000}Ah, that girl.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296772C00000000}Ah-choo!
Someone's
talking about me behind my back.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296782C00000000}Well, I'm off to do maintenance.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296792C00000000}I have a message from Rondo.

{C:819582967A2C00000000}Two new FTs
have apparently rolled out.
Check them over and choose their pilots.



{C:81930100}{C:819582967B2C00000000}Yeah, got it.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967C2C00000000}Phew, it's finally done.
I just can't leave Cloud Saber's maintenance
to anyone else.

{C:81900700}{C:819582967D2C00000000}That's the right attitude.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967E2C00000000}Oh, Professor.
What brings you here?


{C:81900700}{C:819582967F2C00000000}Well, I came to see how Cloud Saber was doing
and whether you'd talked about the FTs.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802C00000000}Oh, yes, we've talked about them.
We have companions who suit the machines' capabilities,
so I'm having them try them out.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296812C00000000}I see...
Pilots who can handle FTs
must be exceptionally capable.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822C00000000}And they're good people too.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296832C00000000}Good companions are a precious treasure.
Be sure to value them.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296842C00000000}Now then, I wonder if Jojo's back.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296852C00000000}Oh, big brother.
Jojo's back.
Everyone says they're ready too.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296862C00000000}By the way, the next continent we can reach is 
{C:819782830300}Brave{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872C00000000}I was just about to ask.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296882C00000000}The first strike wins!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296892C00000000}(I wonder how Mikoto's doing.)

{C:81909202}{C:819582968A2C00000000}Heh heh, Guy,
you're thinking
about Mikoto, aren't you?

{C:81905401}{C:819582968B2C00000000}Yeah.
I'm also worried about
the friends we left behind.

{C:81902201}{C:819582968C2C00000000}Could you launch, please?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968D2C00000000}Yes!
Astante II
is launching for Brave!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938F00}{C:819582968E2C00000000}Damn it, were we too late?
No choice. We'll just keep...

{C:81930B02}{C:819582968F2C00000000}Can this ship fly that far
without resupplying?

{C:81939200}{C:81958296902C00000000}{C:819782830400}Crinn{C:819782830000}'s right.
Let's resupply first.

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296912C00000000}I picked you up in the Cloud Sea,
and now you keep talking back, Crinn!

{C:81939200}{C:81958296922C00000000}Don't take it out on him!
We need supplies first.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933001}{C:81958296952C00000000}Le Caine,
I am ordering you as your commander.

{C:81958296962C00000000}You are forbidden to return to Grados.
Do you understand? Until you hear from me,
you are forbidden to return to Grados.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296972C00000000}Why, Father?!

{C:81958296982C00000000}...I see. It's that man!
That man... My very existence...

{C:81933001}{C:81958296992C00000000}Do you understand? You are forbidden to return.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902B01}{C:819582969A2C00000000}What has happened?

{C:819582969B2C00000000}Set course for Grados!
We're returning to Grados!

{C:81904501}{C:819582969C2C00000000}But Commander Gresco said...

{C:81902B01}{C:819582969D2C00000000}I don't care!
We're returning to Grados!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A702}{C:819582969E2C00000000}Bear! Bear!
Let's go over there next!

{C:8193C902}{C:819582969F2C00000000}How many times do I have to tell you?!
I'm not a bear! I'm Teddyam!

{C:8193A702}{C:81958296A02C00000000}Oh, Bear!
I want to see over there too!

{C:8193C802}{C:81958296A12C00000000}Ah ha ha ha ha ha!
Even Teddyam's
met their match!

{C:8193C602}{C:81958296A22C00000000}Good grief. What a handful this young lady is.

{C:8193C702}{C:81958296A32C00000000}We're in a bind.
At this rate, we can't go
and look for Toya and the others.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42C00000000}If I remember right, they said Toya,
the one Greyfus and the others are looking for,
wears clothes that show his belly button.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296A52C00000000}A belly-baring look, huh?
That sounds pretty uncool.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296A62C00000000}Like that, you mean?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296A72C00000000}Damn, going after a child and a baby!
What a bunch of bastards!

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296A92C00000000}Toya,
don't those people watching over there
look like the ones we heard about?

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296AA2C00000000}One, two... The number's exactly right too.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296E60000000000}Things are starting
to look pretty bad...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296AB2C00000000}Hey, you bastards!
You're those Troopers who kidnapped
a girl called Natsumi, aren't you?!

{C:81958296AC2C00000000}Spit out where she is,
or I'll beat the hell out of you!

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296AD2C00000000}What?! You're saying
we kidnapped Natsumi?!

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296AE2C00000000}Toya! Kira!
These people aren't evil!

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296AF2C00000000}Don't let them fool you!
They're the mortal enemies of Arago,
who's trying to protect the world!

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296B02C00000000}Teddyam! Everyone!
Please fight alongside us!

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296B12C00000000}What do we do, Greyfus?

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296B22C00000000}I'm siding with Kira.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296B42C00000000}It can't be helped.
For now, we have no choice
but to fight while holding back.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B62C00000000}Haaah!
Stop it, you fools!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296B72C00000000}Master?!

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296B92C00000000}Master Asia!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BA2C00000000}What you should be doing
is not fighting each other!
Join hands and fight together!

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296BB2C00000000}What are you talking about, old man?!
I'll send you flying with my warrior powers!

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296BC2C00000000}Stop, Toya!
That man is... strong!

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296BD2C00000000}Master Asia,
we have no intention of listening to you,
not after you abducted Natsumi!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BE2C00000000}That's why you're fools!
If I hadn't claimed to abduct her
and taken her away, who would protect her?!

{C:81958296BF2C00000000}You lot are
immature! Utterly immature!

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296C12C00000000}What did you say?!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296C22C00000000}If that stings, gather more allies,
including those called {C:819782830400}Dagwon{C:819782830000} on the other continents, and storm
{C:819782830300}Arago Castle{C:819782830000}!

{C:81958296C32C00000000}Once Arago has been defeated,
Natsumi and Mirai's safety is guaranteed!
Understood, all of you?!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296C42C00000000}Well, what do we do, everyone?
Do we listen to Master Asia?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296C62C00000000}I believe my master.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296E70000000000}Me too.
I think we can trust him.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296C72C00000000}I can't believe him.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296C82C00000000}Neither can I.
It looks like we agree
on that, at least!

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296C92C00000000}Why don't we travel together
and find out whether it's true?

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296CA2C00000000}Will adding them put too much
strain on the Astante II?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB2C00000000}That'll be fine.

{C:81958296CC2C00000000}But what about you?
Do you want to come with us?

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296CD2C00000000}There's Konoha to think about too.
Wouldn't it be safer to go together?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296CE2C00000000}Why don't we look for Dagwon
first, at any rate?
We can decide after that.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296CF2C00000000}He did say they were on other continents.
Getting a ride on the Astante II
would be safest, boss.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296D02C00000000}You're right...
With Konoha to think about too,
we'll take you up on your help.

{C:81958296D12C00000000}We'll go get Konoha
and come to your ship, then.
See you later.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C202}{C:81958296E90000000000}Master!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D22C00000000}Rai? What is it?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296EA0000000000}Was that all right?
Telling them so much?
Isn't it too soon...?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D42C00000000}Perhaps it is.
But that was the only way
to calm those fools down, wouldn't you say?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296EB0000000000}I do think
you're right, Master.
But if the Yoja find out, your position...

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D52C00000000}Heh... There's no need to worry.
Still, you were the only one
who understood my intentions from the start.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296EC0000000000}That was just chance.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D62C00000000}Well, all we can do is pray
that they join forces.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B202}{C:81958296D72C00000000}Well, what an interesting place
to meet such interesting people.

{C:81958296D82C00000000}How convenient.
For Lord Arago's sake,
you can all die here!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296DA2C00000000}You fight enemies like that?
You and your friends are amazing, Ryo.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296DB2C00000000}Not really.
On the other hand, we're completely hopeless
at piloting machines.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296DC2C00000000}Exactly.
Everyone has their own strengths.
Don't let it bother you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296DD2C00000000}We've come for that ride you promised.

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296DE2C00000000}Thank you for having us.
And this is
Konoha Maihara.

{C:8190C502}{C:81958296DF2C00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Konoha Maihara{C:819782830000}.
I'm sorry for the trouble.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296192C00000000}Shall we stop and rest here?

{C:8190D101}{C:819582961A2C00000000}We mustn't.
This is a {C:819782830300}bar{C:819782830000}, so it's not a place
we should be going into.

{C:8190D801}{C:819582961B2C00000000}Oh, that voice!

{C:8190D101}{C:819582961D2C00000000}Rasid?
It's you, Rasid!

{C:8190D801}{C:819582961E2C00000000}We've been looking for you, Master Quatre!
The entire {C:819782830400}Maganac{C:819782830000} Corps
is here.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D801}{C:81958296202C00000000}From now on, we of the Maganac Corps
intend to fight
alongside Master Quatre.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B801}{C:81958296660100000000}Hey, Wufei,
are you always like that?

{C:8193D201}{C:81958296C43300000000}Like what?

{C:8193B801}{C:81958296670100000000}Your shoulders always seem
so tense, you know.
Doesn't it wear you out?

{C:8193D201}{C:81958296C63300000000}This is who I am.
Nothing more, nothing less.
Strength is all that's expected of me.

{C:8193B801}{C:81958296680100000000}Hmm... Is that so?
I couldn't do it.
I'd definitely get tired.

{C:81958296690100000000}I've got a goal too,
but there's no point getting worn out
before you achieve it.

{C:8193D201}{C:81958296C83300000000}A goal...

{C:81958296C93300000000}(What is my goal now...?)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:81958296352C00000000}Norman!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296362C00000000}Whoa! That startled me...
Oh, it's Roger.
What's he so angry about?

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296372C00000000}What in the world
have you been doing all this time?
I've been looking everywhere for you!

{C:8190A402}{C:81958296382C00000000}My apologies.
The Posaydal Army
had been dragging me around.

{C:81958296392C00000000}When I arrived here, the Posaydal Army
withdrew, leaving me stranded
and at my wits' end.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582963A2C00000000}I see. I'm sorry.
Now that we've met up here,
you should come aboard the Astante II.

{C:8190A402}{C:819582963B2C00000000}Certainly, Master Roger.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909200}{C:81958296162B00000000}Jerid!
Wait, Jerid!
I need to talk to you.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296172B00000000}What is it, Mouar?

{C:81909200}{C:81958296182B00000000}How long do you intend
to keep chasing the Astante?

{C:81908F00}{C:819582961A2B00000000}Until I settle things once and for all!
I won't be satisfied otherwise!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939200}{C:819582961B2B00000000}Listen, Jerid.
Are you really all right with that?
You understand the situation we're in, don't you?

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961D2B00000000}I do!
That's why I'm...

{C:81939200}{C:819582961E2B00000000}Even if it only benefits Scirocco... no,
the person behind him,
and no one else?

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961F2B00000000}What are you trying to say, Mouar?

{C:81939200}{C:81958296212B00000000}As things stand, you're just being used.
Shouldn't you think about the future
and take a different course?

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296222B00000000}Think about the future... huh.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296242B00000000}You were the one
with Chirico, weren't you?
Do you remember me?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296252B00000000}Um, Gregore, was it?
But Chirico said you were dead...

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296272B00000000}Hey, don't go killing me off!
I'm alive and kicking, as you can see.
Anyway, I've got a proposal.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296282B00000000}A proposal?
Do you mean you want to join us?

{C:8190DC00}{C:819582962A2B00000000}You're quick on the uptake!
I'm not as good as Chirico,
but I think I could be useful.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962B2B00000000}Are you sure?
Risking your hard-won life...

{C:8190DC00}{C:819582962E2B00000000}Until now, I was as good as dead.
From now on, I'll fight to live.
It's a good idea, right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302B00000000}That's a positive way of looking at it.
All right,
I'll speak to Rie about it.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296332B00000000}Yeah, I'm counting on you.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296342B00000000}A lot of people around here wear
pilot suits like yours, Chirico.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296372B00000000}They're practically an AT pilot's uniform.
It's nothing unusual.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296392B00000000}Someone's watching us.
Do you know them?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582963A2B00000000}That's... Carson!
It's you, Carson!

{C:8190DF00}{C:819582963C2B00000000}Chirico!
Now, none of that tactless
'So you're alive?' business from either of us!

{C:8190C800}{C:819582963E2B00000000}No... I'm glad you're alive.
So, what are you doing now?

{C:8190DF00}{C:819582963F2B00000000}I'm listed as killed in action,
so I've been quietly watching the war engulf the world
from a distance.

{C:81958296402B00000000}It's a dull life.
You've got it good, Chirico,
with a beauty by your side.


{C:8190C800}{C:81958296432B00000000}Stop teasing...
More importantly, if you're bored,
why not fight with us?

{C:8190DF00}{C:81958296442B00000000}Fight with you?
You can't mean...!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296472B00000000}That's exactly what I mean.
What do you say, Carson?

{C:8190DF00}{C:81958296482B00000000}That sounds interesting.
Yes, very interesting.
But is it all right?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582964A2B00000000}It's all right, isn't it?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B2B00000000}Of course!
Especially since you're someone
Chirico invited.

{C:8190DF00}{C:819582964C2B00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Virgil Carson{C:819782830000}.
Good to meet you.








{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190DD00}{C:819582964D2B00000000}You there, woman!
Let me see Chirico Cuvie!

{C:81905700}{C:819582964E2B00000000}Who are you?
Only authorized personnel are allowed in here.

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582964F2B00000000}Go get Chirico, now!
Or I'll let myself in.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296502B00000000}Absolutely not!


{C:81902201}{C:81958296512B00000000}What's wrong, Leccee?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296522B00000000}Oh, Eiji.
This person says to get Chirico.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296542B00000000}Oh, in that case,
I'll go fetch him.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296552B00000000}That's not the point!
Oh, he's gone...

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296562B00000000}Pfft... Ah ha ha ha ha!
What an amusing fellow.
I haven't laughed like that in ages.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296572B00000000}I agree.
Eiji's a good boy.

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296582B00000000}...
I'm sorry for threatening you.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296592B00000000}I heard someone was asking for me...
...Murza? You managed to survive.

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582965C2B00000000}I don't know why I survived.
But as long as I'm alive,
fighting is all I have left.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582965E2B00000000}Do you want to come with us?

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582965F2B00000000}Of course!






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296602B00000000}A bar... It's no place
for a minor like me...

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296612B00000000}I've been waiting for you, kid.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296622B00000000}Byman!

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296642B00000000}Hey, don't look at me
as if you've seen a dead man!
I'm alive, as you can see.

{C:81958296662B00000000}Though I don't know why.
Well, I suppose it's a whim of the gods.

{C:81958296672B00000000}Chirico told me
you're doing something interesting.
I'm joining in too.







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931E02}{C:819582968C3300000000}We of the {C:819782830400}24th Unit{C:819782830000}
have been waiting for you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3300000000}For us?
Why?

{C:81931E02}{C:819582968E3300000000}To put an end to this pointless war
that's dragged in continent after continent.
Will you accept us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968F3300000000}Of course.
You're welcome to join us.









{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E501}{C:81958296862900000000}What are you doing here?
If you've got time for detours,
surely you have other things to do.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872900000000}...I'm sorry.

{C:8190E501}{C:81958296882900000000}Still, fighting
comes with all kinds of expenses.
Take this with you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582963E2D00000000}I'm hungry...

{C:81900600}{C:819582963F2D00000000}You're showing no discipline.
What sort of behavior is that on the bridge?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296402D00000000}You can't help what your body does.
I'm off to the mess hall.
Whose turn is it to cook today?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296412D00000000}Wataru and his friends, and the Ganba Team.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296422D00000000}That makes me a little nervous...




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296432D00000000}I've got a bad feeling about this.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BF2A00000000}Waaah, it's g-going to spill!

{C:81939202}{C:81958296442D00000000}I'll do something with ninjutsu!


{C:8193A702}{C:81958296452D00000000}Nyahahahaha!
Tora-chan, this is yummy!

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296462D00000000}Let's see... You're right!
I'm gonna eat some more!

{C:81939602}{C:81958296472D00000000}Hey, you two!
No sneaking bites!

{C:81939402}{C:81958296482D00000000}Rikiya, is this all right?
I think it tastes
a little bland.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582964A2D00000000}R-R-R-Rie!
Wh-what's all this shaking?!

{C:81930300}{C:819582964B2D00000000}I don't know!
Huh? The Astante II's controls...

{C:81930700}{C:819582964C2D00000000}Rie, I'll take the helm!

{C:81930300}{C:819582964D2D00000000}Please do.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:819582964E2D00000000}Is this a hacker's work?
Heh... They're pretty good.

{C:819582964F2D00000000}But I won't let them
into the main system!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:81958296522D00000000}That should do it.
Rie, take over the helm for me.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296532D00000000}Yes.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296542D00000000}During all that commotion,
we got a call from Chief Taiga.

{C:81936101}{C:81958296562D00000000}I've finally got through...
Welcome back, heroes!
I imagine you've found new heroes to join you.

{C:81958296572D00000000}While you were away,
new heroes appeared in Brave.
Come to {C:819782830300}Tokio{C:819782830000} so I can introduce them.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935701}{C:81958296582D00000000}Guy!
Can you hear me, Guy?!

{C:81935401}{C:81958296592D00000000}I hear you, Mikoto.
What's wrong? Has something happened?!

{C:81935701}{C:819582965A2D00000000}Mamoru... Mamoru...
GaoFi... Aaaah!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905701}{C:81958296642D00000000}If Renais hadn't been here,
we'd have been in serious trouble.
Thank you, Renais.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296EE0000000000}I just protected this place.
There's no reason to thank me.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296652D00000000}So what happened?
This place looks all right.

{C:81905801}{C:81958296662D00000000}Mamoru suddenly came here
and tried to steal
the GaoFighGar data.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296EF0000000000}And when I tried to stop him,
he started glowing and went on a rampage.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296672D00000000}Mamoru... I can't believe it.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296F00000000000}Facts are facts.
There's been terrible damage.

{C:81958296F10000000000}The GaoFighGar data was stolen.
What are you going to do, Guy?

{C:81906101}{C:81958296692D00000000}We must recover the GaoFighGar data
no matter what.
Swan!

{C:81905801}{C:819582966A2D00000000}Yes!
I'll track Mamoru's movements.

{C:819582966B2D00000000}...I've found him!
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000} is where he's heading!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2D00000000}I'll get the Astante II
ready for launch first!

{C:81905701}{C:819582966D2D00000000}Guy... Are you going to fight Mamoru?

{C:81905401}{C:819582966E2D00000000}There must be a reason for this.
If we can find out what it is,
we shouldn't have to fight.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296F20000000000}I'm coming too.
With you thinking like that, Guy,
there's no telling what might happen.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296702D00000000}The settings Uncle made
are delicate, so I need
to check them often.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296722D00000000}What's wrong? Why are you in such a hurry?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296732D00000000}We're launching soon. Put 
{C:819782830400}Meisarge{C:819782830000} back in the hangar.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:81958296742D00000000}We know where Mamoru's headed! Take us to 
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000}!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296752D00000000}What happened?

{C:81905901}{C:81958296F30000000000}Stop asking questions and launch!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296762D00000000}Be quiet, Renais!

{C:81958296792D00000000}I'll explain as we launch.
Just hurry!

{C:81900300}{C:819582967A2D00000000}Understood.
Astante II, launching.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:819582967B2D00000000}And that's what happened.

{C:81930300}{C:819582967C2D00000000}Something like that happened...?

{C:81935401}{C:819582967D2D00000000}I'm sorry, Rie, but please hurry!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935501}{C:81958296852D00000000}So you're going to get in my way.
Then...!
Final Fusiooon!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296862D00000000}GaoGaiGar is descending into {C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000}!

{C:81935401}{C:81958296872D00000000}I'm sorry, everyone!
Leave things to me from here!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296882D00000000}Let's go down to Kyoto too!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296892D00000000}Let's watch Guy's battle to the end.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935901}{C:81958296F40000000000}Two Hell and Heaven attacks
clashing...

{C:81930300}{C:819582968D2D00000000}What's going to happen,
Renais?

{C:81935901}{C:81958296F50000000000}How should...
...I know?!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:81958296902D00000000}Have you forgotten, Mamoru?
The ones who win...

{C:81958296922D00000000}are those with couraaaage!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905401}{C:81958296962D00000000}You?!
Don't tell me you took
the GaoFighGar data?!

{C:81958296972D00000000}Did you use Mamoru?
Are you working with Grados too?!

{C:81906401}{C:81958296982D00000000}That Latio is...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936301}{C:819582969D2D00000000}You have made three mistakes.
First, it was not Arma
who wanted the GaoFighGar data.

{C:819582969F2D00000000}Second, someone else
was using Latio.

{C:81958296A12D00000000}Third, {C:819782830400}Arma{C:819782830000} is certainly not
a lackey of Grados or its like!
It is all connected.

{C:81935401}{C:81958296A22D00000000}You know something!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906301}{C:81958296A62D00000000}I do!
But helping Arma recover
comes first right now.

{C:81958296AA2D00000000}Farewell, Evoluder Guy.
I'm taking Arma with me.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296AB2D00000000}Wait!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC2D00000000}Are you all right, Guy?!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296AD2D00000000}I'd like to say yes, but I can barely stand.
Could you take me back to 
{C:819782830300}Tokio{C:819782830000}?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AE2D00000000}Understood.
We'll hurry back to Tokio.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AF2D00000000}All right.
Let's carry Guy
to the Astante II.

{C:81958296B02D00000000}...Urgh!
H-he's heavy...

{C:8190A302}{C:81958296B32D00000000}I'll carry him for you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B42D00000000}A girl couldn't do it.
...Wait, how can you
lift him so easily?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B52D00000000}Big brother!
Stop gawking and hurry!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A302}{C:81958296B62D00000000}We can't get to Tokio from here.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296B72D00000000}We can't use GaoFighGar.
Make sure you take that into account
when organizing the unit.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B82D00000000}You're right.
I'd better check, just in case.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935202}{C:81958296B92D00000000}Hey, {C:819782830400}Kaine{C:819782830000}.
Are you sure this is all right?

{C:81935102}{C:81958296F70000000000}We don't have a choice.
There's no other way.

{C:81935302}{C:81958296BB2D00000000}But still...
Following {C:819782830400}Meio Plato{C:819782830000}'s orders
doesn't sit right with me.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296F80000000000}They're the ones in the wrong,
so we've just gotta do it!
Look, it's coming up.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935202}{C:81958296BC2D00000000}That's why
I said I didn't want to do this!

{C:81935102}{C:81958296FA0000000000}You never said that!
Retreat! Retreat!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935A02}{C:81958296BD2D00000000}The people I had fight on your orders
were soundly defeated.
Are you satisfied, Your Excellency Treize?

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296BE2D00000000}I've received word
from the person I sent
aboard the Astante II.

{C:81958296BF2D00000000}As I thought, justice
appears to be on their side.

{C:81958296C02D00000000}At this rate, all the continents
will be ruled by war...
and eventually perish.

{C:81958296C12D00000000}What will you do,
Meio Plato?

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296C22D00000000}You are a devious one, Your Excellency.
You and your friend
have long since made up your minds.

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296C42D00000000}Heh...
But if they cannot make it here,
it is merely a theory on paper.

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296C52D00000000}Indeed.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296C72D00000000}Losing fighting strength now is painful.
But I'm even more concerned about Guy.
He was utterly exhausted...

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81937B02}{C:81958296C82D00000000}Chief! Chief!
Introduce us already!
Make it flashy and cool!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296C92D00000000}Everyone, while Guy is recovering,
let me introduce our new heroes:
three members of the Defense Class.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296CA2D00000000}Hey, I'm {C:819782830400}Jin Hyuga{C:819782830000}.
{C:819782830400}Ken-Oh{C:819782830000} is the machine I pilot!

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296CB2D00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Asuka Tsukishiro{C:819782830000}.
{C:819782830400}Ho-Oh{C:819782830000} is the machine I pilot.
It's nice to meet you all.

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296CC2D00000000}I-I-I'm K-K-{C:819782830400}Koji Hoshiyama{C:819782830000}.
J-J-{C:819782830400}Ju-Oh{C:819782830000} is the machine I pilot.
N-nice to meet you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A602}{C:81958296CE2D00000000}Whaaat? You call yourselves the Defense Class,
but there are only three of you!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296CF2D00000000}Even with only three members,
the Ganba Team
has Gambaruger, so it doesn't matter!

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296D12D00000000}I wasn't asking you!
Well, whatever.
My {C:819782830400}Jyakomaru{C:819782830000} is the best!

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296D22D00000000}If our friends in the Defense Class
get together,
we're absolutely invincible too!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296D32D00000000}Then why don't you go find them?

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296D42D00000000}Don't make it sound so easy.
If we could cross the Cloud Sea,
we wouldn't have this problem. Right, Koji?

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296D52D00000000}Y-yeah.
It's a shame, because we'd be stronger
if the Defense Class got together.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296D62D00000000}If only we could find
our friends in the Defense Class...

{C:81905401}{C:81958296D82D00000000}It certainly is lively in here.

{C:81905701}{C:81958296D92D00000000}Guy!
You mustn't push yourself!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296DA2D00000000}I'm sorry I worried you, Mikoto.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB2D00000000}Guy!
Are you all right already?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296DC2D00000000}A powerful ally
has come back to us.
Right, Mamoru?

{C:81905501}{C:81958296DD2D00000000}Wahaa!
I'm back, everyone!

{C:81905801}{C:81958296DE2D00000000}Welcome back, Mamoru!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296DF2D00000000}With Mamoru's power,
Guy will be fully recovered!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296E02D00000000}Chief Taiga, is that true?





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905701}{C:81958296E92D00000000}A battleship that looks Gradosian
is rapidly approaching the skies above Tokio.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296F02D00000000}Everyone, launch!

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296F12D00000000}Asuka, Koji, we're going too!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296F22D00000000}Big brother,
we'll launch once you're ready,
so hurry!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32D00000000}All right, give me a little time!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A13700000000}Oh, Renais.
What's the matter?

{C:81905901}{C:81958296570200000000}I'm coming too.
There's no telling what might happen.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A43700000000}Wow!
We'd be really happy to have you!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A53700000000}Welcome aboard, Renais.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296093400000000}Are you always like that?

{C:81935901}{C:819582966D0100000000}What are you talking about?

{C:81930400}{C:819582960A3400000000}I was just wondering
why you hide your true feelings.
I used to be like that too.

{C:81935901}{C:819582966E0100000000}You too?

{C:81930400}{C:819582960B3400000000}Even a genius pilot
has worries.

{C:81935901}{C:819582966F0100000000}It sounds like you've got your own problems,
but leave me alone.
You're a nuisance.

{C:81930400}{C:819582960D3400000000}...I'm sorry.

{C:819582960E3400000000}I just assumed
that you might understand
how I feel.

{C:81935901}{C:81958296700100000000}Once I know you better,
I'll have tea with you and hear you out.
But only after the fighting's over.

{C:81930400}{C:819582960F3400000000}Thank you, Renais.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932D01}{C:81958296F52D00000000}A ship's coming up.
It's the one they call Astante II.
What do we do, {C:819782830400}Manjero{C:819782830000}?

{C:81932C01}{C:81958296F62D00000000}Isn't it obvious?
We fucking kill them!

{C:81932E01}{C:81958296FB0000000000}Nobody asked you.

{C:81932F01}{C:81958296F72D00000000}Once we sink that ship,
it'll all be over. Let's go!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296F82D00000000}I'm picking up a reaction in the Cloud Sea.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296F92D00000000}The Cloud Sea is opening...
It seems they really can
control it at will.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296FA2D00000000}I don't know how it's done,
but it's a real nuisance.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2D00000000}I don't know what you're talking about,
but we're leaving for the next continent.

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296FC2D00000000}Where are we going next?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296FD2D00000000}{C:819782830300}Pentagona{C:819782830000} is our next destination.
Kyao contacted us
and asked us to come.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296FE2D00000000}Astante II,
launching for Pentagona.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933001}{C:81958296FF2D00000000}Have you forgotten?
I forbade you to return.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296002E00000000}Father!
What has happened to you?!
Why am I not allowed to return?

{C:81933001}{C:81958296012E00000000}There's no helping it now you're back.
But once you've cooled your head,
you will leave at once.

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296022E00000000}Obey your father
quietly, Lord {C:819782830400}Le Caine{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296032E00000000}{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000}'s people must see
you set a proper example.

{C:81958296042E00000000}{C:819782830400}Gresco{C:819782830000} is your commander.
If you cannot obey those orders,
we shall have to consider what to do with you.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296052E00000000}Why do you obey a man like this?
Father, answer me!

{C:81933001}{C:81958296062E00000000}Leave, {C:819782830400}Le Caine{C:819782830000}.
I will not tell you again.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296072E00000000}Tch...!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C202}{C:81958296FC0000000000}I've been waiting for you.
I'm one of the Dagwon. My name is
{C:819782830400}Rai Utsumi{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296FD0000000000}I've been waiting here
to guide you.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296082E00000000}Guide us?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296FE0000000000}Yes. I've been waiting here
so you can meet up
with my senior teammates.

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296092E00000000}So, where are
these Dagwon?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296FF0000000000}They're waiting at the {C:819782830300}teahouse{C:819782830000}.
I'll head to the teahouse first.
See you there!

{C:8190C302}{C:819582960A2E00000000}The teahouse... This isn't a trap, is it?

{C:8190C702}{C:819582960B2E00000000}Toya,
it's rude to say such things.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296010100000000}You still suspect me?
Considering the situation,
I can understand that.

{C:81958296020100000000}But please understand
how serious it would be
if Arago took Natsumi away.

{C:81958296030100000000}I'll leave it up to you
whether you come to the teahouse.
I'll be going on ahead.


{C:8190B501}{C:819582960C2E00000000}I think I'll go.
What that Rai fellow said
has been bothering me, too.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296050100000000}We face an enemy called Grados,
and there's another behind the scenes...

{C:81958296060100000000}I can't stop wondering about it,
so I'm going with you, big bro.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582960D2E00000000}We don't even need to think about it.
Right, everyone?

{C:8190AE02}{C:819582960E2E00000000}Right.
We're the ones who failed to protect Natsumi.
Of course we should go.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582960F2E00000000}Toma is right.
We should go, even if it's just us.

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296102E00000000}Then it's settled.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296112E00000000}So, are you people
going or not?

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296122E00000000}Toya,
don't you think
we should go, too?

{C:81958296132E00000000}Natsumi and the others...
I can't stop worrying about them.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296142E00000000}You can't get a tiger's cub without entering its den...
All right, I'll go, too.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296152E00000000}That's our chief!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B402}{C:81958296172E00000000}We shall meet again someday
at Lord Arago's castle.
For now, I'll withdraw.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C202}{C:81958296070100000000}Everyone, you came!!
Thank you!!

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296182E00000000}Wait, Rai!
I've heard what you have to say.
But whether we Dagwon agree is another matter.

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296192E00000000}I feel the same!
Hey, for once I agree with Kai.

{C:8190BF02}{C:819582961A2E00000000}Their ecosystems seem different, too.
Hmm, I'd love to study them.

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582961B2E00000000}We came because we trusted Rai.
Isn't that good enough?

{C:8190BE02}{C:819582961D2E00000000}Your failure is what got us
into this situation in the first place.
Do you understand that?

{C:8190C302}{C:819582961E2E00000000}Is that so?
I never thought
you were that pathetic.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582961F2E00000000}We won't make excuses.
That's exactly why we're so desperate.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296202E00000000}I like that manly way
of facing up to it.

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296212E00000000}Uwoooooaaah!
I'm worried about
Natsumi and Mirai-chan!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296222E00000000}I can't fight with my body
like you all can,
but the enemy is immensely powerful.

{C:81958296232E00000000}That's exactly why I think
we should join forces.
Is that so wrong?

{C:8190C002}{C:81958296252E00000000}Right. Wouldn't it be best
to have them show us
just how strong they are?

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296262E00000000}You have a point.

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296282E00000000}Then let's do that.
We'll wait, so get ready.

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296292E00000000}We'll transform into Dagwon, too.
Thanks to Rai,
we can transform now.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C102}{C:819582962A2E00000000}We've won!!
That settles it.

{C:8190BC02}{C:819582962C2E00000000}Hold on, Geki.
Fighting them taught you something, didn't it?
They're desperate, too.

{C:8190BD02}{C:819582962D2E00000000}En is right.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296080100000000}Then...!?

{C:8190BC02}{C:819582962F2E00000000}Let's fight together.
Now we know very well
what dependable allies you are!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296302E00000000}This settles it, right?
We're the ones who won.

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296312E00000000}It can't be helped...
We'll keep our promise.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296322E00000000}Can't we stop this now?
Our goal is to rescue Natsumi and the others
and defeat Arago.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296332E00000000}Now everyone Master told us about
has gathered, right?
So, what do we do now?

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296090100000000}Once everyone's gathered, 
{C:819782830300}Pentagona{C:819782830000} is where we're supposed to go.
That's what Master told me.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296342E00000000}Haaah...
How long are we going to be pushed around?
But we've got no choice but to go.

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296362E00000000}You're right.
I don't like being pushed around
by humans, either.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296372E00000000}If we go to Pentagona,
we might learn something else.
We've got more friends now. Let's keep trying.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296392E00000000}You're optimistic, Ryo.

{C:819582963A2E00000000}Sai Saici and I
may not be much help,
but we'll stay with you to the end.

{C:8190C302}{C:819582963C2E00000000}All right, next stop is Pentagona!
Let's give it our all!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B102}{C:819582963F2E00000000}You bastards, are you really
satisfied with doing things this way!?
Stealing someone else's credit!!

{C:8193B302}{C:81958296402E00000000}What are you saying, Shuten?
We are Lord Arago's servants.

{C:8193B202}{C:81958296412E00000000}Even if he captured the girl himself,
that doesn't mean he can keep her
from Lord Arago forever.

{C:8193B402}{C:81958296422E00000000}You might say we're doing
Master Asia a favor.
What could be wrong with that?

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296432E00000000}But...

{C:8193B202}{C:81958296442E00000000}No matter how much you protest,
the girl is already at Lord Arago's castle.

{C:8193B302}{C:81958296452E00000000}It's about time we left, too.

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296462E00000000}It cannot be helped.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296F83200000000}Seriously,
who does this Master guy
think he is?

{C:81958296F93200000000}Ordering us around,
"Go here, go there"!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296FB3200000000}A simpleton like you
could never understand my teacher's thinking.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C302}{C:81958296FC3200000000}Whaaat did you say!!

{C:8193C402}{C:81958296FE3200000000}Stop it, Toya.
This is no time to fight.

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296FF3200000000}Shut up, Kira!

{C:8193C402}{C:81958296003300000000}But, Toya!

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296013300000000}Are we supposed to let someone weaker than us
talk down to us like that!?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C602}{C:81958296EC3700000000}That's going too far, Toya!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296043300000000}It's all right, Greyfus.
It's true that I'm weak.

{C:81958296053300000000}But without my teacher,
we wouldn't be in the position we are now.
Think about that carefully...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A802}{C:81958296593300000000}Rie... Nelfea...
Lun... They're so cuuute.

{C:819582965A3300000000}But then, Amm
and Mikoto are cute, too.

{C:8193A502}{C:819582965B3300000000}Teacher! Teacher!

{C:8193A802}{C:819582965C3300000000}Oh, what is it, Wataru?

{C:8193A502}{C:819582965D3300000000}Come on, everyone's watching.
You're embarrassing yourself. Stooop it!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938F00}{C:81958296E22C00000000}You're persistent, Crinn.
I have no intention
of joining Astante II!

{C:81930B02}{C:81958296E32C00000000}Why not!?
This is no time to act
on personal feelings, is it?

{C:81958296E42C00000000}There's a war engulfing
the entire world.

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296E52C00000000}Shut up!
I want to fight
Astante!

{C:81958296E62C00000000}Don't forget that I took you in
and say whatever you please!

{C:81930B02}{C:81958296E72C00000000}I'm saying this precisely
because I'm grateful to you.
You're such a capable man, and yet...

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296E82C00000000}Shut up!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908F00}{C:81958296E92C00000000}Every last one of them...

{C:81909200}{C:81958296EA2C00000000}Every last one of them... what?

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296EB2C00000000}Oh, Mouar.
Are you going to say
the same thing as Crinn again?

{C:81909200}{C:81958296EC2C00000000}No, I won't say it again.
All I want
is to follow you.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296ED2C00000000}Mouar...
All right. One more time.
We'll wait for them at Iron Castle and fight.

{C:81958296F02C00000000}If we lose,
we'll join them...

{C:81909200}{C:81958296F12C00000000}Are you sure, Jerid?


{C:81908F00}{C:81958296F22C00000000}At least as things stand,
I'm just a puppet of whoever
is behind Scirocco.

{C:81958296F42C00000000}I have no intention of knowingly
letting anyone use me as they please.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296F62C00000000}That's the Jerid I know!
Let's give it our best!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938F00}{C:81958296F82C00000000}Can you hear me, Astante II?
I surrender to you.
{C:819782830300}Iron Castle{C:819782830000} is where I'd like you to land.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908200}{C:81958296FA2C00000000}I can't believe
Jerid would surrender.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2C00000000}Come on, don't say that.
Let's hear him out.


{C:81908200}{C:81958296FC2C00000000}You're naive.

{C:81908700}{C:81958296FE2C00000000}Here comes Jerid.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296FF2C00000000}I'm with the Titans. I'm {C:819782830400}Jerid Messa{C:819782830000}.
I surrender to your ship.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296002D00000000}I'm with the Titans. I'm {C:819782830400}Mouar Pharaoh.{C:819782830000}
I surrender as well.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296012D00000000}What about the fellow with you?

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296022D00000000}Crinn isn't my subordinate.
He just happened to be aboard.
Don't treat him as a prisoner.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296032D00000000}Wait a moment.
We have no intention
of treating you as prisoners.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296042D00000000}We'd like you to fight alongside us.
Is that too much to ask?

{C:81908700}{C:81958296052D00000000}They've been our enemies all this time.
Are you sure about this!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296072D00000000}What's wrong with it?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296082D00000000}There's no point arguing, Emma.
This is how we've been
gaining allies all along.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296092D00000000}You mean you'll accept us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960A2D00000000}Will you fight alongside us?
I think this has gone beyond
any one person or continent.

{C:81900B02}{C:819582960B2D00000000}I'll help.
Yes! Please let me help.

{C:81908F00}{C:819582960D2D00000000}I haven't thrown away
my pride as a Titan.

{C:819582960E2D00000000}So I'll cooperate with your group, AEUG and all,
only until this war
is over.

{C:819582960F2D00000000}If that's acceptable,
I'll help you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296102D00000000}What do you think, Captain Quattro?
And you, Kamille?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296122D00000000}The more strength we have, the better.
I have no reason to object.


{C:81908200}{C:81958296132D00000000}If that's what you all say,
I can't object.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296142D00000000}Thank you, Kamille.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296152D00000000}I'm looking forward to working with you,
Jerid, Mouar,
and Crinn.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296162D00000000}So he's grown up a little, too.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296172D00000000}What's the matter, Akatsuki?
You look pleased.

{C:81900900}{C:81958296ED0000000000}It's rare to see you
smiling these days, Kyo.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296182D00000000}I thought he was still just a child,
but this battle has shown me how he's grown.
I'm simply happy as his parent.


{C:81900A00}{C:81958296192D00000000}He used to be so tiny.
Now he's a full-fledged FT pilot.

{C:81900700}{C:819582961A2D00000000}It was worth pushing for it.

{C:81900600}{C:819582961B2D00000000}Yes.
But our opponent is Binzvanker.
We can't let our guard down.

{C:81900700}{C:819582961C2D00000000}That's true...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D01}{C:819582961D2D00000000}You're the one
helping Astante II, aren't you?

{C:8193D701}{C:819582961F2D00000000}Yes. And you are?

{C:81930D01}{C:81958296212D00000000}I'm Hilmocha.
My position is much like yours.

{C:8193D701}{C:81958296222D00000000}Oh, I've heard of you.
You back up
Jojo and the others, right?

{C:81930D01}{C:81958296252D00000000}Oh, you know quite a bit.

{C:81958296282D00000000}You've got your work cut out for you, too.
Providing backup
is the biggest headache of all.

{C:8193D701}{C:81958296292D00000000}True, but a war needs more than
just the people in the spotlight.
There's no getting around that, is there?

{C:819582962A2D00000000}Besides, there are people like you
who understand.

{C:81930D01}{C:819582962E2D00000000}Heh...
So we both have our share of troubles.

{C:8193D701}{C:819582962F2D00000000}That's right.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296302D00000000}Oh, Sally and Hilmocha.
What are you two doing here?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296322D00000000}Oh, just...

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296342D00000000}We were just chatting.
What about you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296352D00000000}I like the view here,
so I came by
while I was in White Valley.

{C:81958296362D00000000}I wanted Lun to see it, too.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296372D00000000}Hello.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296382D00000000}Hello.
Well, we don't want to intrude.
Let's go, Hilmocha.

{C:81900D01}{C:819582963C2D00000000}Right.
Don't misbehave just because
we're not around, young man.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963D2D00000000}Hilmocha!!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:81958296463300000000}What's the matter?

{C:8193C402}{C:81958296473300000000}He said I'm too kind
to be a warrior...

{C:81935401}{C:81958296483300000000}Toya is just worried about you.
Kind people get hurt easily.

{C:81958296493300000000}Even Toya, who worries about you,
is very kind himself.
You don't need to be ashamed of being kind.

{C:8193C402}{C:819582964A3300000000}But I...
I can't be like Toya.

{C:81935401}{C:819582964B3300000000}Don't get the wrong idea.
You have your own good qualities, Kira.
You don't need to become Toya.

{C:8193C402}{C:819582964C3300000000}Is that true?

{C:81935401}{C:819582964D3300000000}As a Brave continent hero, I guarantee it.
Have confidence in yourself, Kira.

{C:8193C402}{C:819582964E3300000000}Yes!
Thank you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905F00}{C:81958296753700000000}I've been waiting for you!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296763700000000}You again.
I won't let you lay a hand on my friends.

{C:81905E00}{C:81958296773700000000}How dare you! Stand back!

{C:81905F00}{C:81958296783700000000}You're the one who should stand back, Antoon!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296793700000000}What's going on?

{C:81905F00}{C:819582967A3700000000}We've come to help you.
On orders from Posaydal.

{C:8190B501}{C:819582967B3700000000}Are you serious?

{C:81905F00}{C:819582967C3700000000}There's no choice.
Those are Posaydal's orders.

{C:81905D00}{C:819582967D3700000000}We have the same enemy to defeat.
Of course we should cooperate.

{C:81905F00}{C:819582967E3700000000}That's how it is.
You there, the fellow with the scar on his cheek,
I'm counting on you, too.

{C:8190B501}{C:819582967F3700000000}Right...





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909B00}{C:819582968E3700000000}I never expected to find you
among the opposition, Haman Karn.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582968F3700000000}Scirocco.
What are you doing here?
Have you lost your place in the Titans?

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296903700000000}Me!?
You've taken to talking nonsense.
Have they poisoned your mind?

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296913700000000}Enough of this nonsense.
If you won't tell me
what you're doing, I'm leaving.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296923700000000}Haman,
we're about to leave...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296933700000000}My escort is here, too.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296943700000000}Don't be in such a hurry.
I was waiting here because
I thought I'd offer you my help.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296953700000000}You're going to help us?
I find that hard to believe.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296963700000000}I've been observing the situation and realized
that Binzvanker is an obstacle
to the flow of history.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296983700000000}Those words...
I can trust them, right?

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296993700000000}Of course.
For now, I'll cooperate with you.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582969A3700000000}Don't put too much trust in him, boy.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969B3700000000}No, I will trust him.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582969C3700000000}Heh...
I thought you'd say that.
Do as you like.

{C:81909B00}{C:819582969D3700000000}Then I'll join you as well.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A73700000000}Hello, Sally.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296A83700000000}Hello.
How are you doing?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A93700000000}I'm doing all right.
How about you, Sally?

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AA3700000000}Well,
I'm sorry this will be my last look at this view.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AB3700000000}Are you going away somewhere again?

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AC3700000000}I need to get serious about fighting, too.
Would you let me aboard your ship?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3700000000}Yes, gladly!

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AE3700000000}Hee hee hee...
Then I'm looking forward to working with you again.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938900}{C:81958296A13300000000}Dealing with the youngsters
is tiring for both of us, isn't it?

{C:81930E01}{C:81958296A23300000000}I understand how you feel.
But you're younger than I am.
You mustn't let them wear you out like that.

{C:81938900}{C:81958296A33300000000}Ah...
I'll keep that in mind.

{C:81958296A43300000000}(I've been told off.)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935102}{C:81958296740100000000}I'm so bored.
There's nothing to do without any sorties.

{C:8193CE01}{C:819582961B3400000000}Then do some maintenance.

{C:81932201}{C:819582961C3400000000}If you have a chance to rest,
you should take it.

{C:819582961D3400000000}We don't know when we'll have to sortie.
Once we do, we won't know
when we'll get another rest.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296750100000000}Yeah, but
Tap and the others aren't here,
so I've got no one to play with.

{C:8193CE01}{C:819582961E3400000000}I'm not playing.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296760100000000}You're a cold one.

{C:81932201}{C:819582961F3400000000}Are you thirsty?
I'll make some tea.

{C:81935102}{C:81958296770100000000}Oh, that's thoughtful of you.
Please do.

{C:8193CE01}{C:81958296203400000000}I'd like some, too.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296213400000000}Then I'll go make it.
Let's relax until our next sortie.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939E02}{C:81958296523300000000}I keep Hitomi near me
so I can protect her.

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296533300000000}If being near you puts her in danger,
you shouldn't let her stay.

{C:81939E02}{C:81958296543300000000}You just don't understand.
How can I protect her if she's not near me!?

{C:8193C302}{C:81958296553300000000}That's what I'm saying!

{C:81939E02}{C:81958296563300000000}There's no point talking any further.
Let's stop.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296573300000000}For now, at least,
Van has let it go.
But Toya sure does get into a lot of arguments.

{C:81958296583300000000}I guess that's just how pure-hearted he is.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582961C3300000000}This is where I met Amuro, wasn't it?
That feeling I had then was strange.

{C:819582961D3300000000}...Oh, it's Ryo and the others.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193BE02}{C:819582961E3300000000}Whoa, look at that.
The Cloud Sea stretches out before us.

{C:8193AE02}{C:819582961F3300000000}There are continents beyond it, too.
It's strange to think about.

{C:8193AA02}{C:81958296203300000000}Isn't it amazing that we,
who would never normally have met,
are here together like this?

{C:8193BF02}{C:81958296223300000000}It's also fascinating that
being separated by the Cloud Sea
has led to different forms of life.

{C:8193AE02}{C:81958296233300000000}Ha ha ha... He's an odd one.

{C:8193BE02}{C:81958296243300000000}It's fine, it's fine.
That's just how he is.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296253300000000}It feels like a brief moment of peace.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933001}{C:81958296612E00000000}What are you thinking about,
Binzvanker?

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296632E00000000}I'm thinking about where humanity ought to end up...

{C:81933001}{C:81958296642E00000000}Really...? It doesn't look that way to me.
You're plotting to get Le Caine
to do something, aren't you?

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296652E00000000}I'm not plotting anything.
Whatever your son may do
is no concern of mine.

{C:81933001}{C:81958296662E00000000}(Whether you're made to dance to another's tune
　will decide who wins,
　Le Caine...)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296672E00000000}What's that strange noise!?

{C:81935500}{C:81958296682E00000000}Aaah, aaah, can you hear meee?
This is Mirawoo Kyao.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296692E00000000}Kyao!
What's happening over there!?
Is everyone safe!?

{C:81935500}{C:819582966A2E00000000}I guess it's no good. I can't hear a thing.
If you can hear me, tell Daba...

{C:819582966B2E00000000}Tell him to come straight to {C:819782830300}Trydetol{C:819782830000}.
Tell him to come here.
Trydetol. I'm counting on you.

{C:81935300}{C:819582966C2E00000000}Kyao!
Use the right frequency!

{C:81935500}{C:819582966D2E00000000}Be careful.
{C:819782830400}Gon Jem{C:819782830000}...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938400}{C:819582966E2E00000000}Gon Jem?
What on earth does he mean?
Do you know, Daba?

{C:81935300}{C:819582966F2E00000000}I don't know.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296702E00000000}It looks like we'd better
hurry to Pentagona.
Rie, I'm counting on you.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296712E00000000}Yes. Astante II
is heading for Pentagona at maximum battle speed.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935E02}{C:81958296722E00000000}So that's the prey, Astante II...
It doesn't look
like much.

{C:81958296762E00000000}Well, I've been paid plenty.
If it's an easy job, that's fine by me.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935E02}{C:81958296782E00000000}They're better than I expected.
I'll need more pay
for this job to be worth my while.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
