{C:81905500}{C:81958296792E00000000}Welcome baaack, Daba.
I've got something good,
so I've been waiting for you.

{C:81905300}{C:819582967A2E00000000}Something good?
What is it, Kyao?

{C:81905500}{C:819582967B2E00000000}Well, come this way.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967C2E00000000}I think I'll tag along, too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935500}{C:819582967D2E00000000}I seized an 
{C:819782830400}Amonduul{C:819782830000} from the enemy while waiting for you, Daba, and rebuilt it into 
{C:819782830400}L-Gaim Mk-II{C:819782830000}!!

{C:819582967E2E00000000}Its performance is better than L-Gaim's,
so put it to good use.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935500}{C:819582967F2E00000000}And come by the {C:819782830300}assembly hall{C:819782830000} too.
I've taken in two girls to keep them safe.
Come meet them later.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935500}{C:81958296852E00000000}Rose came by
while I was servicing Mk-II.

{C:81935502}{C:81958296862E00000000}That's right. Kyao's voice
sounds just like
someone I know.

{C:81935500}{C:81958296872E00000000}So we hit it off,
and we've been together ever since.

{C:81958296882E00000000}But Posaydal's army
has been getting more active,
so we thought we'd join you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582968B2E00000000}So Posaydal's forces
are getting more active.

{C:81905700}{C:819582968C2E00000000}We'd better be careful.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D2E00000000}I'll let everyone
on Astante II know, too.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900900}{C:819582960A0100000000}Oh, where have you been?
Apparently, someone called Semuge
sent us a transmission.

{C:819582960B0100000000}Hadn't you better
go up to the bridge?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968E2E00000000}I will.
It sounds like Posaydal's forces are more active,
so I need to tell them that, too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582968F2E00000000}Where have you been?
We've had a transmission.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296902E00000000}A new machine and new allies have joined us.
I couldn't help it, could I?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296912E00000000}Then it couldn't be helped.
Nelfea, tell him
what the message said.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296922E00000000}Yes.
The message was from Semuge. He wants us at 
{C:819782830300}Mizun{C:819782830000}.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296932E00000000}From Semuge?
Did he say anything else?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296942E00000000}It looks like more new allies
will be joining us.
He didn't give any details, though.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296962E00000000}Could you head for Mizun?
There are things I need
to discuss there, too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972E00000000}Understood, Daba.
We're heading for Mizun.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296982E00000000}You're making the adjustments yourself.
Do you distrust people that much...?

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296992E00000000}Say what you like.
The system you brought me
is too advanced for anyone else to handle.

{C:819582969A2E00000000}I suffered a defeat I never wanted
in the last battle because of that.

{C:81930D00}{C:819582969C2E00000000}Then I'll look forward
to this battle.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:819582969D2E00000000}Something that looks like a very powerful barrier
has been erected all around.

{C:81930A00}{C:819582969E2E00000000}Can't you do something
with your skills?

{C:81930700}{C:819582969F2E00000000}Even if we were to hack
Posaydal's systems,
we don't have enough people.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A02E00000000}You, Nelfea,
and one more person, you mean?

{C:81930700}{C:81958296A12E00000000}You're sharp as ever, Akatsuki.
That's right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22E00000000}We need one more person
who's good at that sort of thing.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296A32E00000000}That's right.
For now, all we can do is wait and see.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935102}{C:819582960C0100000000}This time I'll beat them for sure!
But first...
{C:819782830400}Light{C:819782830000}, open a communications channel!

{C:81935302}{C:81958296A42E00000000}What are you planning, Kaine?

{C:81935102}{C:819582960D0100000000}I'm going to declare war.
I'll tell them I'm about to blow them away.

{C:81935202}{C:81958296A52E00000000}You could just fight them...

{C:81935102}{C:819582960E0100000000}Shaddup!
Hurry up, {C:819782830400}Light{C:819782830000}!

{C:81935302}{C:81958296A62E00000000}Yeah, yeah.
...The channel's open.

{C:81935102}{C:819582960F0100000000}Can you hear me, Astante II!?
I'm about to beat the hell out of you.
You'd better be ready!!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:81958296A72E00000000}What is this vulgar transmission?

{C:81938700}{C:81958296A82E00000000}{C:819782830400}Musai{C:819782830000} is the source of the transmission.

{C:81935502}{C:81958296A92E00000000}Hey, that voice just now...

{C:81930700}{C:81958296AA2E00000000}Is it someone you know?

{C:81935402}{C:81958296AB2E00000000}Yes, I'm almost certain of it.

{C:81935502}{C:81958296AC2E00000000}I'll borrow the mic.

{C:81958296AD2E00000000}Heeey, Kaine!
We're aboard this ship.
Attack it and I won't let you get away with it!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935402}{C:81958296AF2E00000000}These people took us in
and protected us, Kaine.
So don't attack them.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935202}{C:81958296B02E00000000}We can't attack them now, can we?
What are you going to do, Kaine?

{C:81935102}{C:81958296110100000000}What am I going to do?
There's nothing I can do, is there?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B12E00000000}We have no intention of attacking.
We're going to land at {C:819782830300}Mizun{C:819782830000}.
Please follow us as well.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935102}{C:81958296120100000000}What does he mean,
'Please follow us as well'!?
What a damn show-off!

{C:81935202}{C:81958296B22E00000000}Then what are you going to do?
You're not going to follow them?
Even with Rose and Linda aboard!?

{C:81935102}{C:81958296130100000000}I'll follow them.
I've got no choice, have I?
Damn, this pisses me off.

{C:81935302}{C:81958296B32E00000000}Then just follow them without fussing.
Honestly.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905102}{C:81958296150100000000}Linda!
Why were you on that ship?

{C:81958296170100000000}We attacked after hearing
what your brother told us.
Not that we wanted to obey his orders.

{C:81905402}{C:81958296B52E00000000}The people on this ship aren't bad.
I could tell just from talking to them a little.

{C:81958296B72E00000000}Please, Kaine.
Lend these people your strength.

{C:81905102}{C:81958296180100000000}It's not that simple...
Right, Tap?

{C:81905202}{C:81958296B82E00000000}Hey, that's dirty.
Don't dump this on me.

{C:81905502}{C:81958296B92E00000000}I'm asking you, too.
There are plenty of other bad people out there.
Please help these people.

{C:81905302}{C:81958296BA2E00000000}When two princesses ask you,
how can you refuse to help?

{C:81905102}{C:81958296190100000000}But...

{C:81905402}{C:81958296BB2E00000000}You won't listen even when I ask?
Fine, then.
As for you and me, Kaine...

{C:81905102}{C:819582961A0100000000}All right, all right! I'll help!
So, please, please,
don't be mad, Linda, pleeease!

{C:81905402}{C:81958296BC2E00000000}Hee hee hee... I was only kidding.
Thank you, Kaine.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296BE2E00000000}I've been waiting for you, Daba.
Let me introduce our new allies.

{C:81903302}{C:81958296BF2E00000000}{C:819782830400}Yuu Tagami{C:819782830000} is my name.
These are {C:819782830400}Doris Wave,{C:819782830000}
{C:819782830400}Skipper{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830400}Manon{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02E00000000}{C:819782830400}Skipper{C:819782830000}?

{C:81903902}{C:81958296C12E00000000}That's what people call me.
You can call me that, too.

{C:81904102}{C:81958296C22E00000000}I have no wish to fight,
but I understand that in this situation,
it can't be helped.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296C32E00000000}They should be a great help to us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C42E00000000}I'm looking forward to working with you.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C52E00000000}Now that everyone's here,
there's something I'd like to say.

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C62E00000000}What's this, all of a sudden?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C72E00000000}Sho, do you remember
what we talked about on Crescent?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582961D0100000000}You mean when Jojo revealed
that he was a prince?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296C82E00000000}Yes. There's something
I want to tell everyone, too.

{C:81958296C92E00000000}I'm a survivor of the Yaman dynasty,
which Posaydal's army destroyed.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582961E0100000000}You were a prince, too, Daba!?
No, I suppose in this case you're a king.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296CA2E00000000}I only wanted to be honest with you.
It doesn't make me
any different from who I've always been.

{C:81905800}{C:81958296CB2E00000000}If you're of the Yaman royal family,
there should be a ceremony.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296CC2E00000000}It's not a ceremony.
It's an expression of gratitude to the earth.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296CD2E00000000}Can you do it, Daba?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296CE2E00000000}Of course... Let's go outside.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905800}{C:81958296D02E00000000}I recognize you as one of the Yaman family.
You are the leader of the rebels!

{C:81905600}{C:81958296D22E00000000}Daba... was a prince all along.
Should I be happy or sad...?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296D32E00000000}Thanks to you all, I found the courage to say it.
Thank you.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582961F0100000000}Come on.
I didn't say a thing.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D42E00000000}It's the same for me.
I could say it because someone
gave me a push... right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D52E00000000}Whoa, don't turn this on me.
I haven't done anything, either.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296D62E00000000}You've done plenty.
Whatever happens,
you'll still be the same, won't you?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D72E00000000}That puts everyone at ease.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296DA2E00000000}You accepted us without a fuss.

{C:8190ED01}{C:81958296DB2E00000000}You even accepted me,
though I was your enemy.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC2E00000000}Ah, please stop!
I just did what came naturally,
without making anything of it.

{C:81958296DD2E00000000}I haven't done anything special!!

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296DE2E00000000}Isn't that what's good about you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF2E00000000}You're killing me with praise!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E02E00000000}Haaah...
What's with everyone?

{C:81900200}{C:819582969D2B00000000}Um...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E32E00000000}Oh, it's you, Lun.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E52E00000000}'Oh, it's you'? That's not very nice.
I went to all the trouble of following you.
Why did you run away?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296E62E00000000}Even you're teasing me, Lun?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E82E00000000}I'm not teasing you.
I'm just happy
that everyone likes you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E92E00000000}Everyone likes me, huh?
It doesn't feel real.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296EA2E00000000}That's fine.
Everyone likes you just as you are.
If you just stay yourself...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB2E00000000}I will.
It's not as if I could change now, anyway.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296EC2E00000000}Shall we go back, then?



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296EE2E00000000}As expected, everyone's gone.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2E00000000}It's better that way...

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296F02E00000000}What are you sneaking around for?
Everyone's back
aboard Astante II.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F12E00000000}Van,
were you waiting for me?

{C:81909E02}{C:81958296F22E00000000}Yeah.
Have you calmed down a little?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32E00000000}Yeah, more or less.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296200100000000}You don't need to worry about it.
Just be yourself.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296F42E00000000}See?
It's just like I told you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F52E00000000}You're right.
I'll keep going at my own pace, as always.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296F62E00000000}Meooow.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296F72E00000000}You're back at just the right time.
Do you know this child?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F82E00000000}No. Who is it?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296F92E00000000}{C:819782830400}Ed{C:819782830000} is Ed, you knooow.
But that's not my real name.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296FA2E00000000}Apparently, the child stowed away from Brave.
Even the security checks
didn't pick anything up.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2E00000000}Then,
how did you find the child?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296FD2E00000000}The Defense Class kids found this child
sneaking food in the dining hall.
We finally caught our stowaway.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FE2E00000000}Hey, young man,
how did you get aboard?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296FF2E00000000}Eheh heh heh heh heh.
Liiike this.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:81958296002F00000000}Rie!
What on earth happened!?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296012F00000000}I don't know!
Astante II
suddenly started up.

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296022F00000000}Can I go ahead and fly it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296032F00000000}So you're the one who caused this!?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296042F00000000}I failed back at Brave,
but now I can go vrooom and whooosh
and fly it!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296052F00000000}Aaah, stop, stop!
Don't fly it!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296062F00000000}Then, saaay,
will you let Ed
ride on Astante II, too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296072F00000000}I'll let you aboard,
so stop it already!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296082F00000000}Yeeeeeeeeees!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:81958296092F00000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
He's an interesting boy.

{C:8190CD02}{C:819582960A2F00000000}Well then, once again,
hellooo!

{C:819582960B2F00000000}I'm Edward Wong Hau Pepelu
Tivrusky IV!
I named myself!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960C2F00000000}Edward... what?

{C:8190CD02}{C:819582960D2F00000000}It's too much trouble. Just call me Ed.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960E2F00000000}(Then don't give yourself
　such a long name...)

{C:819582960F2F00000000}Anyway, welcome aboard, Ed.
But don't ever do that again.

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296102F00000000}Roger-roger, I'm a monster!
Roar, roar!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296210100000000}Oh, what's all the commotion?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296112F00000000}Oh, Tail.
We've got a brilliant hacker on our side.

{C:81900900}{C:81958296220100000000}Oh, a girl hacker.
Nice to meet you, Ed.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296122F00000000}Oh, a giiirl!!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296132F00000000}Eheh heh heh heh heh.


{C:81905300}{C:81958296142F00000000}I heard.
We can't get into Gastogal, can we?
Isn't there some way?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296152F00000000}We need one more person
as skilled as the Professor...
Oh! We've got one!!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296162F00000000}W-what's the matter!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172F00000000}Ed!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296182F00000000}Meooow?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192F00000000}Could you give us a hand?
We need your skills.

{C:81900700}{C:819582961A2F00000000}Of course! With her help,
we can get into Gastogal!
Let's launch Astante II.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961B2F00000000}Yes, Professor!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936E00}{C:81958296232F00000000}How long do you intend
to keep this up?

{C:81958296252F00000000}Please stop
involving yourself with that man.

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296262F00000000}You're persistent!
I'm merely using that man.

{C:81937C00}{C:81958296272F00000000}Reporting!
The Gon Jem Squad has been defeated.

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296292F00000000}So in the end, I can rely only on myself.
Whale, we're moving out!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:819582962A2F00000000}Whale is rising!
It's Amandra Kamandra's ship!

{C:81930100}{C:819582962B2F00000000}Maintain battle readiness!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936F00}{C:819582962C2F00000000}Whatever you do is useless.
The likes of you
could never defeat me!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935300}{C:819582962E2F00000000}Why isn't he
taking any damage!?

{C:8193CD02}{C:819582962F2F00000000}Well, it's Bio Relation.
Apparently, as long as it's there,
Amandra is invincible.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296302F00000000}Ed, do you know
how to cut it off?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296312F00000000}Come out, come out,
Bio Relatiooon!

{C:81958296322F00000000}Oops, from here,
there's nothing I can dooo.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296332F00000000}What are we supposed to do?!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936E00}{C:81958296342F00000000}Young men,
I'll help you.

{C:81936F00}{C:81958296352F00000000}{C:819782830400}Mian{C:819782830000}, you're betraying me!?

{C:81936E00}{C:81958296372F00000000}The times are no longer in your hands.
Please give up.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936F00}{C:81958296382F00000000}Damn Mian! She turned off the switch.
Hmph, it doesn't matter.
I'll defeat you with my own strength!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905300}{C:819582963B2F00000000}Is it over...?

{C:81905400}{C:819582963C2F00000000}It's over, Dabaaa!!

{C:81905300}{C:819582963D2F00000000}Now, peace for Pentagona, too...
No, it's not over.

{C:81905600}{C:819582963E2F00000000}What are you saying?
Amandra has fallen.
It's over, isn't it?

{C:81905700}{C:819582963F2F00000000}Daba, don't tell me you're...!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296402F00000000}Now that Pentagona
is finally at peace,
if you wanted to get off here...

{C:81905300}{C:81958296412F00000000}Don't say that.
We're friends, after all.
I'll stay with you to the very end.

{C:81905500}{C:81958296432F00000000}It can't be helped.
This time I'm coming along, too.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296442F00000000}Let's head for the next continent.
Which continent is next?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296452F00000000}Um, the way toward {C:819782830300}Byston Well{C:819782830000} is
open.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296230100000000}Byston Well, huh?
I wonder if Nie and the others are all right.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296462F00000000}It's Nie and the others we're talking about.
I'm sure they're all right.
Rie, would you set off?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296482F00000000}Yes! Astante II
is launching
for Byston Well!!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:819582964B2F00000000}I'm settling this with nothing more than exile
for you, a man who killed his father.
You should be grateful, Le Caine.

{C:81932B01}{C:819582964C2F00000000}That's absurd! Father
should still have been alive then.

{C:81930D00}{C:819582964D2F00000000}Who knows?
That's no concern of mine.
The result is all that matters.

{C:819582964E2F00000000}Now leave this land, Le Caine.
Grados has no need of you.

{C:81932B01}{C:819582964F2F00000000}Ghh... Binzvanker.
I'll let you keep your life
until I return.

{C:81958296502F00000000}I will return! I definitely will!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:81958296512F00000000}Apparently an enemy called the Gon Jem Squad
is somewhere nearby.

{C:81958296522F00000000}I hear they're mercenaries.
As a negotiator,
I'll go and talk to them.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296532F00000000}Isn't that dangerous?

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296542F00000000}Negotiations
always go hand in hand with danger.
The more dangerous, the more interesting.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296552F00000000}Still, our information says
they're called the Filth of {C:819782830300}Giganos{C:819782830000},
so please be careful.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296562F00000000}Understood.
I'll be careful.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935E02}{C:81958296572F00000000}Spare me the bullshit.
What I want is money! Money!
How much is your outfit offering?

{C:8193A202}{C:81958296582F00000000}How much?
I believe there are matters
we ought to discuss first...

{C:81935F02}{C:81958296592F00000000}Well, aren't you impressive,
Mr. Negotiator?

{C:81935E02}{C:819582965A2F00000000}Captain {C:819782830400}Min{C:819782830000}, keep your mouth shut.

{C:819582965B2F00000000}Let's see. If we're adding conditions,
you can compensate us for the damage
we took fighting you, too.

{C:8193A202}{C:819582965C2F00000000}You would demand even that?
Negotiations are conducted between equals.
Do you have any intention of negotiating?

{C:81935E02}{C:819582965D2F00000000}I never had any intention of negotiating.
I just wanted a look at the mug
of the fool who proposed negotiations.

{C:8193A202}{C:819582965E2F00000000}What?!

{C:81936102}{C:81958296602F00000000}That's how it is.
Now that you understand, get lost!
Hya ha ha ha ha!

{C:8193A202}{C:81958296612F00000000}This is distasteful. Good day.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296622F00000000}Roger!
You're safe!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296632F00000000}How... did the negotiations go?

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296642F00000000}You both waited for me?
Thank you.

{C:81958296652F00000000}There were no negotiations.
They never intended
to negotiate in the first place.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296662F00000000}I see.
Thank you for trying, Roger.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296672F00000000}I'm sorry, but I'm tired.
I'll go back to the Astante II
and get some rest.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296682F00000000}Yes, of course.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296802F00000000}So you've finally all shown your ugly mugs.

{C:8190C202}{C:81958296240100000000}Master!
What's the situation?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296812F00000000}It's not good.
Natsumi was taken by the Four Masho to 
{C:819782830300}Arago Castle{C:819782830000}.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296822F00000000}What?!
Weren't you supposed
to be protecting her?!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296832F00000000}If certain fools didn't start fighting
every time they met up,
I could have stayed with Natsumi!

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296842F00000000}Let's discuss
what we should do.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296862F00000000}Kira is right.
What should we do, Master?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296872F00000000}Is there any way?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296892F00000000}There is just one.
Domon.
The Shuffle Alliance is all here, yes?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582968A2F00000000}Yes!

{C:8190C001}{C:819582968C2F00000000}Then concentrate your power
as the Shuffle Alliance right here!
Get on with it!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B501}{C:819582968D2F00000000}I'm sorry, everyone.
Lend me your strength.

{C:8190B901}{C:819582968E2F00000000}If it's for justice, I will.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C001}{C:819582969F2F00000000}We managed to break through
the Yoja barrier.

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296A02F00000000}To think Arago Castle was there!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296A12F00000000}Now, let's go.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22F00000000}I can't do anything to help,
but may I come too?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296A32F00000000}I'll leave the driving to you.
You're the best at it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42F00000000}Thank you, Domon.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C001}{C:81958296A52F00000000}From here on, it's one battle after another.
Don't let your guard down!

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296A62F00000000}Uwoooooh!
I'm itching for a fight!

{C:8190B602}{C:81958296A72F00000000}Master Asia, have you betrayed us?!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296A82F00000000}No more talk!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296AA2F00000000}Master Asia, Undefeated of the East...
Whatever you call yourself,
what exactly are you trying to do?!

{C:8190BE02}{C:81958296AB2F00000000}Yeah, I'd like to know too.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296AC2F00000000}Would you tell us, old man?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296AD2F00000000}You can't understand unless I explain...
That's why you're all idiots!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296B02F00000000}Master!
We're risking our lives in these battles!
Please explain it to them!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B12F00000000}Arago learned of a baby who crossed time and space
and is plotting to take
that power for himself.

{C:81958296B22F00000000}I learned of this before anyone else
and took action, but I couldn't
find out where Arago was.

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296B32F00000000}So you infiltrated the enemy's ranks.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B42F00000000}Precisely.
But I couldn't locate his castle without gaining his trust.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296B52F00000000}So you turned against us
and took Natsumi away from us?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B62F00000000}I never imagined the Four Masho
would do what they did, though.
That was the one thing I miscalculated.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296B72F00000000}Forget about that for now.
Let's hurry up and rescue Natsumi and the others!

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296B92F00000000}Oh, what a splendid idea!
I think you and I will get along, little monkey!
Come on, let's get moving!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BA2F00000000}Hmm, you're right.
For now, I'll devote all my strength
to rescuing Natsumi and Mirai.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B102}{C:81958296BB2F00000000}I commend you
for getting this far inside!

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296BC2F00000000}I thought you were acting strangely.
So you did betray us after all,
Master Asia!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BD2F00000000}Betrayal?
That word applies to comrades.
I was never one of yours!

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296BE2F00000000}Talk about
a brazen thief!

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296BF2F00000000}Hah! You took Natsumi away
when Master wasn't there.
You've got a nerve!

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296C02F00000000}Quit your whining
and come at us, Four Masho!

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296C12F00000000}Enough of your insolence!
Prepare yourselves, brats!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B502}{C:81958296C22F00000000}Four Masho, gather before me!

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296C32F00000000}Lord Arago?!

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296C42F00000000}Next time, we'll settle this once and for all!


{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296C52F00000000}With all of us together,
we should be able to manage.

{C:8190B801}{C:819582962A0100000000}Heh heh, this is a piece of cake!

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296C62F00000000}We shouldn't get careless.

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296C72F00000000}Hmph! Why are humans
such cowards?

{C:8190C202}{C:819582962C0100000000}Shall we rest a little before going on?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296C92F00000000}Our next battle will likely be against Arago.
A rest would be wise.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190BF02}{C:81958296CA2F00000000}We must get Natsumi back,
no matter what!

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296CC2F00000000}All right, let's go!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B102}{C:81958296C43700000000}Everyone, wait.

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296C53700000000}What is it, Shuten?

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296C63700000000}Don't you think
Lord Arago is acting strangely?

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296C73700000000}You think so too?

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296C83700000000}So you've all felt it as well?

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296C93700000000}It seems none of us
can make sense of it.

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296CA3700000000}I suspect that Lord Arago
may be an impostor.

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296CB3700000000}If that's true, what will you do?

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296CC3700000000}Surely you don't mean to defy him?

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296CD3700000000}If he truly is Lord Arago,
there's no way we could win.
Shall we try fighting him?


{C:8190C001}{C:81958296CE3700000000}You seem to be wavering.
Understandably so.

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296CF3700000000}Master,
do you know something?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D13700000000}Your leader is an impostor.
Though I don't know where the real one is.

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296D23700000000}How do you expect us
to believe that?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D33700000000}You fool!
How dare you call yourselves the Four Masho
when you can't even see that?!

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296D43700000000}I'll side with Master Asia.
If Lord Arago is an impostor,
I cannot let that impostor go unpunished.

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296D53700000000}So we are to fight?
Then I'll join you.

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296D63700000000}Master,
we would like you
to let us join your group as well.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296D83700000000}What?!
There's no way
I'll fight alongside the likes of you!

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296D93700000000}Then shall we settle this right here?!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296DA3700000000}Kaaaah!
Stop it, you fools!

{C:81958296DB3700000000}This is not where we belong!
A true battle is fought where one belongs!
Do not fight meaningless battles!

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296DC3700000000}You are right.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296DD3700000000}Then let us fight together.

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296DE3700000000}Very well.
But if Lord Arago is not an impostor,
we will strike you down at once!

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296DF3700000000}I'd like to see you try!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E03700000000}Well, let's move on.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296E13700000000}Good. Let's head to the final battlefield!







{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296CE2F00000000}I've found Natsumi!

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296CF2F00000000}We must get out at once!
Everyone, hurry!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C402}{C:81958296D02F00000000}Natsumi won't wake up.
What's wrong with her?

{C:8193DA02}{C:81958296D12F00000000}Mmm...

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296D22F00000000}She's awake!

{C:8190DA02}{C:81958296D42F00000000}Good morning...
What's going on?
Why is everyone here?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C902}{C:81958296D62F00000000}This kid
doesn't remember a thing?

{C:8190DA02}{C:81958296D72F00000000}Huh? What?
Did something happen?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D82F00000000}If she doesn't remember,
why don't we just leave it at that?

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296D92F00000000}What?!
Then all our hard work...

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296DA2F00000000}Hah ha ha ha ha ha!
What does our hard work matter?
It's just a drop in the ocean!

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296DB2F00000000}Those are fine words.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296DD2F00000000}That's my master!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296DE2F00000000}Enough flattery.

{C:81958296DF2F00000000}You still have things
you must do, don't you?
Go on, then.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296E02F00000000}What will you do?
Won't you come with us?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E12F00000000}I'd like to ask too.
Would you please come with us?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296E22F00000000}Hmm... That might not be so bad.
I think I'll join you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E32F00000000}Then let's go!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296472E00000000}It's Rie and the others...
That's an interesting group.
Well, I'd better not disturb them.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939F02}{C:81958296482E00000000}...That's what happened.
Honestly, Van
is so rude!

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296492E00000000}You is much the same.
He kisses me at every opportunity.
In front of everyone, too!

{C:81930300}{C:819582964A2E00000000}Wow, how bold!

{C:819582964B2E00000000}Still, you two are lucky.
You have someone you can talk about like that.
All I have is my big brother...

{C:8193A102}{C:819582964C2E00000000}What? That's not so bad.
He seems nice.

{C:81939F02}{C:819582964D2E00000000}I agree!
He's really sweet!

{C:81930300}{C:819582964E2E00000000}Do you think so?
I'm the one
who envies you two.

{C:8193A102}{C:819582964F2E00000000}The grass is always greener, as they say.
Want to trade him for You?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296502E00000000}What?!
No, no, no!

{C:81939F02}{C:81958296512E00000000}See? That's why Nelfea
says you've got a brother complex!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A302}{C:819582965E2E00000000}Norman.

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296522E00000000}I don't think you need
to do the maintenance.

{C:8193A402}{C:81958296532E00000000}Making sure Master Roger can use
the Megadeus whenever he wishes
is part of my job.

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296542E00000000}Then Roger ought
to do it himself.

{C:8193A402}{C:81958296552E00000000}Unfortunately, Master Roger
cannot maintain the Megadeus.

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296562E00000000}He's clumsy, then.

{C:8193A402}{C:81958296572E00000000}No, no. Master Roger
simply lacks the necessary knowledge.

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296592E00000000}I see.
Then I suppose it can't be helped.

{C:8193A402}{C:819582965A2E00000000}Doing maintenance
has its rewards, too.

{C:8193A302}{C:819582965C2E00000000}Rewards?

{C:8193A402}{C:819582965D2E00000000}A beautiful young lady
makes tea for me.

{C:8193A302}{C:819582965E2E00000000}Norman.

{C:8193A402}{C:819582965F2E00000000}Yes?

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296602E00000000}Thank you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909400}{C:81958296923600000000}I've finally caught up
with the Astante II!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296933600000000}Um, can I help you?

{C:81909400}{C:81958296943600000000}I'm joining the crew today. I'm 
{C:819782830400}Yazan Gable{C:819782830000}.
I'll be counting on you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296953600000000}Rie, have you heard about this?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296973600000000}No?
Um, Mr. Yazan...

{C:81909400}{C:81958296983600000000}Oh, I decided that myself.
I'm not being used
by someone I know nothing about.

{C:81958296993600000000}I walked out on that guy
Binzvanker.
Binzvanker's your enemy, right?

{C:81900600}{C:819582969A3600000000}That's right.

{C:81909400}{C:819582969B3600000000}At the very least, I don't want
to team up with that bastard.
And I sure as hell won't be ruled by that bastard.

{C:819582969C3600000000}That's my reason.
It's enough, isn't it?

{C:81900600}{C:819582969D3600000000}I see.
We can let him join us, can't we, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:819582969E3600000000}If you say so, Dad.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A202}{C:81958296763300000000}What do you think of this fighting?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296773300000000}...It's pointless.

{C:8193A202}{C:81958296783300000000}Heh. Is that so?
Then why did you come aboard
the Astante II?

{C:8193CA02}{C:819582967A3300000000}There's someone I don't like.
Not someone out in the open,
but someone sneaking around behind the scenes.

{C:819582967C3300000000}Besides... The people on that ship
are fun to watch.

{C:8193CA02}{C:819582967D3300000000}That's about it.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E301}{C:819582968D2900000000}You realize your struggle
won't end easily, don't you?

{C:819582968E2900000000}But there are limits
to the help we can give you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E301}{C:819582968F2900000000}This should be of some use.

{C:81958296902900000000}Whatever happens, you must survive.
If you don't survive,
you have no future anyway...






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296D63000000000}Lun, have you got a moment?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D83000000000}Yes!
What is it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D93000000000}I'd like you to leave the Astante II.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296DB3000000000}What? Why?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC3000000000}I think the fighting
is going to get even worse.
I can't leave you in a place like that.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296DD3000000000}But it's all right for Rie and Nelfea?
They're younger than I am.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF3000000000}That's because they've both
had combat training.
It's different for you.


{C:81900200}{C:81958296E13000000000}I can pilot a GT too!
Isn't that enough?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E23000000000}Heh heh heh.
You've lost this one, big brother!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E33000000000}Oh, Rie. You were here?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E43000000000}Yes, I was!
I know how you feel, big brother,
but let's all do our best together to the end!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E63000000000}Exactly!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E73000000000}All right.
But please don't
push yourself too hard.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E83000000000}I won't.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900B00}{C:81958296400100000000}How did things go?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA3000000000}Admiral Tsuragi!
We destroyed the Norstan,
but we couldn't capture the mastermind.

{C:81900B00}{C:81958296410100000000}I see...
Well done.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB3000000000}But the fighting isn't over yet.
A new enemy has appeared.

{C:81900B00}{C:81958296420100000000}I've received the report.
A ghost from the past has appeared.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EC3000000000}A ghost from the past...?

{C:81900B00}{C:81958296430100000000}Yes.
Peace was almost within reach,
and yet that person still seeks war.

{C:81958296440100000000}It will be a hard fight.
I cannot tell you not to push yourselves,
but please stay safe.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296ED3000000000}Yes. Thank you.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D002}{C:81958296EE3000000000}Welcome home!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF3000000000}Huh? This is...

{C:81900600}{C:81958296F03000000000}You're late.
Where did you stop on the way?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F23000000000}Dad, when did you have a secret child...

{C:81900600}{C:81958296F33000000000}I knew you'd say that,
you idiot son!

{C:81958296F53000000000}Just after you left Claudia,
some people wandered into this world.
We've been looking after them.

{C:8190D002}{C:81958296F63000000000}{C:819782830400}Asuka Sugo{C:819782830000} is my name.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F73000000000}Oh, hello.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296F83000000000}I have a daughter named Rie as well,
but she's aboard the ship
and hasn't returned yet.

{C:8190D002}{C:81958296F93000000000}There are others here too,
but they've all gone out.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA3000000000}Dad, just how many people
are you looking after?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296FB3000000000}There are nine altogether,
but the two staying with us
are Asuka and {C:819782830400}Hayato{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296FC3000000000}I asked Rondo and the others to help too.
They should be all over the place.
Go and say hello if you like.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D002}{C:81958296FD3000000000}Hayato...
You'll make yourself ill if you don't eat.

{C:8193CF02}{C:81958296FE3000000000}I don't need anything.
I don't want to eat!

{C:8193D002}{C:81958296003100000000}But you won't even be able to race...

{C:8193CF02}{C:81958296013100000000}Where in this world
are there any races?!

{C:81958296023100000000}Aren't you afraid, Asuka?
We've been thrown into a place we don't know.

{C:8193D002}{C:81958296033100000000}I'm terribly afraid.
But... you're here, Hayato.
I can bear it because you're with me.

{C:8193CF02}{C:81958296043100000000}Asuka...




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296273100000000}Professor, who was that boy?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296283100000000}Ryo Siegel.
He's the son of a late comrade of mine.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296293100000000}{C:819782830400}Siegel{C:819782830000}, was he the man they called
your right-hand man?

{C:81900700}{C:819582962A3100000000}Yes.
I don't want to drag him into the fighting,
but he just won't accept it.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962B3100000000}He has a strong sense of justice.

{C:81900700}{C:819582962C3100000000}Which is all the more reason
I don't want him joining the fighting.

{C:819582962D3100000000}If possible, I'd like him to protect his mother, {C:819782830400}Siruna{C:819782830000},
and the girl
he grew up with.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962E3100000000}Heh. I don't think that'll work, Professor.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900500}{C:819582963B3100000000}Professor Rondo, please let me come too!
With Dad gone, I'll protect
Mom and {C:819782830400}Tilfy{C:819782830000} myself!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963C3100000000}See?

{C:81900700}{C:819582963D3100000000}Don't give me that.

{C:819582963E3100000000}Ryo, you can protect your mother and childhood friend
on Claudia as well.
Can't you understand that?

{C:81900500}{C:819582963F3100000000}But the Astante is
the only Cloud Ship left!
If it sinks, I won't be able to protect anyone!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296403100000000}Professor, let's take him with us.
When he's this determined,
there's no telling what he'll do.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296413100000000}You're right.
Ryo, come with us.
But whatever you do, don't push yourself too hard.

{C:81900500}{C:81958296423100000000}Thank you!






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193C102}{C:81958296263300000000}We Dagwon have combined
to become more powerful before.

{C:8193AC02}{C:81958296273300000000}Combined?

{C:8193BD02}{C:81958296283300000000}D-don't get the wrong idea.
We have machines of our own,
though we don't have them right now.

{C:8193AD02}{C:81958296293300000000}Of course.
I thought that sounded strange.

{C:8193C102}{C:819582962A3300000000}Why don't you Troopers
try combining with us?

{C:8193BD02}{C:819582962B3300000000}Geki!
Don't shout about combining
in the middle of the street!

{C:8193C102}{C:819582962C3300000000}Combining is a man's dream!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B801}{C:819582965F0100000000}Bro, it's good that we have more companions
who can fight without machines,
but don't you think they're disorganized?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296333300000000}I can't fight without a machine,
so I'm in no position to lecture them,
but they don't seem to get along.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296343300000000}That doesn't seem to be the case.
Take a look, both of you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296353300000000}What we must do
is rescue Natsumi.

{C:8190C002}{C:81958296363300000000}So we agree on that.
But why do you protect her?

{C:8190BC02}{C:81958296373300000000}You don't even have to think about it.
She's a child. She's weak.
The strong have to protect her.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296383300000000}Exactly.
But why did you think Arago
was protecting the world?

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296393300000000}I'd like to know that too.

{C:8190C002}{C:819582963A3300000000}I've thought so ever since
I first met Natsumi.

{C:8190BC02}{C:819582963B3300000000}Come to think of it, I feel like I couldn't
become Dagwon anymore once I decided
to hand Natsumi over to Arago.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582963C3300000000}Perhaps Arago cast
some sort of spell on you.

{C:8190BC02}{C:819582963D3300000000}Damn Arago!

{C:819582963E3300000000}No matter how you look at it,
the Troopers can't be in the wrong.
We were completely fooled.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296403300000000}You're right.
It is just as you said.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296413300000000}They're warriors too.
They can understand each other.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296623300000000}So you're Domon.
I've got a message from Master.

{C:8193B501}{C:81958296633300000000}From my master?!
Where did you meet him?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296643300000000}Don't get so impatient.
His message was, 'Trust me.'
I have no idea what he meant.

{C:8193B501}{C:81958296653300000000}Did he say
anything else?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296663300000000}He said, 'Keep training, you idiot apprentice.'
That's what he told me.

{C:8193B501}{C:81958296673300000000}What did you say?!

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296683300000000}Hey, hey.
I'm just passing on his words.
Don't get so angry.

{C:8193B501}{C:81958296693300000000}Oh, right. Of course.
...I'm sorry!

{C:8193CA02}{C:819582966A3300000000}Well, that's the message.
See you!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D802}{C:81958296083100000000}I'm not saying
I won't cooperate!

{C:8193D702}{C:819582960A3100000000}Then why do you find fault
with every single thing I say?!

{C:8193D802}{C:819582960B3100000000}Because everything you say
is a waste of breath!
Why don't you use your head for once?

{C:8193D702}{C:819582960D3100000000}What was that?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E3100000000}(I don't even know them,
 so I'll just ignore them.)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D302}{C:819582960F3100000000}...You're saying I should
respect my mechanic?

{C:8193B601}{C:81958296103100000000}Yes.
Mechanics work hard
for their drivers too.

{C:81958296113100000000}But I mean respect.
That doesn't mean subservience.

{C:8193D302}{C:81958296123100000000}That's difficult.

{C:8193B601}{C:81958296153100000000}You're teammates. There's nothing difficult about it.
Just be honest about your feelings.
It's simple, isn't it?

{C:8193D302}{C:81958296163100000000}Honest... I'll try that.
Thank you, Ms. Mikamura.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190B601}{C:81958296173100000000}Oh, what's wrong?
Why are you standing there in a daze?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296183100000000}Who was that?
I've never seen him before.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296193100000000}He's just a passerby.
He spoke to me while I was doing maintenance.

{C:819582961B3100000000}He said he wasn't getting along with his mechanic,
so I gave him some advice.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961C3100000000}You're kind even to complete strangers,
Rain.

{C:8190B601}{C:819582961D3100000000}Oh, stop it!
Don't tease me!

{C:81930100}{C:819582961E3100000000}I mean it!

{C:8190B601}{C:819582961F3100000000}Well, thank you.
If Domon were this open with me,
it would make my life easier.

{C:81958296203100000000}Now, I'd better get back to maintenance.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296433100000000}You've got quite an attitude
for someone freeloading at Uncle's!

{C:8193D202}{C:81958296443100000000}I'm simply being looked after.
Please don't use a word like freeloading.
It isn't elegant.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296453100000000}Grrr...
You're really getting on my nerves.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296463100000000}Nelfea,
what's wrong?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296473100000000}Doesn't he seem full of himself?
He claims he's a genius.
Self-proclaimed, I'm sure.

{C:8190D202}{C:81958296483100000000}You're mistaken.
Everyone recognizes my genius, myself included.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296493100000000}Pfft... Ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:81900400}{C:819582964A3100000000}What are you laughing at?


{C:81930100}{C:819582964B3100000000}I think he's a lot like
you were when we first met, Nelfea.


{C:81900400}{C:819582964C3100000000}Anyway, don't
cause Uncle any trouble!

{C:8190D202}{C:819582964D3100000000}I would never do
anything so uncouth.

{C:81900400}{C:819582964E3100000000}Let's leave this guy and go.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964F3100000000}Don't pull so hard!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296503100000000}We're minors, so a bar
isn't really our kind of place.

{C:8190D502}{C:81958296DA0100000000}You there!
You're obviously underage.
What are you doing here?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296513100000000}I didn't come here to drink alcohol.
I just want peach juice...

{C:8190D502}{C:81958296DC0100000000}Then you hardly needed
to come all the way to a bar.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296523100000000}What a pain in the ass you are.

{C:8190D502}{C:81958296DE0100000000}Underage drinking hinders mental and physical growth.
It does you no good at all.
Remember that.

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296533100000000}Yeah, yeah.
Peach juice is all I'm interested in anyway,
so it doesn't concern me.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296543100000000}I'm glad I didn't go in.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D402}{C:81958296553100000000}It's best to take everything easy.

{C:8193AD02}{C:81958296563100000000}Yeah, you're right.
You can't show your true strength
if you're all tensed up.

{C:81958296573100000000}You know, that's good advice.

{C:8193D402}{C:81958296583100000000}It's nothing.
You just looked like
you were carrying a lot of tension in your back.

{C:81958296593100000000}I suppose I'm meddling.

{C:8193AD02}{C:819582965A3100000000}No, you really helped.

{C:8193D402}{C:819582965B3100000000}I'm glad.
My business here is done,
so I'll be going.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582965C3100000000}Shu, who was that?

{C:8190AD02}{C:819582965D3100000000}I was thinking about Arago,
and he came over
and told me to relax.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3100000000}Hmm.

{C:8190AD02}{C:819582965F3100000000}He's a good guy.
I'd like to see him again
once the fighting is over.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296213100000000}Yes.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582962F3100000000}Are you sure this is the right way?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296303100000000}Yes, this way.
I can sense tremendous armor power.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296313100000000}Was it really all right for only me to come?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296323100000000}It's around here.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296333100000000}What?!
Power is welling up inside me!

{C:81930000}{C:819782830400}Kikoutei{C:819782830000}'s power was acquired.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296343100000000}{C:819782830400}Kikoutei{C:819782830000}...?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296353100000000}You heard it too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296363100000000}I heard Kikoutei.
Did you hear it too, Ryo?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296373100000000}Yes. Kikoutei is the name of a Yoroi Gear.
I've obtained a new Yoroi Gear.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296383100000000}That's incredible!
That'll make us stronger.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296393100000000}Yes!
Thank you for coming with me.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963A3100000000}All I did was come along.
I haven't done anything.
Well, shall we head back?



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935401}{C:81958296193300000000}...To me, you're already heroes,
fighting with nothing but yourselves
as you do.

{C:8193AA02}{C:819582961A3300000000}We wear Yoroi Gear,
so there's not much difference.



{C:81935401}{C:819582961B3300000000}A hero is someone with courage.
That makes everyone a hero,
including our friends who pilot machines.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D902}{C:81958296743600000000}You're Mr. Akatsuki's son, aren't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296753600000000}Yes. Who are you?

{C:8190D902}{C:81958296763600000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Akira Hiyoshi{C:819782830000}.
Your father has helped me
in all sorts of ways.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296773600000000}Oh, has he?

{C:8190D902}{C:81958296783600000000}I heard you were back,
so I thought I'd at least say hello.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296793600000000}Thank you for going out of your way.

{C:8190D902}{C:819582967A3600000000}Oh, it's nothing.
Sorry for holding you up.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A000}{C:81958296E13600000000}I've been waiting for you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E23600000000}Huh? For me?

{C:8190A000}{C:81958296E33600000000}Yes. You're traveling
with Captain Quattro, aren't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E43600000000}I am. Can I help you?

{C:8190A000}{C:81958296E53600000000}Actually, I have a machine
I'd like you to give to Captain Quattro.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E63600000000}That's fine,
but I can't accept it here.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E73600000000}Oh, big brother!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E83600000000}You don't have to point out the obvious.

{C:8190A000}{C:81958296E93600000000}Ha ha... Quite right. At the 
{C:819782830300}dock{C:819782830000}, I'll have it loaded onto your ship.

{C:81958296EA3600000000}But it's a prototype,
so please keep it confidential.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB3600000000}Understood.
I'll check it when I get back to the dock.

{C:8190A000}{C:81958296EC3600000000}Then I'll leave it in your hands.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296FF3600000000}We meet again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296003700000000}Oh, hello.
You're Haman, aren't you?

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296013700000000}Excuse me.
Are they here?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296023700000000}Did you bring us
another machine this time?

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296033700000000}Something like that.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296043700000000}You're awfully familiar, boy.
Being so approachable
can be quite a nuisance.

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296053700000000}L-Lady Haman!
I-I'm terribly sorry!

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296063700000000}Never mind.
What have you brought this time?


{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296073700000000}Yes, it's ready.
It's already been loaded onto the ship.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296083700000000}Well done.
Give everyone my regards.

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296093700000000}Your words honor us!
I'll pass them on.
Now, if you'll excuse me.


{C:81909E00}{C:819582960A3700000000}Boy, you understand without my saying it now, yes?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960B3700000000}You want me to tell Captain Quattro
to use the new machine.

{C:81909E00}{C:819582960C3700000000}Exactly.
I'm counting on you, boy.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939B00}{C:81958296912900000000}You act out of concern for the world.
Your dedication as a soldier
is something I would like to emulate.

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296922900000000}There's no need for flattery.

{C:81958296932900000000}I'm going to another continent.
What will you do?

{C:81939B00}{C:81958296942900000000}I still have things to do on this continent,
so I'll remain on the Terra continent.

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296952900000000}I see.
Then let us meet again, if the opportunity arises.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909B00}{C:81958296962900000000}Even if it was a coincidence,
there is a reason someone like that appeared.

{C:81958296972900000000}It may be a sign
of the tide of the times.

{C:81958296982900000000}You cannot win
by opposing such a tide.
For now, I shall observe the situation.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2900000000}Oh, it's Lun.
What's she doing with Sai Saici
at that stall?

{C:81900200}{C:819582967B2900000000}Is this right?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B40000000000}Whoa, miss!
That's salt! Salt!

{C:81900200}{C:819582967C2900000000}Huh? What?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B70000000000}And stop swinging
the pan around like that!
It's dangerous!

{C:81900200}{C:819582967E2900000000}If you're going to complain so much,
show me how it's done, Sai Saici!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B801}{C:81958296B90000000000}You do it like this,
and just a little flick...
There, it's done!

{C:81930200}{C:819582967F2900000000}Amaaaazing!

{C:8193B801}{C:81958296BA0000000000}Heh heh heh!
With me on the job,
it's a piece of cake!

{C:81958296BC0000000000}You'd better try harder too, miss,
or Bro won't like you anymore!

{C:81930200}{C:81958296812900000000}It isn't like that!
Oh, Sai Saici!
Idiot...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822900000000}Taste-testing looks scary,
so I'd better get out of here!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E401}{C:819582968B2900000000}Well, I don't need to say anything.
You know what you must do, don't you?
Do your best.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:81958296E42F00000000}It looks like everything's going smoothly.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E52F00000000}Oh, Professor.
The Astante II is running well, too.
We'll be entering Byston Well soon.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296E72F00000000}Whoa, don't shoot!
We're not enemies.
We know Ed, who's with you.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296E92F00000000}Don't you hello us!
You said you were going to the Astante II
as our representative!

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296EA2F00000000}Don't you go
abandoning us!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296EB2F00000000}Did I say that?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EC2F00000000}Is that right, Ed?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296ED2F00000000}Hmmmmmm?
Maybe I did. Forgive me,
Faye-Faaaye!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296EE2F00000000}Anyway,
we'll give you this ship we stole,
so let us join you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2F00000000}Rie.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296F12F00000000}Understood.
I'll match our cruising speed to yours,
so come alongside.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32F00000000}All right, Rie. We're ready.
Take us into Byston Well.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296F42F00000000}Astante II is
entering Byston Well.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296F52F00000000}What's this shaking?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62F00000000}Ed!
Are you up to something again!?

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296F72F00000000}Yes, yeeees!!
Ed's eating right nooow!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296F82F00000000}Anomaly ahead!
The Astante II is being pulled in!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2F00000000}Owww.
What was that just now?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296FC2F00000000}What's going on?
Nelfea, give me a status report.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FD2F00000000}The situation is unknown.
There's nothing
on the radar display.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296FE2F00000000}Can you tell us anything, Rondo?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296FF2F00000000}I've never encountered anything like this.
I really can't comment on it.
I'll investigate as far as I can.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296003000000000}We've got a radar contact.
It appears to be an Aura Ship.
We're receiving a transmission.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932700}{C:81958296043000000000}Well, so this is the famous Astante II.
I found quite a prize
chasing Her Majesty Queen Ciela!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296073000000000}Welcome aboard the Astante II.
I'm Captain Rie Akatsuki.

{C:81902000}{C:81958296093000000000}Thank you for rescuing me.
I am Ciela Lapana.

{C:819582960A3000000000}Todd Guinness of the Kingdom of A pursued me,
and I wandered into this space.

{C:81900700}{C:819582960B3000000000}Do you know
how to get out of here?

{C:81902000}{C:819582960C3000000000}Would you take me to the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Na{C:819782830000}?
Please?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960D3000000000}That much is easy.
Just tell us where to go.


{C:81932000}{C:819582960E3000000000}I'll assist you with my aura power.
Proceed freely through the Cloud Sea.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:819582960F3000000000}We got out so easily!

{C:81932000}{C:81958296103000000000}Now then,
please head for the Kingdom of Na.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296113000000000}What are you doing?
This isn't the Kingdom of Na.
Head for the Kingdom of Na.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296123000000000}Y-yes!
I'm sorry...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902000}{C:81958296133000000000}Thank you for your trouble.
In return, let me tell you something useful.

{C:81958296143000000000}I hear Nie Given is in the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Lau{C:819782830000},
waiting for you.
Do go and see him.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296153000000000}The Kingdom of Lau?
Understood. We'll go there.

{C:81902000}{C:81958296173000000000}And once you've joined up with Nie Given,
come back to the Kingdom of Na.
I have something good to give you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296183000000000}Something good...?

{C:81902000}{C:819582961A3000000000}Now, be on your way.
The Kingdom of Lau must be in dire straits.
Go prepared for what awaits you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961B3000000000}Thank you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:819582961E3000000000}I've been waiting for you to return.

{C:81901D00}{C:819582961F3000000000}Welcome back! Have you been well?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582962D0100000000}I heard things were bad in the Kingdom of Lau,
so I'm relieved you're safe.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296203000000000}Lady Elle will tell you about that herself. Let's go to 
{C:819782830300}Chiron Castle{C:819782830000}.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296213000000000}Chiron Castle? Then King Foizon
has accepted Lady Elle.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A02}{C:81958296223000000000}Those are good terms.
I'll lend a hand, too.

{C:81936500}{C:81958296243000000000}Things on my continent
are beyond hope now,
so I'm grateful for your help.

{C:81930A02}{C:81958296263000000000}I'm a target myself, you know.
It's reassuring to have
someone willing to cooperate.

{C:81936500}{C:81958296273000000000}All riiight, let's
corner the Astante II!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902400}{C:81958296293000000000}I'm so glad you've returned.
I'm happy you're safe.
You all look much more confident now.

{C:819582962B3000000000}Sho Zama, I sense aura power in you
truly worthy of a Holy Warrior.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582962E0100000000}Thank you.
So, what's
the current situation?

{C:81902400}{C:819582962C3000000000}King Foizon died in battle,
and I succeeded him to the throne.

{C:819582962D3000000000}The Kingdoms of A and Na
are building large Aura Ships.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962E3000000000}Large Aura Ships?
Come to think of it,
this place looks like a ship's bridge, too.

{C:81902400}{C:819582962F3000000000}That's right.
This is the bridge of Lau's large Aura Ship, the 
{C:819782830400}Goraon{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296303000000000}With these larger ships,
the devastation of war will spread as well.
Please lend us your strength again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296313000000000}Gladly.
What should we
do first?

{C:81902400}{C:81958296323000000000}Ultimately, I believe we'll need
to destroy the large Aura Ships.

{C:81958296333000000000}Until then, defeat the enemies
throughout the region.
Nie, I ask you and your companions to help, too.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296343000000000}Of course!

{C:81902400}{C:81958296353000000000}Then I'm counting on you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296363000000000}Yes.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901C00}{C:81958296373000000000}To think King Foizon has died...

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296383000000000}King Foizon was brave.
He was always at the front,
leading the fight.

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963A3000000000}We won't get anywhere
by standing around mourning.

{C:819582963C3000000000}While you were away from Byston Well,
we found some allies.
Could you take them aboard the Astante II?

{C:81930100}{C:819582963D3000000000}It's reassuring
to have allies everywhere.

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963E3000000000}Let me introduce the three of them: 
{C:819782830400}Jiron{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Rag{C:819782830000}, and {C:819782830400}Elchi{C:819782830000}.

{C:8190FD01}{C:819582963F3000000000}Great to meet you!!






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:81958296403000000000}Have you decided
where you're heading?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296413000000000}Someone named Ciela in the Kingdom of Na
asked us to come,
so I think we'll go there first.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296423000000000}Lady Ciela did!?
That's incredible!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296443000000000}I thought she seemed noble,
but is she really that important?

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296453000000000}Important doesn't begin to cover it! Right, Nie?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296473000000000}Lady Ciela is
the name of the Queen of Na.
If it's true, this is quite something.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582962F0100000000}She acted important,
but she really was important, huh?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296483000000000}I'm starting to dread going.
I had no idea she was so important.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296300100000000}What are you talking about?
We've got a prince with us, too.

{C:81900200}{C:819582964A3000000000}We haven't done anything wrong.
Let's hold our heads high.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B3000000000}Thanks, Lun.
I feel a little better now.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193E901}{C:819582964C3000000000}{C:819782830400}Noin{C:819782830000},
you don't have to come with me.

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296310100000000}Please don't make me say it twice.
I told you
I wouldn't leave your side.

{C:8193E901}{C:819582964D3000000000}Very well.
Then we'll join the Astante II.
Our guests behind us are getting noisy, too.

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296320100000000}Yes, Zechs.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:819582964F3000000000}Ah, you came at just the right time.
I've finished a new FT.
Choose a pilot for it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296503000000000}That's amazing, Professor.
FT development has been
going smoothly lately!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296513000000000}Seeing machines from other continents
is a good source of inspiration.

{C:81958296523000000000}Anyway,
look at the machine and choose
a pilot who seems capable of flying it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296533000000000}Then I'll check it later.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296543000000000}I'm counting on you.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902000}{C:81958296563000000000}You've come as you promised.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296573000000000}Lady Ciela, isn't it dangerous
for you to come all the way out here?

{C:81902000}{C:81958296583000000000}It's all right, Nie Given.
This is all
I can do.

{C:81958296593000000000}I'll entrust Sho Zama with an Aura Battler
developed in the Kingdom of Na.
The Aura Battler {C:819782830400}Billbine{C:819782830000}.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296330100000000}Billbine?

{C:81902000}{C:819582965A3000000000}I've already given orders
to take it aboard the Astante II.
Go and see it for yourself.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296340100000000}Sorry,
I'm heading back to the Astante II
to take a look!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B3000000000}Thank you,
Queen Ciela Lapana.

{C:81902000}{C:819582965C3000000000}Now that you've returned,
both Drake and Bishot
will attack you in earnest.

{C:819582965D3000000000}I, too, will begin operations
aboard the Gran-Garan.
Do your best, all of you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3000000000}Yes, Lady Ciela.
Let's go, Nie!

{C:81901E00}{C:819582965F3000000000}Let's go!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296623000000000}So, what are we going to do?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296633000000000}Which countries
are our enemies on this continent?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296643000000000}Allow me to answer that.
The Kingdoms of A and Ku.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296663000000000}If we know where they are,
we should head for those countries.

{C:81958296673000000000}They'll probably send out their forces, too.
We'll stop them before they get going.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296683000000000}Heh, that Kyo...
He's really getting back into his stride.

{C:81900900}{C:81958296350100000000}For a moment, I could see
the old Kyo in him.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296693000000000}If you have objections, speak up now.
But give me an alternative, too.

{C:81908400}{C:819582966A3000000000}I have no particular objections.

{C:81905401}{C:819582966C3000000000}I'm fine with it, too.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966D3000000000}It looks like nobody objects,
so let's go with Dad's plan.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932B00}{C:81958296370100000000}I'm sorry my power wasn't enough.

{C:81933100}{C:819582966F3000000000}There's no need to worry.
The fighting will continue for a long time yet.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932900}{C:81958296703000000000}So you've returned, Astante II.
I'll teach you a lesson!

{C:81932700}{C:81958296713000000000}Hold on there, {C:819782830400}Black Knight{C:819782830000}.
Don't forget you're fighting alongside
Todd Guinness here.

{C:81932900}{C:81958296723000000000}I know.
As long as I can sink the Astante II,
that's all I need.

{C:81932700}{C:81958296733000000000}As long as you understand that, fine.
Let's sink them!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932400}{C:81958296753000000000}Can you hear me, Astante II?
I hear the Kingdom of Ku's large Aura Ship
has begun operations.

{C:81958296763000000000}Please head for the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Ku{C:819782830000} at once.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296783000000000}Understood.
We're heading for the Kingdom of Ku.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933800}{C:819582967A3000000000}What a strange thing to say.
You want me to build a large Aura Ship, too?

{C:81930C00}{C:819582967B3000000000}That's right...

{C:81933800}{C:819582967C3000000000}Wouldn't that make me appear
to have intentions of rebelling
against His Excellency Drake?

{C:81930C00}{C:819582967E3000000000}Use that gift of gab of yours
to explain it away however you like.

{C:81933800}{C:819582967F3000000000}Well, I'll consider it.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933800}{C:81958296803000000000}It seems I was right to listen
to that insolent brat back then.

{C:81958296813000000000}Soldiers!
Annihilate the enemy with all your strength!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:81958296823000000000}More enemies!?

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296833000000000}I am Treize Khushrenada.
I've come to join your ship.

{C:81958296843000000000}My envoy, Lady Une,
should be with you.

{C:8193ED01}{C:81958296863000000000}I'm here, Your Excellency.

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296853000000000}Well done, Lady.
We'd like to join you, too.
Would you speak to them for us?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296873000000000}If you know them,
I don't mind.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296883000000000}It's dangerous to trust people so easily.
First we need to investigate more thoroughly...

{C:81930300}{C:819582968A3000000000}Dad, keep quiet!
This is how we've done things all along!

{C:81930600}{C:819582968B3000000000}But...

{C:81930400}{C:819582968C3000000000}It's no use, Uncle Akatsuki.
We've always done things this way,
and I don't think that's going to change.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3000000000}That's right.
Just give it up, Dad.
Nelfea!

{C:81930400}{C:819582968E3000000000}Yes, yes. I'll get ready to receive them.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193EC01}{C:819582968F3000000000}Thank you for allowing us to join you.
I'm grateful for the captain's bold decision.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296913000000000}No, thank you.
We're glad you've joined us.

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296923000000000}I wanted to join you a little sooner,
but I was investigating the enemy's affairs.
My apologies.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296933000000000}Not at all.
We're just glad you've joined us.

{C:81935402}{C:81958296943000000000}Brother!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905A02}{C:81958296963000000000}I didn't know where you'd gone.
So you were aboard this ship!

{C:81905402}{C:81958296973000000000}Yes, they let me aboard
in Pentagona.

{C:81905A02}{C:81958296983000000000}Now I can fight with peace of mind.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:819582969A3000000000}Since you were on the enemy's side,
do you also know where
the mastermind behind this war is?

{C:8190EC01}{C:819582969B3000000000}Of course.
The ringleader's name is...

{C:81900600}{C:819582969C3000000000}Redros Binzvanker.

{C:8190E901}{C:819582969D3000000000}How do you know that!?

{C:81900700}{C:819582969E3000000000}I'm ashamed to say
Binzvanker comes from our continent.
That's why we're pursuing them.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933200}{C:81958296390100000000}There is no path forward for you!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296A03000000000}That voice is Drake Luft's!!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296A13000000000}A large Aura Ship is approaching!
Battle stations!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A23000000000}I'm sorry to ask when you've only just arrived,
but please help us right away!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933200}{C:819582963A0100000000}What rules the world is ability, power!
In turmoil, parent, child and sibling mean nothing.

{C:819582963B0100000000}If the low overthrowing the high is the way of the world,
then the powerful must destroy
those who deserve it and bring peace to the world.

{C:819582963C0100000000}Ignorant rabble like you could never
understand my lofty ideals!
That's why destruction is the fate you deserve!!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A33000000000}Don't give us that self-serving nonsense!
You're just a man riding
Binzvanker's coattails!!

{C:81933200}{C:819582963D0100000000}Impudent fool!
Whether I'm merely riding someone's coattails
is something you can find out firsthand!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933100}{C:81958296A43000000000}Things are proceeding
just as you predicted.

{C:81958296A53000000000}As promised, I'll now transmit
the Astante II's combat data
and information on the large Aura Ships.

{C:81958296A63000000000}(Now, let's see how you'll respond,
 Binzvanker.)




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:81958296A73000000000}Le Caine!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A83000000000}Who is that?

{C:81932201}{C:81958296A93000000000}He's the son of Gresco,
Grados's supreme commander.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296AA3000000000}It looks like something is pursuing him.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936500}{C:81958296AB3000000000}You did well to escape from Gon Jem and me.
I'm impressed.
But this is the end!!

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296AC3000000000}Ngh, in a place like this...!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3000000000}Let's help him!

{C:81932201}{C:81958296AF3000000000}He's the enemy commander's son!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B03000000000}We'll think about that after we help him.
Rie, engage the enemy!!


{x00}
