rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902201}{C:81958296B33000000000}Saving an enemy...
That's just like you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B43000000000}Sorry...

{C:81902201}{C:81958296B53000000000}You don't need to apologize.
I'm genuinely impressed
that you'd reach out to an enemy.

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296B63000000000}Who's in command of this ship!?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B73000000000}I'm the captain.

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296B83000000000}I am Le Caine of Grados.
I am requisitioning this ship.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296B93000000000}We can't allow that.
We have our own objectives.

{C:81902F01}{C:81958296BA3000000000}Shall we kill them, Lord Le Caine?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296BC3000000000}You're going to kill the people who saved you!?
Are Gradosians
really such an inferior race!?

{C:81902C01}{C:81958296BD3000000000}You're Eiji!
What a perfect place to meet you!
I'll fucking kill you right now!

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296BE3000000000}Stop, Death Demon Squad!
Our priority now is to eliminate
the one who has taken control of Grados.

{C:81902E01}{C:819582963F0100000000}You can't mean... Lord Le Caine?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03000000000}Will you lend us your strength?

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C13000000000}For now,
our interests coincide.
I'll cooperate only as long as they do.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C23000000000}Understand!?
Only for as long
as our interests coincide!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296C33000000000}Has the commotion died down?
We're leaving immediately.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296C63000000000}{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} can now be reached through the opening in the Cloud Sea.
At last, it's time for the final battle!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296C53000000000}Organize our forces
so we're ready for battle at any time.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932000}{C:81958296C73000000000}In the end,
we left you to shoulder all the hardship alone.
I'm sorry.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C83000000000}We've been fighting all this time.
Please don't worry about it.

{C:81932400}{C:81958296C93000000000}But if we'd arrived in time,
your battle should have been a little easier.
When I think of that...

{C:81930600}{C:81958296CA3000000000}The Cloud Sea has opened, too.
We're heading for Grados.
We'll leave the rest to you.

{C:81932000}{C:81958296CB3000000000}Understood.
We'll concentrate our efforts
on pacifying Byston Well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CC3000000000}Thank you. We're counting on you.
Rie, take us out.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CD3000000000}Yes! Astante II is
launching for Grados!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932000}{C:81958296CF3000000000}They've gone.
Are you sure it was all right
not to tell them you were here?

{C:81936101}{C:81958296D03000000000}It's all right.
They have a hard road ahead,
but I'll devote myself to supporting the heroes.

{C:81932000}{C:81958296D13000000000}I was surprised, though.
Who would have thought someone with responsibilities in {C:819782830300}Brave{C:819782830000}
had stowed away aboard the Astante II?

{C:81936101}{C:81958296D23000000000}My old blood started stirring.
I couldn't help coming aboard.
It's embarrassing at my age.

{C:81932000}{C:81958296D33000000000}Since you're here,
please make yourself comfortable and relax.

{C:81936101}{C:81958296D43000000000}Thank you.
I'll gladly accept your hospitality,
Queen Ciela Lapana.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936102}{C:819582961D3000000000}So you've come, Astante II.
There's no need to wait for the colonel.
I'll shoot you down myself!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902D00}{C:819582968D3A00000000}So that Astante II
that's been giving Todd trouble is back.

{C:819582968E3A00000000}Stealing someone else's prey isn't my style,
but shooting it down myself...
That sounds fun. Very interesting indeed!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A302}{C:819582965E3300000000}You're strange.

{C:8193CD02}{C:819582965F3300000000}Well, you knooow,
Ed is Ed.

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296603300000000}That's not what I mean.
You don't understand
what I'm saying.

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296613300000000}Eheh heh heh heh heh!
I don't really get it.






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901E00}{C:81958296A53300000000}Keen!
Don't leave the tools lying around!

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296A63300000000}Oh, soooorry!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A83300000000}Nie's in a bad mood, isn't he?

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296A93300000000}It looks like he's remembering
how he failed to rescue Riml.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA3300000000}That happened?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931D00}{C:81958296AC3300000000}Apparently, Riml's mother, {C:819782830400}Louser{C:819782830000}, held a knife to Riml
and threatened
Nie.

{C:81933400}{C:81958296AD3300000000}If you don't leave, I'll stab her in the eye, then kill her!

{C:81931D00}{C:81958296AE3300000000}That's what she said, apparently.
What a complicated mother and daughter.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AF3300000000}So that's what happened.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901D00}{C:81958296B03300000000}So please let it slide.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B13300000000}You're kind, Keen.
All right, I'll forget what just happened.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296B23300000000}You're a good person, too.
Thank you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933302}{C:81958296B83300000000}It's amazing, isn't it?
A world with fairies.

{C:81931B00}{C:81958296B93300000000}There are lots in my world.
It's perfectly normal.

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BA3300000000}The place I was in had
lots of even stranger things.
So I'm not all that surprised.

{C:81931B00}{C:81958296BB3300000000}What do you mean, even stranger!?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BC3300000000}Oh, sorry!
I didn't mean you're strange, Chum.

{C:81933302}{C:81958296BD3300000000}Wow!
Then I'd like to go
where you were, too, Wataru.

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BE3300000000}Come and visit sometime.

{C:81933302}{C:81958296BF3300000000}I will!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03300000000}Hey, Wataru, Yuu.
Could you give me a hand?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296C13300000000}Yeees!

{C:81933302}{C:81958296C23300000000}We're coming!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B501}{C:81958296E13300000000}This is the state of Serene Mind.
It's in this state that my Hyper Mode
manifests.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190C302}{C:81958296E23300000000}That's amazing.
I've gained a little respect for you.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296E33300000000}You're physically strong.
{C:819782830400}Toya{C:819782830000}, you can do it too, with the right mindset.
That goes for Kira, of course.

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296E63300000000}Yes, Domon!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296E73300000000}Hey!
Would you like to train with us, too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E83300000000}I'll pass.
If I tried to keep up with everyone,
I'd wreck my body.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935300}{C:81958296692F00000000}So this is a Brain's cockpit.
I can feel similarities to an HM
all over the place.

{C:8193A002}{C:819582966A2F00000000}Really?
I'm no good with machinery.

{C:81935300}{C:819582966B2F00000000}Then how do you manage to pilot a Brain?

{C:8193A002}{C:819582966C2F00000000}A Brain is, well,
something like a child.
So it doesn't really feel like piloting.

{C:81935300}{C:819582966D2F00000000}Oh, I see.
That's interesting.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966E2F00000000}Oh, what are you two doing?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905300}{C:819582966F2F00000000}It feels a bit similar,
so I was being shown
the Brain's cockpit.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296702F00000000}Similar to an HM?
I can't see it.

{C:81958296712F00000000}I think the new FT I was shown earlier
is much more similar.


{C:81905300}{C:81958296722F00000000}Of course they're different.
A Brain is alive, after all.
Right, You?

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296732F00000000}Yes. They even have emotions.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:81958296742F00000000}The Brain seems to like you two.
It's giving off a gentle color.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296752F00000000}That makes me happy.
Thank you, Brain.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A102}{C:81958296772F00000000}That's why these little ones can fight.
They don't really want to fight.
Brains are afraid of battle.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296782F00000000}Of battle?

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296792F00000000}Yes, just like people.
But they want to protect the continent and everyone,
so they fight for us.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2F00000000}I'll take that to heart.

{C:8190A102}{C:819582967B2F00000000}You're a good kid.
That's why the Brains like you.
Let's do our best together.

{C:81900200}{C:819582967D2F00000000}Oh, we'd better be going.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967E2F00000000}Right.
We're going out for a bit.

{C:8193A102}{C:819582967F2F00000000}Have a nice triiip!
Bring back souveniiirs!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A002}{C:819582967E3300000000}Have you seen Hime?

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F3300000000}She's over there,
together with Natsumi and the others.

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296803300000000}Hm?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D301}{C:81958296813300000000}Oh, oh! Mirai-chan looks ready to cry!
What should I do?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296823300000000}First, calm down.
If you panic,
the baby will pick up on it, too.

{C:8193DA02}{C:81958296833300000000}There, there, Mirai-chan.
It's all riiight.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296843300000000}Aren't you going over?

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296853300000000}They're busy, so I'll leave them to it.
It's nothing urgent.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296863300000000}That might be for the best.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190E201}{C:81958296832900000000}What, you're back again?
You certainly go to a lot of trouble.

{C:81958296842900000000}Well, I can't very well
send you off empty-handed.
Take this with you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81938400}{C:81958296F73300000000}When I look at you,
I'm reminded of a man
named Char Aznable.

{C:8193E901}{C:81958296F83300000000}Char Aznable, sir?

{C:81938400}{C:81958296F93300000000}He hid his past for his ambitions
and covered his face with a mask,
but vanished with his goal only half achieved.

{C:81958296FA3300000000}Of course, I'm not saying
that's who you are.
It's your mask that reminds me of him.

{C:8193E901}{C:81958296FB3300000000}In the sense of hiding my past,
perhaps we are alike.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296FC3300000000}Someday, I'd like to meet you without the mask
and have a leisurely talk,
Zechs Merquise.

{C:8193E901}{C:81958296FD3300000000}Yes, I would, too,
Captain Quattro.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:81958296603100000000}I'll enter the information, so head for the 
{C:819782830300}Liberation Front Base{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296613100000000}Input confirmed.
I'll display it on the radar.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296623100000000}Is {C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} on the other side?
Wouldn't it be better
to go straight there?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296633100000000}We should get a grasp of the situation.
As Eiji says,
we should head for the Liberation Front Base.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296643100000000}Well, you heard him.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296653100000000}Yes.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:81958296663100000000}It's dangerous beyond here.
Let's head for the Liberation Front Base.
We need to get information first.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905002}{C:81958296673100000000}Head for the Liberation Front Base.

{C:81904202}{C:81958296683100000000}You're {C:819782830400}Muller{C:819782830000}!!
What are you doing here!?

{C:81904402}{C:81958296693100000000}Waaah!
Why is Muller here?
What do we do, Roddy, Barts!?

{C:81901C00}{C:819582966B3100000000}Is he someone you know?

{C:81904302}{C:819582966C3100000000}He's the old guy
who keeps chasing us.
I can't believe he came all this way.

{C:81905002}{C:819582966D3100000000}Our battle is on hold.
Right now, there's something more important to do.

{C:819582966E3100000000}Eiji, our comrades have been captured.
I want to go and rescue them first.
Will you help?

{C:81902201}{C:819582966F3100000000}Of course.
Who's been captured?

{C:81905002}{C:81958296703100000000}David and Anna.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296713100000000}What!?

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296723100000000}They've taken hostages!?
What are the proud people of Grados
doing!?

{C:81905002}{C:81958296733100000000}There are no demands.
They just intend to kill them as an example.

{C:81958296743100000000}Let's set out to rescue them at once.
I know where they are,
so I'll come with you.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932401}{C:81958296753100000000}Are you all right, {C:819782830400}Anna?{C:819782830000}

{C:81932301}{C:81958296763100000000}Yes.

{C:81932401}{C:81958296773100000000}It looks like this is the end for us.
I'm sorry you have to die with me of all people.

{C:81932301}{C:81958296783100000000}David, don't give up.
I'm sure he'll come. Eiji will come for us.


{C:81932401}{C:81958296793100000000}Will he?
He's been missing all this time.

{C:81932301}{C:819582967A3100000000}I'm sure Eiji will come for us.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935002}{C:819582967B3100000000}We're heading for {C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000}!

{C:8193A002}{C:819582967C3100000000}We're going straight for their headquarters?
Isn't that far too reckless!?

{C:81935002}{C:819582967D3100000000}The execution will take place
in ruins near Grados.
We have to go.

{C:81930300}{C:819582967E3100000000}Everyone, we may face battle
as soon as we arrive.
Take your positions.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81935E02}{C:81958296803100000000}Those people from Terra
are pretty generous, aren't they?
This is a fine ship, even if it's old.

{C:81935F02}{C:81958296813100000000}I suppose your threats worked, Colonel.

{C:81935E02}{C:81958296823100000000}Don't spoil it.
We just requisitioned it because we needed it.

{C:81936102}{C:81958296833100000000}Either way,
the enemy's approaching.
It's our old friend, the Astante II.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296843100000000}I've got a proposal.
Do you want to hear it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296853100000000}What is it?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296863100000000}How about
Jet, Faye and I
go and rescue the hostages?

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296873100000000}Hey, hold on. You want me to go, too?

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296883100000000}I don't want to, either.
Why should I have to
do something so tiring?

{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296893100000000}I don't like freeloading.
You don't have to come if you don't want to.
Anyway, I'm doing it.

{C:819582968A3100000000}Ed, give us a diversion
when we get off the ship.

{C:8193CD02}{C:819582968B3100000000}Yes, yeees!
You can leave it to meee!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C3100000000}I'll leave the rescue operation entirely to you,
but be careful, Spike.

{C:8193CA02}{C:819582968D3100000000}Thanks.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81936202}{C:819582968F3100000000}Whaaat?
The instruments have gone haywire!

{C:81935E02}{C:81958296903100000000}You idiot!!
The enemy might get away.
Hurry up and fix them!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CA02}{C:81958296913100000000}Well then, I'm off.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296923100000000}It can't be helped.
I'll come with you.

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296933100000000}Ugh, what a pain.
Oh, and don't lose.
I'd hate to have nowhere to come back to.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81932201}{C:819582969B3100000000}Anna, I'm sorry
I'm so late...

{C:81932301}{C:819582969D3100000000}It's all right... Eiji...
You've come back to us.

{C:81932401}{C:819582969E3100000000}You...!
Where have you been all this time?

{C:81932201}{C:819582969F3100000000}I've found some friends.
We've kept on fighting all this time.
They're all good people.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902401}{C:81958296A03100000000}Let me introduce the comrades
who've been fighting with us. Come to the 
{C:819782830300}briefing room{C:819782830000}.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902401}{C:81958296A13100000000}I'm David Rutherford.
This is Anna Stephanie.
You already know Muller, right?

{C:81958296A33100000000}There are a lot of others,
so I'll keep this brief:
they're nine members of the Defense Class.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296A53100000000}Did you say Defense Claaass!?
Where? Where are they!?

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296A63100000000}Is everyone safe?

{C:81902401}{C:81958296A73100000000}Who are these brats?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A83100000000}They're Defense Class members, too.
Could you tell them where the others are?

{C:81905002}{C:81958296A93100000000}Those kids?
I think they were playing on the outskirts.

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296AA3100000000}May we go and see them?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296AB3100000000}There's no need to hold back.
Go and see them right away.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296AC3100000000}Thanks, Professor.
Koji, Asuka, let's go!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902401}{C:81958296AD3100000000}Then let's load up our belongings.
Now that Eiji's back,
we've no more use for this place.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296AE3100000000}What do you mean?

{C:81902301}{C:81958296AF3100000000}We'd decided that
once Eiji returned, we'd attack 
{C:819782830300}Grados Tower{C:819782830000}.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B03100000000}Grados Tower
is the enemy's strongpoint, then?

{C:81902301}{C:81958296B23100000000}Yes.
We were captured
when we went to investigate it, though.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B33100000000}Then let's prepare to sortie.
I'll go back to the Astante II
ahead of you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B43100000000}Oh, I'll go back, too.

{C:81958296B53100000000}David,
please let everyone in the Defense Class
know, too.

{C:81902401}{C:81958296B63100000000}OK. Leave it to me.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B73100000000}Hey, you!
Stop flopping around
and carry the luggage properly!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296B83100000000}Meooow-laaa... flooop, flooop...

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B93100000000}Even I, the great Demon Prince,
am working!

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296BA3100000000}Mmm... purrr... flooop, flooop...
It feels so gooood...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BB3100000000}I think you'd better
stop bothering her.
I'm sure she won't budge.

{C:8193A702}{C:81958296BC3100000000}Mrowww... purrr...

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BD3100000000}Don't you start slacking off too, Himikooo!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE3100000000}You've already started loading?
Thanks, Wataru and Toraoh.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902B01}{C:81958296BF3100000000}What are you people doing!?
Hurry up with the preparations!!
Hm? What happened to the Death Demon Squad?

{C:81900900}{C:81958296450100000000}SPTs, was it?
They went off with their machines.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C03100000000}What!?
Are they betraying me, too!?
I'll never forgive you! Never, Binzvanker!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296460100000000}You're so young.
That's why {C:819782830400}Binzvanker{C:819782830000}
can fool you.


{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C23100000000}What, woman!?
What did you just say!?

{C:81900900}{C:81958296470100000000}You get fooled because
you lose your temper so quickly.
Calm down and think things through.

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C33100000000}Ghh...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C43100000000}Tail,
we've finished our preparations here!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296490100000000}We're done here, too.
Now we just have to wait for the Defense Class.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81907B02}{C:81958296C83100000000}Sorry to keep you waaaiting!
Listen to this!

{C:81958296C93100000000}Now that the whole Defense Class is here,
Ken-Oh, Ho-Oh and Ju-Oh can combine into 
{C:819782830400}Raijin-Oh{C:819782830000}!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA3100000000}Rai...?

{C:81907E02}{C:81958296C23A00000000}Raijin-Oh.
They can combine
into a giant robot.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB3100000000}Um, are you a Defense Class member, too?

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964B0100000000}Yes. I'm the Defense Class commander, 
{C:819782830400}Maria Shiratori{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CC3100000000}To tell the truth, I don't want to drag
you kids into this.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296CD3100000000}Hey, we can fight, too!
You can't leave us out!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CE3100000000}I know.
I haven't stopped you before, have I?

{C:81958296CF3100000000}I think this will be the final battle.
So let's give it our all.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296D03100000000}Of course!!
I'm counting on you and the others, Maria.

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964C0100000000}Of course!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296D23100000000}There are so many more people all at once.
Are you all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D33100000000}I'm fine.
...I'm more worried about
the opponent waiting in Grados.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D43100000000}Are they that strong?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D53100000000}That's what Dad says.
They're someone you read about in history books.

{C:81958296D63100000000}It's scary to fight someone who can take on
Dad and the others on equal terms or better.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296D73100000000}You're naive, boy.
You'll die thinking like that.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D83100000000}I won't die.
I've got my friends, after all.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296D93100000000}With that spirit, you'll be all right.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296DA3100000000}Haman seems
a little awkward with people.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB3100000000}Yeah,
she was looking out for me.

{C:81958296DC3100000000}All right!
It's the final battle.
Let's get fired up!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296DD3100000000}Well done, making it this far.
Out of respect for all that futile effort,
I'll fight you myself in {C:819782830400}Imakarum{C:819782830000}.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF3100000000}W-what?
The world is...

{C:81930200}{C:81958296E13100000000}It seems to be the enemy's power.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296E23100000000}Damn Binzvanker.
They've acquired a strange power.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296E33100000000}Perhaps they're even moving
the Cloud Sea with this power.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296E43100000000}Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:81958296E53100000000}You've certainly earned your way here.
Then I suppose I'll
fight you seriously, too!!

{C:81958296E73100000000}But this isn't where the final battle will be.
{C:819782830300}Claudia{C:819782830000} is where it will be!
I'll be waiting in Claudia!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A00}{C:81958296E83100000000}Shouldn't we go after them?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E93100000000}They're not someone we can beat easily.
Let's get ourselves ready first, too.
We'll leave after that.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582961A3200000000}Once we enter Claudia,
we'll probably face one battle after another.

{C:819582961B3200000000}If there's anything you want,
get it now while you can.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961C3200000000}You're right.
We should get what we want while we can.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193D601}{C:81958296983300000000}Oh, they're fighting.
Is a war starting?
A war is starting, isn't it?!

{C:81958296993300000000}Come on, let there be waaaar!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960D3700000000}That red machine... It's beautiful.

{C:81908400}{C:819582960E3700000000}Does it interest you?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960F3700000000}Oh, Captain Quattro.
Yes, it does.
It's beautiful, like a jewel.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296103700000000}Without someone to pilot it,
it's nothing but scrap metal.
Isn't that right, Char?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296113700000000}Haman.
How many times must I tell you? I'm...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296123700000000}Hah! How long will you keep up this charade?
Don't you understand yet?!
What we need now is power.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296133700000000}Are you saying...
I don't have that power?


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296143700000000}What power could you have,
now that you're a spineless Federation puppet?

{C:81958296153700000000}A man without ambition has no power!
Be Char again!
Even if it's only for this battle.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296163700000000}Haman...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296173700000000}That's all I have to say.


{C:81908400}{C:81958296183700000000}Only for this battle...?
So Haman also feels
that the enemy's power is that great.

{C:81958296193700000000}Very well, Haman.
For now, I'll go along with your proposal.
Until we've defeated the enemy before us.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961A3700000000}Captain Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:819582961B3700000000}From now on, I will be Char again,
for the sake of this battle.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961C3700000000}Char?


{C:81908400}{C:819582961D3700000000}Yes.
The man feared as the Red Comet:
Char Aznable.

{C:819582961E3700000000}I'm going to service my MS.
Give me a hand.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961F3700000000}Oh, yes. Of course.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81907B02}{C:81958296EC3100000000}You're all safe!

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296ED3100000000}I was worried about yooou!

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964D0100000000}Weren't you and the others in trouble
without us, Jin?

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296EE3100000000}Us?
Of course not.
Right, Jin?

{C:81909202}{C:81958296EF3100000000}You liaaar!
Weren't you saying, 'If only we could pull off an invincible combination into Raijin-Oh,'
or something like that?

{C:81908302}{C:81958296F03100000000}Oh? Who are these people?

{C:81909602}{C:81958296F13100000000}We're Gambaruger's pilots,
the Ganba Team!

{C:81909402}{C:81958296F23100000000}Rikiya, is that all right?
Giving away our identities so easily?

{C:81909202}{C:81958296F33100000000}It's fine.
The curse doesn't work here, after all.

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296F43100000000}That's riiight!

{C:81909402}{C:81958296F53100000000}Waaah! It's Yaminorius!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296F63100000000}You bastard! What the hell are you doing here?!

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296F73100000000}Calm down, boy.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296F93100000000}{C:819782830400}Belzeb{C:819782830000}!
Even you've come here?!

{C:81908F02}{C:81958296FA3100000000}Didn't I tell you to calm down?

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964E0100000000}Then what are you here for?
Explain yourselves!

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296FB3100000000}This place is filled with an evil power
unlike our own.

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296FC3100000000}Because of that,
our power is all but nonexistent.

{C:81908F02}{C:81958296FD3100000000}That's what we came to tell you.

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296FE3100000000}For now,
we won't lay a hand on you.

{C:81909602}{C:81958296013200000000}Is that really true?
I'm not sure I can believe it.

{C:81908D02}{C:81958296023200000000}My power is restricted as well.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296033200000000}{C:819782830400}Eldran{C:819782830000}!
It's been ages!

{C:81908D02}{C:81958296043200000000}I have no intention of speaking for evil,
but it is the truth.

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964F0100000000}If even Eldran says so,
I suppose we can believe you.

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296053200000000}We won't be crossing paths
with you anyway.
Do as you please.

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296063200000000}Then I'll disappear as well.
Hazuramu Saraiyaa!

{C:81908F02}{C:81958296073200000000}Well then, do your best!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296083200000000}Um... What was all that about?

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296093200000000}Belzeb and Falzeb
are our enemies.

{C:81909202}{C:819582960A3200000000}Yaminorius
is our enemy.

{C:81907B02}{C:819582960B3200000000}Eldran is the one who gave us
Raijin-Oh... I guess?

{C:81909402}{C:819582960C3200000000}Eldran gave us
Gambaruger.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960D3200000000}Ha ha... I see.
Oh, right.

{C:819582960E3200000000}(The world's a big place... isn't it?)




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908202}{C:81958296C13900000000}Surely no one will find me
here, right?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296C23900000000}Hidenori,
what are you sneaking around for?

{C:81908202}{C:81958296C33900000000}Waaah!
...Oh, I was mistaken.

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296C43900000000}What on earth is wrong?

{C:81908202}{C:81958296C53900000000}I-I
haven't been here!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908A02}{C:81958296C63900000000}What's he so flustered about...?

{C:81908902}{C:81958296C83900000000}Tokieee!
Have you seen Hidenori?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296CB3900000000}...You've been doing special training, haven't you?

{C:81908902}{C:81958296CC3900000000}Yes, that's right.
How did you know?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296CD3900000000}Special training is your specialty, Love.
Of course I knew!

{C:81908902}{C:81958296CF3900000000}So, do you know
where Hidenori went?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296D03900000000}He went that way, but...

{C:81908902}{C:81958296D13900000000}That way!
Thanks, Tokie!

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296D23900000000}(Poor Hidenori.)




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A702}{C:819582960F3200000000}Hey, lady! Hey, lady!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296103200000000}Hey, Faye-Faye!
She's calling you!

{C:8190CC02}{C:81958296123200000000}Oh, even a little squirt like you
is on that ship?
So, what do you want?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190A702}{C:81958296133200000000}Lady, you've got huge boobs!

{C:8190CC02}{C:81958296143200000000}Huh?

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296153200000000}Faaaye, are your boobs huge?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296163200000000}Cow boobs! Cow booobs!
Nya ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296173200000000}Faye's boobs are cow booobs!
...What are cow boobs?

{C:8190CC02}{C:81958296183200000000}Oh, for crying out loud!
I can't deal with you two!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901C00}{C:81958296FF3300000000}I'm envious of you, Fyana and Noin.
The men you're with
are so straightforward.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296003400000000}Chirico isn't straightforward.
If anything, he's quiet.

{C:8190EB01}{C:819582966B0100000000}Zechs will suddenly
leave me behind, you know.
Would you still want that?

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296013400000000}Hehe. I heard from
some other girls earlier,
and everyone seems to have their troubles.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296023400000000}Nothing comes easily,
just like this battle.

{C:8190EB01}{C:819582966C0100000000}I think there's nothing wrong
with doing our best
for our own happiness.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296043400000000}You're right.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296710100000000}Zechs, where are you?
Oh, have you seen Zechs?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296133400000000}I haven't seen him.

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296143400000000}Do you enjoy clinging
to that Zechs fellow,
even though he leaves you behind?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296153400000000}(Ugh, what an unpleasant atmosphere.)

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296720100000000}I do.
Whatever our difference in rank,
Zechs and I are equals at heart.

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296173400000000}Hmm, equals, are you?
That's one way of looking at it.
How interesting.

{C:819582961A3400000000}I'll observe you for a while.
Heh, you don't mind, do you?

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296730100000000}Please yourself.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D03300000000}What's wrong, Relena?
You're staring into space.
That's not like you.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D13300000000}Don't you think it's hard
to understand how boys feel?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D23300000000}Oh, I agree.
They're a different species,
so maybe it can't be helped.

{C:81958296D33300000000}But I'm sure the boys
think they can't understand
girls either.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D43300000000}So the feeling's mutual?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D53300000000}Exactly.
So don't worry so much
about Heero.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D63300000000}You can tell?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D73300000000}Of course.
You're so sweet, Relena.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D83300000000}Hime!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81904501}{C:819582969F3700000000}We've been waiting for you.
We in the Security Unit have learned the truth.
We're siding with Lord Le Caine.

{C:81958296A03700000000}From now on,
we'll be serving under you.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81905E02}{C:81958296B73700000000}Hey, kid.
Do you know someone called Roger?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B83700000000}Mr. Roger,
someone's asking for you.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296BA3700000000}Colonel Gon Jem?
What on earth do you want?!
Our negotiations broke down.

{C:81905E02}{C:81958296BB3700000000}Things have changed.
Staying alive comes
before money.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BC3700000000}Staying alive... you say?

{C:81905F02}{C:81958296BD3700000000}If we let that Binzvanker
have free rein,
the world'll come to an end.

{C:81958296BE3700000000}We've changed our minds.

{C:81906102}{C:81958296BF3700000000}Hya hya hya hya!
That's the way it is.

{C:81906002}{C:81958296C03700000000}I'll be in trouble if the world goes away.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296C23700000000}That's commendable.
But you won't be paid. Understood?

{C:81905E02}{C:81958296C33700000000}If you'll give us weapons and ammo,
we'll forget about the money.
Anything to stay alive!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908302}{C:81958296A83900000000}My, my, myyy! It's lovely here.
To think there could be such a difference...
It's very interesting!

{C:81908C02}{C:81958296A93900000000}It looks like there'll be
plenty of delicious food here, too!

{C:81908B02}{C:81958296AA3900000000}I'd rather meet
the Security Unit than eat.

{C:81908102}{C:81958296AB3900000000}The Security Unit?!
That's far too dangerous, Kirara!

{C:81908B02}{C:81958296AC3900000000}No way! We've come all this way.
I've got to get an on-the-spot report.
Oh, there they are! I'll be off!

{C:81908102}{C:81958296AD3900000000}I said no!
...Oh, she's gone.

{C:81908C02}{C:81958296AE3900000000}Then I'll go
and look for somewhere to eat.

{C:81908302}{C:81958296AF3900000000}Ohhh, everyone!
You can't just do whatever you want!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908402}{C:81958296B03900000000}Look, everyone! That's
{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} headquarters!

{C:81958296B13900000000}Wouldn't it be awesome
to hold a concert there?
Ooh, I'm fired up!

{C:81908602}{C:81958296B23900000000}...Yeah.

{C:81908502}{C:81958296B33900000000}What's wrong, Yoppa?
You don't look too happy.
Are you hungry or something?

{C:81908602}{C:81958296B43900000000}That too,
but there's no TV here.
It's boring.

{C:81908502}{C:81958296B53900000000}Oh, dear, dear, dear...
Then let's go back to the ship
and ask to watch something.

{C:81908602}{C:81958296B63900000000}I guess that's all we can do...

{C:81908402}{C:81958296B73900000000}Oh, you're going back to the ship?
I'll come too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81907F02}{C:81958296B83900000000}Hey, hey, Hiroshi!

{C:81908102}{C:81958296BA3900000000}Cookie,
what are you all doing here?

{C:81908702}{C:81958296BB3900000000}Have you seen Asuka?
We were going to look around
Grados together.

{C:81908802}{C:81958296BC3900000000}We can't find him anywhere.
We thought
maybe you might know.

{C:81908102}{C:81958296BD3900000000}Everyone went off on their own
once we left the ship.
Sorry, I don't know.

{C:81908802}{C:81958296BE3900000000}If you don't know, you don't know.
What should we do, everyone?

{C:81908002}{C:81958296EB3A00000000}Um...

{C:81908702}{C:81958296BF3900000000}Oh, it's you, Yu.
Is something wrong?

{C:81908002}{C:81958296EC3A00000000}If you're looking for Asuka,
I think he went that way...

{C:81907F02}{C:81958296C03900000000}Thank you, Yu!
Come on, everyone.

{C:81908002}{C:81958296ED3A00000000}I-I'll come along too.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906101}{C:81958296483700000000}I've been waiting, brave heroes!

{C:81900300}{C:819582964A3700000000}C-Chief Taiga?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B3700000000}What are you doing
on this continent, Chief?!

{C:81906101}{C:819582964C3700000000}Never mind that!
Her Majesty Queen Ciela
is waiting for you.

{C:81900400}{C:819582964D3700000000}Lady Ciela?

{C:81902000}{C:819582964E3700000000}Everyone,
I'm glad you've returned.

{C:819582964F3700000000}I've decided to board
Astante II as well.
That is all right, isn't it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296503700000000}Even if you ask
whether it's all right...

{C:81902000}{C:81958296513700000000}Is there a problem?
Then tell me.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296523700000000}There's no problem with the ship,
but what about Na?

{C:81902000}{C:81958296533700000000}It seems Drake has also
left this land.
And so I shall go as well.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296543700000000}I understand.
We'll cooperate.

{C:81902000}{C:81958296553700000000}I am counting on you.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902400}{C:81958296563700000000}I've been
waiting for you.

{C:81958296573700000000}The ship has arrived.
Have them hurry with loading the supplies.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296583700000000}Thank you, Lady Elle.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296593700000000}Not at all. It's the least I can do.

{C:819582965A3700000000}More importantly, I have a request.
Will you hear me out?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B3700000000}If it's something we can do.

{C:81902400}{C:819582965C3700000000}Please let me join the battle.
I've learned to pilot an Aura Battler.
You'll take me with you, won't you?

{C:81900300}{C:819582965D3700000000}What should we do, big brother?

{C:81900400}{C:819582965E3700000000}She seems determined.
She's even learned to pilot one.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296603700000000}True...

{C:81958296623700000000}Very well, Lady Elle.
Please come with us.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296633700000000}Then it's settled?
Thank you!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902A00}{C:81958296643700000000}You're the crew of the ship
fighting Lord Drake, aren't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296653700000000}You're from that time...
Are you going to arrest us?

{C:81902A00}{C:81958296663700000000}...No.
Lord Drake has abandoned me.
I've been hiding here all this time.

{C:81958296683700000000}Please!
Take me away from this continent.
I'll do anything if you take me with you.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296693700000000}We're fighting
Drake too, you know.
Are you sure you don't mind?

{C:81902A00}{C:819582966A3700000000}Staying here would only put me in danger.
I accept that I have no choice.

{C:81900300}{C:819582966B3700000000}You won't have to fight if you don't want to.
We don't mind.
Come with us.

{C:81902A00}{C:819582966C3700000000}I'm sorry to impose. I'm in your debt.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81903300}{C:819582966D3700000000}Lord Nie!!

{C:81901E00}{C:819582966F3700000000}Riml!
What are you doing here?!

{C:81903300}{C:81958296703700000000}Gyre Garing was about to leave,
so I hurried and hid.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296723700000000}How reckless...
But I'm glad you're safe.
Rie, may we take Riml aboard?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296733700000000}Of course.
Welcome, Riml.

{C:81903300}{C:81958296743700000000}I'm counting on you from now on.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906600}{C:81958296803700000000}Heh heh heh heh heh...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296813700000000}Big brotheeer, there's someone strange
looking over here!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296823700000000}Ignoring them is the best thing to do.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296833700000000}Ignoring us...?
That's cold, boy!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296843700000000}You're... from Posaydal's army...

{C:81906500}{C:81958296863700000000}That's right! I'm one of the Thirteen:
Lili Hassy!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296873700000000}What do the Thirteen want with us?
If you want a fight, I'll take you on!

{C:81906600}{C:81958296883700000000}How spirited.
Fu ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha...

{C:81906500}{C:81958296893700000000}Shut up, little girl!
We've come to help you
with your battles!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968A3700000000}The Thirteen? Some of the very best
in Posaydal's army?
That's rather hard to believe.

{C:81906300}{C:819582968B3700000000}The Thirteen aren't
all of one mind.

{C:81906500}{C:819582968C3700000000}We're coming with you,
even if you don't want us to.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3700000000}(Hey, now...)






{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900A02}{C:81958296AF3700000000}Hey, kid. Hey, kid!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B03700000000}Huh, me?

{C:81900A02}{C:81958296B13700000000}Yeah, you.
Could you let me
aboard your ship?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B23700000000}Who are you?

{C:81900A02}{C:81958296B33700000000}{C:819782830400}Timp Sharon{C:819782830000}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B43700000000}Timp is Jiron and the others' enemy.
Are you sure we can let him aboard?

{C:81900A02}{C:81958296B53700000000}We've got the same goal now.
I'm sure they'll understand.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B63700000000}To be honest, we could use the firepower.
I'll try to persuade them.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902D00}{C:819582968F3A00000000}I've been watching your battles...
The odds are bad for me.
I don't make reckless bets.

{C:81958296903A00000000}I'm joining you.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296913A00000000}If you can follow our orders,
I'll allow you aboard.
Well?

{C:81902D00}{C:81958296923A00000000}If I said no...
you wouldn't let me aboard, would you?
I have no choice but to obey.

{C:81958296933A00000000}{C:819782830400}Allen Brady{C:819782830000} is my name.
I'm counting on you.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296943A00000000}Welcome to Astante II.
We're glad to have you.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296EF3300000000}Whew. Having to go outside the ship
just to smoke a cigarette...
It's a real pain.

{C:8193BA01}{C:81958296F03300000000}Then don't smoke.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296F13300000000}I can't do without cigarettes.

{C:8193BA01}{C:81958296F23300000000}Then there's nothing you can do.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296F33300000000}Well, true enough.

{C:81958296F43300000000}But tell me,
do you enjoy living like that?

{C:8193BA01}{C:81958296F53300000000}I have no obligation to answer.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296F63300000000}Well, that's true enough.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582966B3300000000}Let's see, where's Rie...?
Oh, she's talking to Henken and the others.
I'll wait till later.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931E00}{C:819582966D3300000000}I always try to stay calm,
but I get worked up so easily.

{C:81938900}{C:819582966E3300000000}I can only do things my own way, too.
I've acted on my own
and failed before.

{C:81930300}{C:819582966F3300000000}But you both served admirably
as captains, didn't you?
That's amazing!

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296713300000000}What are you saying?
You're the captain now, Rie.

{C:81938900}{C:81958296723300000000}We're merely guests
aboard Astante II.

{C:81958296733300000000}If I may give my opinion,
I think you're doing
quite well as captain.

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296743300000000}Yes, to be honest,
I think so too.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296753300000000}Thank you.
It makes me very happy
to hear that from you both.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930B00}{C:81958296500100000000}This is Tsuragi.
Astante II, respond.

{C:81900600}{C:819582961D3200000000}Admiral!
Are you all right?!

{C:81930B00}{C:81958296510100000000}Part of the army has gone underground.
But Binzvanker has taken control
everywhere.

{C:81958296520100000000}Akatsuki, I need you to use all your strength
to retake the cities!

{C:81900700}{C:819582961E3200000000}Do you know
where Binzvanker is?

{C:81930B00}{C:81958296530100000000}{C:819782830400}Rondo{C:819782830000}, is that you?
Probably just where you imagine.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582961F3200000000}Admiral!
It's no use...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296203200000000}Uncle, where do you think
Binzvanker is?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296213200000000}There, I take it?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296223200000000}Yes.
Where they first deployed
Imakarum in battle.

{C:81958296233200000000}They have other ties
to that place as well.
I can't imagine them being anywhere else.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296243200000000}Then why don't we just
get over there
and attack?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296263200000000}Naive. It won't be that easy.
They're bound to have
some kind of trap waiting.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296273200000000}Then we'll defeat them one by one.
Let's liberate the cities, one at a time.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296283200000000}That sounds best.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296293200000000}{C:819782830300}Astante Fortress{C:819782830000} aside,
our two targets are {C:819782830300}Deon Town{C:819782830000} and
{C:819782830300}Cloud City{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962A3200000000}How did you know
Binzvanker was in Astante Fortress,
Rie?

{C:81900400}{C:819582962B3200000000}Honestly.
It's in any reasonably detailed
history book.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C3200000000}Was it?

{C:81900600}{C:819582962D3200000000}In any case,
it'll be either Deon Town
or Cloud City.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81931A00}{C:81958296550100000000}Drake Luft!
How long do you intend
to cling to someone else's dream?

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81933200}{C:81958296560100000000}What are you saying?
I am not merely
being used either!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930A01}{C:819582962F3200000000}Mardoul realized that,
and lent us his strength!
You, too...!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296323200000000}Are there any other signs of the enemy?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296333200000000}None at the moment.
Except in Cloud City.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296343200000000}Then Cloud City is next.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81939B00}{C:819582964E3200000000}To think I have to come
all the way to a place like this.

{C:81936F00}{C:819582964F3200000000}Then finish your business
and hurry back to that Terra place.

{C:81939B00}{C:81958296503200000000}I'll do just that.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296523200000000}So you've liberated the cities?
Then come.
Come to Astante Fortress.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296643200000000}Why do you think I started these wars?
I knew of the existence of
{C:819782830400}Mediator{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296653200000000}People's hatred, anger, sorrow...
I knew that such intense emotions
would draw the Mediator here.

{C:81958296663200000000}You were delightfully active,
spreading the ravages of war.

{C:81958296673200000000}Thanks to you, I have obtained
this magnificent power!!
Let me show you a glimpse of it.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296693200000000}I can now
bring even the dead back to life
with ease!!

{C:819582966A3200000000}Next, you shall
face these opponents.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:819582966C3200000000}That's what I'd expect.
It wouldn't be any fun otherwise.

{C:819582966F3200000000}I acknowledge you as worthy opponents,
and I shall fight you!!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900C00}{C:819582963A3700000000}Hey...

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3700000000}Oh, it's you, Omega.
Sorry, but I'm busy with maintenance,
so I can't stop to talk.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900C00}{C:819582963C3700000000}My FT should have been recovered.
Where is it?

{C:81900A00}{C:819582963D3700000000}Are you planning to use it to make a getaway?

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296403700000000}Is my FT usable?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296413700000000}The repairs are finished.
But I can't hand it over unless I know
what you intend to use it for.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296423700000000}Don't worry.
You aren't the ones I'll be fighting.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296433700000000}Could it be...

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296443700000000}Don't misunderstand.
That person is not in their right mind now.

{C:81958296453700000000}{C:819782830400}Mediator{C:819782830000} is the name
of the nightmare haunting them.
I'll fight to drive it away.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296463700000000}Really?
Thank you!!

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296473700000000}But once that nightmare has been driven away,
I'll become your enemy again.
Don't forget that!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902700}{C:81958296353200000000}Are you
one of the Astante II's crew?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296363200000000}Drake's army?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296580100000000}Todd!
Todd Guinness!
What are you doing here?!

{C:81902700}{C:81958296373200000000}I was waiting for the right moment.
The right moment to join up with you.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296393200000000}You mean you're joining us?
I don't believe it.

{C:81902700}{C:819582963A3200000000}I'm no fool, either.
Even I know what the situation is.
Is that a problem?

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3200000000}I don't mind.
We could use more allies.

{C:81902700}{C:819582963D3200000000}I owe you one.
It's not much of a thank-you,
but I brought some Aura Battlers.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81901C00}{C:819582963E3200000000}How on earth did you get
this many Aura Battlers...

{C:81902700}{C:819582963F3200000000}That's what you call personal charm.
Well, I'm counting on you!



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296403200000000}Oh, big brother.
This person says she wants to join us,
but...

{C:81902B00}{C:81958296590100000000}I'm Musiy Poe.
This is not my own wish, but Lord Shot
has ordered me to join you.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296413200000000}That Shot...
Isn't he plotting something?

{C:81902B00}{C:819582965A0100000000}Don't insult him!
Lord Shot always looks ahead
when he acts.

{C:819582965C0100000000}Someone as ordinary as you could never understand.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296423200000000}What should we do, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296433200000000}I suppose we can let her join for now.
There are no guarantees, though.
Same as always.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81902900}{C:81958296443200000000}Are you a member of the Astante II's crew?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296453200000000}Yes, I am. What can I do for you?

{C:81902900}{C:81958296463200000000}I am the Black Knight.
I conceal my face because it bears an ugly scar.
I ask for your understanding.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296473200000000}And what brings you here,
Black Knight?

{C:81902900}{C:81958296483200000000}I would like you to take me aboard your ship.
I have a small score
to settle with Binzvanker.

{C:81958296493200000000}What say you?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964A3200000000}Anyone willing to fight alongside us
is more than welcome.
Um...

{C:81902900}{C:819582964B3200000000}I discarded my name when I concealed my face.
I would therefore have you call me the Black Knight.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964C3200000000}Well then, Black Knight,
please take your luggage
to the Astante II at the airport.

{C:81902900}{C:819582964D3200000000}Understood.

rows.en:
{C:81905900}{C:81958296533200000000}I slipped away from Posaydal's ship
and have been waiting for you,
Daba Myroad.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296553200000000}What do you mean by that, Gablae?

{C:81905900}{C:81958296573200000000}I don't like being used
by these Claudians however they please.
There's no chance of promotion, either.

{C:81958296593200000000}I don't like having that devil around,
but Binzvanker
I dislike even mooore!!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B3200000000}In that case,
welcome aboard, Gablae.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582965C3200000000}What's this?
The door's unlocked...

{C:81906301}{C:819582965D3200000000}You're late.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3200000000}Waaah!
What are you doing in my house?!

{C:81906301}{C:819582965F3200000000}Arma asked me
to provide you with support.
I'm joining you as of now.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296603200000000}Uh... pleased to have you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81906301}{C:81958296613200000000}Then I shall go on ahead to the Astante II.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81908900}{C:819582967D3A00000000}Still, I never imagined I'd be fighting
alongside you, Yazan Gable.

{C:81909400}{C:819582967E3A00000000}The feeling's mutual.
Why the hell should I be happy about
having to join forces with AEUG?

{C:81905002}{C:819582967F3A00000000}What odd things you say,
considering we're already working together.

{C:81909400}{C:81958296803A00000000}What was that?!
Are you picking a fight with me, bastard?!

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296823A00000000}Hey, hey, what are you arguing about?
We've got the same objective right now.

{C:81958296843A00000000}In that sense, we all belong
to the Astante II.
Am I wrong?

{C:81908900}{C:81958296853A00000000}Hmm, that makes sense.
You're quite right, Gregore.

{C:81909400}{C:81958296863A00000000}For now, at least...
Yeah, that's how it is.

{C:81905002}{C:81958296873A00000000}(Why do they keep repeating
the obvious?
I don't understand people from other continents.)



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296873300000000}Grados is quite a cultured city
when there's no fighting...
Speaking of culture, there's Elchi.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296883300000000}Now, this
is quite a fine piece.

{C:8193FE01}{C:81958296600100000000}Oh, Lord Treize!
You exude such a rich fragrance of culture!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296893300000000}Elchi's a strange one.
Treize certainly does
have an air of refinement, though.

{C:8190FE01}{C:81958296610100000000}Did you say somethiiing?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968A3300000000}No, nothing at all.

{C:819582968B3300000000}(Time to go, time to go.)




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8190D601}{C:819582969A3300000000}You're the crew
of that famous Astante II, aren't you?
How wonderful!

{C:819582969B3300000000}Say, you're
fighting a war, aren't you?
I'm so envious.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E93300000000}What's all the commotion?

{C:8193B901}{C:81958296EA3300000000}Beautiful young lady,
please,
accept this rose.

{C:8193FF01}{C:81958296EB3300000000}You're giving me a rose?
Really, truly?!

{C:8193B901}{C:81958296EC3300000000}Indeed. I give roses
only to beautiful people.

{C:8193FD01}{C:81958296ED3300000000}Hey, get away from Rag!!
Don't go near her!!

{C:8193FE01}{C:819582966A0100000000}Why?! Why Rag?!
What about me is
inferior to heeer?!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE3300000000}That's even more trouble.
Well, let's just call it
communication. Yes.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:8193B701}{C:81958296053400000000}What, you can't even drink?
Still just a boy, huh?
Then I bet you don't know a thing about women, either.

{C:81935900}{C:81958296063400000000}Th-th-th-th-th-th-that's not true!
There are plenty of women
I'm close to. Lots of them!

{C:8193B701}{C:81958296073400000000}I'd feel a lot more at ease
if the Chibodee Gals were here with me, too.
Let's take it easy, my frieeend.





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296073300000000}Big brother,
have the Defense Class and Ganba Team
come your way?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296083300000000}What's wrong?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296093300000000}Gambaruger and Raijin-Oh
just flew off!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960A3300000000}They flew over this way.
I'll go take a look.

{C:81907B02}{C:819582960B3300000000}All right, everyone, line up!

{C:81909302}{C:819582960C3300000000}Tch, don't boss us around!

{C:81909502}{C:819582960D3300000000}Let's hurry up,
or we'll get scolded.

{C:81937C02}{C:819582960E3300000000}I'll take it nooow!
Strike a pose!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81909702}{C:81958296103300000000}All riiight,
let's head baaack to the Astante II!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296113300000000}Rie, can you hear me?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296123300000000}Yes, Rie here.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296133300000000}The Defense Class and Ganba Team
will be back soon.
Guess what they were doing?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296143300000000}What were those kids doing?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296153300000000}They were taking a commemorative photo.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296163300000000}What...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296183300000000}So, that's the story.


{x00}
