rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296393400000000}What do you mean, enemies?
There shouldn't be anyone for us to fight.

{C:81930600}{C:819582963A3400000000}Calm down!
You're a man! Don't panic!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3400000000}Dad?

{C:81930600}{C:819582963C3400000000}Good, you can hear me?
Without a ship,
we can't get to you.

{C:819582963D3400000000}I'll give you instructions from the ground.
Just do what you can to hold out.

{C:81930300}{C:819582963E3400000000}No way...
We can't do this, Dad!

{C:81930600}{C:819582963F3400000000}It's all right. You two can do it.
I'll give you a brief explanation of combat.

{C:81958296403400000000}If you fight as I explain, at least
we should be able to keep the city from harm.
Please, do your best.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296413400000000}Okay, I'll try!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296423400000000}First, calm down and look at the top of the monitor.

{C:81958296433400000000}You should see data labeled HP and EN
up there.
Do you see it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296443400000000}The top of the screen? ...Oh, this?
I found it, Dad.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296453400000000}Good. I'll explain HP first.
This {C:819782830400}HP{C:819782830000} reading
shows the Norstan's durability.

{C:81958296463400000000}In other words,
when the Norstan's HP reaches zero,
we lose--

{C:81958296473400000000}Conversely,
we win by reducing the enemy's HP to zero.
...Do you understand?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296483400000000}Yeah.
Basically, before the Norstan runs out of HP,

{C:81958296493400000000}we just have to get their ship's HP
down to zero, right?

{C:81930600}{C:819582964A3400000000}Exactly.

{C:819582964B3400000000}Next is the {C:819782830400}EN{C:819782830000} reading.
This value
shows the Norstan's energy.

{C:819582964C3400000000}Whenever the ship takes action,
such as deploying a unit,
it almost always consumes EN.

{C:819582964D3400000000}If you run short of EN in a crisis,
it could get you killed in the worst case.
Never waste it.

{C:819582964E3400000000}Now, I'll explain attacking.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582964F3400000000}In combat, both sides take turns.
Each turn is divided into a defense phase
and an attack phase.

{C:81958296503400000000}We attack, and the enemy defends.
The enemy attacks, and we defend.
Combat consists of repeating this cycle.

{C:81958296513400000000}Since we have the initiative,
this battle begins with the attack phase
of our turn.

{C:81958296523400000000}Now,
I'll explain the battlefield.

{C:81958296533400000000}The places where units can deploy are marked
by {C:819782830400}lanes{C:819782830000} connecting our side to the enemy's.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296543400000000}There are six lanes.
Deployed units take up space
according to their width.

{C:81958296553400000000}For FT and GT units,
the standard unit width is two.

{C:81958296563400000000}Therefore,
a maximum of three machines
can stand side by side.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296583400000000}So there's a front and a back?
What's the difference?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296593400000000}The drawback of the Forward position is
that it's easier to take damage,
but it also makes attacking easier.

{C:819582965A3400000000}Conversely, the Back position makes it
harder to take damage,
but it also makes attacking harder.

{C:819582965B3400000000}Choose the more suitable position
based on the enemy's situation
and the units you can deploy.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582965F3400000000}When a unit runs out of HP, it is damaged.
It can't deploy from the ship
until it receives the minimum repairs.

{C:81958296603400000000}However, units are repaired
every turn.

{C:81958296613400000000}If several units have been destroyed,
you can't choose which one
will be repaired that turn.

{C:81958296623400000000}To fight reliably,
try to avoid having units damaged
as much as possible.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296633400000000}Okay, I'll try.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296643400000000}As for EN,
you can basically think of it
just as you would a ship's.

{C:81958296653400000000}Next are unit attributes.

{C:81958296663400000000}First, units have location attributes: 
{C:819782830400}Ground{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Anti-Air{C:819782830000}, and {C:819782830400}Flying{C:819782830000}.
These indicate their position.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296683400000000}And GT-A
has the Ground location attribute.

{C:81958296693400000000}When units have the same location attribute,
there's no change, but...

{C:819582966A3400000000}when units with different attributes
fight, the effect is substantial.

{C:819582966B3400000000}Basically, Ground has an advantage over Anti-Air,
Flying has an advantage over Ground,
and Ground has an advantage over Anti-Air.

{C:819582966C3400000000}Remembering this three-way relationship
should prove useful.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582966D3400000000}Next, I'll explain another attribute.

{C:819582966E3400000000}Each unit has a range
at which it can attack.

{C:819582966F3400000000}{C:819782830400}Long Range{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Short Range{C:819782830000},
and there are also 
{C:819782830400}Piercing units{C:819782830000} that attack at both short and long range simultaneously.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296713400000000}And Short Range attack units
like GT-A
are probably better suited to the front.

{C:81958296723400000000}These Short Range, Long Range and Piercing types are called 
{C:819782830400}range attributes{C:819782830000}.
Make sure you remember them.

{C:81958296733400000000}Now, I'll get back to explaining the combat procedure.

{C:81958296743400000000}You need to give action orders
to the units you've deployed.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296753400000000}Deployed units won't act
unless you give them orders like this.
Don't forget.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296763400000000}Giving a unit an action order
consumes that unit's EN.

{C:81958296773400000000}Like the ship, it can't move if it runs short of EN,
so be careful.

{C:81958296783400000000}Once you've finished all actions and orders,
select Turn End,
and your units will advance on the enemy.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:819582967A3400000000}So they're receiving instructions from the ground.
An opponent with no combat experience at all...
They pose no problem.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582967C3400000000}The enemy unit
seems to have chosen to defend.

{C:819582967D3400000000}An enemy that chooses to defend
can spend its defense power
to reduce our attack power.

{C:819582967E3400000000}What's more, that defense power value
only applies for one turn,
and is fully restored the next turn.

{C:819582967F3400000000}But that also means its defense power
doesn't recover during the turn.
It only decreases with each attack it takes.

{C:81958296803400000000}If we can deplete its defense power
all the way to zero,
we'll be able to damage it.

{C:81958296813400000000}Against a defending enemy, what matters is
whether you can attack with enough power
to exceed its defense within a single turn.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296833400000000}Units act in order,
starting with the fastest.

{C:81958296843400000000}Basically, units taking action
advance toward the enemy ship
in order to attack it.

{C:81958296853400000000}And when units from both sides
are in the same lane,
they fight.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296863400000000}As I thought, a defending unit
isn't easy to take down...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296873400000000}Damn it.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296883400000000}...But GT-B is next.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296893400000000}Huh?

{C:81930600}{C:819582968A3400000000}As I'm sure you know,
GT-B is a Long Range unit.

{C:819582968B3400000000}Normally, when other Ground units
are in the same lane, you can't pass them,
whether they're allies or enemies.

{C:819582968C3400000000}But GT-B, a Long Range unit,
can attack one space farther
than the normal attack range.

{C:819582968D3400000000}In other words, it can attack
the enemy in front of GT-A.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582968E3400000000}By using Long Range
and Short Range units this way,
you can attack in succession.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968F3400000000}Oh, I get it.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296903400000000}However!
There's something you must watch out for
when planning successive attacks.

{C:81958296913400000000}Even if, as before,
you put a Short Range unit in Forward
and a Long Range unit in Back,

{C:81958296923400000000}if the Short Range unit in Forward
is slower than the Long Range unit
you've placed in Back,

{C:81958296933400000000}the Long Range unit can't advance,
and its turn will end
before it reaches the enemy's position.

{C:81958296943400000000}Speed can easily lead to mistakes
in various other situations as well.
...Be careful.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296953400000000}For a first battle,
they're doing rather well...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296963400000000}Dad, it looks like they're going to attack.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296973400000000}Don't panic!
First, take a good look around
and understand the situation.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296983400000000}I got it!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296993400000000}Listen. When you switch from defense to attack,
ships and units recover.

{C:819582969A3400000000}Specifically,
ships and units replenish their EN.

{C:819582969B3400000000}And units aboard ships
recover
their HP.

{C:819582969C3400000000}What's more, one damaged unit
finishes its repairs and can deploy again.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969D3400000000}What?
That unit's back in action?!

{C:81930600}{C:819582969E3400000000}Relax. It may be repaired,
but its HP shouldn't have recovered yet.
Even if it deploys now, it's no match for us.

{C:819582969F3400000000}More importantly...
it looks like another unit is coming.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A13400000000}That one in the back...
Didn't it just change lanes?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A23400000000}Yes, it definitely moved.
...Right.
I'd better explain that too.

{C:81958296A33400000000}Deployed units can spend EN
to move to an adjacent lane,
or to Forward or Back.

{C:81958296A43400000000}Of course, a unit can't move if its action
has already been decided, or if other units
surround it and leave it no room to move.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296A73400000000}You can still attack
even when you're the defending side.

{C:81958296A83400000000}The only difference is
that you don't advance when attacking.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296A93400000000}All right, you deploy too!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA3400000000}...Huh?
Oh, right!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296AB3400000000}Their units have the Ground attribute.
So Impulse 7, a Flying unit,
should have the advantage.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC3400000000}All right, leave it to me!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3400000000}Whoa!

{C:81958296AE3400000000}Dad!
Even if I have the advantage,
I can't take on two units!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B03400000000}Don't panic. Listen carefully!

{C:81958296B13400000000}When fighting several units,
attack power, defense power and damage
are distributed according to the area of contact across their widths.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B23400000000}In this situation, GT-A takes
two-thirds of the damage
it would take fighting alone.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B43400000000}And Impulse 7 takes one-third
of the damage from each of them,
for a total of two-thirds as well.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B53400000000}That example
was about the damage our side takes.

{C:81958296B63400000000}Conversely, consider our attacks.
Each of them has to fight GT-A,
and on top of that...

{C:81958296B73400000000}each has to take half
of Impulse 7's attack.

{C:81958296B83400000000}Do you understand?
Then get out there!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296BA3400000000}A unit that has spent its EN
can't act.

{C:81958296BB3400000000}In that case, it's better to have it {C:819782830400}Return{C:819782830000} to the ship
and replenish its EN.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296BC3400000000}There's something
you need to watch out for here.

{C:81958296BD3400000000}First, returning to the ship
instantly replenishes EN,
but it doesn't replenish HP.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296BE3400000000}Also, you can't return
during the defense phase.

{C:81958296BF3400000000}Make sure you get that into your head
while you have the chance.

{C:81958296C03400000000}Now, let's finish this in one go.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C23400000000}What is it...? I've got a bad feeling.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296393400000000}Enemies? What do you mean? There shouldn't be anyone for us to fight.

{C:81930600}{C:819582963A3400000000}Calm down! If you're a man, stop panicking!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3400000000}Dad?

{C:81930600}{C:819582963C3400000000}Good, you can hear me. We don't have a ship, so there's no way for us to get to you.

{C:819582963D3400000000}I'll give you instructions from the ground. Just hold out somehow.

{C:81930300}{C:819582963E3400000000}No way! That's impossible, Dad!

{C:81930600}{C:819582963F3400000000}It's all right. You two can do this. I'll give you a quick explanation of combat.

{C:81958296403400000000}If you follow my instructions in battle, you should at least be able to prevent damage to the town. Do your best.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296413400000000}Got it. I'll try!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296423400000000}First, calm down and look at the top of the monitor.

{C:81958296433400000000}You should see values marked HP and EN there. Do you see them?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296443400000000}The top of the screen? ...Oh, this. I found it, Dad.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296453400000000}All right. First, HP. The value marked {C:819782830600}HP{C:819782830000} shows Norstan's durability.

{C:81958296463400000000}In other words, when Norstan's HP reaches 0, you lose--

{C:81958296473400000000}And if you reduce the enemy's HP to 0, you win. Do you understand?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296483400000000}Yeah. So before Norstan runs out of HP...

{C:81958296493400000000}...we just need to bring their ship's HP down to 0, right?

{C:81930600}{C:819582964A3400000000}Exactly.

{C:819582964B3400000000}Next is the value marked {C:819782830600}EN{C:819782830000}. That shows Norstan's energy.

{C:819582964C3400000000}Almost every action the ship takes, such as deploying units, consumes EN.

{C:819582964D3400000000}If you run short of EN when it matters most, it could even get you killed. Never waste it.

{C:819582964E3400000000}Now I'll explain attacking.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582964F3400000000}In combat, each side has its own turns. A turn is divided into a defense phase and an attack phase.

{C:81958296503400000000}You attack while the enemy defends, then the enemy attacks while you defend. Battle repeats that cycle.

{C:81958296513400000000}Since our side has the initiative, this battle begins with the attack phase of your turn.

{C:81958296523400000000}Now I'll explain the battlefield.

{C:81958296533400000000}There are {C:819782830600}lanes{C:819782830000} connecting the two sides. They show where units can deploy.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296543400000000}There are six of these lanes. Deployed units occupy them according to their width.

{C:81958296553400000000}The basic unit width for FTs and GTs is 2.

{C:81958296563400000000}That means a maximum of three machines can stand side by side.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296583400000000}So there's a front and a rear. What's the difference?


{C:81930600}{C:81958296593400000000}In Forward, a unit takes damage more easily, but it also has an easier time attacking.

{C:819582965A3400000000}In Back, it's the reverse. A unit takes damage less easily, but it has a harder time attacking.

{C:819582965B3400000000}Decide which position is best based on the enemy's situation and the units you can deploy.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582965F3400000000}When a unit runs out of HP, it's damaged. It can't launch from the ship until it receives at least basic repairs.

{C:81958296603400000000}Units are repaired every turn, though.

{C:81958296613400000000}If several units are broken, you can't choose which unit will be repaired that turn.

{C:81958296623400000000}To fight reliably, try to avoid having your units damaged as much as possible.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296633400000000}Got it. I'll do my best.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296643400000000}As for their EN, you can basically think of it the same way as a ship's EN.

{C:81958296653400000000}Next, I'll explain unit attributes.

{C:81958296663400000000}First, units have location attributes: {C:819782830600}Ground{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830600}Anti-Air{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830600}Flying{C:819782830000}.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296673400000000}For example, this {C:819782830400}GT-B{C:819782830000} has the Anti-Air location attribute.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296683400000000}And {C:819782830400}GT-A{C:819782830000} has the Ground location attribute.

{C:81958296693400000000}When units have the same location attribute, there is no attribute-related change.

{C:819582966A3400000000}But when units with different attributes fight, it has a major effect.

{C:81958296C43A00000000}Basically, Ground has an advantage over Anti-Air, Flying over Ground, and Anti-Air over Flying.

{C:819582966C3400000000}Remembering that three-way relationship should help you.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582966D3400000000}Next, I'll explain the other kind of attribute.

{C:819582966E3400000000}Each unit has a distance at which it can attack.

{C:819582966F3400000000}There are {C:819782830600}Long Range{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830600}Short Range{C:819782830000} units, plus {C:819782830600}Piercing units{C:819782830000} that attack at both ranges at once.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296703400000000}In general, {C:819782830600}units that attack at Long Range{C:819782830000}, like GT-B, are best suited to fighting from the rear.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296713400000000}And {C:819782830600}units that attack at Short Range{C:819782830000}, like GT-A, are probably better suited to the front.

{C:81958296723400000000}Short Range, Long Range and Piercing are called {C:819782830600}range attributes{C:819782830000}. Remember those terms.

{C:81958296733400000000}Now, back to how combat proceeds.

{C:81958296743400000000}Once you've deployed a unit, you need to give it orders.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296753400000000}A deployed unit won't act unless you give it orders like these. Don't forget.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296763400000000}Giving units action orders consumes EN for each unit.

{C:81958296773400000000}Just like a ship, a unit can't move if it doesn't have enough EN. Be careful.

{C:81958296783400000000}Once you've finished all your actions and orders, select Turn End. Your units will advance against the enemy.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:819582967A3400000000}So they're taking orders from the ground. They have no combat experience at all... Pathetic.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582967B3400000000}The enemy unit that's appeared seems to be a Ground unit.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582967C3400000000}The enemy unit seems to have chosen defense.

{C:819582967D3400000000}A defending opponent can reduce your Attack Power by using up its Defense Power.

{C:819582967E3400000000}That Defense Power is only spent for the current turn. It recovers completely on the next turn.

{C:819582967F3400000000}But that also means Defense Power never recovers during a turn. Each attack just uses up more of it.

{C:81958296803400000000}If you can use up all its Defense Power and bring it to 0, you'll be able to deal damage.

{C:81958296813400000000}Against a defending opponent, you need enough attacks in one turn to exceed its Defense Power.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296823400000000}Once the enemy finishes choosing its actions, each unit will start carrying out its orders.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296833400000000}Units carry out their actions in order, starting with the fastest.

{C:81958296843400000000}Basically, units advance toward the enemy ship in order to attack it.

{C:81958296853400000000}And when units from opposing sides occupy the same lane, they fight.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296863400000000}As I thought, a defending unit isn't easy to bring down...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296873400000000}Damn it!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296883400000000}...But GT-B is next.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296893400000000}Huh?

{C:81930600}{C:819582968A3400000000}As you probably know, GT-B is a Long Range unit.

{C:819582968B3400000000}Normally, ground units can't pass either friend or foe occupying the same lane.

{C:819582968C3400000000}But GT-B is a Long Range unit, so it can attack one step beyond the normal range...

{C:819582968D3400000000}...which means it can hit the enemy in front of GT-A.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:819582968E3400000000}By using Long Range and Short Range units together like this, you can make successive attacks.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968F3400000000}Oh, I see.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296903400000000}But! There's something you need to watch out for when planning successive attacks.


{C:81958296913400000000}Even if you put a Short Range unit in Forward and a Long Range unit in Back, as we just did...

{C:81958296923400000000}...if the Short Range unit in Forward is slower than the Long Range unit in Back...

{C:81958296933400000000}...the Long Range unit can't advance. Its turn will end before it can reach the enemy.

{C:81958296943400000000}Speed can lead to mistakes in all sorts of other situations too. ...Be careful.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296953400000000}They're doing quite well for their first battle...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296963400000000}Dad, it looks like they're going to attack!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296973400000000}Don't panic! First, take a good look around and understand the situation.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296983400000000}Got it!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296993400000000}Listen. When you go from defense to attack, your ship and units recover.

{C:819582969A3400000000}Specifically, the ship's EN and the units' EN are replenished...


{C:819582969B3400000000}...and units aboard the ship recover HP.

{C:819582969C3400000000}Also, one damaged unit finishes its repairs and can be deployed again.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969D3400000000}What?! That unit's back?!

{C:81930600}{C:819582969E3400000000}Don't worry. It's repaired, but its HP shouldn't have recovered yet. If it launches now, it can't match you.

{C:819582969F3400000000}More importantly... it looks like another unit's on its way.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296A13400000000}That unit farther back... Didn't it just change lanes?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A23400000000}Yes, it definitely moved. ...Right. I'd better explain that too.

{C:81958296A33400000000}Units already deployed can spend EN to move to an adjacent lane, or between Forward and Back.

{C:81958296A43400000000}Of course, units with their actions already decided can't move. Neither can units boxed in by other units.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296A93400000000}All right, you get out there too!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA3400000000}...Huh? Oh, right!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296AB3400000000}Their units have the Ground attribute, so the Flying unit {C:819782830400}Impulse 7{C:819782830000} should have the advantage.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC3400000000}All right! You can count on me!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3400000000}Whoa!

{C:81958296AE3400000000}Dad! Even with an advantage, I can't take on two units at once!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B03400000000}Don't panic. Listen carefully!

{C:81958296B13400000000}Against multiple units, Attack Power, Defense Power and damage are split according to the width in contact.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B23400000000}In this formation, GT-A takes 2/3 of the damage it would take fighting alone.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B33400000000}The upper GT-A also takes 2/3 of the damage it would take on its own.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B43400000000}Impulse 7 takes 1/3 of the damage from each opponent, for a total of 2/3.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296B53400000000}That example was about the damage our side takes.

{C:81958296B63400000000}Now consider our attacks. Each enemy faces a GT-A, and on top of that...

{C:81958296B73400000000}...each has to take half of Impulse 7's attack as well.

{C:81958296B83400000000}Do you understand? Then get out there!





{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296B93400000000}The orders from the ground are accurate. This might take a little longer...



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930600}{C:81958296BE3400000000}And you can't use Return during the defense phase.

{C:81958296BF3400000000}Make sure you remember that.

{C:81958296C03400000000}All right, let's finish this in one push!




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930C00}{C:81958296C13400000000}It looks as though every unit has launched from Norstan...


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C63400000000}What's going on? They're not intercepting us?!

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296C73400000000}Quick question.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C83400000000}Hm?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296C93400000000}Before we start,
have you ever used
the items carried aboard the ship?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA3400000000}No, I haven't.
Why do you ask?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296CB3400000000}Then I'll teach you now, so remember this.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CC3400000000}Yeah, please do.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296CD3400000000}First, to use an item,
you need to select this part of the menu.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296CE3400000000}Like deploying units,
using the items displayed here
consumes the ship's EN.

{C:81958296CF3400000000}And once an item has been used,
once per turn,

{C:81958296D03400000000}at the time when units would be repaired,
the item may be readied again
instead of the units being repaired.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D13400000000}Instead of the units?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D23400000000}Yes.
So, if an item
is readied again,

{C:81958296D33400000000}you need to remember that
the units won't be repaired.


{C:81958296D43400000000}Also, if you use up an item
that has a limited number of uses,
you can't use it again during that battle.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D53400000000}So I have to be careful
not to waste them... This is tricky.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D63400000000}Next,
I'll explain the types of items.

{C:81958296D73400000000}They have all sorts of effects,
so it's quicker to read their descriptions
or actually try using them.

{C:81958296D83400000000}But their targets fall
into just three broad categories,
so those should be easy to remember.

{C:81958296D93400000000}First, 
{C:819782830600}items the ship equips and uses{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296DA3400000000}Once used, this type of item
continually boosts the ship's capabilities.
...For example, this one.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296DB3400000000}With this, your maximum EN
stays increased throughout this battle.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC3400000000}Hey, what do we gain
from increasing the maximum?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296DD3400000000}Oh, honestly...

{C:81958296DE3400000000}A higher maximum means
you can carry more EN over, right?
Don't you get it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF3400000000}Oh! So less goes to waste,
and we can attack all at once next time!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296E03400000000}That's right.
Now, on to the next type.

{C:81958296E13400000000}{C:819782830600}Items that restore or build up
points for ships or units{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296E23400000000}These two are examples.
First, the one
used on a unit.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296E43400000000}Both do just what you saw,
so there's no need to explain further.

{C:81958296E53400000000}Last, I'll explain 
{C:819782830600}items for which you specify
a location on the battlefield{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296E73400000000}The items we've covered so far
take effect the moment you use them,
but these are different.

{C:81958296E83400000000}You send these items onto the field
at a specified time during battle
to provide support.

{C:81958296E93400000000}So you need to specify their Speed
and where to send them.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA3400000000}...Speed and location?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296EB3400000000}Yes.
Anyway, I think you'll understand
once you see for yourself.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296EC3400000000}For Speed,
each item has a base Speed.

{C:81958296ED3400000000}By spending additional EN,
you can change it within the range
fixed for that item.

{C:81958296EE3400000000}And even at the same Speed,
an item's effect occurs before a unit acts.

{C:81958296EF3400000000}As for location,
each item has its own
specified range.

{C:81958296F03400000000}Anyway,
each item's capabilities...

{C:81958296F13400000000}You can find them
in the descriptions displayed,
so it's best to check before using an item.

{C:81958296F23400000000}All right, I'm going on the attack!








{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296F33400000000}I'll leave the rest to you, then.
Let's finish this battle quickly
and set off in pursuit of the Norstan.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296F43400000000}Big brother, you can use
the Astante's bombardment now!
Let me know if you need anything.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296F93400000000}I'm telling you, this has nothing to do with me.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296FC3400000000}Oh, I'll explain it myself!
Listen carefully!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FD3400000000}Y-yes!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296FE3400000000}There are several types of bombardment,
depending on their purpose.

{C:81958296FF3400000000}First, {C:819782830600}the main cannon targets the enemy ship.{C:819782830000}
You can use this when invading the enemy,
during the attack phase.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296003500000000}Its effect is to {C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to the enemy ship{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296013500000000}However, that only applies
when there are no enemy units
in the enemy's lane.

{C:81958296023500000000}If there are enemy units,
the damage for that lane
will go to those units instead.

{C:81958296033500000000}What's more,
the damage that hits units
is spread out,

{C:81958296043500000000}so it is
almost completely nullified.

{C:81958296053500000000}So, to ensure you deal damage,
you need to create a situation where it's difficult
for the enemy to deploy multiple units.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296063500000000}Next is {C:819782830600}support bombardment.{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296073500000000}You can also use this during the attack phase to 
{C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to enemy units on the field{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296083500000000}But even if this support bombardment
fails to hit a unit,
it won't deal damage to the ship.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296093500000000}Finally, there's interception bombardment,
which attacks enemy units
when the enemy invades you.

{C:819582960A3500000000}Since interception bombardment can only
be used during the defense phase,
I'll explain it later.

{C:819582960B3500000000}All right, here I go.








{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:819582960D3500000000}Like support bombardment, interception bombardment can 
{C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to enemy units{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E3500000000}Hmm...

{C:81930400}{C:819582960F3500000000}You don't understand?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296123500000000}(Then I'll use that EN for bombardment, too.)


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296133500000000}Oh, I forgot to mention:
bombardment strength varies with the ship's capabilities
and the amount of EN you spend.

{C:81958296143500000000}You should consider the EN needed to deploy units
and whether leftover EN can be carried over,
and think about your EN use carefully.

{C:81958296153500000000}Well then,
let's go welcome them too.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296173500000000}Yeah, I'm fine.

{C:81958296183500000000}Even a flying unit
takes damage
when it faces ground units, huh.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296193500000000}That's right.

{C:819582961A3500000000}But when attacking, your target is the ship,
so you don't need to engage
the ground units...

{C:819582961B3500000000}During the defense phase, your targets are units,
so you need to match
the enemy's position.

{C:819582961C3500000000}The damage doesn't seem serious,
but you'd better come back just in case.
Rie, is that all right?

{C:81930300}{C:819582961D3500000000}Yes,
repairs are fine.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961E3500000000}Repairs?

{C:81930300}{C:819582961F3500000000}Yes.
First, return to the ship.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296203500000000}Got it.
Give me a moment.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296223500000000}Like bombardment,
the amount of HP you can restore depends
on capabilities and the amount of EN.

{C:81958296233500000000}So when you use it,
I think you should consider it carefully.
Good luck, then.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296243500000000}Everything clear?
I'll leave the remaining orders to you.
Let's finish this in one go.

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:819782960000} Akatsuki
He is a 16-year-old ace selected as a test pilot for the Flying Trooper (FT).
His grades as a pilot cadet were average, but he excelled in mock battles designed to simulate actual combat. He is a pilot who can be counted on to adapt to changing situations.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rie Akatsuki
Despite being only 16, she already holds a doctorate and is also an accomplished Ground Trooper (GT) pilot.
Her ability to handle a wide range of missions earned her the assignment to pursue the Norstan.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Nelfea Northrock
She is a young genius pilot.
Studying under Hakuto Rondo, she has learned all the know-how of Ground Troopers (GTs) and Flying Troopers (FTs) at just thirteen.
She has done it all because she wants to be with Hakuto.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ryo Siegel
He is the son of Shuud Siegel, Hakuto's close friend and right-hand man.
He learned to pilot a Ground Trooper (GT) from childhood without knowing what it was, and can handle it as naturally as his own limbs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Kyo Akatsuki
He is one of the heroes who distinguished themselves in the Third Claudian War.
No one surpassed his Ground Trooper (GT) piloting during the war, and his skills remain undiminished today.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Hakuto Rondo
Hakuto is one of the heroes who distinguished themselves in the Third Claudian War. Formerly, Hakuto served with the Deon Federation forces.
An excellent pilot, Hakuto is also a central figure in the development of Ground Troopers (GTs) and Flying Troopers (FTs).
No account of the Cloud Ship's successful development would be complete without Hakuto.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Wind Shiga
He was a Ground Trooper (GT) pilot during the Third Claudian War.
He served in the same unit of the Cloud Alliance forces as Kyo Akatsuki, and competed with him for ace status.
He is so unconventional that he hardly seems like a soldier, yet his comrades trust him deeply. He remains as cheerful as ever and has a wide network of connections today.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Lake Tsuragi
During the Third Claudian War, Lake led the Third Army of the Cloud Alliance forces.
Lake skillfully reined in the youthful impulsiveness of Kyo Akatsuki and the others in the Third Army's Thirteenth Independent Unit, guiding that unit to legendary status.
Those abilities are still valued, and Lake is now a senior figure in the military.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Omega Fokurosu
Omega is the cold-hearted combat weapon raised by Redros Binzvanker.
If Binzvanker gives the order, Omega will not hesitate to sacrifice even their own life.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Redros Binzvanker
During the Third Claudian War, Redros served with distinction as adjutant to the main force, the Second Army.
Later, Redros took control of the Second Army and seized power. The Second Army persecuted Deon Federation citizens, and civil war broke out.
Binzvanker, the mastermind, fought Kyo and Hakuto and was believed to have died.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Sho Zama
He is a motorcycle racer from Japan.
He was one of the surface people summoned by Drake. After meeting Marvel, he rapidly developed his abilities and aura power as a Holy Warrior of the anti-Drake forces.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Chum Huau
She is a Mi Ferario of the Common realm, with a fairy-like appearance. She is a lively girl full of curiosity.
She has high aura power herself, and boards an Aura Battler (AB) with Sho.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Marvel Frozen
She is a surface person who was summoned before Sho.
Opposing Drake's deeds, she fights for the anti-Drake forces in an Aura Battler (AB).

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Keen Kiss
Her affection for Nie Given led her to board the Zelerna.
Though traces of childishness still show here and there, she is fully competent at operating an Aura Battler (AB).

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Nie Given
He is the son of Romun Given, a provincial lord in the Kingdom of A.
When his father recognized Drake's intentions, Nie began acting alongside him, but lost both his parents. Even so, he resisted Drake's forces as captain of the Zelerna.
Nie's true strength is his political ability: despite bearing disgrace, he built a cooperative alliance with the Kingdoms of Lau and Na.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ciela Lapana
She is the Queen of Na, a girl who carries the blood of the distinguished Lapana family.
She recognized Sho Zama as a Holy Warrior and gave him Billbine. She also had the huge Aura Battleship Gran-Garan built, and opposes Drake's forces.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Elle Hunm
She is the only daughter of Pinegan Hunm, King of Mi, and the granddaughter of Foizon, King of Lau. She has aura power that can sense the future.
Because her mother, Pattofoot, eloped, Foizon does not acknowledge Elle as his granddaughter.
After Foizon's death, she becomes Queen of Lau.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Foizon Gow
He is the King of Lau.
Strict with himself and others, he treats Elle coldly because of his position as king: she is the child of his daughter who eloped.
He is strongly determined to act righteously himself and earn the trust of his people.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Todd Guinness
He is a cheerful elite pilot from Boston who was summoned along with Sho.
As he fights as a warrior in Drake's forces, he discovers his own ambition. Yet he also worries about the mother he left back home, showing a contrasting side of his character.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bern Bunnings
He is an elite knight serving Drake. He values status and honor, and seeks to gain as much power as Drake himself.
However, his failure to carry out the order to defeat Sho gradually undermines his standing, and he is ultimately removed from his post. As a result, he develops an abnormal hostility toward Sho.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Black Knight
This is Bern wearing a mask to avenge his humiliation after failing to defeat Sho and losing face as a knight.
Clad in the aura power of hatred, his fighting ability is in no way inferior to Sho's.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Garalia Nyamhee
She is a female warrior in Drake's forces.
Because her father deserted in the face of the enemy, she grew up branded a coward's child. Impatient to earn military merit and clear that disgrace, she pilots Bastole.
She and Sho end up on the surface. She tries to return to Byston Well, but fails and dies in an explosion.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Allen Brady
He is a surface person brought to Byston Well after Sho and Todd.
He was Todd's senior in the air force and enjoyed a reputation as a genius pilot.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Shot Weapon
He is a young roboticist from the surface.
Summoned to Byston Well by Drake, he develops Aura Machines by combining surface technology with aura power.
His unhappy life on the surface fuels his great ambition: he intends eventually to oust even Drake and rule Byston Well.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Drake Luft
He is an ambitious man who breaks the taboo by bringing surface technology to Byston Well, seeking to use Aura Machines to reign over every world.
A commanding figure skilled in intrigue, he has the capacity to rule people and possesses high aura power himself.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Riml Luft
She is Drake Luft's daughter, but opposes his ambition.
She and Nie Given of the anti-Drake forces are lovers. She tries to escape time and again, but is brought back to Drake each time.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Louser Luft
She is the wife of Drake Luft, a provincial lord in the Kingdom of A.
Despite being married to Drake, she has an illicit affair with Bishot, King of Ku, and secretly diverts Aura Machine technology to him.
She does it all for her own ambition.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bishot Hatta
He is the King of Ku and an ally of Drake.
He steadily builds up his country's strength and plots world conquest.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Helmsman of A
This is an Aura Ship helmsman.
As a rule, steering an Aura Ship requires less aura power than operating an Aura Battler (AB).
However, some helmsmen have enough aura power to operate an AB.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Daba Myroad
He leaves the countryside of Koam with L-Gaim, a handmade Heavy Metal (HM).
He is actually a survivor of the Yaman royal family, which Posaydal destroyed. After many events, he throws himself into the rebel army and eventually comes to seek the restoration of the Yaman dynasty.
He is unflappable in any situation.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Lilis Faw
She is a survivor of the Mirarii, the indigenous people of Pentagona World.
Daba Myroad takes her in from a sideshow in Prearmo, a town on Koam, and she joins his group.
She has a limited degree of telepathic sensitivity.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Mirawoo Kyao
He is Daba's best friend and a genius mechanic. His manner is lighthearted, but he has a surprisingly sensitive side.
He dreamed of becoming a regular soldier in Posaydal's army, but follows Daba into the rebels.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Fannaria Amm
She was originally an actor, but became a bandit after Miyama Lilin took her in.
Attracted to Daba, she leaves the bandits and begins traveling with him.
She is a quick learner who can handle anything from piloting a Heavy Metal (HM) to commanding troops.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gaw Ha Leccee
She was a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a member of the Thirteen, a group of highly skilled fighters.
Meeting Daba leads her to leave the army.
She is so strong-willed that she can temporarily suppress even her love for Daba to pursue her goal.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Semuge Shato
He is the leader of the rebels in Trydetol.
At first, he hears of Daba's exploits and tries to make him a symbol of the rebellion.
However, he recognizes Daba's ability to take action, and the fact that Daba is a survivor of the Yaman dynasty proves decisive. He gradually comes to follow Daba with respect.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gavlet Gablae
He is a hot-blooded man seeking to restore his fallen provincial noble house.
He recognizes Daba's worth and considers him a rival.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Hekeler Mauzer
He is a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a candidate for the Thirteen.
He distinguishes himself under Nei, but serves directly under Giwaza after she goes to Gastogal.
He is impulsive and makes a good team with the rational Antoon, who joined the army at the same time.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Antoon Randow
He is a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a candidate for the Thirteen.
He distinguishes himself under Nei, but serves directly under Giwaza after she goes to Gastogal.
He makes a good team with Hekeler, who joined the army at the same time.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Nei Moh Han
She is a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a member of the Thirteen, a group of highly skilled fighters.
While members of the Thirteen are often deployed to planets under Posaydal's rule, she often operates alongside division commander Giwaza.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Barn Gania Killas
He is a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a member of the Thirteen, a group of highly skilled fighters.
On Giwaza's orders, he seeks to concentrate forces to bring down Sveto, and works to persuade the Mizun Division.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Lili Hassy
She is a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a member of the Thirteen, a group of highly skilled fighters.
She hates men and loses control of herself when enraged.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
MF McTomin
He is a regular soldier in Posaydal's army and a member of the Thirteen, a group of highly skilled fighters.
On Giwaza's orders, he undertakes the purge of senior officers in the regular army.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Oldna Posaydal
Formerly a member of the Temple Knights, she is the true Posaydal's body double, a woman who devoted herself to him body and soul.
Bio Relation has given her a false personality, memories and appearance, and she is controlled from outside.
Her real name is Mian Ku Ha Attsher.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Amandra Kamandra
He is the founder of Pentagona World's largest financial conglomerate.
Operating under the name Aman Trading Company, he supplies weapons to both the regular army and the rebels, earning him the name "merchant of war."
His true identity is Oldna Posaydal, Number 1 of the Temple Knights, who unified Pentagona. He is the true Posaydal.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rebel Soldier
The rebels resist Posaydal's tyranny by force.
They once fought separately in different places, but gradually unite with the appearance of Daba.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Posaydal Soldier
"Posaydal soldiers" is the common name for the regular army led by Oldna Posaydal.
The regular army has grown too large and complacent, and corruption has begun to set in.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Kamille Bidan
He grew up with deep-seated insecurities about his parents' neglect of family life and his feminine-sounding name.
When his pent-up frustration erupts, Kamille rashly steals a prototype Gundam from the Titans and joins AEUG.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Fa Yuiry
She lived next door to the Bidan family on Green Noa 1.
Headstrong, she nags Kamille like an older sister. In truth, she likes him, and follows him into Mobile Suit (MS) piloting after he becomes a pilot.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Quattro Bajeena
He is a Mobile Suit pilot in AEUG.
His true identity is, of course, Char Aznable.
He joins the fight under an assumed name to witness the Newtypes his father spoke of: humanity's transformation.
His real name is Casval Rem Deikun.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Char Aznable
He is a Mobile Suit (MS) pilot feared as the "Red Comet" of the Principality of Zeon.
He joined the Principality of Zeon military, which assassinated his father, Zeon Zum Deikun, and drew close to the Zabi family.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Emma Sheen
She came to AEUG after questioning the Titans' actions.
Despite her harsh words, she seems to have been concerned about Kamille.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Katz Kobayashi
Having adoptive parents, being unable to go into space, and seeing the hero Amuro confined to Earth all combined to make him grow into a bratty child.
His former name was Katz Hawin.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Henken Bekkener
He is the captain of AEUG's battleship Argama.
A former soldier in the Earth Federation Forces, he joined AEUG because he agreed with its ideals.
He also fought in the One Year War.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Amuro Ray
He is a hero of the One Year War.
As the pilot of Gundam, he clearly demonstrated the qualities of a Newtype.
After the war, the Earth Federation Forces, fearing the very existence of Newtypes, confined him to Earth.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Jerid Messa
He is an elite member of the Titans who came from Earth to Green Noa 1 after being selected to pilot the cutting-edge Gundam Mk-II.
His encounter with Kamille creates an ill-fated bond, and he comes to fight driven by anger alone.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Four Murasame
She is the fourth research subject at the Murasame Research Institute, a facility devoted to Newtype research.
That is why she is called Four, but she intensely hates being called "Number 4."
She lost both her parents and her memories in the One Year War, and the Murasame Research Institute exploited that loss.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rosamia Badam
She is a Cyber-Newtype who underwent biological modification at a Newtype research institute in Augusta.
She lost her family in a colony drop during the One Year War. The terror she felt then is exploited as hatred of Spacenoids.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rosammy
She is a Cyber-Newtype who underwent biological modification at a Newtype research institute in Augusta.
She lost her family in a colony drop during the One Year War. The terror she felt then is exploited as hatred of Spacenoids.
Manipulated memories make her believe that she is Kamille's younger sister.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Paptimus Scirocco
He is the captain of Jupitris, flagship of the Jupiter Fleet.
After returning to the Earth Sphere, he enters the service of Titans leader Jamitov Hymem. This is merely a means for him to seize control of everything.
His past is a mystery. He had never been in the Earth Sphere, and there is no record of him taking part in the One Year War.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Haman Karn
She is the guardian of Mineva Lao Zabi, a surviving member of the former Principality of Zeon's Zabi family. She gains effective control of Axis after Char leaves.
She is extremely cunning and intensely dislikes being understood by others, because Char used her when she was an innocent girl.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Titans
Taking a lesson from the colony drop carried out by remnants of the former Principality of Zeon during Operation Stardust, Jamitov Hymem advocated hunting down remnants of the former Principality military.
The Titans were created for that purpose.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Axis Officer (Male)
Axis is an asteroid base where remnants of the Principality of Zeon gathered after their defeat in the One Year War against the Earth Federation Forces.
This is a male officer serving at that base.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Axis Officer (Female)
Axis is an asteroid base where remnants of the Principality of Zeon gathered after their defeat in the One Year War against the Earth Federation Forces.
This is a female officer serving at that base.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

Axis Soldier (Male)
Axis is an asteroid base where remnants of the Principality of Zeon gathered after their defeat in the One Year War against the Earth Federation Forces.
This is a male soldier serving at that base.

{x00}

rows.en:
Axis Soldier (Female)
Axis is an asteroid base where remnants of the Principality of Zeon gathered after their defeat in the One Year War against the Earth Federation Forces.
This is a female soldier serving at that base.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Chirico Cuvie
He is an Armored Trooper (AT) pilot who formerly served in the Red Shoulders, feared as the "bloodsucking unit."
He is still tormented by nightmares of the indiscriminate murder he experienced during that service.
His abilities as an AT pilot are exceptional, surpassing those of a Perfect Soldier (PS).

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Fyana
She is a Perfect Soldier (PS), also called Proto One.
She was being developed as the first PS, but encountered Chirico just before completion and awakened while still incomplete.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Coconna
She is the charming girl who serves as the face of the junk shop in Uoodo.
She is lively and cheerful.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Vanilla Vartla
He is Gotho's business associate.
At first, he tries to use Chirico, but friendship develops as they spend time together as partners.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bouleuse Gotho
He is a junk dealer in Uoodo. He also arranges Battling matches and similar work.
He takes a liking to Chirico and looks after him in all sorts of ways.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ru Shako
He is a kindhearted giant from Quent, over two meters tall. Though quiet, he has an honorable, manly spirit.
He meets Chirico as a mercenary with Assemble EX-10. They fight together on many occasions, including pursuing the secret of Wiseman, and share a deep friendship.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Pol Potaria
He is a former member of the Kingdom of Kummen's royal guard.
Concerned for Kummen's future, he volunteers as a mercenary.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Heloram Kanjelman
He is the third prince of the Kingdom of Kummen.
He establishes the Holy Kingdom of Kummen in opposition to modernization. However, with the kingdom's future in mind, his true intent is to destroy the old order, which has no place in modernization, along with himself as the symbol of that old order.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Epsilon
He is a Perfect Soldier (PS) developed from research data on Fyana, also known as Proto One.
When he pilots Strike Dog, he is the very image of a combat machine.
He resents Chirico calling Proto One "Fyana."

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gregore Garosh
He is a veteran and a leading figure among the former Red Shoulder AT pilots.
Because of his continued defiance of Pailsen, and to preserve secrecy, he was meant to be murdered under cover of a military operation.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Murza Melym
He is a former Red Shoulder AT pilot who is skilled in mechanics.
Because he kept defying Pailsen along with Gregore and the others, and to preserve secrecy, he was meant to be murdered under cover of a military operation.
He survived, but his family was murdered, and he burns for revenge on Pailsen.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Byman Hagard
He is a former Red Shoulder AT pilot.
Because he kept defying Pailsen along with Gregore and the others, and to preserve secrecy, he was meant to be murdered under cover of a military operation.
He lost his right arm then and now uses a prosthesis.
He is proud and sometimes sarcastic.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Virgil Carson
Carson is a former Red Shoulder AT pilot.
In truth, Carson is an astute spy sent by military intelligence to investigate Pailsen.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Riemann
He is the former head of the Red Shoulders' training facility.
He acts as a military adviser to Pailsen, the founder of the Red Shoulders.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Yoran Pailsen
He is the founder of the Red Shoulders, feared as the "bloodsucking unit."
At first, he takes an interest in Chirico's abilities, but in time he comes to fear them and tries to eliminate Chirico.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

He was born a prince of Vorder, but Mardoul seized his country.
Raised by the warrior Azuves, he pilots the armored soldier Galient and fights Mardoul.

rows.en:
Gunblaze A
The Gunblaze family has 26 variants built around a common main frame. Gunblaze Assault is the most representative of them.
These outstanding ground combat machines made it possible for the Cloud Alliance forces to win the Third Claudian War on Claudia.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze B
Gunblaze Backup is configured for medium-range support.
A shoulder-mounted sensor unit allows precise fire from medium range while the machine takes a kneeling stance. It can also evade rapidly to avoid enemy counterattacks after firing. This variant combines Gunblaze mobility with supporting artillery fire.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze C
Gunblaze Cold is configured for combat in cold regions.
It was developed with an emphasis on pilot survivability and mobility in freezing conditions. Systems throughout the machine are protected against freezing, and dedicated equipment allows it to operate on glaciers and in blizzards.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze D
Gunblaze Destruction is configured for demolition and annihilation operations.
Designed to break through enemy front-line forces and demolish strong defenses such as fortresses, it boasts unrivaled firepower and payload capacity. Once its ammunition is exhausted, it promptly withdraws from the battlefield.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze E
Gunblaze Express is configured for high-speed resupply.
GT units deploy at very high speed in combat, so their supply units must be just as fast.
Transport takes priority over armament, with container trays fitted to the shoulders, back, waist and legs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze G
Gunblaze Ghost is configured for illusion-based combat.
It creates a Vision Field and projects decoy images. This is highly effective tactically, concealing the strength of friendly forces from the enemy and reducing the chance of being hit.
It can project a wide variety of images, provided the data is available.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze H
Gunblaze Hover is configured for hover-mobile combat.
Gunblaze is capable of high-speed ground combat, but some ravines are impassable and wetlands reduce its mobility. This equipment overcomes those obstacles and greatly expands its operating range.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze I
Gunblaze Interceptor is configured for disruption and interception.
The I configuration was developed to focus Gunblaze's mobility on disrupting and intercepting enemies. Its role calls for greater consideration of mobility than the similarly heavily equipped D configuration.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze J
Gunblaze Jamming is configured for information warfare.
Its equipment is designed to block and disrupt the transmission of information. It deploys a jamming dome to form a magnetic-field lens, generating powerful jamming. It can also focus a powerful magnetic field on a precise point, enabling special tactics such as hindering a machine's operation or destroying electrical circuits.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze K
Gunblaze Knight is configured for close combat.
GT combat normally centers on firearms, but close combat accounts for a large share of the fighting. This machine is the culmination of research into that role. No other equipment configuration can surpass Knight in close combat.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze L
Gunblaze Long Range Killer is configured for ultra-long-range combat.
The Cloud Alliance forces had successfully broadened their medium- and long-range attack options by exploiting Gunblaze's mobility. They developed this equipment to enable ultra-long-range, intercontinental ballistic fire.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze M
Gunblaze Marine is configured for underwater combat.
This equipment was developed to extend Gunblaze's operations into underwater and undersea environments. It can carry out a wide range of missions, from ambushing passing ships and submarines to amphibious landings and securing the area ashore. Claws fitted to its arms and legs also allow close combat.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze N
Gunblaze Night Attack is configured for night assaults.
This equipment fully adapts Gunblaze's mobility for nighttime use. It cannot turn invisible, but heat-dissipation filters and other equipment help it blend into the darkness.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze O
Gunblaze Overhead is configured for aerial combat.
This equipment extends Gunblaze's operations into the sky. The Cloud Stream naturally makes high-altitude flight virtually impossible, but the machine is built to fly and glide.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze P
Gunblaze Personnel is configured for antipersonnel combat.
This equipment was developed to fight personnel. It carries three Cart Gunners with armor comparable to a GT's. Out of respect for human life, the fitted pulse-cannon armament can also serve as a long-range stun gun.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze Q
Gunblaze Quarterback is configured for overall command support.
Normally, pilots of crewed Gunblazes coordinate AIM (unmanned) units. This equipment coordinates information from the entire battlefield during larger battles. All of the machine's capacity is devoted to information processing so that it can handle large amounts of information efficiently.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze R
Gunblaze Reconator is configured for reconnaissance in force.
It normally operates covertly, but its primary mission is reconnaissance in force, using its mobility and wide-area identification capabilities. During these operations, it may also coordinate with AIM (unmanned) units to disrupt the enemy.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze S
Gunblaze Sapper is configured for combat engineering.
Its equipment can reshape the terrain into a suitable environment, making terrain effects more favorable to the ground-combat Gunblazes. After completing its work, it can change equipment and return to the front as another Gunblaze configuration. It can also use its equipment in hand-to-hand combat.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze T
Gunblaze Taking Off is configured for assassination operations.
It was successfully developed after research into optics and material composition. Its system, called optical transmission camouflage, makes it disappear by allowing the background behind it to pass through, rather than projecting that background onto its front.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze U
Gunblaze Unite is configured for combat with additional armor.
This equipment was developed to keep hits received to a minimum in GT combat, where accurate shooting has become the norm. It maximizes defense while minimizing added weight, so it weighs little more than the A configuration. It is used when hits are unavoidable, such as when assaulting enemy strongholds.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze V
Gunblaze Volt is configured for electrical attacks.
GTs are weapons built from advanced electronic equipment. This configuration was developed to destroy them from within. On contact with enemy units, it uses a stun wire to deliver a momentary high-voltage current and silence them.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze W
Gunblaze Wrestle is configured for hand-to-hand combat.
Close combat is frequent in GT battles. This equipment was developed to pursue bare-handed fighting that feels more natural to the pilot. Additional external armor over its standard armor further increases its rigidity and strength.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze X

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Meisarge

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

{x00}

{x00}
