Winted
This machine was developed to inflict massive damage on an opponent during a brief deployment.
Its main weapon, the Buster Rifle, is designed to activate the powerful Cloud Stream (CS) Fire attack. However, CS Fire can only be used in flight mode.
This is unit 3.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Air Cavalier
This machine has no expendable weaponry and is designed for extended deployment.
Its main weapon, the Double Blade Whipster, can be used as a sword at close range or split into multiple blades to attack like a whip at medium range. It also has Cloud Stream (CS) Armor, which nullifies physical attacks.
This is unit 1.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Air Cavalier
This machine has no expendable weaponry and is designed for extended deployment.
Its main weapon, the Double Blade Whipster, can be used as a sword at close range or split into multiple blades to attack like a whip at medium range. It also has Cloud Stream (CS) Armor, which nullifies physical attacks.
This is unit 2.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Deathgweed
This machine was conceived to give a Flying Trooper (FT) even greater Gunblaze-style mobility and capability in suppression operations.
It was successfully made smaller while retaining its firepower. Its Cloud Stream (CS) Absorber allows descents from high altitude and brief bursts of highly mobile sliding movement.
This is unit 1.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Deathgweed
This machine was conceived to give a Flying Trooper (FT) even greater Gunblaze-style mobility and capability in suppression operations.
It was successfully made smaller while retaining its firepower. Its Cloud Stream (CS) Absorber allows descents from high altitude and brief bursts of highly mobile sliding movement.
This is unit 2.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Galstorm
This machine was developed with an emphasis on mobility in aerial combat.
Its main weapon is a saber. It excels at diving sharply from an airborne position, attacking, then breaking away. Within a limited area, no other machine can match its mobility.
This is unit 1.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Galstorm
This machine was developed with an emphasis on mobility in aerial combat.
Its main weapon is a saber. It excels at diving sharply from an airborne position, attacking, then breaking away. Within a limited area, no other machine can match its mobility.
This is unit 2.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Wahrheit
This is an H-type Flying Trooper (FT).
It was designed to achieve a structure and movements even more humanlike than those of a Ground Trooper (GT), and succeeded. Along with a solid blade, it carries small but powerful cannons on both shoulders. A single blow from the Spinel Lancer it wields can split the earth.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rayfall
This is a P-type Flying Trooper (FT).
It was developed with two main goals: mobility within the Cloud Stream and extended deployment.
Its acrobatic movements bewilder enemies and prevent them from fixing their aim on it.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dunbine
Shot Weapon built three prototypes of this Aura Battler (AB), which emphasizes mobility.
Its firearms are mounted externally to reduce dead weight.
As a prototype, it has the drawback that its performance depends on the pilot's aura power, making it sensitive and difficult to handle.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dunbine (Todd)
This is Todd Guinness's personal unit, one of the three Dunbine prototypes. Its body is painted black.
All three Dunbines have the same basic performance, but compared with Sho, it is hard to say that Todd brought out its full potential.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Billbine
This transformable Aura Battler (AB) was independently developed by the Kingdom of Na.
Its Aura Battler form excels in combat. In Wing Caliber form, its carrying capacity and cruising speed increase, allowing it to cover a wide operational area.
However, operating it requires high aura power, limiting who can pilot it.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Drumlo
This was the first Aura Battler (AB) to be mass-produced in Byston Well.
It has heavy armor suited to Aura Battler combat, which centers on sword fighting. Equipped with Flay Bombs for close-range attacks, it offers an excellent balance of offense and defense.
It is also easy to pilot and was used to train beginners.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Drumlo (Improved)
This was the first Aura Battler (AB) to be mass-produced in Byston Well.
It has heavy armor suited to Aura Battler combat, which centers on sword fighting. Equipped with Flay Bombs for close-range attacks, it offers an excellent balance of offense and defense.
It is also easy to pilot and was used to train beginners.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Virunvee
This was the first machine equipped with an "Aura Amplifier," allowing even pilots with weak aura power to operate an Aura Battler.
Like Dunbine, it emphasizes mobility and was mainly piloted by those at the level of a knight commander.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bastole
This experimental Aura Battler (AB) was designed to draw out the maximum aura power of its pilot with an "Aura Amplifier."
It can produce considerable power, but as an experimental machine it has many unstable elements. An improved model was later introduced.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Leprechaun
Alongside mobility, this design sought greater firepower through built-in weapons.
However, excessive emphasis on armament increased its weight relative to its power output. The result was a poorly balanced machine that excelled only in firepower.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Wryneck
This Aura Battler (AB) combines Bastole's mobility with a full complement of built-in weapons.
Although heavily armed with built-in weapons such as missile pods, its large Aura Converter gives it greater mobility than Billbine.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zwarth
This Aura Battler (AB) could be called the ultimate form of Shot Weapon's designs.
It combines Leprechaun's firepower with Vierres's high mobility. However, it is harder to manufacture and maintain than existing models, so only a small number were produced.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zwarth (Musiy)
This Zwarth was tuned specifically for Musiy Poe.
Its body is painted white, though a version in the standard rose-red color also exists.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dana-O'Shee
House Given independently developed this Aura Battler (AB) using information the family had acquired.
Simplified armor improves its mobility, while a missile launcher increases its firepower.
It surpasses Gedo, the machine used as a reference, but cannot match the performance of later Aura Battlers.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Botune
The kingdoms of Lau and Na jointly developed this Aura Battler (AB), building on the designs of Dunbine and Bozune.
It emphasizes aerial combat and maneuverability, boasting a high cruising speed. Safety was also considered in the cockpit design, and it was mass-produced as a mainstay unit for Lau and Na.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Botune (Foizon)
Foizon Gow, King of Lau, used this Botune.
Its body is painted violet.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Botune (Royal Guard)
This Botune was tuned specifically for the royal guard of the Queen of Na.
Its body is painted white.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zwauth
Shot modified the high-performance Zwarth, which could be called the ultimate Aura Battler, to create this most powerful and vicious Aura Battler (AB).
Its distinctive features are a dragon-like tail and a large Aura Converter.
Its only weapon is a sword, for its overwhelming attack power makes firearms unnecessary.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
L-Gaim
This Heavy Metal (HM) was redesigned for easier mass production from the Gayrahm owned by the Yaman royal family of the planet Mizun.
Its cockpit uses the Spiral Flow system to withstand G-forces. Its design also draws on the optional firearms of Bat-Shu, which was developed by the Koam dynasty.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
L-Gaim Mk-II
Kyao rebuilt Amonduul Stack, a Class A Heavy Metal (HM) made with Yaman dynasty technology, as a successor to L-Gaim.
Its main features are a panoramic display covering 360 degrees and the ability to transform into the Prowler Land Booster.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Allone
Alongside Greia, this is one of the most common Class B Heavy Metals (HMs) in Pentagona.
It was also the first machine that could be mass-produced, so many variants exist.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Mizun Allone
This Allone is built to specifications for the planet Mizun.
Energy from its arms is diverted to the Power Launcher and the Flosser on its back, leaving the arms little more than decoration.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Military Allone
This version is built to Posaydal's regular military specifications.
It is considered the basic Allone model.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Allone Custom
This is an internally tuned version of Allone, the most common Class B Heavy Metal (HM) in Pentagona.
Its appearance is unchanged from a standard Allone.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gorongo
This Allone is used by the rebels.
The only major difference from the regular military version is the shape of its head, which was changed for ease of production.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
S-Gorongo
This Gorongo is built for space combat.
It differs from the ground model in its chest cooling ducts and the space-combat equipment on its back.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Greia
This is the most widely used Class B Heavy Metal (HM) in the Posaydal forces.
Development began before Allone, but its final rollout came later. As a result, Greia appears to have been built with greater precision.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bal-Bud
This Class B Heavy Metal (HM) comes closest to Class A.
Its arms use Class A power units, giving it arm strength and Power Launcher firepower beyond Class B standards.
It formed the basis for all Class B HMs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bal-Bud Kayzess
Bal-Bud Kayzess is a tuned-up Bal-Bud.
Its exterior changes include redesigned chest and head sections and the removal of the leg stabilizers.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Bat-Shu
This is a Class A Heavy Metal (HM) whose Koam-built original is unaccounted for.
Its excellent overall balance has led to many replicas. Despite its heavily equipped appearance, its rubber body has relatively little armor.
The resulting low energy loss gives it excellent mobility and makes it well suited to close combat.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ashura Temple
This is one of a series of Class A Heavy Metals (HMs) built on Gastogal and used by the Temple Knights.
Posaydal built a prototype replica. This HM emphasizes offense and has four arms and four Power Launchers, plus a Reverse Bomber and Energy Sash in its chest.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Auge
This Class A Heavy Metal (HM) was built exclusively for Posaydal.
Its shoulder Round Binders conceal Power Launchers at their tips and can move independently of the arms. Their undersides also house a total of 30 lancers.
Nei borrowed it, but she did not bring out its true power.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gundam Mk-II
The AEUG repainted Gundam Mk-II Unit 3, captured from the Titans, to resemble the Gundam that fought in the One Year War.
There were three units, but the AEUG deployed only Unit 3 in combat. The others were used for spare parts.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gundam Mk-II (Titans)
This is an Earth Federation prototype Mobile Suit (MS).
The Titans developed it as a mainstay unit, but their prejudice against Spacenoids kept them from incorporating former Zeon technology, leaving it inferior to contemporary MS in some respects.
However, the high performance of the Gundam on which it was based compensates for its shortcomings.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
G-Defenser
This machine was developed to enhance Gundam Mk-II's armament and armor.
After it combines with the Mk-II, its cockpit is ejected and can be used as a small fighter.
G-Defenser itself can also operate independently.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zeta Gundam
Anaheim Electronics developed this transformable prototype Mobile Suit (MS) from Kamille's design, incorporating designs from Gundam Mk-II and Rick Dias.
A newly developed generator greatly increases its power output.
Its Waverider form enables atmospheric entry.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Hyaku Shiki
Anaheim Electronics supplied this prototype Mobile Suit (MS) to the AEUG.
It was developed using the best technology available at the time, but its control system could not keep up with its capabilities, limiting who could pilot it.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rick Dias
The AEUG, a group of Spacenoids, developed this assault Mobile Suit (MS) to fight the Earth Federation.
Its structure incorporates the strengths of Rick Dom and Gundam, giving it extremely high maneuverability despite its ponderous silhouette.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rick Dias
This Rick Dias was tuned exclusively for Quattro Bajeena.
Initially, only Quattro's unit was painted red, while the others were dark gray. All units were later standardized to red.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Hizack
This improved Hizack was repainted for use by the Titans.
For some reason, its body is green rather than the Titans colors.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Hizack
The Earth Federation designed and mass-produced this Mobile Suit (MS) after the One Year War.
It is largely an improved version of the former Principality of Zeon's Zaku, with a smaller, higher-output generator. However, its output is still too low to use a Beam Rifle and Beam Saber simultaneously.
Its body is painted blue.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Marasai
Anaheim Electronics transferred this Mobile Suit (MS) to the Titans to curry favor with them as well.
Its excellent versatility made it a candidate to succeed Hizack, but its high cost kept it from becoming the mainstay unit.
However, it is said that the real reason was that it was made by Anaheim.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gabthley
The Titans built this transformable Mobile Suit (MS) prototype.
This assault MS has ball-jointed beam cannons on both shoulders and an optional large launcher. Numerous powerful verniers throughout its body give it excellent mobility.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Messala
Scirocco designed and built this transformable Mobile Armor (MA) aboard the deuterium transport Jupitris during his voyage back from Jupiter.
It is equipped with a large generator and thrusters because Scirocco had an intense physical aversion to Jupiter's strong gravity.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
The-O
This Mobile Suit (MS) was the fourth machine Scirocco built aboard Jupitris.
Its joints have a fourfold or fivefold structure, it has verniers at 50 points throughout its body, and an extremely high-output generator is housed in its torso. It boasts power and speed far beyond what its appearance suggests.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Qubeley
This assault Mobile Suit (MS) was built at Axis for Newtypes.
Developed from Elmeth, which was deployed in the One Year War, it is equipped with a psycommu system. Its waist skirt carries funnels, the equivalent of Elmeth's bits, making it adept at all-range attacks.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Qubeley (Haman)
This assault Mobile Suit (MS) was built at Axis for Newtypes.
Developed from Elmeth, which was deployed in the One Year War, it is equipped with a psycommu system. Its waist skirt carries funnels, the equivalent of Elmeth's bits, making it adept at all-range attacks.
This unit is exclusively for Haman Karn.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Scopedog
Scopedog was a mainstay Armored Trooper (AT) of the Gilgamesh army in the latter part of the Hundred Years' War.
Its versatility and reliability made it the most-produced AT on the Astragius continent. Equipment and parts are easy to replace, so many variants have emerged on different fronts.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Scopedog Light Type
This machine was modified for long-range reconnaissance and reconnaissance in force based on hit-and-run attacks.
Scopedog's weight has been reduced to the limit, leaving it with virtually no armor. Although intended for special missions, some pilots who prioritize mobility also preferred this machine.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Brutishdog
This is a Scopedog variant.
The control and drive systems of this custom version have been upgraded to match the reaction speed of a Perfect Soldier (PS), a pilot whose abilities far surpass those of ordinary humans.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Burglary Dog
This variant appeared thirty-some years after Scopedog's development.
It carries a Trample Rigger, a Dropper's Folding Gun and other equipment. The Gilgamesh army did not formally adopt it.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Diving Beetle
This is an H-class Armored Trooper (AT) for wetland warfare.
A large air tank on its back enables it to operate underwater for two hours.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Standing Tortoise
This H-class Armored Trooper (AT) specializes in jungle warfare.
Despite its class, it is highly mobile, but without Gliding Wheels it falls behind other ATs on flat ground.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Berserga WP
This custom Armored Trooper (AT) was manufactured for domestic use in Quent, a country of towering men.
It uses Diving Beetle as its base, but carries a high-performance Quent-made metal detector.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Blood Sucker
As the RSC in its model designation suggests, Pailsen developed this Armored Trooper (AT) for the remnants of the Red Shoulders, using Scopedog's design concept.
This machine has been scaled up to the heavy class, and its mobility and power surpass those of other ATs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Strike Dog
This Armored Trooper (AT) is a more powerful development of Blood Sucker, built exclusively for the Perfect Soldier (PS) Epsilon.
This heavy-class combat AT is a size larger than Scopedog and boasts top-class attack power and mobility.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Rabidly Dog
This Armored Trooper (AT) is a version of Strike Dog redesigned for mass production.
An Iron Claw and a machine gun are fixed to its left hand. It has strong close-combat capabilities.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Fatty
This is the Balarant army's mainstay Armored Trooper (AT).
The Balarant army developed it by studying a captured Scopedog.
It can glide using hover propulsion instead of Gliding Wheels, but its performance falls far short of Scopedog's.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Galient
Galient's Dash Wheel mechanism lets it race over rough terrain and close the distance to an enemy in an instant.
By transforming its main weapon, the Galient Blade, into a whip, it demonstrates fearsome close-combat capabilities.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Galient Heavy Armor Kai
This Galient has been modified with a Flying Cannon and shield to increase its firepower and defenses.
It is also called Assault Galient.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zuwel
Designed for mobility in ground combat, it can close the distance to an enemy in an instant.
Its dedicated sword rotates at high speed, greatly increasing its armor-piercing power.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Promaxis
This is the most widely used main battle weapon on the Crescent continent.
Its four legs let it traverse the ravaged terrain of Crescent with ease.
As its reliance on special equipment for its main armament suggests, its melee capabilities fall short of Panzer Hunters such as Zuwel.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Promaxis Wee
Based on the command centaur trooper Promaxis Zee, this machine serves in the "Brown Centaur Corps" led by Don Slarzen.
The corps often undertakes special missions, so each member's machine has received further performance enhancements.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Wingal
Wingal can fly as a standard feature. Flying weapons are rare in the world of Crescent, making it a threat.
It also excels in melee combat, making it an extremely powerful asset.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Wingal Zee
Wingal boasts a high survival rate, and this version is reserved for combat commanders.
Its head differs in shape from the standard machine's, and its performance has been improved slightly.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Monoccoto Heavy Type
The effectiveness of flash rounds developed against armored soldiers drew attention, leading to the introduction of the Panzer Ballista as an armored soldier for long-range attacks.
This Panzer Ballista sacrifices melee capabilities for a wide range of firing equipment. This greatly improves its accuracy and even allows it to fire at aerial targets.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Evil God Soldier
Excavated on the Crescent continent, this weapon has an unusual shape, with a snake-like lower body.
It is larger than other armored soldiers (PB), and its imposing presence is overwhelming. Many mysteries about its mechanisms remain unsolved.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Layzner
This general-purpose prototype was developed by Eiji's father, Ken Asuka.
It has an emergency activation system that lets it respond to any situation without changing its backpack. The AI Rei, installed as its main computer, also supports its pilot, Eiji.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Terminator Police
This unmanned machine was designed for anti-personnel sweeps.
It has an anti-personnel laser sensor in its head.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunstaid
It was developed as a version of the Super Powered Tracer (SPT) with increased firepower.
It carries removable equipment including missile pods, a backpack with a super-heavy-particle beam cannon, electronic laser cannons on its arms and missile pods on its legs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zakaal
This Super Powered Tracer (SPT) was developed exclusively for Le Caine.
Based on Layzner, it was developed with a focus on improving mobility, increasing output and upgrading computer performance.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GaoGaiGar
GGG devoted all its resources to developing this Super Mechanoid, drawing on the advanced technology contained in the G-Stone.
It boasts tremendous durability and destructive power, and can also fly.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GaoFighGar
This Fighting Mechanoid replaces GaoGaiGar. It was developed from GaoGaiGar's space equipment, with its power increased by the new Evolual Ultech Power system.
Naturally, it can connect to existing G-Tools.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Volfogg
Volfogg belongs to GGG's Intelligence Division, and its main duty is protecting Mamoru Amami.
Its courteous AI is modeled on the personality of Kirio Inugami, an assassinated Cabinet Research Office agent.
It was developed in Japan.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
HyoRyu
This Brave Robot serves in GGG's mobile force on rescue duty. It carries the new-generation AI GBR-2.
Its activation was confirmed five seconds before that of EnRyu, which carries GBR-3.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
EnRyu
This Brave Robot serves in GGG's mobile force on rescue duty. It carries the new-generation AI system GBR-3, the same type of AI as HyoRyu's, but has a somewhat emotional personality.
It struggles to land after being launched, and has almost never succeeded.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
FuuRyu
This transformable combat Brave Robot carries the AI GBR-6.
Its training by Yang Longli of the People's Liberation Army Third District Headquarters initially left it unemotional. However, working alongside GGG made a deep impression on it, and it came to value humanitarian principles.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
RaiRyu
This transformable combat Brave Robot carries the AI GBR-7. Its weaponry was upgraded using data from EnRyu and other robots.
Unfortunately, this also passed on EnRyu's habit of botching landings.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
KouRyu
This Vehicle Robot carries the AI GBR-8 and is assigned to Chasseur, France's organization for combating special crimes.
Her AI uses female thought patterns, making her the first Brave Robot to be female in both form and mind.
She is AnRyu's older sister, but was captured by the enemy while her personality was forming. As a result, her speech and behavior show signs of immaturity.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
AnRyu
This Vehicle Robot carries the AI GBR-9 and is assigned to Chasseur, France's organization for combating special crimes.
When its SympaRate with KouRyu reaches at least 90 percent, they can perform Symmetrical Docking to become TenRyuJin.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
ChoRyuJin
This high-power robot is formed when HyoRyu and EnRyu perform Symmetrical Docking.
Its original mission is to operate Eraser Head, which dissipates explosive energy and electromagnetic waves.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GekiRyuJin
This combat robot is formed when FuuRyu and RaiRyu perform Symmetrical Docking.
Yang Longli of the People's Liberation Army Third District Headquarters designed it to be the world's strongest combat robot.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GouRyuJin
This new form is created when EnRyu and FuuRyu perform Symmetrical Docking.
Its finishing attack is Burning Hurricane, a combined technique using fire and wind.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GenRyuJin
This new form is created when HyoRyu and RaiRyu perform Symmetrical Docking.
It can use HyoRyu's and RaiRyu's weapons, with the exception of Chest Thriller.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Goldymarg
Goldymarg is a member of GGG's mobile force and carries the AI GBR-5.
To shorten development time, the personality of operations staff officer Geki Hyuma was used as its model. This gave Goldymarg a rough disposition.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Mic Sounders the 13th
Developed by an American research institution, this robot can perform System Change from Cosmo Robo to Boom Robo mode. This enables it to emit Solitary Waves, theoretically capable of destroying any matter.
Its XCR-13 AI is modeled on the personality of Stallion White, Swan White's older brother.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gundam
The Earth Federation Forces devoted all their resources to developing this mobile suit (MS) for close combat, using the Principality of Zeon's Zaku as a reference.
It boasts high mobility, maneuverability and durability. It uses the Core Block System, which serves as both cockpit and auxiliary power reactor.
It was also the first MS to carry beam weapons as standard equipment, giving it extremely high attack power.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Guncannon
Developed alongside Gundam, this mobile suit (MS) provides mid-range artillery support. Like Gundam, it uses the Core Block System.
Its maneuverability is lower than Gundam's, but it surpasses Gundam in armor thickness and long-range sniping capabilities with its dedicated beam rifle.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GM
The Federation developed this close-combat mobile suit (MS) as a simplified, mass-production version of the RX-78 Gundam.
All nonessential equipment has been removed, including the structurally complex Core Block System.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ball
This combat pod was developed to support the RGM-79 GM.
It was originally a work pod used by both the military and civilians, fitted with armor and a modified version of Guntank's main cannon.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zaku II
The Principality of Zeon's first combat mobile suit (MS), Zaku I, fully demonstrated the effectiveness of the MS.
Combat experience and know-how gained from it were incorporated into a more refined MS: Zaku II.
This became the Zeon forces' standard machine, and numerous variants were produced for different fronts.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zaku II Commander Type
This modified Zaku II was developed for commanders and veteran pilots.
The modifications yielded only slight performance gains. However, pilots who mastered this machine achieved combat results beyond what its specifications would suggest.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Char's Zaku II
This red command Zaku II is piloted by Major Char Aznable.
It is said to move at three times the speed of a normal Zaku. The Earth Federation Forces feared Char, calling him the Red Comet.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gouf
The Principality of Zeon developed this close-combat mobile suit (MS) by modifying Zaku II with a focus on ground warfare.
Its extensive mid- and close-range weaponry lets it fight Gundam on equal terms if its pilot is skilled enough.
In its first battle, piloted by Ramba Ral, it overwhelmed even Gundam.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dom
This heavy mobile suit (MS) was designed for ground combat. Its strong armor and fast hover movement greatly help MS units break through enemy lines.
Its high energy consumption means the Zeon forces must still rely on Zaku in prolonged battles. Even so, the Earth Federation Forces found a moving Dom extremely difficult to destroy.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gyan
Gyan was developed at roughly the same time as Gelgoog as a candidate for the next mainstay mobile suit (MS).
Its focus on close combat means its firepower differs little from Zaku II's.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gelgoog
This was the first Zeon mass-production machine to carry portable beam weapons as standard equipment.
It has excellent offensive and defensive capabilities and is lighter than Dom. This outstanding, highly versatile machine was intended to be the next mainstay mobile suit (MS).

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Char's Gelgoog
This modified Gelgoog was developed for commanders and veteran pilots.
The prototype assigned to Colonel Char Aznable has a red body to match his Red Comet epithet.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zakrello
Development of this mobile armor (MA) was abandoned partway through because its maneuverability and acceleration fell short of their planned targets.
Details are unknown, but it apparently carries something resembling a scattering beam cannon.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Big Zam
This mobile armor (MA) was the first mobile weapon to be equipped with an anti-beam barrier.
Its numerous mega-particle cannons give it overwhelming firepower.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Zeong
Zeong carries wire-controlled mega-particle cannons on both arms, with additional mega-particle cannons in its waist and head. Its sections are designed to separate and fight individually.
It has no legs because it could not be completed in time, but this does not greatly affect its performance.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
God Gundam
Neo Japan developed this Mobile Fighter (MF) for the finals of the 13th Gundam Fight. It surpasses its predecessor, Shining Gundam, in every respect.
In Hyper Mode, the wings on its back open, making it look as though it has a halo behind it.

{x00}

rows.en:
Wing Gundam Zero
This was the original Gundam design on which Wing Gundam and the other Gundams of its line were based.
Its special piloting system, the Zero System, feeds tactical data for fighting the enemy directly into the pilot's brain. If mastered, it offers immeasurable combat power, but places a heavy burden on the pilot.
Development was originally shelved because of the risk of losing control.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gundam Deathscythe Hell
After OZ severely damaged Gundam Deathscythe, it was secretly recovered and repaired into this form.
The Active Cloak has an anti-radar coating, and the jamming system has been upgraded. Protection against both beam and projectile weapons has also been improved.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gundam Heavyarms
This heavily armed mobile suit (MS) was designed for large-scale destruction.
Its heavy armament causes some limitations in mobility and close combat, but its capabilities still exceed those of a standard MS.
It was primarily designed for ground use, so maneuvering thrusters and other equipment were added later to adapt it for space.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gundam Sandrock
This mobile suit (MS) was designed for desert guerrilla warfare, with an emphasis on power and armor.
It has sensors and is tightly sealed, allowing it to operate effectively in harsh conditions. It was designed to coordinate with allied units and has strong command capabilities.
It was primarily designed for ground use, so maneuvering thrusters and other equipment were added later to adapt it for space.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Altron Gundam
After OZ damaged Shenlong Gundam, it was secretly recovered and repaired into this form. Its armor and output were enhanced, and a twin beam cannon on the backpack and Dragon Fangs on both arms increased its attack power.
Altron means "two-headed dragon," but its pilot, Chang Wufei, calls it Nataku.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Maganac
This mass-produced mobile suit (MS) is used by the Maganac Corps, the Winner family's private army.
It has high mobility in desert terrain and excels at coordinated group combat at close range. Various types exist to suit their pilots.
Its name derives from a Tagalog word meaning "family."

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Aries
This mass-produced mobile suit (MS) can operate on land or in the air, flying freely without optional equipment.
Its ground-combat capabilities are limited, but it has high mobility in aerial combat. Its legs transform and fold away to form its flight configuration.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Xabungle
Walker Machines (WMs) were designed primarily for practical work, but Xabungle excels in combat.
It consists of two vehicles, Bungle Rover and Bungle Skipper, and also excels at long-distance travel.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Walker Gallia
This large Walker Machine (WM) combines Xabungle-type agility with high mobility.
It also maintains high attack power and armor strength. Its hover system even allows limited flight.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Brockary
A large rotor on its back and two hover nozzles on its underside allow this machine to make high-altitude jumps and glide.
Its design combines the best features of Xabungle and Walker Gallia.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dougram
This Combat Armor (CA) was developed during the Deloyer War of Independence under Dr. Samarin, the guerrilla group's leader, to counter the Earth Federation Forces' CAs.
It is fully adapted to the X-Nebula environment, which disrupts electronics. This adaptation, together with its versatile armament, gives it combat power far beyond that of other CAs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dougram (Turbozack)
This Dougram has an enhancement unit called Turbozack mounted on its back.
It enables prolonged independent operation and repeated Linear Gun fire, increasing the machine's attack power.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Soltic Korchima Special
This Combat Armor (CA) is a Soltic modified for X-Nebula conditions, with further improvements to its performance.
Turbozack increases its generator output, allowing it to carry an Arm Linear Gun. Its drive power has also been strengthened, while reduced weight and increased output improve its maneuverability.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gorg
Gorg is one of the relics of an alien civilization hidden on Austral Island, a mysterious island in the southern seas.
Its body has no seams, and the armor around its joints apparently softens when it moves. Its extraordinary armor strength makes it almost impossible to destroy with projectile weapons.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Manon Gorg
Like Gorg, this is one of the relics of an alien civilization hidden on Austral Island, a mysterious island in the southern seas.
It combines extraordinary armor strength with tremendous attack power, and is thought to be a special commander-class machine.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Guardian
These Guardians are among the relics of an alien civilization hidden on Austral Island, a mysterious island in the southern seas.
Their individual machine names cannot be verified, so they are collectively called Rubble Guardians.
They were originally intended to be piloted by the beings sleeping beneath the ruins, but sometimes operate unmanned to accomplish their objectives.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Vifam
Unlike earlier Round Vernians (RVs), which emphasized versatility, Vifam was developed for specialized combat.
It uses the Pod system shared with earlier machines such as Neofam and Dillfam. The Pod serves as both cockpit and escape device.
Its high performance often leads to its use as a mission-leader machine.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Neofam
This Round Vernian (RV) was developed before Vifam. It was the first RV officially adopted by the military.
It uses an escape Pod as its cockpit to improve RV pilots' chances of survival.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Torunfam 8
This Round Vernian (RV) was developed to fight enemy mobile weapons.
A computer manages its basic movements, and its Pod has two seats: one for the gunner and one for the pilot.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dragonar-1
This Metal Armor (MA) is piloted by Kaine Wakaba.
It excels at close combat and hand-to-hand fighting, and moves nimbly.
As a result, it has thin armor and a low fuel capacity, but fitting Cavalier-0 or a Lifter compensates for these weaknesses.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dragonar-2
This long-range-support Metal Armor (MA) was developed in Giganos and seized by the Allied Forces.
Like Dragonar-1, it is highly versatile thanks to interchangeable equipment. Its weapons emphasize firepower, giving it strong long-range combat capabilities.
It is especially effective when used to support D-1.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Dragonar-3
This information-gathering Metal Armor (MA) was developed in Giganos and seized by the Allied Forces.
It excels at combat command and control and electronic interference, making it the key to coordinated operations with Dragonar-1 and Dragonar-2.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Deins
This mass-produced Metal Armor (MA) was used by the Giganos military before the Dragonars appeared.
It is designed for close combat and hand-to-hand fighting, and is piloted by commander-class personnel.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gilgazamune (Gon Jem)
This is the ultimate Metal Armor (MA), adjusted exclusively for Gon Jem.
Its massive body has thick armor, and its thought-control system allows the pilot to control the machine directly from the brain.

{x00}

Ken-Oh
This humanoid robot excels at sword techniques and combat using agile footwork.
It forms Raijin-Oh's torso and parts of both legs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ho-Oh
This bird-shaped robot excels at aerial and high-speed combat.
It forms parts of Raijin-Oh's head, body and back.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ju-Oh
This beast-shaped robot excels at ground combat.
It has the greatest power and armor strength of the three Raijin machines, and forms Raijin-Oh's shield and part of its legs.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Raijin-Oh
This giant robot is formed by combining Ken-Oh, Ju-Oh and Ho-Oh. Eldran, Warrior of Light, entrusted these three machines to the students of fifth grade, class 3 at Hinobori School to protect the world from the invading Jaaku Empire.
It is a versatile giant robot that uses its abundant armament to fight through all kinds of battles.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gambaruger
This giant robot is formed by combining Go Tiger, Mach Eagle and King Elephant.
Eldran, Warrior of Light, entrusted these three machines to Kotaro Kirigakure, Yosuke Kazamatsuri and Rikiya Ryuzaki, three fourth-graders at Aozora Elementary School, to protect the world from Great Demon King Gokuark's invasion.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Escaflowne
This is the guardian deity of Fanelia, a small frontier kingdom.
It was built by the legendary Ispano Clan, who possess the technology of Atlantis. It took approximately 150 years to build.
Reserved for royalty, it is rumored to be the strongest Guymelef.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
You Brain
Each Brain Powerd is an independent lifeform that functions fully with a human aboard.
Height, weight, body color and personality vary from one individual to another.
You's Brain is blue and has a curious personality.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Hime Brain
This Brain Powerd underwent Revival before Hime's eyes.
It has a gentle personality and naturally dislikes fighting. It understands its pilot's intentions and has an open disposition, seeking cooperation with people.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Ryujinmaru
This Mashin was created when the Golden Dragon inhabited the clay robot Wataru made in arts-and-crafts class.
It has a will of its own and can converse freely. As an experienced mentor, it encourages and admonishes Wataru both in and outside battle.
As Wataru gains experience, Ryujinmaru also learns various attack techniques.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Jyakomaru
Toraoh pilots this Mashin, one of the few that can transform.
It can change between the humanoid Machine Mode and the tiger-shaped Tiger Mode.

{x00}

Kikoutei
No one knows Kikoutei's true form.
It exists in every age as "the Shining One." When someone needs it, it appears in a form that embodies the symbol of power within that person's heart.
This white armor gives form to the symbol of Ryo Sanada's power.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Arago
Arago is the Yoja demon emperor. Together with the Jiryoshu, he unified the Yoja realm.
He then invaded the human world with armor made by the Jiryoshu's leader, who had gathered the power of nature to create it.
He was sealed away about a thousand years ago, but built up his power and revived in the modern age.

{x00}

Yoja Soldier
This soldier serves Arago, the Yoja demon emperor.
It is so powerful that Ryo and the others cannot match it while wearing Under Gear.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Fire En
True to his name, Fire En is hot-blooded.
He charges straight toward his goals, but tends to be indifferent to everything else.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Turbo Kai
Turbo Kai is a second-year student at Sankai High School. He chairs the disciplinary committee and values proper manners.
He seems to have two stock phrases: "A true Japanese man..." and "No ifs or buts!"

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Armor Shin
Armor Shin is a second-year student at Sankai High School.
He is captain of the judo club, and his hobby is picking up women. But when he falls seriously in love, he seems to have eyes for no other woman.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Wing Yoku
Wing Yoku is a second-year student at Sankai High School.
He is a biology enthusiast with a slight mad-scientist streak.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Shadow Ryu
Shadow Ryu is a first-year student at Sankai High School.
He is calm, composed and always aloof. He excels at unarmed combat and fights with ninja tactics that take advantage of his speed. He is also skilled with a sword.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Drill Geki
Drill Geki is a third-year student at Fuun High School and a gang boss with a hundred or more followers.
He is a good old-fashioned school tough, full of chivalry, but sometimes becomes so convinced of his own assumptions that he acts strangely.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Thunder Rai
Thunder Rai is a rookie detective from planet Jinrai, sent by the Space Police Organization.
He transfers into the first year at Sankai High School. He is very earnest, but surprisingly careless.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Toya
Toya is a boy who carries the soul of Radias, the legendary warrior of Heavenstia.
Led by destiny, he continues fighting alongside the Animanoid warriors.
He is impulsive, yet oddly sensitive in some ways. He is fond of peach juice.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Kira
Kira is a boy who carries the soul of Lute, the legendary warrior of Heavenstia.
Although he initially felt almost crushed by the fact that he was a warrior, he gradually awakened to his warrior powers. He became a true warrior before Toya did.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Greyfus
Greyfus is a wolf Animanoid and the leader of the Animanoid warriors. He is quiet but hot-blooded.
He is always eager to take things apart, but apparently rarely manages to put them back together properly.
Receiving power from Toya's sword, he transforms into a Kiba, a mechanized divine beast in golden armor, and grows to giant size.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Beakwood
Beakwood is a hawk Animanoid. He speaks politely and never loses his composure. Perhaps that is why he practices seated Zen meditation wherever he happens to be.
Receiving power from Toya's sword, he transforms into a Kiba, a mechanized divine beast in golden armor, and grows to giant size.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Garriel
Garriel is a gorilla Animanoid. He is a jolly fellow who loves children. In contrast, he is uncomfortable when young women touch him.
Receiving power from Toya's sword, he transforms into a Kiba, a mechanized divine beast in golden armor, and grows to giant size.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Teddyam
Teddyam is a bear Animanoid. Perhaps because they are still young, they are hot-blooded and often do as they please.
Yet their actions are driven by a desire to avenge their younger sister, who died in the fighting.
Receiving power from Kira's axe, Teddyam transforms into a Kiba, a mechanized divine beast in golden armor, and grows to giant size.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Domon Kasshu
Domon Kasshu represents Neo Japan as a Gundam Fighter.
He is the champion of martial arts in the colonies, holds the title King of Hearts, and follows The School of Master Asia.
Behind his cool, cynical exterior lie kindness and a determination to uphold justice.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Sai Saici
Many martial-arts practitioners moved to the colony's Chikurin Temple, leaving Shaolin Temple in decline. Sai became Neo China's Gundam Fighter to restore Shaolin.
He lost his father when he was a child and was raised by his guardians, Zuisen and Keiun.
His grandfather, Sai Feilong, won the fourth Gundam Fight.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Undefeated of the East
The Undefeated of the East is commonly known as Master Asia.
He is renowned as the winner of the twelfth Gundam Fight. With his elegant, invincible techniques, he built a legend of invincibility.
He is also the previous King of Hearts.

{x00}

Char's Gundam Mk-II

Char's Zeta Gundam
Like the Hyaku Shiki, this Zeta Gundam was developed at Axis using stolen AEUG technology.

Char's Hyaku Shiki
This Hyaku Shiki was developed at Axis using stolen AEUG technology.
It was made specifically for Char at Haman Karn's direction, so its body has a color best described as red-gold.

{x00}

rows.en:
Quattro's Zeta Gundam
AEUG adjusted this Zeta Gundam for Quattro.
It is painted gold to suit Quattro, who piloted the Hyaku Shiki.

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
GT Lost Number
Hakuto Rondo entrusted this machine to a close friend who was leaving the military.
That friend's son, Ryo, used it for work as a Multi Worker (MW), unaware that it was a Ground Trooper (GT).

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
Gunblaze AL
This machine was customized from Gunblaze A.
Its basic performance is almost unchanged from Gunblaze A, but its AI and various machine parts have been tuned.

{x00}

rows.en:
Imakarum
This is Redros Binzvanker's personal machine.
It has 26 types of outer armor around a central Ground Trooper (GT) frame.
It is rumored to have been deployed during the Third Claudian War. A machine of the same type is also said to have been destroyed during the civil war through the combined efforts of Kyo and Hakuto.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296833200000000}Huh? The Cloud Sea...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296843200000000}What's wrong, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296853200000000}Something about the Cloud Sea looks strange.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296863200000000}The Cloud Stream's concentration has increased.
It's exceeded the Astante's tolerance.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296873200000000}Exceeded its tolerance?
Does that mean we...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296883200000000}Yes. We can't leave
this continent anymore.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296893200000000}What do we do, big brother?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968A3200000000}It might be a natural phenomenon,
so there's nothing we can do.

{C:819582968B3200000000}We'll just have to wait
for the Cloud Stream's concentration to fall.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968C3200000000}Yeah...

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3200000000}Meanwhile, let's gather information on the Norstan
and learn about this continent.
We can't do anything else, anyway.

{C:81900300}{C:819582968E3200000000}You're right!
There's no point worrying about it.

{C:819582968F3200000000}That's my big brother!
You're so positive.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296913200000000}Flattery won't
get you anything, you know.




{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296B63200000000}All right! We're finally here!!
I'm going to have a good look around!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B73200000000}Wait a minute.
I'm coming with you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B83200000000}What is it, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B93200000000}Professor Rondo asked me to come, too.
I can't leave the scouting
to someone as carefree as you.

{C:81958296BA3200000000}That's why I'm coming.
Got it?


{C:81900300}{C:81958296BB3200000000}Hmph...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BC3200000000}What's wrong, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296BD3200000000}If Nelfea's going,
then I'm going too!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE3200000000}Oh, fine! Do whatever you want!

{C:81958296BF3200000000}(What on earth
 is Rie so angry about?)


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03200000000}Hey, Rie,
have you seen Nelfea?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C13200000000}I don't know.
Isn't she in the hangar?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C23200000000}No, she isn't.
I wanted to see her about something.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C33200000000}Do you want to check the ship's monitors?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C43200000000}Hmm, no.
I'll look for her myself.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296C53200000000}Claudia...
I can't see it anymore.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C63200000000}(Nelfea... Of course.
 She may act tough, but she's still a child.)

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C73200000000}Professor... I wonder how you're doing.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C83200000000}Are you lonely?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C93200000000}O-of course not!
What are you talking about?!

{C:81958296CA3200000000}Of course I'm worried.
Unc... the Professor isn't here.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CB3200000000}I know you can't rely on me
as much as Professor Rondo, but...

{C:81958296CC3200000000}I'll work hard too.
I'll get stronger, so you can count on me.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CD3200000000}Is something wrong with your head?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CE3200000000}That's harsh, Nelfea!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CF3200000000}Well, do your best.

{C:81958296D03200000000}(Thank you.)

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D13200000000}(That's right. Unless I get stronger,
 I won't be able to get Lun back.)

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296923200000000}How's the Cloud Stream
looking, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296933200000000}Hmm, right now... Oh.
The Cloud Stream's concentration is rising.

{C:81958296943200000000}...Just as I thought.
We can't get out again.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296953200000000}Then we'll have to
gather information again.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296963200000000}That's right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296973200000000}(I couldn't get a word in...)

{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296983200000000}It's the same here. The concentration is rising.
We can still get out now. What will you do?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296993200000000}We can carry on, can't we, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A3200000000}Yeah.
We have to enter
some continent or other, anyway.

{C:81900400}{C:819582969B3200000000}And we need information on the Norstan.

{C:81900300}{C:819582969C3200000000}Exactly.

{C:819582969D3200000000}With any luck,
we might find more people
willing to join us.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296D23200000000}Is that a blip on the radar?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D33200000000}Should we prepare for battle?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D43200000000}There's only one machine,
so I don't think we need to go that far.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D53200000000}Then I'll ask
my brother to go out.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296D63200000000}Big brother!
An unidentified flying object is approaching.
Go out in Impulse 7 and take a look.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D73200000000}Understood. I'll launch right away.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296D83200000000}Is that the machine that came from the Cloud Sea?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D93200000000}Yes, but...
It's obviously an FT, isn't it?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DA3200000000}Is there anything in the cockpit?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB3200000000}I'm looking right now, aren't I?
...Oh, here it is.
I'll put it on the monitor.


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:81958296DC3200000000}Good work on your mission to pursue the Norstan.
That's what Akatsuki
would probably say, but...

{C:81958296DD3200000000}Above all, I'm concerned
about your safety.

{C:81958296DE3200000000}So, to ease your burden even a little,
I've sent the newly developed 
{C:819782830400}ＦＴ－Ⅱ Cloud Saber{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296E03200000000}I'm sure you can handle it.
Protect Rie and Nelfea for me.
I'm counting on you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E13200000000}I know, Professor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E23200000000}Make sure you protect us, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E33200000000}Still, the Professor takes some crazy risks.
What was the plan
if we hadn't picked it up?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E43200000000}What are you talking about?!
Unc... the Professor would never
do something like that without being sure.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E63200000000}Then how did the Professor
know where we were?


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296E73200000000}Well, that's... mumble, mumble.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E83200000000}Ahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry.
I was only joking!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E93200000000}Oh!
Rie, you're so mean!!


{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.
No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582969E3200000000}Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:819582969F3200000000}Don't ask me.
Or do you want to hear
the same answer for the fourth time?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A23200000000}No, that's all right.



{x00}
rows.native_integration: No native approval added by this collection.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB3200000000}At last... the final continent.
Will this be the end of everything...?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EC3200000000}Are you scared?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296ED3200000000}I'm not afraid of fighting.

{C:81958296EE3200000000}(What scares me
 is not getting Lun back.)

{C:8190B801}{C:819582965E0100000000}If you can think that way, you'll be fine.
Right, Domon?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296EF3200000000}Yeah.
Besides, we're with you too.
Don't worry.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296F03200000000}But don't get overconfident.
Carelessness can bring unexpected danger.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296F13200000000}If we all stick together,
there's nothing to fear.
We're heroes, after all!

{C:81909302}{C:81958296F23200000000}That's right! With us,
the Ganba Team, here,
there's no way we'll lose!!

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296F33200000000}Now, now, everyone.
Do not let your guard down.
There's no telling what may happen.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296F43200000000}Like getting shot down out of nowhere.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296F53200000000}Oh, will you shut up?!
We'll find out when we get there!
Isn't that enough?!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F63200000000}Now, now,
please calm down, Leccee.

{C:81958296F73200000000}I know things will still
be difficult for everyone,
but please keep helping us.

{x00}
